sections.text: Ancestor Spirit is found in an isolated arena accessible from Siofra River. To access it, you must light all eight obelisks by the stairs to the Hallowhorn Grounds east of the Siofra River Bank Site of Grace. The pillars are: By the Siofra River Bank site of grace. Map Link In a corner to the west of the first pillar. Map Link On a small island in the watery area with the lightning wisps.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Cleanrot Knight Boss Guide
sections.text: Cleanrot Knight Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Cleanrot Knight: Don't just keep attacking over and over—once it uses Spear Guard, back off or it'll counter-attack. Use Fire Pots . It's very weak to fire and has low health to begin with, so a single pot will do a lot of damage even at low levels Long windups and attack animations leave it very vulnerable to backstabs Melee Users Baiting: Stay close and towards its left to tempt it into using Spear Stab, Impale, or Sacred Phalanx. sections.heading: Elden Ring Crucible Knight Ordovis Boss Guide
sections.text: Crucible Knight Ordovis Fight Strategy Melee Users Spearfishing: Focus on killing the Crucible Knight with the spear first, since it has the best reach and is best at covering distance and disrupting your attacks on the other one. Try to draw it away from Ordovis, and keep pillars between you and Ordovis when you're attacking the spear knight. Don't get greedy: if you get in more than a hit or two at a time, Ordovis will catch up to you and make you regret it.

sections.heading: Crucible Knight Ordovis Notes & Other Trivia
sections.text: Like his counterpart Siluria, Ordovis appears to have been named after an ancient Celtic tribe: the Ordovices, who lived in present-day Wales, and shared a border with the Silures. The ruins of an ancient Thracian fortress named Urdovisa (also Urdoviza) lie near the present-day town of Kiten in Bulgaria. May also be named after the Ordovician Period, a prehistoric epoch of life on Earth, much like the Crucible.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Fallingstar Beasts are creatures formed of shiny black rock. They have spiky tails, patches of white fur, and insect-like mandibles. They are found in craters, likely indicating that they plummeted onto the Lands Between from a great distance. The more mature Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast have greater magical abilities, able to control gravity in their vicinity and unleash great magical beams akin to Comet Azur. They can use Gravity-based abilities, much like other enemies associated with meteors and fallen stars such as Alabaster Lords, Onyx Lords, and Withered Astel.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Gideon Ofnir is the Tarnished leader of Roundtable Hold and the adoptive father of Nepheli Loux. Called to the Lands Between by the guidance of Grace, Gideon wishes to become Elden Lord. To this end he accumulates information on the Shardbearers, employing a network of spies to aid in his hunt for knowledge. Initially, he is apprehensive of the Tarnished, but after they have claimed a Great Rune he becomes willing to share his knowledge of the remaining shardbearers.

sections.text: Sir Gideon Ofnir, The All-Knowing Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Sir Gideon Ofnir, The All-Knowing: Use the Eternal Darkness spell to redirect nearly all his spells Use the Inescapable Frenzy spell to deal major damage during his monologue. sections.heading: Elden Ring Grafted Scion Boss Guide
sections.text: Grafted Scion Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Grafted Scion: Avoid guarding as much as possible, focus on rolling instead. Use quick to cast spells like Glintstone Pebble . Vagabound and Samurai classes are the best to kill him during 1st encounter due to their stance-breaking skills. Melee Strategy Bait: Keep your distance and try to get it to use Leaping Stab, Crawling Stabs or (later in the fight) Piercing Stabs. Dodge the attack, get in a couple hits, and then back off. Don't get greedy: it will often use Scream after being damaged, and you don't want to be nearby for that.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Guardian Golem Boss Guide
sections.text: Guardian Golem Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Guardian Golem: Stay just behind its legs. Most of its attacks aim forward or just in front of its feet. Melee Users Charge and Crit: Two charged heavy attacks from most weapons are enough to stagger Guardian Golem. Once it falls to the ground, you have a chance a chance for a critical hit on its chest which will do a massive amount of damage. It's slow enough that you should be able to get in a charged attack after each successful evasion, so stay close to its ankles and roll through its melee attacks.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Silver Tears are formless, arcane creatures of mimicry that can reshape and harden their liquid metal bodies at will, becoming weapons and even other living organisms. The Nox of the Eternal Cities sought to forge a Lord, and thus the Mimic Tear was born. It immediately assumes the form of the player as they enter the room, complete with their equipped weapons, armor, and spells. Its Stats and Attributes, such as HP, shall also reflect the player's.

sections.heading: Night's Cavalry Combat information
sections.text: Stance : 80 Stance damage reduction: 80% Stance cannot be broken while on horseback Is vulnerable to a critical hit after being stance broken or knocked out of horse The horse and rider have separate health bars, and only the rider needs to be killed to end the fight. Killing the horse causes the rider to fall to the ground and become vulnerable to a dismount critical . After some time, the rider will resummon the horse with its Remount attack. It's much more likely to remount quickly if you move far away from it, so stay close to maximize the amount of time it's in a weakened state.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Night's Cavalry Boss Guide
sections.text: Night's Cavalry Boss Video Guide Night's Cavalry Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Night's Cavalry: Use Lightning Spear to whittle down its health from afar Use Glintstone Arc to hit both the horse and its rider at once Use a weapon with long reach that deals Pierce Damage , such as a Spear or Halberd Knights met at Dragonbarrow and Forbidden Lands can be - with precise maneuvering - tricked into falling from the cliff. Melee Users Fighting on foot is recommended. They're fast enough to match your pace on Torrent, and the extra maneuverability and ability to dodge on foot will help a lot.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Onyx Lord Boss Guide
sections.text: Onyx Lord Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Onyx Lord: Fight him on the outer edges of the arena. Take advantage of his Meteorite's long cast animation. Melee Users Onyx Lord only has a few moves in his repertoire and it is relatively easy to discern his patterns. Consider fighting him on the outer edges of the arena as the center has uneven terrain which can cause his meteorites to impact with the ground near you, dealing splash damage. Onyx Lord has three main attack patterns: Meteorite, Slice and Dice, and Gravity Well. He will rarely diverge from these attacks.

sections.heading: Starscourge Radahn Notes & Trivia
sections.text: Upon release, Radahn's boss fight was substantially critized by fans, who took issue with his huge hitboxes, high damage, and the speed of his moveset; many deemed Radahn as an unfair boss. As a result Radahn was nerfed in Patch 1.03, with his hitboxes corrected but also lowering his damage. The nerf was partially reversed in Patch 1.03.03, with the damage restored but his hitboxes remaining corrected. His military rank is "General". According to the game files, his horse's name is Leonard.

sections.heading: Crucible Knight Siluria Notes & Other Trivia
sections.text: Siluria seems to have been named after the Silures, an ancient Celcic tribe that lived in present-day Wales. The Silures lived south of the Ordovices, which in turn may have inspired the name of Siluria's counterpart Ordovis . Her name also may reference the Silurian Period, a prehistoic epoch of life that occurred after the end of the Ordovician, much like the Crucible.

sections.text: Stonedigger Troll Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Stonedigger Troll: Use the Kaiden Sellsword Ashes for an easier fight or Spirit Jellyfish Ashes as a distraction. Continue northeast up two sets of stairs, then go through the first door on your right and continue north along the waterlogged passageway. Head northeast out to the balcony and up the stairs to the northwest.

build:azur.name: Comet Azur glass
build:azur.description: One-shot setups for dragons and late bosses if you can stand still. Terra Magicus + Graven-Mass + Magic Scorpion.

build:blackflame.name: Black Flame Godslayer
build:blackflame.description: Black Flame burns a percentage of max HP on hit, so it keeps pace with boss health pools where flat-AR incantations fall off. The real faith caster build that is not Blasphemous Blade.

build:blasphemous.name: Blasphemous Blade
build:blasphemous.description: Taker’s Flames heals on every wave. Facetanks most of base game. Falls off vs holy resist in SotE.

build:bloodfiends-arm.name: Bloodfiend's Arm
build:bloodfiends-arm.description: The Bloodfiend’s Arm builds Hemorrhage on a big arcane-scaled strike, so each opening both procs bleed and heals you back.

build:bolt-gransax.name: Bolt of Gransax sniper
build:bolt-gransax.description: Ancient Lightning Spear is a long-range nuke with a charged window, so Godfrey Icon and Shard of Alexander both apply. Pair it with a Lightning Nagakiba for the melee.

build:dark-moon.name: Dark Moon Greatsword
build:dark-moon.description: The Moonlight Greatsword beam on the charged heavy is ranged frost damage; Godfrey Icon, Magic Scorpion and Shard of Alexander all stack it. Frostbite then a heavy trade.

build:deaths-poker.name: Death's Poker frost
build:deaths-poker.description: Ghostflame Ignition leaves a patch that keeps ticking, and the charged R2 beam is a safe ranged punish on anything that respects frost.

build:eleonora.name: Eleonora's Poleblade
build:eleonora.description: Bloodblade Dance chains fast Hemorrhage on a dex-arcane twinblade, and the two Winged Insignia talismans ramp the damage as the combo lands.

build:frost-bleed.name: Frost-bleed twinblade
build:frost-bleed.location: Found inside one of the two chests at the Dragon-Burnt Ruins located in Limgrave. It will be in the basement room without the Rats, reached by jumping over a crumbled wall into an enclosure.

build:giant-crusher-jump.name: Giant-Crusher jump attack
build:giant-crusher-jump.description: A jump attack from a colossal greathammer does huge stance damage, and Claw plus Axe Talisman both reward the same jumping R2.

build:great-stars-crag.name: Great Stars Cragblade
build:great-stars-crag.description: Cragblade adds stamina damage against guards and poise damage in the open, which a heavy Great Stars turns into constant staggers.

build:greatshield-poke.name: Fingerprint poke
build:greatshield-poke.description: Block with the highest-stability greatshield in the game and poke with a thrusting sword. Safe, boring, and one of the strongest PvE setups there is. Antspur adds Scarlet Rot through the shield.

build:greatsword-lions-claw.name: Greatsword Lion’s Claw
build:greatsword-lions-claw.description: Lion’s Claw is unparryable, has hyper armour, and does real stance damage — on a colossal sword it breaks most bosses in two casts. Pure Strength, no casting stat tax.

build:heavy-bonk.name: Heavy Knight bonk
build:heavy-bonk.description: The pack’s Heavy Knight already has the poise. Giant-Crusher or Anvil Hammer, lion’s claw / cragblade.

build:helphens.name: Helphen's Steeple
build:helphens.description: Helphen’s Steeple buffs itself with ghostflame on the skill, so a strength-int spread gets frostbite pressure and a real melee threat on one weapon.

build:leontiel.name: Leontiel matador
build:leontiel.description: Pack invader weapon. Reach + stance. Pairs with Heavy Knight or a dex hybrid after Radahn.

build:marais.name: Marais Executioner's Sword
build:marais.description: Eochaid’s Dancing Blade spins the sword into a buzzsaw that scales off Arcane, so the arcane-bleed talisman stack lifts the whole skill.

build:meteoric-ore.name: Meteoric Ore arcane
build:meteoric-ore.description: The Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword scales off Arcane as well as Strength, so one spread feeds both the weapon and a bleed-heavy talisman set.

build:mimic-status.name: Mimic Tear bleed
build:mimic-status.description: The Mimic copies your bleed kit and doubles the Hemorrhage pressure, so the fight ends before either of you runs out of flasks.

build:moonveil.name: Moonveil Shinobi
build:moonveil.description: Transient Moonlight is a fast ranged slash that staggers at range. Powerstance with a Cold Uchigatana to stack Hemorrhage and Frostbite off the same L1 chain.

build:night-comet.name: Night Comet Sellia

build:night-comet.description: Enemies barely dodge it. Staff of Loss in offhand. Best “I hate lock-on” sorcery.

build:pest-threads-plus.name: Pest-Thread Spears faith
build:pest-threads-plus.description: Pest-Thread Spears hits many times through a big body, and the Dragon Communion Seal turns Arcane into incantation scaling on the same spread.

build:ripple-arc.name: Ripple arcane
build:ripple-arc.description: The Ripple Crescent Halberd scales purely on Arcane, so the whole stat line goes into bleed buildup and Lord of Blood’s Exultation uptime.

build:rivers.name: Rivers of Blood
build:rivers.description: Still deletes most of the Lands Between. Weak to high bleed resist (Malenia is the joke).

build:starscourge.name: Starscourge pull
build:starscourge.description: Starcaller Cry pulls a whole pack into one swing, so the Starscourge Greatsword clears groups and stance-breaks single targets at the same time.

build:sword-night-flame.name: Sword of Night and Flame
build:sword-night-flame.description: Night and Flame stance still gives a ranged magic beam and a close flame sweep, so one weapon covers both ranges without a second catalyst.

build:wing-of-astel.name: Wing of Astel
build:wing-of-astel.description: Nebula is a free ranged burst on a light curved sword, and the weapon still keeps normal dex scaling for the melee you actually land.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: **Malenia, Blade of Miquella**, later known as **Malenia, Goddess of Rot**, is an optional remembrance Boss in Elden Ring. She is a Demigod Shardbearer who is encountered in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

sections.heading: Combat Overview
sections.text: - HP: **33,251** (total) - Defense: **123** - Stance: **80** - She must be parried three times to trigger a stance break, enabling a Critical Hit. - Multiplayer is enabled - Spirit Ashes are enabled - She regains lost HP with every successful attack, even if they are blocked. - She gains +10 Fire negation (0 → 10) and -10 Lightning negation (20 → 10) while standing in water.

sections.heading: Drops
sections.text: - 480,000 runes - Malenia's Great Rune - Remembrance of the Rot Goddess

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Defeating this boss for the first time unlocks the Shardbearer Malenia achievement. - The "Demigod Slain" flyout is displayed upon defeating Malenia, Goddess of Rot. - Malenia has a prosthetic right arm, left leg, and right foot. These were added due to the infection of the scarlet rot. The rot has also visibly spread over her eyes, so she is presumably also blind. However, her disabilities do not handicap her battle prowess in the slightest. - According to the Scarlet Aeonia Incantation description, Malenia will become a true Goddess if her scarlet flower blooms three times.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: **Messmer the Impaler** (串刺し公、メスメル, *Kushizashi Kō, Mesumeru*), later known as **Base Serpent Messmer** (邪な蛇、メスメル, *Yokoshimana Hebi, Mesumeru*), is a mandatory remembrance boss in Shadow of the Erdtree.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Messmer is a Demigod who is encountered in the Shadow Keep. He is the source of Messmerfire and the Messmer's Flame incantations. Messmer is **not** an optional boss as he must be defeated in order to acquire Messmer's Kindling that would allow the burning of the Sealing Tree at the Church of the Bud.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Messmer was likely born earlier than the other Demigods. Exactly when he was born remains unknown, as all mention of him was erased by his mother after she abandoned him in the Land of Shadow. - He is older than Radahn, who was born before Miquella, Malenia, Trina, and Ranni. - Although not explicitly stated, Messmer is strongly implied to be an Empyrean child of Marika and Radagon, born of a single god. - Messmer has the red hair of Radagon and his children. - Messmer was cursed at birth by a threat to Marika's power.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: **Patches** is an NPC and boss in Elden Ring. He surrenders if you reduce his HP to 50% or less. From then on, he acts as a merchant and gives helpful advice to players.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Patches is a Tarnished who leads a group of bandits, operating out of Murkwater Cave in Limgrave. He is a nomadic and free-spirited individual with a proclivity for tricking people and robbing them of their possessions. If the Tarnished opens the treasure chest in Murkwater Cave, Patches accosts them with accusations of theft. After a brief fight, Patches surrenders and offers his services as a merchant. He reveals that the bandits he leads are former foot soldiers from a defeated army. Later, Patches moves to Liurnia of the Lakes, setting up camp on the Scenic Isle.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Patches is a reoccurring character in From Software's games, having appeared in *Armored Core: For Answer*, *Demon's Souls*, *Dark Souls*, *Bloodborne*, and *Dark Souls III*. Many of his recognisable traits, such as his physical appearance, use of a spear, and proclivity for tricking the player have been retained for his appearance in *Elden Ring*. - Patches can be summoned during the boss fight against Starscourge Radahn, however he will return to his world after a few seconds.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: **Grave Warden Duelists**, **Frenzied Duelists**, and **Putrid Grave Warden Duelists** are recurring enemies and bosses in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Duelists are muscular warriors lightly accoutered in bronze armor adorned with serpent effigies, which represent a traitor to the Erdtree. Whether armed with a Duelist Greataxe and iron ball or twin Battle Hammers, they are unrelenting fighters blessed with boundless stamina. During the time of Lord Godfrey, these champions honored the Erdtree by participating in gladiatorial combat at colosseums. Their excited spectators were delighted to see the serpents on their armor get battered and broken. However, the gladiators were banished when the colosseums closed during the age of Lord Radagon.

sections.text: Putrid Tree Spirit Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Putrid Tree Spirit: If possible, bring Scarlet Rot Talismans such as Kindred of Rot's Exultation which can increase attack power or Immunizing Horn Charm which raises Immunity Use Meteorite Spell to cause it to stagger Summon Black Knife Tiche Use Bloodhound's Step to help with the boss's quick movements Be ready upon entering the fog gates, as it approaches for an attack almost immediately. sections.text: From the War-Dead Catacombs Site of Grace, head down the stairs and straight ahead through the double doors once you've pulled the level to open them. Turn east at the corner, run through the next room, then turn south at the next corner. In this room, you'll see a knight sitting at the other end, but instead of running up to it, jump through the window to the west onto a ledge below.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: The **Dung Eater** is an character in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: A self-described "scourge upon the living," the loathesome Dung Eater is a Tarnished who revels in murder and defilement. He places the Seedbed Curse on his victims to sever their souls from the Erdtree and its grace, trapping them in eternal torment. The Dung Eater has the heart of an Omen without the body to match. He wears a malformed set of hefty red armor with tufts of red hair emerging from the bleeding stumps of its severed Omen horns. His helmet has no opening except for a deep gash over the right eye.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Roderika cautions the spiritual harm done by the Dung Eater's Seedbed Curse is worse than Godrick's grafting. - The Dung Eater possesses a fate. - During the intro cinematic, the Dung Eater is hung by an iron chain in a gallows, silhouetted against the bright Erdtree or sun. A faint golden Grace near his chest illuminates the sun medallion, visually linking it to the haloed backdrop. - He was confined to the same prison as nobleborn Omen beneath the streets of Leyndell. Like the Omen, his body also contains cursed spirits.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: The **Revenger** was an unseen character in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The nameless revenger was a champion who lived during the Age of the Erdtree, when Godfrey reigned as Elden Lord. After the golden armies of the Erdtree decimated his clan, he vowed vengeance and returned to Castle Morne. There, he collected the swords of his fallen kin and forged them into a single massive blade—the Grafted Blade Greatsword. He challenged Lord Godfrey during the Siege of Castle Morne, but was slain by Queen Marika's Grace-given champion.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - The revenger likely belonged to the Stormveil faction that once controlled Limgrave and the Weeping Peninsula. They may be the rebellion-starting laborer-turned-champion whose Brick Hammer is found at Stormveil Castle. They were said to have had the strength of a giant. - Serosh, Lord of Beasts appears on the Grafted Blade Greatsword's hilt. - Castellan Edgar, a Banished Knight in Godrick's service, refuses to abandon Castle Morne until the Grafted Blade Greatsword is reclaimed from the Leonine Misbegotten.

sections.text: **Millicent** is an NPC cooperator in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Millicent is a red-haired woman afflicted by Scarlet Rot. She and her sisters were found in the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid by Sage Gowry, who raised them as his daughters. Her four sisters travelled to Miquella's Haligtree under Gowry's guidance, however Millicent alone remained behind. At Gowry's behest, the Tarnished obtains an Unalloyed Gold Needle and brings it to the Church of the Plague, where Millicent is slowly succumbing to the Rot. She inserts the needle to stall the Rot, regaining her strength.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Millicent's questline can still be started even after defeating Malenia. - The Valkyrie's Prosthesis links Millicent and Malenia through the symbolic loss of the right arm. Statues of Malenia at Haligtree Town depict her in her youth without a right arm. None of Millicent's Sisters meet this criteria.

invader:millicents-sisters.name: Millicent's Sisters

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: **Millicent's sisters** are adopted daughters of Sage Gowry and siblings of Millicent. These red haired girls once sprouted as buds from the Scarlet Aeonia found within the heart of Caelid. They all wear the Traveler's Set and use weapons and skills associated with either aspects of their inadvertent mother Malenia, both her role as the unalloyed blade of Miquella and her looming transformation into the goddess of rot. They all seek to aid their adoptive father in cultivating Millicent into a Scarlet Valkyrie. __TOC__

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: All sisters can be found in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree towards the end of Millicent's questline. To reach them the player needs to: - 1. Retrieve the snapped Unalloyed Gold Needle by defeating Commander O'Neil in the Heart of Aeonia. - Optional: Polyanna, Adopted Daughter can be summoned as a cooperator to assist in this fight. - 2. Give the snapped needle to Sage Gowry at Gowry's Shack so that he may repair it. - 3. Reload the area by either: - A. Resting at/teleporting to a Site of Grace - B. Exit to the Main Menu and then enter back into the game. - 4.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Maureen's Treespear is unique and impossible to replicate by the player as it has Charge Forth. Instead the version the player has access to cannot be infused with Ashes of War and it has Sacred Order as it's default skill.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: **Preceptor Miriam** is a hostile character in Elden Ring. Miriam can be fought twice in the Carian Study Hall, once before placing the Carian Inverted Statue and once after.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Preceptor Miriam, as indicated by the name, is a teacher of sorcery at the Carian Study Hall. She served the Carian royals in the past and now guards the hall from intruders.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - She rather predictably wears the Preceptor Set, using the standard chest and head pieces. - Wields an Academy Glintstone Staff which she uses to cast Carian Slicer, Greatblade Phalanx, Loretta's Greatbow, and Magic Downpour, of which the Greatbow spell is usually the most used. - Can teleport to the next spot in her area upon taking sufficient damage, though she may skip over a spot in the Standard Study Hall if enough damage is taken at one spot. This cannot happen in the Inverted Study Hall unless killed in the first spot, as she only has two spots there.

sections.heading: Drops
sections.text: - Lucidity (only in the inverted version of the Carian Study Hall) - Magic Downpour (only in the normal version of the Carian Study Hall)

sections.heading: Elden Ring Sanguine Noble Boss Guide
sections.text: Sanguine Noble Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Sanguine Noble: Bring Stanching Boluses Item Melee Users For melee users, be wary as the Sanguine Noble's swings are very fast, so it's recommended that you use a fast one-hand weapon like a straight sword or an axe. Every single type of attack this boss does stacks bleed so it's best that you bring Stanching Boluses . Do not rush this boss and be careful with its string of stabs and slashes. sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: **Vargram the Raging Wolf** is an NPC in *Elden Ring*.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Vargram was one of the first Tarnished to visit Roundtable Hold. He earned his nickname from the white wolf pelt that adorns his helm. Vargram aspired to attain the status of a wolf, based on the old legend that wolves are shadows of the Empyreans. Vargram was a friend of Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm, however guidance led the two into confrontation with one another, and Wilhelm was taken prisoner in Roundtable Hold. The Tarnished encounters Vargram and Wilhelm together in the Fortified Manor in Leyndell, Royal Capital, during a joint mission with Knight Bernahl on behalf of the Volcano Manor.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: **White Mask Varré** (白面のヴァレー) is an NPC in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Varré is an enigmatic man who dresses as a war surgeon. War Surgeons, despite their name, are not surgeons or doctors. They act as mercy killers on battlefields, putting dying soldiers out of their misery as quickly as possible by delivering final blows. Varré was a war surgeon prior to his association with Mohg. Varré was abducted by Mohg against his will along with various other war surgeons, however it was noted that Varré was particularly talented with blood incantations, and that of all the war surgeons abducted he was the only one able to "tame" Mohg's cursed blood.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Limgrave (The First Step) Just past the Site of Grace. Will leave a message in his spot after talking with Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold. - Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake) At the entrance of the Rose Church, to the west of the Site of Grace. - Mohgwyn Palace (Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance) His invasion sign is located in the hallway before the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint Site of Grace. After defeating him, Varré will be found laying on the floor close to where the sign previously was.

The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear. At the end that should not be.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:all-knowing-helm.location:
**Location**: Leyndell, Ashen Capital
- All-Knowing Helm is dropped by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing upon his defeat at the Erdtree Sanctuary.

item:altus-bloom.name: Altus Bloom
item:altus-bloom.description: A golden-tingerd flower from a succulent plant that blooms on the Altus Plateau. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:altus-bloom.location:
- Grows in the Altus Plateau.
- 8% chance for 5 Altus Blooms to drop from Perfumers.
- 15% chance for 5 Altus Blooms to drop from Depraved Perfumers.

item:ambush-shard.name: Ambush Shard
item:ambush-shard.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Launches a projectile from a distance removed from the caster, so as to strike the enemy from behind. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. The Sellian sorcerers were assassins, and it is said that they often hunted their fellows.
item:ambush-shard.location:
**Loot:** Weeping Peninsula
- Acquired from a corpse next to the imprisoned Sellen in the cellar of Witchbane Ruins.

stats.Effect: Strikes from behind with projectile fired from distance

item:ancestral-follower-ashes.name: Ancestral Follower Ashes
item:ancestral-follower-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of an ancestral follower.

stats.Effect: Summons ancestral follower spirit

item:ancestral-infant-s-head.name: Ancestral Infant's Head
item:ancestral-infant-s-head.description: Skull of a very young ancestral spirit. Just think how many sproutings It might bear.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to spray spirit vapor

item:ancestral-infant-s-head.location: Ancestral Infant's Head is looted from a chest in a ruin north of Hallowhorn Grounds (North).

item:ancestral-spirit-s-horn.name: Ancestral Spirit's Horn
item:ancestral-spirit-s-horn.description: Item cut from the horns of the Regal Ancestor Spirit.

stats.Effect: Restores FP upon defeating enemies

item:ancestral-spirit-s-horn.location:
Trade the Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor, gained by defeating Regal Ancestor Spirit, with Finger Reader Enia.

Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

item:ancient-death-rancor.name: Ancient Death Rancor
item:ancient-death-rancor.description: Sorcery of the servants of Death.
item:ancient-death-rancor.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Acquired from defeating the Death Rite Bird that roams the sunken ruins south of the Gate Town North Site of Grace.

stats.Effect: Summons horde of vengeful spirits that chase down foes

item:ancient-dragon-apostle-s-cookbook-1.name: Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [1]
item:ancient-dragon-apostle-s-cookbook-1.description: A record of crafting techniques taught by the capital's ancient dragon cult. Details techniques that harness lightning, the weapon of the ancient dragons.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:ancient-dragon-apostle-s-cookbook-1.location: Found on a corpse in Wyndham Catacombs.

item:ancient-dragon-apostle-s-cookbook-2.name: Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [2]
item:ancient-dragon-apostle-s-cookbook-2.description: A record of crafting techniques taught by the capital's ancient dragon cult. Details techniques that harness lightning, the weapon of the ancient dragons. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: -Lightning Pots -Roped Lightning Pots

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:ancient-dragon-apostle-s-cookbook-3.name: Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [3]
item:ancient-dragon-apostle-s-cookbook-3.description: A record of crafting techniques taught by the capital's ancient dragon cult. Details techniques that harness lightning, the weapon of the ancient dragons.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:ancient-dragon-apostle-s-cookbook-3.location: Found in the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid.

item:ancient-dragon-apostle-s-cookbook-4.name: Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [4]
item:ancient-dragon-apostle-s-cookbook-4.description: A record of crafting techniques taught by the capital's ancient dragon cult. Details techniques that harness lightning, the weapon of the ancient dragons. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Ancient Dragonbolt Pot - Lightningproof Dried Liver

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:ancient-dragon-apostle-s-cookbook-4.location: Found in Crumbling Farum Azula, in a collapsing cylindrical building that can be accessed by crossing some floating ruins near the Dragon Temple Lift Site of Grace, near Alexander, Warrior Jar's location.

item:ancient-dragon-knight-kristoff-ashe.name: Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff Ashes
item:ancient-dragon-knight-kristoff-ashe.description: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Kristoff, the Ancient Dragon Knight. Spirit of Kristoff, an honorable knight of Leyndell who was also a devout worshipper of the ancient dragons. His skills strike down foes with thunderbolts, the dragons' weapon of choice. After the First Defense of Leyndell, Kristoff earned the hero's honor of Erdtree Burial for the feat of capturing Godefroy the Grafted.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff

item:ancient-dragon-knight-kristoff-ashe.location: Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor in Sainted Hero's Grave.

item:ancient-dragon-smithing-stone.name: Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
item:ancient-dragon-smithing-stone.description: Smithing stone made polishing a golden Gravel Stone. A scale of the Ancient Dragonlord, and hidden treasure of Farum Azula

stats.Effect: Reinforce armamanets to +25

item:ancient-dragons-lightning-spear.name: Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear
item:ancient-dragons-lightning-spear.description: A secret incantation of the capital's ancient dragon cult.
item:ancient-dragons-lightning-spear.location: **Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants - Sold for 8,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Ancient Dragon Prayerbook. - Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Stabs with red lightning spear from above

item:ancient-dragons-lightning-strike.name: Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike
item:ancient-dragons-lightning-strike.description: A secret incantation of the capital's ancient dragon cult.
item:ancient-dragons-lightning-strike.location: **Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants - Sold for 10,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Ancient Dragon Prayerbook. - Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Summons red lightning that spreads from impact

item:ancient-meteoric-ore-greatsword.name: Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Arc D

item:ancient-meteoric-ore-greatsword.location: SotE greatsword found in the Realm of Shadow.

item:ansbach-s-longbow.name: Ansbach's Longbow
item:ansbach-s-longbow.location:
- Complete the invasion event involving Needle Knight Leda and Sir Ansbach inside the Shadow Keep on the lower floors of the Specimen Storehouse by siding with either Leda or Ansbach.
- It can also be acquired at any moment by killing him outside the event.

item:ant-s-skull-plate.name: Ant's Skull Plate
item:ant-s-skull-plate.description: Huge head of one of the giant ants which inhabit the two underground rivers, used without modification as a shield. Excels at repeling enemy attacks. Giant ants are venomous creatures, granting a boost to immunity when wielding the shield.
item:ant-s-skull-plate.location:
Nokstella, Eternal City
- Can be found in a chest in a small room found just up the stairs from the city's main Site of Grace.

item:antspur-rapier.name: Antspur Rapier
item:antspur-rapier.description: Spur of a giant ant which has been fashioned into a rapier. The blade drips with scarlet rot.  Scarlet rot is an old legend, of which Maleigh Marais of the Shaded Castle was a private believer. And indeed, he eventually found his own personal goddess.
item:antspur-rapier.location: The Antspur Rapier is dropped by Maleigh Marais (Shaded Castle Castellan), a hostile NPC found in the rocky fields west of The Shaded Castle.

item:anvil-hammer.name: Anvil Hammer

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Int E · Fai D

item:anvil-hammer.location: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past — Tarnished Pack / SotE forge puzzle.

item:arbalest.name: Arbalest
item:arbalest.description: Large crossbow made from composite materials. One of the largest of all bolt.firing devices. Its limbs are more pliable than metallic ones, allowing bolts fired from this weapon to pierce even forged of steel.
item:arbalest.location: The Arbalest is located in Stormveil Castle (Limgrave).

item:archer-ashes.name: Archer Ashes
item:archer-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon three archer spirits.

stats.Effect: Summons three archer spirits

item:archer-ashes.location: Found in Nokstella, Eternal City, behind a building.

item:aristocrat-boots.name: Aristocrat Boots
item:aristocrat-boots.description: Boots made from tanned leather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Abandoning their birthplace after the shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:aristocrat-boots.location: Chance to drop from Wandering Noble enemies that wear it. The Sorcerer variant and the variant that carries the torch or the Noble's Slender Sword all wear them.

item:aristocrat-coat.name: Aristocrat Coat
item:aristocrat-coat.description: Tanned leather coat adorned with fine gold embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital, and the belonging of a family which claims a knight as an ancestor. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 8 · Slash 8 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 10 · Holy 8

item:aristocrat-coat.location: Chance to drop from Wandering Noble enemies that wear it. There are two immediately north of the Mistwood Ouksirts Sites of Grace, following a torch bearer.

item:aristocrat-garb.name: Aristocrat Garb
item:aristocrat-garb.description: High quality garb adorned with fine golden embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Terribly faded and tattered. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 8 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 7 · Holy 6

item:aristocrat-garb.location: Chance to drop from Wandering Nobles that wear it, such as the Sorcerer type. Two Sorcerer Wandering Nobles can be found to the east and north of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace.

item:aristocrat-garb-altered.name: Aristocrat Garb (altered)
item:aristocrat-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the Aristocrat Garb.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 8 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 7 · Holy 6

item:aristocrat-garb-altered.location: Chance to drop from the Wandering Noble enemies that wear it.

item:aristocrat-hat.name: Aristocrat Hat
item:aristocrat-hat.description: Leather hat decorated with a withered feather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital, and the belonging of a family which claims a knight as an ancestor.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:aristocrat-hat.location: - The Aristocrat Hat has a 1.50% chance to drop from Wandering Nobles that wear it. Two can be found following a torch bearer immediately north of the  Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace in east Limgrave.

item:aristocrat-headband.name: Aristocrat Headband

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 1 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:aristocrat-headband.location: Chance to drop from the Noble Sorcerers that wear it. Two can be found in the vicinity of the  Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. One to the east up the hill and one along the road to the north. Allowing the Kaiden Sellsword to pass while heading to both groups will allow the Tarnished to kill them uncontested.

item:armorer-s-cookbook-1.name: Armorer's Cookbook [1]
item:armorer-s-cookbook-1.description: Record of crafting techniques left by an armorer who served the great general Radahn. Contains knowledge of dealing with decay; the application of fire in particular.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:armorer-s-cookbook-1.location: - Found at the center of a small camp of Kaiden Sellswords south-southwest of the Murkwater Coast Site of Grace, northeast of the Agheel Lake North Site of Grace.

item:armorer-s-cookbook-2.name: Armorer's Cookbook [2]
item:armorer-s-cookbook-2.description: Record of crafting techniques left by an armorer who served the great general Radahn. Contains knowledge of dealing with decay; the application of fire in particular.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:armorer-s-cookbook-2.location: Sold by Nomadic Merchant (Western Limgrave) south-east of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.

item:armorer-s-cookbook-3.name: Armorer's Cookbook [3]
item:armorer-s-cookbook-3.description: A record of crafting techniques left by an armorer who served the great general Radahn. Contains knowledge of dealing with rot; the application of fire in particular.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:armorer-s-cookbook-3.location: Sold by Nomadic Merchant (Eastern Limgrave) north-west of Fort Haight.

item:armorer-s-cookbook-4.name: Armorer's Cookbook [4]
item:armorer-s-cookbook-4.description: A record of crafting techniques left by an armorer who served the great general Radahn. Contains knowledge of dealing with rot; the application of fire in particular.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:armorer-s-cookbook-4.location: Found in Redmane Castle, in the gatehouse on the western side of the dungeon.

item:armorer-s-cookbook-5.name: Armorer's Cookbook [5]
item:armorer-s-cookbook-5.description: A record of crafting techniques left by an armorer who served the great general Radahn. Contains knowledge of dealing with rot; the application of fire in particular. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Immunizing Cured Meat - Immunizing White Cured Meat

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:armorer-s-cookbook-5.location: Found in Redmane Castle, in a room on the southern side of the castle.

item:armorer-s-cookbook-6.name: Armorer's Cookbook [6]
item:armorer-s-cookbook-6.description: A record of crafting techniques left by an armorer who served the great general Radahn.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:armorer-s-cookbook-6.location:
**Location**: Siofra River
- The Armorer's Cookbook [6] is on a corpse located in the lower Worshippers' Woods section of the Siofra River, near the southern Hallowhorn Grounds. After descending the second elevator, keep left. There are two spectral Ancestral Follower Warriors on a cliff, just before one of the Ancient Dynasty obelisks that must be lit. The cookbook is looted from a corpse near one of the horned folk.

item:armorer-s-cookbook-7.name: Armorer's Cookbook [7]
item:armorer-s-cookbook-7.description: A record of crafting techniques left by an armorer who served the great general Radahn.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:armorer-s-cookbook-7.location: Found in Fort Laiedd on Mt. Gelmir, inside the door past the Fire Prelate.

item:arrow-s-reach-talisman.name: Arrow's Reach Talisman
item:arrow-s-reach-talisman.description: A talisman depicting three arrows. Carried by hunters of beasts.

stats.Effect: Increases bow effective range.

item:arrow-s-reach-talisman.location: - Found in a chest along the bridge over Stormgate's entrance. To access it, go to the southwest tower, kill the guards here, and then you can enter the area.

item:arrow-s-sting-talisman.name: Arrow's Sting Talisman
item:arrow-s-sting-talisman.description: A talisman depicting three iron arrows. Carried by soldiers long ago.

stats.Effect: Raises attack power of arrows and bolts

item:arrow-s-sting-talisman.location: - Obtained from a chest, atop the wooden siege tower, next to Impassable Greatbridge, in Caelid, near Redmane Castle.

item:arsenal-charm.name: Arsenal Charm
item:arsenal-charm.description: An iron charm that resembles a mass of weaponry. Boosts maximum equipment load. This talisman was derived from an unusual greatsword, once wielded by a hero hungry for vengeance.

stats.Effect: Raises maximum equipment load

item:arsenal-charm.location:
**Quest Item:** Roundtable Hold
- Received from Nepheli Loux in Roundtable Hold, after talking to her at Stormveil Castle and defeating Godrick the Grafted.

item:arteria-leaf.name: Arteria Leaf
item:arteria-leaf.description: Dark red leaves with thick, swollen veins. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. A faint pulse can be felt in the veins. Stirs the blood, providing an enlivening effect.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:arteria-leaf.location:
- Arteria Leaves do not respawn after being harvested.
- It grows rarely in various locations across the Lands Between.

item:ash-of-war-bloodhound-s-step.name: Ash of War: Bloodhound’s Step
item:ash-of-war-bloodhound-s-step.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Bloodhound's Step: Skill that allows the user to become temporarily invisible while dodging at high speed. Moves faster and travels farther than a regular quickstep. This skill can be used to circle around lock-on targets."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:ash-of-war-bloodhound-s-step.location: Night scarab on the Caelid cliff by Lenne’s Rise.

item:ash-of-war-cragblade.name: Cragblade
item:ash-of-war-cragblade.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Cragblade: Skill that manipulates gravity. Bury the armament in the ground, pulling rocks from the earth to reinforce it. Increases attack power and makes it easier to break enemy stance."Usable on melee armaments (whips excepted).
item:ash-of-war-cragblade.location: Teardrop scarab on the Caelid / Limgrave border near the tunnel.

item:ash-of-war-lion-s-claw.name: Ash of War: Lion's Claw
item:ash-of-war-lion-s-claw.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Lion's Claw: Skill of the Redmanes, who fought alongside General Radahn. Somersault forwards, striking foes with armament."Usable on swords, axes, and hammers (small armaments and thrusting swords excepted).
item:ash-of-war-lion-s-claw.location: Scarab behind Fort Gael in Caelid.

item:ash-of-war-scarab.name: Ash-of-war Scarab
item:ash-of-war-scarab.description: Gray scarab worn directly on the head.

stats.Negation: Physical -5 · Strike -5 · Slash -5 · Pierce -5 · Magic -4 · Fire -4 · Light -4 · Holy -5

item:ash-of-war-scarab.location:
**Location**: Stormveil Castle
- The Ash-of-War Scarab is found on a corpse at the edge of the broken bridge behind a Sending Gate.

item:aspect-of-the-crucible-breath.name: Aspect Of The Crucible: Breath
item:aspect-of-the-crucible-breath.description: One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.

stats.Effect: Creates throat pouch to spew fire while walking

item:aspects-of-the-crucible-bloom.name: Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom
item:aspects-of-the-crucible-bloom.location: Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom is found in the upper sections of the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East site of grace, head across the bridge just to the west, then drop down to a slightly lower bridge section at the end.

item:aspects-of-the-crucible-breath.name: Aspects of the Crucible: Breath
item:aspects-of-the-crucible-breath.location: Aspects of the Crucible: Breath is acquired upon defeating Tanith's Knight, which can be fought after killing Tanith in Rykard's arena in the Volcano Manor, at the end of her questline.

item:aspects-of-the-crucible-horns.name: Aspects Of The Crucible: Horns
item:aspects-of-the-crucible-horns.description: One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.
item:aspects-of-the-crucible-horns.location: Aspects of the Crucible: Horns is acquired by defeating the Crucible Knight in Stormveil Castle, down the outer western rampart. From the Rampart Tower Site of Grace, head north to the walkway with the Warhawks, and drop down to the left at the guard tower. Continue dropping down until you reach a breakable cliff and fall through it to arrive on a cliffside with the Crucible Knight.

stats.Effect: creates shoulder horn to gore foes from a low stance.

item:aspects-of-the-crucible-tail.name: Aspects Of The Crucible: Tail
item:aspects-of-the-crucible-tail.description: One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.
item:aspects-of-the-crucible-tail.location: Aspects of the Crucible: Tail is acquired by defeating the Crucible Knight trapped in the Stormhill Evergaol, located in Stormhill.

stats.Effect: Creates supple tail to sweep area before caster

item:aspects-of-the-crucible-thorns.name: Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns
item:aspects-of-the-crucible-thorns.location: Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns is acquired by defeating the Golden Hippopotamus boss found just inside the main gate of Shadow Keep on Scadu Altus.

item:assassin-s-approach.name: Assassin's Approach
item:assassin-s-approach.location: **Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants - Starting spell for the Confessor origin. - Sold for 2,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Assassin's Prayerbook. - Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

item:assassin-s-cerulean-dagger.name: Assassin's Cerulean Dagger
item:assassin-s-cerulean-dagger.description: An assassin's dagger, misshapen and stained in cerulean. Critical hits restore FP.

stats.Effect: Critical hits restore FP

item:assassin-s-cerulean-dagger.location: - Obtained from defeating the Black Knife Assassin in Black Knife Catacombs in northeast Liurnia of the Lakes

item:assassin-s-crimson-dagger.name: Assassin's Crimson Dagger
item:assassin-s-crimson-dagger.description: An assassin's dagger, misshapen and stained in crimson. Critical hits restore HP.

stats.Effect: Critical hits restore HP

item:assassin-s-crimson-dagger.location: - Obtained by defeating the Black Knife Assassin in Deathtouched Catacombs, in northern Limgrave

item:assassin-s-gambit.name: Assassin's Gambit
item:assassin-s-gambit.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:"Assassin's Gambit: Skill that masks the user's presence at the cost of a self-inflicted wound. Grants near-invisibility and silences footsteps."Usable on small and medium straight swords and thrusting swords.
item:assassin-s-gambit.location:
**Purchase:** Volcano Manor
- 1x Sold for 6,500 Runes by Recusant Bernahl in the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:astrologer-gloves.name: Astrologer Gloves
item:astrologer-gloves.description: Gloves fashioned from fine, supple cloth. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:astrologer-gloves.location:
- The Astrologer Gloves are the starting armwear of the Astrologer Origin.
- The Astrologer Gloves can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore) for  1,000 runes.

item:astrologer-hood.name: Astrologer Hood
item:astrologer-hood.description: Hood fashioned from supple cloth. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:astrologer-hood.location:
- Starting equipment for the Astrologer origin.
- Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore) for  1,000 runes.

item:astrologer-robe.name: Astrologer Robe
item:astrologer-robe.description: Robe fashioned from supple cloth. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:astrologer-robe.location:
Starting gear for the Astrologer class.

Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore).

item:astrologer-robe-altered.name: Astrologer Robe (altered)
item:astrologer-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Astrologer Robe

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 13 · Holy 12

item:astrologer-robe-altered.location:
Starting gear for the Astrologer class (unaltered).

Purchased unaltered from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore).

Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

item:astrologer-s-staff.name: Astrologer's Staff
item:astrologer-s-staff.description: Staff of the astrologers. A glintsone is embedded in the tip, enabling it to be used as a catalyst for sorceries.  Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.
item:astrologer-s-staff.location: The Astrologer's Staff in Elden Ring can be obtained by starting as the Astrologer Class or buying it from the Nomadic Merchant at South Liurnia Lake Shore for 800 runes.

item:astrologer-trousers.name: Astrologer Trousers
item:astrologer-trousers.description: Trousers worn inside a robe. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:astrologer-trousers.location:
Starting gear for the Astrologer class.

Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore).

item:avionette-soldier-ashes.name: Avionette Soldier Ashes
item:avionette-soldier-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two avionette soldiers. Spirits of marionette soldiers with avian features that were created to serve a sorcerer. Equipped with long-hafted scythes, they also attack from the skies by lobbing fire pots. Can sometimes malfunction when damaged.

stats.Effect: Summon the spirits of two avionette soldiers

item:avionette-soldier-ashes.location: Found at the bottom of the waterwheel near the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace in the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

item:axe-of-godfrey.name: Axe Of Godfrey
item:axe-of-godfrey.description: Weapon of Godfrey, Elden Lord. It was broken in a battle fought as leader of the Tarnished during the Long March. This weapon is symbolic of Godfrey's vow to conduct himself as a lord, later becoming an emblem of the golden lineage. In the days of the past, a crown was warranted with strength.
item:axe-of-godfrey.location: Remembrance of Hoarah Loux (Godfrey, First Elden Lord)

item:axe-of-godrick.name: Axe Of Godrick
item:axe-of-godrick.description: Greataxe wielded by Godrick the Grafted. This golden battleaxe is emblazoned with the figure of a beast, representing the strength of Godfrey, First Elden Lord and patriarch of the golden lineage. "I command thee kneel! For I am the lord of all that is golden!"
item:axe-of-godrick.location: Remembrance of the Grafted (Godrick the Grafted)

item:axe-talisman.name: Axe Talisman
item:axe-talisman.description: A talisman depicting an axe and a warrior. Enhances charge attacks.

stats.Effect: Enhances charge attacks.

item:axe-talisman.location: Cellar beneath the Mistwood Ruins in eastern Limgrave.

item:azula-beastman-ashes.name: Azula Beastman Ashes
item:azula-beastman-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two Azula beastmen. Spirits of beastmen from doomed Farum Azula, the slowly crumbling ruins in the skies. These ruins are said to be the remains of a giant mausoleum enshrining an ancient dragon, guarded by chosen beastmen who wield weapons clad in lightning.

stats.Effect: Summons two Azula beastman spirits

item:azula-beastman-ashes.location: Found in a room guarded by a Banished Knight, with another Banished Knight patrolling nearby, in the Dragon Temple before the Godskin Duo.

item:azur-s-glintstone-crown.name: Azur's Glintstone Crown
item:azur-s-glintstone-crown.description: Crown of Azur, primeval current sorcerer, set with a prominent blue-green glintstone.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 5 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:azur-s-glintstone-crown.location:
**Location**: Primeval Sorcerer Azur
- Azur's Glintstone Crown is obtained upon completing Sorceress Sellen's questline, then returning to the spot where Azur was found on Mt. Gelmir to loot Azur's Set.

item:azur-s-glintstone-robe.name: Azur's Glintstone Robe
item:azur-s-glintstone-robe.description: A robe reserved for grant masters at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Corroded by blue-green glintstones.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 15 · Fire 12 · Light 13 · Holy 13

item:azur-s-glintstone-robe.location: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Azur on Mt. Gelmir to loot the Azur armor set.

item:azur-s-glintstone-staff.name: Azur's Glintstone Staff
item:azur-s-glintstone-staff.description: Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Azur. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it. Reduces casting time of all sorceries, but consumes additional FP.
item:azur-s-glintstone-staff.location: Azur's Glintstone Staff is located on the second floor of the Church of the Cuckoo in Raya Lucaria Academy, Liurnia.

item:azur-s-manchettes.name: Azur's Manchettes
item:azur-s-manchettes.description: Manchettes corroded by blue-green glintstones. Worn by Azur, primeval current sorcerer.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:azur-s-manchettes.location: - Azur's Manchettes are obtained by completing Sorceress Sellen's questline, then returning to the location of Primeval Sorcerer Azur on Mt. Gelmir to loot the Azur's Set.

item:backhand-blade.name: Backhand Blade
item:backhand-blade.location: This weapon can be found beside a coffin, in the Inquisitor enemies' area of Gravesite Plain, northeast from the  Scorched Ruins site of grace.

item:baldachin-s-blessing.name: Baldachin's Blessing
item:baldachin-s-blessing.description: Favor bestowed by a deathbed companion. Protection of a hidden

stats.Effect: Uses FP to temporarilty boost poise

item:bandit-boots.name: Bandit Boots

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:bandit-boots.location:
Starting gear for the Bandit class.
Purchased from Gatekeeper Gostoc.

item:bandit-garb.name: Bandit Garb

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 8 · Slash 9 · Pierce 9 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 10 · Holy 9

item:bandit-garb.location:
Starting gear for the Bandit class.

Purchased from Gatekeeper Gostoc.

item:bandit-manchettes.name: Bandit Manchettes
item:bandit-manchettes.description: Manchettes made by simple wrapping dirty cloth around the arms. Worn by bandits.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 1 · Fire 1 · Lightning 2 · Holy 1

item:bandit-manchettes.location:
- The Bandit Manchettes are the starting armwear of the Bandit Origin.
- The Bandit Manchettes can be purchased from Gatekeeper Gostoc for  1,000 runes.

item:bandit-mask.name: Bandit Mask
item:bandit-mask.description: Mask of black cloth that covers the mouth. Favored by bandits for hiding their faces, it also provides some protection against poison.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:bandit-mask.location:
- Starting equipment for the Bandit class.
- Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Northern Limgrave) for  1,500 runes.

item:bandit-s-curved-sword.name: Bandit's Curved Sword
item:bandit-s-curved-sword.location: To get the Bandit's Curved Sword, you will need to farm it from Skeletal Bandits, as it is a random drop (has a low drop rate).

item:banished-knight-armor.name: Banished Knight Armor
item:banished-knight-armor.description: Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This armor was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

stats.Negation: Physical 17 · Strike 16 · Slash 18 · Pierce 18 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:banished-knight-armor.location: - 3.0% chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it, such as the one accompanied by two wolves in Castle Sol.

item:banished-knight-armor-altered.name: Banished Knight Armor (altered)
item:banished-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Banished Knight Armor.

stats.Negation: Physical 18 · Strike 14 · Slash 18 · Pierce 17 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:banished-knight-armor-altered.location:
- 3.00% chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it.
- Cannot be obtained by altering Banished Knight Armor.

item:banished-knight-engvall-ashes.name: Banished Knight Engvall Ashes
item:banished-knight-engvall-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Engvall, the Banished Knight. One of the two knights dubbed the Wings of the Storm. Despite his banishment, he rejected the invitation of the Grace-Given Lord, instead keeping watch over a masterless castle for many years, gaining renown as a hero of the fringes.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Banished Knight Engvall

item:banished-knight-engvall-ashes.location: - Dropped by Grave Warden Duelist in Murkwater Catacombs.

item:banished-knight-gauntlets.name: Banished Knight Gauntlets
item:banished-knight-gauntlets.description: Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. These gauntlets were worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:banished-knight-gauntlets.location: - The Banished Knight Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies.

item:banished-knight-greaves.name: Banished Knight Greaves
item:banished-knight-greaves.description: Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. These greaves were worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 8 · Slash 11 · Pierce 10 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:banished-knight-greaves.location: - 3.00% chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies.

item:banished-knight-helm.name: Banished Knight Helm
item:banished-knight-helm.description: Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This helm was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:banished-knight-helm.location:
- The Banished Knight Helm has a **3.00%** chance to drop from Banished Communion Knights that wear it, such as the one near the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid.
- Cannot be obtained by altering Banished Knight Helm (Altered).

item:banished-knight-helm-altered.name: Banished Knight Helm (altered)
item:banished-knight-helm-altered.description: Lighter version of the Banished Knight Helm

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 5 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:banished-knight-helm-altered.location:
- The Banished Knight Helm (Altered) has a **3.00%** chance to drop from Banished Knights that wear it.
- Cannot be obtained by altering a Banished Knight Helm.

item:banished-knight-oleg.name: Banished Knight Oleg
item:banished-knight-oleg.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Oleg, the Banished Knight.

stats.Effect: Summons Banished Knight Oleg spirit

item:banished-knight-s-greatsword.name: Banished Knight's Greatsword
item:banished-knight-s-greatsword.description: A finely-crafted greatsword intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.
item:banished-knight-s-greatsword.location: The Banished Knight's Greatsword doesn't have a guaranteed fixed spawn; instead, it is acquired by farming Banished Knights who wield it.

item:banished-knight-s-halberd.name: Banished Knight's Halberd
item:banished-knight-s-halberd.description: A finely-crafted halberd intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.
item:banished-knight-s-halberd.location: In Elden Ring, you can get a guaranteed Banished Knight's Halberd (+8) by defeating Edgar at the Revenger's Shack in West Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:banished-knight-s-shield.name: Banished Knight's Shield
item:banished-knight-s-shield.description: A tall medium-sized metal shield. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.
item:banished-knight-s-shield.location: - 4% chance to drop from various shield-wielding Banished Knights.

item:barbaric-roar.name: Barbaric Roar
item:barbaric-roar.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Barbaric Roar: Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power. While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks."Usable on melee armaments (daggers, thrusting swords, and whips excepted).
item:barbaric-roar.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Drops from a Scarab found in the Ravine-Veiled Village in northern Liurnia, situated north of the eponymous Site of Grace.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:barbed-staff-spear.name: Barbed Staff-Spear

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Fai C

item:barbed-staff-spear.location: - Guaranteed drop from Jori, Elder Inquisitor, found at the end of the Darklight Catacombs.

item:barrage.name: Barrage
item:barrage.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Barrage: Archery skill using a bow held horizontally. Ready the bow, then fire off a rapid succession of shots faster than the eye can see."Usable on light bows.
item:barrage.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Mt. Gelmir
- Drops from a Scarab north of the Seethewater River Site of Grace in Mt. Gelmir.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:barricade-shield.name: Barricade Shield
item:barricade-shield.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Barricade Shield: Skill made famous by Sir Neidhardt. Focus your energy into the shield, temporarily hardening it to deflect greater blows."Usable on all shields.
item:barricade-shield.location:
**Location:** Weeping Peninsula
- Ash of War: Barricade Shield is guaranteed to drop from the Night's Cavalry encountered at night along the road near the  Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace in the Weeping Peninsula.

item:barrier-of-gold.name: Barrier Of Gold
item:barrier-of-gold.description: One of the incantations of Erdtree Worship.
item:barrier-of-gold.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Leyndell, Royal Capital
- Drops from an invisible Scarab rolling back and forth on the path patrolled by a Crucible Tree Knight, north of the Erdtree Sanctuary Site of Grace, past the elevator downwards.
  - <font color="red">WARNING:</font> If Maliketh, the Black Blade is defeated before this incantation is acquired it becomes unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.

stats.Effect: Greatly increases magic damage negation for self & allies

item:bastard-s-stars.name: Bastard's Stars
item:bastard-s-stars.description: Flail which deals magic damage, having been imbued with power by the remembrance of Astel. Formed of the same many-colored star debris that comprised the form of the Naturalborn of the Void.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int C

item:bastard-s-stars.location: To get the Bastard's Stars flail in Elden Ring, defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, take his remembrance to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold, and trade it for the weapon.

item:bastard-sword.name: Bastard Sword
item:bastard-sword.description: A large sword with a straight blade. This heavy sword is normally wielded with two hands, but those with sufficient strength can wield it in one alone. The hefty blade can be swung into multiple foes at once thanks to the broad, sweeping attack, making fending off crowds all the easier.
item:bastard-sword.location: You can purchase the Bastard Sword in Elden Ring from the Nomadic Merchant near the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace in the Weeping Peninsula.

item:battle-axe.name: Battle Axe
item:battle-axe.description: A thick, heavy blade attached to a handle. A versatile, standard weapon Capable of powerful attacks thanks to the weighty blade, these weapons are also regarded for their powerful charge attacks.
item:battle-axe.location: The Battle Axe can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 800 Runes.

item:battle-hammer.name: Battle Hammer
item:battle-hammer.description: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.
item:battle-hammer.location: Battle Hammer: Dropped by the hammer-wielding Duelist enemies wandering near the colosseum in Leyndell, Royal Capital (accessible from the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace).

item:battlemage-hugues-ashes.name: Battlemage Hugues Ashes
item:battlemage-hugues-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Battlemage Hugues. Hugues came from Sellia to study the Haima Conspectus at the academy, where he became a battlemage. Haima scholars seek to quell conflict with cannon fire and the gavel, but Hugues developed a longing for it.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Battlemage Hugues

item:battlemage-legwraps.name: Battlemage Legwraps
item:battlemage-legwraps.description: Legwraps worn by the scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy, tattered from being worn on the battlefield.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 3 · Magic 7 · Fire 6 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:battlemage-legwraps.location: A Battlemage enemy drops the entire set the first time you defeat him, directly north of the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace, Altus Plateau, up on a hill behind the bridge where you first meet Goldmask.

item:battlemage-manchettes.name: Battlemage Manchettes
item:battlemage-manchettes.description: Manchettes worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy, tattered from being worn on the battlefield.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:battlemage-manchettes.location:
**Location**: Altus Plateau
- The Battlemage Manchettes are dropped by the Battlemage north of the  Road of Iniquity Side Path Site of Grace in the Altus Plateau, on the hill behind the bridge where Goldmask is first encountered.

item:battlemage-robe.name: Battlemage Robe
item:battlemage-robe.description: Robe worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy scholar, tattered from being worn on the battlefield.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 4 · Pierce 5 · Magic 13 · Fire 11 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:battlemage-robe.location: A Battlemage enemy drops the entire set the first time you defeat him, directly north of the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace, Altus Plateau, up on a hill behind the bridge where you first meet Goldmask.

item:bayle-s-flame-lightning.name: Bayle's Flame Lightning
item:bayle-s-flame-lightning.location:

- Trade the Heart of Bayle at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.
  - Mutually exclusive with Bayle's Tyranny, as the Heart of Bayle and its reward cannot be duplicated.
