  - Mutually exclusive with Bayle's Flame Lightning, as the Heart of Bayle and its reward cannot be duplicated.

item:beast-blood.name: Beast Blood
item:beast-blood.description: Fresh beast blood, glinting with gold. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting materials

item:beast-champion-armor.name: Beast Champion Armor
item:beast-champion-armor.description: Silver armor engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant. Beasts are drawn to champions, and to lords. And this armor befits a champion worthy of becoming a lord. And that is what Bernahl was. Until his maiden threw herself into the fire.

stats.Negation: Physical 16 · Strike 15 · Slash 18 · Pierce 18 · Magic 12 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:beast-champion-armor.location:
Altered version is received upon:
- Killing the invader Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula.
- At the Warmaster's Shack if the player never joined Volcano Manor and killed Praetor Rykard.

Needs to be altered at a Site of Grace or by Boc.

item:beast-champion-armor-altered.name: Beast Champion Armor (altered)
item:beast-champion-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the  Best Champion Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 17 · Strike 16 · Slash 18 · Pierce 18 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:beast-champion-armor-altered.location:
Received upon:
- Killing the invader Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula.
- At the Warmaster's Shack if the player never joined Volcano Manor and killed Praetor Rykard.

Can be altered at a Sites of Grace or given to Boc to Beast Champion Armor.

item:beast-champion-gauntlets.name: Beast Champion Gauntlets
item:beast-champion-gauntlets.description: Silver gauntlets engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant. Beasts are drawn to champions, and to lords. And this armor befits a champion worthy of becoming a lord. And that is what Bernahl was. Until his maiden threw herself into the fire.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:beast-champion-gauntlets.location:
- The Beast Champion Gauntlets are obtained by defeating Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula.
- Alternatively, the Beast Champion Gauntlets can be obtained at the Warmaster's Shack if the player defeats Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy without joining the Recusants at Volcano Manor.

item:beast-champion-greaves.name: Beast Champion Greaves
item:beast-champion-greaves.description: Silver greaves engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 9 · Slash 10 · Pierce 10 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:beast-champion-greaves.location:
Received upon:
- Killing the invader Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula.
- At the Warmaster's Shack if the player never joined Volcano Manor and killed Praetor Rykard.

item:beast-champion-helm.name: Beast Champion Helm
item:beast-champion-helm.description: Silver helm engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:beast-champion-helm.location:
- The Beast Champion Helm is dropped by Recusant Bernahl upon defeating his invasion north of the  Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.
- Alternatively, obtained at the Warmaster's Shack if the player defeats Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy without joining Volcano Manor.

item:beast-claw.name: Beast Claw

stats.Effect: Creates claws that tear through the land.

item:beast-claw.location:
**Quest Item:** Bestial Sanctum, Greyoll's Dragonbarrow
- Beast Claw is rewarded from Gurranq after giving him the fifth Deathroot. (If Gurranq is hostile after consuming the fourth Deathroot, he may be calmed down by reducing his HP.)
item:beast-claw.description: Incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.

item:beast-crest-heater-shield.name: Beast Crest Heater Shield
item:beast-crest-heater-shield.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. Features a beast as its crest, serving to remind warriors not to succumb to the arousal of battle. Fight with passion, but become nor its prisoner.
item:beast-crest-heater-shield.location: - In a chest at a Godrick Knight's camp northeast of the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill.

item:beast-eye.name: Beast Eye
item:beast-eye.description: Claw-marked stone eye received from Gurranq, Beast Clergyman.

stats.Effect: Said to tremble when close to Deathroot

item:beast-eye.location:
**Location**: Bestial Sanctum
- The Beast Eye is given by Gurranq, Beast Clergyman at the Bestial Sanctum in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow after he receives the first Deathroot.

item:beast-liver.name: Beast Liver
item:beast-liver.description: The fresh liver of a beast; a luscious fruit of life. Material used for crating items. Found by hunting herbivorous beast. Dried liver boost damage negation.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:beast-liver.location:
- Dropped by herbivorous animals with an 8% droprate:
  - Sheep are found in large quantities between the Church of Pilgrimage and Witchbane Ruins, in the Weeping Peninsula.
  - Deer are commonly found in upper and lower Siofra River, where they roam freely.
  - Springhares are found throughout Limgrave.

item:beast-repellent-torch.name: Beast-repellent Torch
item:beast-repellent-torch.description: A torch which burns oil infused with a special incense. The aroma pacifies wild beasts. Torches such as these were used to keep unwelcome beasts away from treasure troves hidden in caves.
item:beast-repellent-torch.location: The Beast-Repellent Torch can be purchased for 1,200 Runes from the Isolated Merchant in his shack, located at the northwestern edge of the Dragonbarrow region in northern Caelid

item:beast-s-roar.name: Beast's Roar
item:beast-s-roar.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Beast's Roar: Unleash a beastly roar, rending the air as a forward-travelling projectile."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:beast-s-roar.location:
**Quest Item:** Greyoll's Dragonbarrow
- Reward for giving 4 Deathroot to the Beast Clergyman, Gurranq.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:beastclaw-greathammer.name: Beastclaw Greathammer
item:beastclaw-greathammer.description: Greathammer with a striking end modelled to resemble five beastly claws. The black nails protruding from golden fur are said to represent Serosh, Lord of Beasts, who went to become King Godfrey's Regent.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:beastclaw-greathammer.location: You can get the Beastclaw Greathammer by trading seven Deathroot items to Gurranq, Beast Clergyman at the Bestial Sanctum in Dragonbarrow.

item:beastlure-pot.name: Beastlure Pot
item:beastlure-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Enchanted with assassin incantations. Consumes FP. Throw to create a red shadow. The illusion lures in beasts into attacking it. This effect does not change even during combat.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Lures beasts only.

item:beastman-s-cleaver.name: Beastman's Cleaver
item:beastman-s-cleaver.description: Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is incredibly heavy, but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers. It's clear the beastmen possess knowledge beyond human ken.
item:beastman-s-cleaver.location: The Beastman's Cleaver is a rare drop from Azula Beastmen who wield this specific weapon in the Crumbling Farum Azula legacy dungeon.

item:beastman-s-curved-sword.name: Beastman's Curved Sword
item:beastman-s-curved-sword.description: Curved sword forged of dull iron wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is heavy but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers.
item:beastman-s-curved-sword.location: The Beastman's Curved Sword is a rare drop from Azula Beastman enemies in Crumbling Farum Azula.

item:beastman-s-jar-shield.name: Beastman's Jar-shield
item:beastman-s-jar-shield.description: Shield fashioned from a tall broken jar carried by the beastmen of Farum Azula. There is a particular knack to wielding it. The beastmen have always fired earthenware jars for the express purpose of making shields. Such are their ways, strange though they are.
item:beastman-s-jar-shield.location: 2% chance to be dropped by various shield-wielding beastmen in Crumbling Farum Azula.

item:bestial-constitution.name: Bestial Constitution
item:bestial-constitution.description: Incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.
item:bestial-constitution.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Greyoll's Dragonbarrow
- Bestial Constitution drops from a Scarab near the western cliffs on the southern side of Farum Greatbridge.

stats.Effect: Alleviates blood loss and frost buildup

item:bestial-sling.name: Bestial Sling
item:bestial-sling.description: Incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. Swiftly flings a number of sharp rock shards. This incantation can be cast without delay after performing another action. It is said that in the time before the Erdtree, stones were the first weapons of the beasts who had gained intelligence.
item:bestial-sling.location:
**Quest Item:** Greyoll's Dragonbarrow
- Bestial Sling is rewarded from Gurranq after giving him the second Deathroot.

stats.Effect: Swiftly flings numerous sharp rock shards

item:bestial-vitality.name: Bestial Vitality
item:bestial-vitality.description: Incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.
item:bestial-vitality.location:
**Quest Item:** Bestial Sanctum, Greyoll's Dragonbarrow
- Bestial Vitality is rewarded from Gurranq after giving him the third Deathroot.

stats.Effect: Heals HP over a period of time

item:bewitching-branch.name: Bewitching Branch
item:bewitching-branch.description: Tree branch blessed with an incantation of unalloyed gold. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to charm pierced enemy

item:bewitching-branch.location:
- Craftable (requires Fevor's Cookbook [3])
- One of nine optional keepsakes during Character Creation, that rewards you five branches
- 3 sold by the Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.
- 5 sold by the Nomadic Merchant at Bellum Church

item:black-blade.name: Black Blade
item:black-blade.description: Power gleaned from the remembrance of Maliketh.
item:black-blade.location:
Trade the Remembrance of the Black Blade, dropped by Maliketh, the Black Blade, with Finger Reader Enia.

Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

stats.Effect: Black blade spinning slash that emits wave of light.

item:black-bow.name: Black Bow
item:black-bow.description: Longbow carved from black wood to resemble a blade. One of the most difficult bows to master. The blade-like body of the bow is light and cuts through the air. Though a longbow, it can be wielded similarly to a shortbow.
item:black-bow.location: The Black Bow is located on a corpse on a rooftop in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:black-dumpling.name: Black Dumpling
item:black-dumpling.description: Mask forced on a victim's head to lend torture an extra degree of cruelty. It magnifies one's fears and make them acutely aware of all forms of pain Raises attack power when the wearer suffers from madness. When the Black Dumpling goes on, the torturer no longer seeks answers; only to inflict suffering without hope of relief.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:black-dumpling.location:
**Drop**: Black Dumpling Albinaurics
- The Black Dumpling has a 0.50% drop rate from fast-crawling Elder Albinaurics that wear it, found only in the Prison Town and Subterranean Inquisition Chamber of Volcano Manor, in Leyndell, Royal Capital, or at Castle Sol.
- Farmable near the  Guest Hall and  Subterranean Inquisition Chamber sites of grace

item:black-flame.name: Black Flame
item:black-flame.description: A black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles.
item:black-flame.location: Godskin Prayerbook, found at the Roundtable Hold.

stats.Effect: Throws a ball of raging black fire

item:black-flame-blade.name: Black Flame Blade
item:black-flame-blade.description: A black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles.
item:black-flame-blade.location: **Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants - Sold for 6,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Godskin Prayerbook. - Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Enchants right-hand armament with black flame

item:black-flame-ritual.name: Black Flame Ritual
item:black-flame-ritual.description: Superior black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles.
item:black-flame-ritual.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Mountaintops of the Giants
- Black Flame Ritual is received upon defeating the Spiritcaller Snail boss in Spiritcaller Cave on the Mountaintops of the Giants. This Snail summons the spirits of a Godskin Apostle and a Godskin Noble.

stats.Effect: Summons circle of black flame pillars around caster.

item:black-flame-s-protection.name: Black Flame's Protection
item:black-flame-s-protection.description: A black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles.
item:black-flame-s-protection.location: Godskin Prayerbook, found at the Roundtable Hold.

stats.Effect: Increases phyiscal damage negation

item:black-flame-tornado.name: Black Flame Tornado
item:black-flame-tornado.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Flame affinity and the following skill:"Black Flame Tornado: Spin armament overhead and then punge it into the ground to summon a raging vortex of black flames. Hold to create an initial flame tornado while spinning the armament."Usable on polearms and twinblades.
item:black-flame-tornado.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Crumbling Farum Azula
- Drops from the Godskin Duo bossfight.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:black-hood.name: Black Hood
item:black-hood.description: Hood of lusterless black fabric that conceals its wearer's identity.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:black-hood.location:
**Location**: Sage's Cave
- The Black Hood is looted from a chest behind an illusory wall within Sage's Cave in Altus Plateau.

item:black-knife.name: Black Knife
item:black-knife.description: Dagger once belonging to one of the assassins who murdered Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives.  A ritual performed on the oddly misshapen blade imbued it with the power of the stolen Rune of Death.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Fai D

item:black-knife.location: You can get the Black Knife by defeating a Black Knife Assassin roaming outside the Sainted Hero's Grave in the Altus Plateau.

item:black-knife-armor.name: Black Knife Armor
item:black-knife-armor.description: Scale armor used by the Black Knife Assassins, forged to make no sound. Traces of power yet remain in its concealing veil, which muffles the sound of footsteps. The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 10 · Slash 12 · Pierce 12 · Magic 8 · Fire 9 · Lightning 6 · Holy 11

item:black-knife-armor.location: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield.

item:black-knife-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Black Knife Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 10 · Slash 12 · Pierce 12 · Magic 8 · Fire 9 · Lightning 6 · Holy 11

item:black-knife-armor-altered.location: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield. The chest piece can then be altered at a site of grace or with the help of Boc.

item:black-knife-gauntlets.name: Black Knife Gauntlets
item:black-knife-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets used by the Black Knife Assassins. Crafted with scale armor that makes no sound. The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 2

item:black-knife-gauntlets.location: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield.

item:black-knife-greaves.name: Black Knife Greaves
item:black-knife-greaves.description: Greaves used by the Black Knife Assassins. Crafted with scale armor that makes no sound. The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 3 · Holy 6

item:black-knife-greaves.location: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town, located in Consecrated Snowfield.

item:black-knife-hood.name: Black Knife Hood
item:black-knife-hood.description: Hood used by the Black Knife Assassins. The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be N u men who had close ties with Marika herself.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:black-knife-hood.location:

item:black-knife-tiche.name: Black Knife Tiche

item:black-knife-tiche.location: Ringleader’s Evergaol after Ranni opens the altar.

item:black-knifeprint.name: Black Knifeprint

stats.Effect: Mark of the Night of the Black Knives ritual

related: Show the knifeprint to Ranni and enter her service
Meet Rogier in Stormveil and again at the Roundtable Hold

item:black-leather-shield.name: Black Leather Shield
item:black-leather-shield.description: Roundshield covered in black leather. On the larger side for a medium-sized shield. From the north, this shield depicts the polar star in rivets of gold. The inside is lined with fur, protecting the carrier from frost.
item:black-leather-shield.location: Bought for 2,500 Runes from Pidia, Carian Servant or by the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Pidia's Bell Bearing.

item:black-steel-greathammer.name: Black Steel Greathammer

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Fai D

item:black-steel-greathammer.location: Guaranteed drop from the Black Knight found in the Church of Consolation at the end of the downhill path east of the Gravesite Plain Site of Grace.

item:black-steel-greatshield.name: Black Steel Greatshield
item:black-steel-greatshield.location:
**Location**: Fog Rift Fort
- Dropped by Black Knight Garrew at the Fog Rift Fort, accessible from the Scadu Altus.

item:black-steel-twinblade.name: Black Steel Twinblade

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:black-steel-twinblade.location: Guaranteed drop from the Black Knight at the top of the western hill camp off to the side of the encampment in front of the Shadow Keep in Scadu Altus.

item:black-whetblade.name: Black Whetblade
item:black-whetblade.description: Black whetblade with a cipher engraved. Can be used as a whetstone knife.

stats.Effect: Grants choice of affinity upgrade to weapon

item:blackflame-monk-amon-ashes.name: Blackflame Monk Amon Ashes
item:blackflame-monk-amon-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Amon, the Blackflame Monk. Amon swore fealty to the god-slaying black flame, and so became the first fire monk to turn traitor. Or perhaps it is better said that he fled from the Giants' Flame—out of cowardice.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Blackflame Monk Amon

item:blackflame-monk-amon-ashes.location: Dropped by the Stray Mimic Tear in Hidden Path to the Haligtree.

item:blackflame-monk-armor.name: Blackflame Monk Armor
item:blackflame-monk-armor.description: Black iron armor adorned with ashen cloth.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 14 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 13 · Lightning 8 · Holy 10

item:blackflame-monk-armor.location: The Blackflame Monk Armor has a 3.00% chance to drop from Blackflame Monk enemies.

item:blackflame-monk-gauntlets.description: Black iron gauntlets featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Blackflame Monks.

item:blackflame-monk-hood.description: Mail hood of iron links covering a headband engraved with black flames.

item:blackguard-s-iron-mask.name: Blackguard's Iron Mask
item:blackguard-s-iron-mask.description: Iron mask forced on convicted prisoners. Worn by the blackguard Big Boggart. To Boggart, the mask made him all the more threatening, and helped him get what he wanted. But it was also a mirror of his emptiness.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 4 · Slash 6 · Pierce 5 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:blackguard-s-iron-mask.location: - Dropped by Blackguard Big Boggart upon his death.

item:blade-of-calling.name: Blade Of Calling
item:blade-of-calling.description: Dagger given to one who set out on a journey to fulfill her duty long ago. The power of its former owner, the kindling maiden, is still apparent. The one who walks alongside flame, Shall one day meet the road of Destined Death.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai C

item:blade-of-calling.location: The Blade of Calling is found in a hidden room just off the Grand Lift of Rold, south of the Forbidden Lands Site of Grace in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:blades-of-stone.name: Blades of Stone
item:blades-of-stone.location: - Defeat Commander Gaius and trade his Remembrance with Finger Reader Enia.

item:blaidd-s-armor.name: Blaidd's Armor
item:blaidd-s-armor.description: Well-worn black armor of the man-wolf Blaidd

item:blaidd-s-armor.location: Received after killing Blaidd during Ranni's questline.

item:blaidd-s-gauntlets.description: Well-worn black gauntlets of the man-wolf Blaidd.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:blaidd-s-gauntlets.location:
**Location**: Three Sisters
- Blaidd's Gauntlets are obtained after defeating Blaidd the Half-Wolf at Ranni's Rise.

item:blaidd-s-greaves.name: Blaidd's Greaves
item:blaidd-s-greaves.description: Well-worn black greaves of the man-wolf Blaidd.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 7 · Slash 8 · Pierce 8 · Magic 6 · Fire 7 · Lightning 6 · Holy 6

item:blasphemous-blade.name: Blasphemous Blade
item:blasphemous-blade.description: Sacred sword of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. Remains of the countless heroes he has devoured writhe upon the surface of this blade. Now they share the same blood, bound together as family. Some HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:blasphemous-blade.location: Remembrance of the Blasphemous (Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy)

item:blasphemous-claw.name: Blasphemous Claw
item:blasphemous-claw.description: A slab of rock engraved with traces of the Rune of Death.

stats.Effect: Deflects the power of the Black Blade

item:blasphemous-claw.location:
**Location**: Crumbling Farum Azula
- The Blasphemous Claw is dropped by Bernahl at Crumbling Farum Azula, provided his quest at Volcano Manor was completed and Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy has been defeated.

item:blessed-dew-talisman.name: Blessed Dew Talisman
item:blessed-dew-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a drop of the Erdtree's sap, a blessed boon.

stats.Effect: Slowly restores HP.

related: Forge of the Giants / burning the Erdtree

item:blessing-of-the-erdtree.name: Blessing Of The Erdtree
item:blessing-of-the-erdtree.description: One of the ancient Erdtree incantations
item:blessing-of-the-erdtree.location:
**Loot:** Leyndell, Royal Capital
- Blessing of the Erdtree is located near the Queen's Bedchamber Site of Grace in Leyndell, on the Altus Plateau.
- <font color="red">WARNING:</font> This item is no longer obtainable after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

stats.Effect: Grants greater blessing to self and nearby allies

item:blessing-s-boon.name: Blessing's Boon
item:blessing-s-boon.description: One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.
item:blessing-s-boon.location: Sold by Miriel at the Church of Vows, or found on a corpse in the minor erdtree vicinity.

stats.Effect: Grants blessing to self and nearby allies

item:blood-blade.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Altus Plateau
- Drops from a Scarab found in a pond south of the entrance for Old Altus Tunnel.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:blood-grease.name: Blood Grease
item:blood-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of blood-red materials.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting blood loss

item:blood-grease.location: Craftable — Root Resin x1, Bloodrose x1

item:blood-tainted-excrement.name: Blood-tainted Excrement
item:blood-tainted-excrement.description: The bloody excrement of a carnivorous beast. Material used for crafting items. Found in the land of the new dynasty. Mixed inside with half-digested flesh are dense colonies of tiny eggs of unknown but assuredly revolting origin.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:blood-tax.name: Blood Tax
item:blood-tax.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Blood affinity and the following skill:"Blood Tax: Blood Oath skill granted by the Lord of Blood. item:blood-tax.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum
- Drops from a Scarab found in a small cave in the eastern stone walls by the lake of blood north of the Palace Approach Ledge-Road Site of Grace.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:bloodboil-aromatic.name: Bloodboil Aromatic
item:bloodboil-aromatic.description: Forbidden art of depraved perfumers. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to enter a temporary state of fervor, raising maximum attack power and stamina while also increasing damage received. "Even upon the battlefield, do you fear being wounded? Take a good look. Your limbs are frozen stiff."

stats.Effect: Uses FP to enter a temporary state of fervor.

item:bloodboil-aromatic.location: Can be crafted after acquiring the Perfumer's Cookbook 2 from The Shaded Castle. Head north from the **Shaded Castle Inner Gate** Site of Grace and climb up a ladder, then enter the dark room and take the ladder inside to a small rooftop with a body on a chair holding the item.

item:bloodboon.name: Bloodboon
item:bloodboon.description: Sacred incantation of Mohg, Lord of Blood.
item:bloodboon.location:
Trade the Remembrance of the Blood Lord, dropped by Mohg, Lord of Blood, with Finger Reader Enia.

Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

stats.Effect: Scatters bloodflame before caster to set area aflame.

item:bloodfiend-s-arm.name: Bloodfiend's Arm

item:bloodfiend-s-arm.location: SotE bloodfiend weapon dropped in the Realm of Shadow.

item:bloodflame-blade.location: Dropped by the scarab west of Rose Church after talking to Varre.

item:bloodhound-claws.location: The Bloodhound Claws are dropped by a Lesser Bloodhound Knight in the basement of Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir.

item:bloodhound-knight-floh.name: Bloodhound Knight Floh

item:bloodhound-s-step.name: Bloodhound's Step
item:bloodhound-s-step.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Bloodhound's Step: Skill that allows the user to become temporarily invisible while dodging at high speed. Moves faster and travels farther than a regular quickstep. This skill can be used to circle around lock-on targets."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:bloodhound-s-step.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Greyoll's Dragonbarrow
- Drops from a the Night's Cavalry patrolling the easternmost bridge of Dragobarrow, north of Lenne's Rise during the night.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:bloodrose.name: Bloodrose
item:bloodrose.description: Blood-slick roses that bloom in festering blood. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:bloodrose.location:
- Bloodrose can be harvested throughout the Lands Between.
  - Fort Haight
  - Rose Church
- Can be purchased in unlimited quantity from Imprisoned Merchant at the Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum for 800 Runes each.

item:bloodsoaked-manchettes.name: Bloodsoaked Manchettes
item:bloodsoaked-manchettes.description: Manchettes formed from tightly-wound bandages soaked through with blood. Any protection is welcome for the festering arms beneath.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:bloodsoaked-manchettes.location:
**Location**: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
- The Bloodsoaked Manchettes are found on a corpse near the  Underground Roadside Site of Grace in the sewers beneath Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:bloodsoaked-mask.name: Bloodsoaked Mask
item:bloodsoaked-mask.description: Mask formed from tightly-wound bandages soaked through with blood. Even the most ghastly cover is more inviting than the festering face beneath.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 2 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:bloodsoaked-mask.location:
**Location**: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
- The Bloodsoaked Mask is found on a corpse near the  Underground Roadside site of grace, located in the sewers beneath Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:bloodsoaked-tabard.name: Bloodsoaked Tabard
item:bloodsoaked-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with indelible bloodstains around the neck. Worn by headless foot soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 9 · Slash 10 · Pierce 9 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 12 · Holy 11

item:bloodsoaked-tabard.location: Chance to drop from Mausoleum Foot Soldier enemies.

item:bloodstained-dagger.name: Bloodstained Dagger
item:bloodstained-dagger.description: Dagger with a bloodstained blade. Afflicts targets with blood loss. As blood darkened the dagger through repeated slashing and stabbing, its blade only grew sharper and harder.
item:bloodstained-dagger.location: The Bloodstained Dagger is a rare drop from Fierce Demi-Humans and Demi-Human Chiefs.

item:bloody-finger.name: Bloody Finger
item:bloody-finger.description: Item for online play. Attempts an invasion of another player's world. If successful, your objective will be to defeat the Host of Fingers of the world to which you were summoned. The nail of this finger is shot through with streaks of fresh, glistening blood. The finger's sickly pale skin feels nothing now, but the nail still aches with sweetest pain.

stats.Effect: Attempts invasion of other player's world.

item:bloody-finger.location:
**Location**: Rose Church
- The Bloody Finger is obtained upon returning the bloodsoaked Lord of Blood's Favor to White Mask Varré and agreeing to become one of Mohg's Bloody Fingers.

item:bloody-helice.name: Bloody Helice
item:bloody-helice.description: Ominous piercing sword with a winding blade. Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood. Designed to bore into flesh, causing severe blood loss at the wound. The extracted blood trickles gracefully down the length of the blade.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Arc D

item:bloody-helice.location: The Bloody Helice is a Heavy Thrusting Sword located at the Writheblood Ruins in the northern Altus Plateau.

item:bloody-slash.name: Bloody Slash
item:bloody-slash.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Blood affinity and the following skill:"Bloody Slash: Bloody Oath skill granted by the Lord of Blood. From a low stance, coat the blade in your own blood to unleash a rending blood slash in a wide arc."Usable on swords (colossal weapons excepted)
item:bloody-slash.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Limgrave
- Drops from the Bloodcrazed Godrick Knight found at Fort Haight in east Limgrave.
Once This Item Has Been Obtained, It Can Be Duplicated By Trading In Lost Ashes of War To Smithing Master Hewg.

item:blue-cipher-ring.name: Blue Cipher Ring
item:blue-cipher-ring.description: Item for online play. Puts the wearer in ready state to answer should someone in another world call for rescue. You will be summoned to their world as a hunter. When summoned to rescue another player, your objective will be to defeat the invader.

stats.Effect: Enables the wearer to answer calls for rescue

item:blue-cipher-ring.location: - The Blue Cipher Ring is purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for  1,000 runes.

item:blue-cloth-cowl.name: Blue Cloth Cowl
item:blue-cloth-cowl.description: Cowl of a nomadic warrior. The blue color of its fabric symbolizes brisk waters, as fluid and flowing as the sword in the hand of its wearer. Just as still waters turn foul, stagnation leads to decay. Warriors must remain ever-drifting.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 2

item:blue-cloth-cowl.location:
- Starting equipment for the Warrior class.
- The Blue Cloth Cowl is purchased from Isolated Merchant camped outside the Academy of Raya Lucaria for  1,000 runes.

item:blue-cloth-vest.name: Blue Cloth Vest
item:blue-cloth-vest.description: Vest of a nomadic warrior. The blue color of its fabric symbolizes brisk waters, as fluid and flowing as the sword in the hand of its wearer. Just as still waters turn foul, stagnation leads to decay. Warriors must remain ever drifting.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 9 · Slash 8 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 11 · Holy 9

item:blue-cloth-vest.location:
Starting gear for the Warrior class.

Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Academy of Raya Lucaria).

item:blue-crest-heater-shield.name: Blue Crest Heater Shield
item:blue-crest-heater-shield.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest represents a forest and river.
item:blue-crest-heater-shield.location:
- Starting gear for the Confessor class.
- Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant near Bellum Church for  1500 Runes.

item:blue-dancer-charm.name: Blue Dancer Charm
item:blue-dancer-charm.description: A cloth doll depicting a dancer garbed in blue. An ancient heirloom of some sort.

stats.Effect: Raises attack power with lower equipment load

item:blue-dancer-charm.location: - The Blue Dancer Charm is obtained by defeating the Guardian Golem in Highroad Cave in northern Limgrave.

item:blue-feathered-branchsword.name: Blue-feathered Branchsword
item:blue-feathered-branchsword.description: A talisman adorned with blue feathers, once used in ancient death rituals.

stats.Effect: Raises defense when HP is low.

item:blue-feathered-branchsword.location:
**Location**: Stormhill
- The Blue-Feathered Branchsword is obtained by defeating the Deathbird that appears east of Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill. The Bird only appears at night, descending from the sky when the player approaches a ruin covered in Ruin Fragments and Sanctuary Stones that fell from Crumbling Farum Azula.

item:blue-festive-garb.name: Blue Festive Garb
item:blue-festive-garb.description: Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills. Use of this garb, dyed in a stunning blue, is only permitted for the young maids who play the central role in the festival.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 6 · Pierce 5 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:blue-festive-garb.location: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau.

item:blue-festive-hood.name: Blue Festive Hood
item:blue-festive-hood.description: Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills. Use of this hood, dyed in a stunning blue, is only permitted for the young maids who play the central role in the festival.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:blue-festive-hood.location: - The Blue Festive Hood has a 1.50% chance to drop from Dominula Dancers that wear it in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau. The enemies always wield the Celebrant's Sickle.

item:blue-gold-kite-shield.name: Blue-gold Kite Shield
item:blue-gold-kite-shield.description: A standard medium-sized shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. The design represents the Erdtree foreground against a blue sky.
item:blue-gold-kite-shield.location: Purchased for 1,000 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant in East Limgrave south of the Minor Erdtree or from the Twin Maiden Husks upon giving them his Bell Bearing.

item:blue-silver-bracelets.name: Blue Silver Bracelets
item:blue-silver-bracelets.description: Bracelets crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 1 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 1 · Fire 1 · Lightning 1 · Holy 1

item:blue-silver-bracelets.location: - The Blue Silver Bracelets have a 2.00% chance to drop from Albinauric Archer enemies.

item:blue-silver-mail-armor.name: Blue Silver Mail Armor
item:blue-silver-mail-armor.description: Chainmail armor crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers. Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 9 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 8 · Holy 8

item:blue-silver-mail-armor.location: - Chance to drop from Albinauric Wolfback Archer enemies.

item:blue-silver-mail-armor-altered.name: Blue Silver Mail Armor (altered)
item:blue-silver-mail-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Blue Silver Mail Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 9 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 10 · Fire 9 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:blue-silver-mail-armor-altered.location: - Armor Adjustment of Blue Silver Mail Armor

item:blue-silver-mail-hood.name: Blue Silver Mail Hood
item:blue-silver-mail-hood.description: Chainmail hood crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:blue-silver-mail-hood.location: - The Blue Silver Mail Hood has a 2.00% chance to drop from Albinauric Archers.

item:blue-silver-mail-skirt.name: Blue Silver Mail Skirt
item:blue-silver-mail-skirt.description: Chainmail skirt crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:blue-silver-mail-skirt.location: - ?.??% chance to drop from Albinauric Wolfback Archer enemies.

item:blue-white-wooden-shield.name: Blue-white Wooden Shield
item:blue-white-wooden-shield.description: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield. The design is said to represent the stars of the night sky, portending fate.
item:blue-white-wooden-shield.location: Found behind a building in Academy Gate Town, in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:boiled-prawn.name: Boiled Prawn
item:boiled-prawn.description: Boiled prawn meat. A prime specimen of plump and moist meat. True connoisseurs know how to keep from over-salting.

stats.Effect: Boosts physical damage negation for a time

item:boiled-prawn.location:
- Sold by Blackguard Big Boggart for 600 Runes each.
  - Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold using Blackguard's Bell Bearing, if he died, for the same price.
  - Only tied to his Bell Bearing if at least one was bought from him before his death.
- One of nine optional keepsakes from Character Creation, that rewards five pieces of prawn.

item:bolt-of-gransax.name: Bolt Of Gransax
item:bolt-of-gransax.description: Spear whittled from the weapon wielded by Gransax. One of the legendary armaments.  A great ancient dragon, Gransax once rained calamity upon the Royal Capital - the only time in historical record that Leyendell's walls have fallen. This marked the dawn of the war against dragons.
item:bolt-of-gransax.location: Found on the giant bolt (drop down to the ledge)
related: Forge of the Giants / burning the Erdtree

item:boltdrake-talisman.name: Boltdrake Talisman
item:boltdrake-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a yellow ancient dragon. Boosts lightning damage negation.

stats.Effect: Boosts lightning damage negation.

item:boltdrake-talisman.location:
**Loot:** Stormveil Castle
- Obtained from a corpse just before the bridge leading eastward, to the Divine Tower of Limgrave.

item:bone-bow.name: Bone Bow
item:bone-bow.location:
**Location**: Belurat, Tower Settlement
- The Bone Bow is found on a corpse in the Upper Residential Ward of Belurat, Tower Settlement. From the  Belurat, Tower Settlement site of grace, turn left and ascend the elevator shortcut, then turn left again to enter the bottom of the spiral staircase tower. The bow is on the other side of the room, guarded by numerous Baby Spider Scorpions and two Large Spider Scorpions.

item:bone-dart.name: Bone Dart
item:bone-dart.description: Animal bone sharpened into a knife for throwing. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to inflict damage

item:bonny-butchering-knife.name: Bonny Butchering Knife
item:bonny-butchering-knife.location: The weapon can be found at Bonny Village below a small shed outside a house, near the broken bridge.

item:borealis-s-mist.name: Borealis's Mist
item:borealis-s-mist.location:
**Dragon Communion:** Caelid / Jagged Peak
- Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid and the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak for 2 Dragon Hearts after defeating Borealis the Freezing Fog on the Mountaintops of the Giants.

stats.Effect: Spews icy breath of Borealis from above

item:braggart-s-roar.name: Braggart's Roar
item:braggart-s-roar.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Braggart's Roar: Declare your presence with a boastful roar. Raises attack power, defense, and stamina recovery speed."Usable on melee armaments (daggers, thrusting swords, and whips excepted ).
item:braggart-s-roar.location:
'''Guaranteed Drop/Quest Item: Liurnia of the Lakes / Capital Outskirts
- Found pre-equipped on the Iron Ball Fist weapon, which can be looted off the body of Blackguard Big Boggart. Who can be found dead either at the hands of the player in either of his locations or Dung Eater after he is released from his cell while Boggart is present at Capital Outskirts.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:brass-shield.name: Brass Shield
item:brass-shield.description: On the larger side for medium-sized shield, the face has been covered in brass. Commonly employed in the Shattering.
item:brass-shield.location:
- 2% chance to be dropped by various shield-wielding Soldiers across factions.
- 1.5% chance to be dropped by various shield-wielding Mausoleum Soldiers.

item:brave-s-battlewear.name: Brave's Battlewear
item:brave-s-battlewear.description: Battlewear fashioned from leather armor adorned with a large sheet of cloth. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands The red cloth signifies participation in the Long March long, long ago and this ceremonial garb beseeches the favor of the Warrior King who led them.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:brave-s-battlewear.location: - The Brave's Battlewear is  unused content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:brave-s-battlewear-altered.name: Brave's Battlewear (altered)
item:brave-s-battlewear-altered.description: Lighter version of the Brave's Battlewear

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:brave-s-battlewear-altered.location: - The Brave's Battlewear (Altered) is  unused content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:brave-s-bracer.name: Brave's Bracer
item:brave-s-bracer.description: Gauntlets wrapped in thick leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands. Has a fur lining which excels at keeping the cold at bay.

stats.Negation: Magic 3 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:brave-s-bracer.location: - The Brave's Bracer is  unused content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:brave-s-cord-circlet.name: Brave's Cord Circlet
item:brave-s-cord-circlet.description: Warrior's headband of woven leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands. The small flags, white cloths and sheaves of wheat often found hung from these headbands are prayers of farewell from the people of their home. In bidding farewell t warriors departing on a journey from which they aren't like to return, this small act offers only meager relief.

stats.Negation: Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:brave-s-cord-circlet.location: - The Brave's Cord Circlet is  unused content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:brave-s-leather-helm.name: Brave's Leather Helm
item:brave-s-leather-helm.description: Battlewear wrapped in thick leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:brave-s-leather-helm.location: - The Brave's Leather Helm is  unused content and cannot be acquired through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:brave-s-legwraps.name: Brave's Legwraps
item:brave-s-legwraps.description: Greaves wrapped in thick leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands. Has a fur lining which excels at keeping the cold at bay.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:brave-s-legwraps.location: - The Brave's Legwraps are  unused content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:briar-armor.name: Briar Armor
item:briar-armor.description: Battered iron armor from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of the Briar.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 11 · Slash 13 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 10

item:briar-armor.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 6,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar.

item:briar-armor-altered.name: Briar Armor (altered)
item:briar-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Briar Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 10 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 7 · Holy 9

item:briar-armor-altered.location: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 6,000 runes once Elemer of the Briar has been defeated. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:briar-gauntlets.name: Briar Gauntlets
item:briar-gauntlets.description: Battered iron gauntlets from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of the Briar.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:briar-gauntlets.location: - The Briar Gauntlets can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for  4,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar at the Shaded Castle.

item:briar-greatshield.name: Briar Greatshield
item:briar-greatshield.description: Greatshield from a foreign land, used by Elemer of the Briar. Attacks with this armament utilize the iron thorns that have been wound around its frame. Originates from Eochaid, a land of proudly solitary ascetics.
item:briar-greatshield.location: Defeat Elemer of the Briar in the Shaded Castle.

item:briar-greaves.name: Briar Greaves
item:briar-greaves.description: Battered iron greaves from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of the Briar.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 7 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:briar-greaves.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar.

item:briar-helm.name: Briar Helm
item:briar-helm.description: Battered iron helm from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of he Brair.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:briar-helm.location: - Purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for  4,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar at The Shaded Castle.

item:briars-of-punishment.name: Briars Of Punishment
item:briars-of-punishment.description: An aberrant sorcery discovered by exiled criminals. Theirs are the sorceries most reviled by the academy. Wounds the caster with thorns of sin, sending a trail of bloodthorns running over the ground to impale enemies from below. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. The guilty, their eyes gouged by thorns, lived in eternal darkness. There, they discovered the blood star.
item:briars-of-punishment.location:
**Loot:** Mountaintops of the Giants
- Located by a dead tree on the western cliffs of the southern end of the giant stone bridge surrounded by Guilty enemies.

stats.Effect: Wounds caster to unleash trail of bloodthrorns

item:briars-of-sin.name: Briars Of Sin
item:briars-of-sin.description: An aberrant sorcery, discovered along with red glintstone by those exiled to the north for their crimes. Summons large thorns from a whorl of blood shed by one's own hand in penance for sins. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. The Academy reviles this sorcery, which draws its power from faith.
item:briars-of-sin.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Obtained by defeating a lone Guilty located southwest of the Fire Monk Campsite, near the Church of Vows in Liurnia. This Sorcerer is near a group of Fire Slugs to the north of the Artist's Shack (Liurnia).

stats.Effect: Summons thorns from a whorl of your own blood.

item:brick-hammer.name: Brick Hammer
item:brick-hammer.description: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.
item:brick-hammer.location: The Brick Hammer is located in Stormveil Castle.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: The **Brick Hammer** is a Melee Armament in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Acquisition
sections.text: **Location**: Stormveil Castle - The Brick Hammer is found on a corpse in Stormveil Castle in the area within the wall past the Stormveil Cliffside site of grace. It is accessed by climbing the ladder behind the door unlocked by the Rusty Key and turning right to jump across the gap, crossing the beams, and then jumping to another platform leading to an opening in the wall. Follow the path outside and reenter at the round tower. The corpse hangs from a ledge.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - The Brick Hammer is a Great Hammer. - This weapon may reference the Revenger.

item:brick-hammer.strategy: - The Brick Hammer is a Great Hammer. - This weapon may reference the Revenger.

item:broadsword.name: Broadsword
item:broadsword.description: A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks. Horizontal swings boast wide attack range, making it easier to connect with foes.
item:broadsword.location: The Broadsword is the starting weapon for the Confessor class.

item:buckler.name: Buckler
item:buckler.description: A small metal roundshield. The bump in the center enables parrying techniques. A well-timed parry can break an enemy's stance, allowing a critical hit. Best suited for those prepared to take the risk to reap their reward.
item:buckler.location: Bought from Patches after his cave, Limgrave.

item:budding-cave-moss.name: Budding Cave Moss
item:budding-cave-moss.description: Faintly luminescent moss that grows in dark caves, speckled with tiny, yellow flowers. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:budding-cave-moss.location:
- Budding Cave Moss is found in caves throughout the Lands Between. It will respawn after being harvested.
  - Lakeside Crystal Cave
  - Perfumer's Grotto
- Dropped by Perfumers (x5, 8%) and Depraved Perfumers (x5, 15%).

item:budding-horn.name: Budding Horn
item:budding-horn.description: A rarely-seen specimen of a young, budding horn. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting herbivorous beasts.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:bull-goat-armor.name: Bull-goat Armor
item:bull-goat-armor.description: Great Horned Tragoth's armor. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise.

stats.Negation: Physical 20 · Strike 20 · Slash 18 · Pierce 18 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 13 · Holy 12

item:bull-goat-armor.location: Found in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:bull-goat-gauntlets.name: Bull-goat Gauntlets
item:bull-goat-gauntlets.description: Great Horned Tragoth's gauntlets. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:bull-goat-gauntlets.location: - The Bull-Goat Gauntlets are obtained by defeating Great Horned Tragoth at the Ruin-Strewn Precipice after receiving the Letter to Patches.

item:bull-goat-greaves.name: Bull-goat Greaves
item:bull-goat-greaves.description: Great Horned Tragoth's greaves. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 11 · Slash 10 · Pierce 10 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 8 · Holy 7

item:bull-goat-helm.name: Bull-goat Helm
item:bull-goat-helm.description: Great Horned Tragoth's helm, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provides high poise.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 7 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 5 · Holy 4

item:bull-goat-helm.location: - Obtained by defeating Great Horned Tragoth during Patches' assassination request in the arena of Magma Wyrm Makar at the Ruin-Strewn Precipice.

item:bull-goat-s-talisman.name: Bull-goat's Talisman
item:bull-goat-s-talisman.description: A talisman depicting the horns of a bull-goat. Raises poise.

stats.Effect: Raises Poise

item:bull-goat-s-talisman.location: Found in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:burn-o-flame.name: Burn O Flame!
item:burn-o-flame.description: One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the
item:burn-o-flame.location:
Trade the Remembrance of the Fire Giant, gained by defeating the Fire Giant, with Finger Reader Enia.

Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

stats.Effect: Raises a series of flame pillars around caster

item:butchering-knife.name: Butchering Knife
item:butchering-knife.description: Huge carving knife made to cleanly butcher the human body. Signature weapon of the Ogress Anastasia, known to have eaten countless Tarnished while disguised as a Finger Maiden.  Restores a very small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.
item:butchering-knife.location: The Butchering Knife is dropped by the NPC invader Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater.

item:caestus.name: Caestus
item:caestus.description: A weapon built for striking with the fists, made of tough leather inlaid with iron rivets. Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.
item:caestus.location: Purchase the standard Caestus from Gatekeeper Gostoc at Stormveil Castle or the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 800 Runes.

item:candletree-wooden-shield.name: Candletree Wooden Shield
item:candletree-wooden-shield.description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Thought to represent a surreptitious prophecy of cardinal sin, the lit candle-tree design was forbidden.
item:candletree-wooden-shield.location:
**Location**: Sage's Cave
- Found in a chest hidden behind an illusory wall in Sage's Cave.

item:cane-sword.name: Cane Sword
item:cane-sword.description: Beloved sword of an aged knight whose last quest was long behind him, repurposed into a walking stick. The tip is rather worn.  Though bent of back and without the brawn required even to raise the sword aloft, still he wished to meet his end with weapon in hand.
item:cane-sword.location: The Cane Sword is located in Leyndell, Royal Capital (or Leyndell, Ashen Capital in the late game).

item:cannon-of-haima.name: Cannon Of Haima
item:cannon-of-haima.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Lobs an explosive magic projectile that flies in an arc. Charging enhances potency. Drawn from the conspectus of Haima, the adjudicator of the academy, this sorcery employs might as a means to quell conflict.
item:cannon-of-haima.location:
Converted Fringe Tower, north-east Liurnia of the Lakes, not to be mistaken with the Converted Tower in the south-west.

You will need to use the Erudition gesture given by Thops in front of the statue of Marika. This will reveal a hidden ladder to the top of the tower with a treasure chest that contains the spell.

Unlike with the Converted Tower, here you will not only have to do the gesture, but also wear a glintstone crown headpiece while doing so.

 Show Patch Notes

stats.Effect: Lobs an explosive magic projectile in an arc

item:carian-filigreed-crest.name: Carian Filigreed Crest
item:carian-filigreed-crest.description: A talisman adorned with the royal crest.

stats.Effect: Lowers FP consumed by skills

item:carian-filigreed-crest.location: Bought from Iji, or found at the Kingsrealm Ruins.

item:carian-glintblade-staff.name: Carian Glintblade Staff
item:carian-glintblade-staff.description: Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff. Gifted to enchanted knights, it enhances Glintblade sorceries.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Int C

item:carian-glintblade-staff.location: The Carian Glintblade Staff is found on a corpse atop the Highway Lookout Tower in southeastern Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:carian-glintstone-staff.name: Carian Glintstone Staff
item:carian-glintstone-staff.description: Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff. Given to sorcerers that they might enact the role of knight. Enhances Carian sword sorceries.
item:carian-glintstone-staff.location: The Carian Glintstone Staff is located inside the Carian Study Hall in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:carian-grandeur.name: Carian Grandeur
item:carian-grandeur.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:"Carian Grandeur: Carian royal prestige embodied in a skill. Transform blade into a magical greatsword and swing it down. Can be charged to increase its power by up to two levels."Usable on swords (colossal weapons excepted).
item:carian-grandeur.location:
**Loot:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Found on a body in the Caria Manor. Requires dropping down multiple levels on the cliff to the south-east from the Royal Moongazing Grounds Site of Grace, where you'll come across a bunch of jar enemies and a Cracked Pot.
  - The precise spot is on top of the standalone gate on the path towards the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:carian-greatsword.name: Carian Greatsword
item:carian-greatsword.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family. Conjures a magic greatsword and then delivers a sweeping blow. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. Armed with this spell, sorcerers gain the strength of knights, their loyalty sworn to the moon.
item:carian-greatsword.location:
**Purchase:** Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 10,000 Runes by Miriel, Pastor of Vows.
- Should Miriel die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Miriel's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Performs sweeping slash using magical greatsword

item:carian-inverted.name: Carian Inverted Statue
item:carian-inverted.description: Statuette of a scholar, with ground and sky inverted.

stats.Effect: Key revealing the hidden form of Carian Study Hall

item:carian-knight-armor.name: Carian Knight Armor
item:carian-knight-armor.description: Armor of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 10 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 9 · Holy 11

item:carian-knight-armor.location: Can be found in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria.

item:carian-knight-armor-altered.name: Carian Knight Armor (altered)
item:carian-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Carian Knight Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 9 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 11 · Fire 11 · Lightning 9 · Holy 11

item:carian-knight-armor-altered.location: Can be found unaltered in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:carian-knight-gauntlets.name: Carian Knight Gauntlets
item:carian-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen,  were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 3 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:carian-knight-gauntlets.location:
**Location**: Academy of Raya Lucaria
- The Carian Knight Gauntlets are found in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

item:carian-knight-greaves.name: Carian Knight Greaves
item:carian-knight-greaves.description: Greaves of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all decorated heroes, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 7 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:carian-knight-greaves.location: Can be found in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria.

item:carian-knight-helm.name: Carian Knight Helm
item:carian-knight-helm.description: Helm of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:carian-knight-helm.location:
**Location**: Academy of Raya Lucaria
- The Carian Knight Helm is found in front of a prominent grave near the rotating lift inside the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

item:carian-knight-s-shield.name: Carian Knight's Shield
item:carian-knight-s-shield.description: A teardrop-shaped shield embedded with blue glintstones. Carried by knights who served the Carian royal family. Excels when facing magic or holy attacks. Just who were these knights preparing to fight?

item:carian-knight-s-sword.name: Carian Knight's Sword
item:carian-knight-s-sword.description: Straight sword embedded with a blue glintstone.  Weapon of knights sworn to Carian royalty. These knights' swords could serve as catalysts, letting them wield sorcerous battle skills. Despite numbering fewer than twenty, this power made them a match for even the champions of gold in battle.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int D

item:carian-knight-s-sword.location: The Carian Knight's Sword is located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:carian-phalanx.name: Carian Phalanx
item:carian-phalanx.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.
item:carian-phalanx.location:
**Purchase:** Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 12,000 Runes by Preceptor Seluvis.
- Should Seluvis die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Seluvis's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Forms a defensive arch of numerous magic glintblades

item:carian-piercer.name: Carian Piercer
item:carian-piercer.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.
item:carian-piercer.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Acquired from felling a Scarab in Caria Manor, located on the cliffs littered with Living Jars south of the Royal Moongazing Grounds Site of Grace.

stats.Effect: Impales foes with magical greatsword

item:carian-regal-scepter.name: Carian Regal Scepter
item:carian-regal-scepter.description: Magic scepter of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. The glintstone is known as a Carian Blue, enhancing full moon sorceries. Only those of the highest intelligence may wield this, the finest of all glintstone staves.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Int B

item:carian-regal-scepter.location: To get the Carian Regal Scepter, you must defeat Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, at the Raya Lucaria Grand Library in Liurnia of the Lakes.
related: Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen
Remembrance of The Full Moon Queen

item:carian-retaliation.name: Carian Retaliation
item:carian-retaliation.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.
item:carian-retaliation.location:
**Purchase:** Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 9,000 Runes by Preceptor Seluvis.
- Should Seluvis die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Seluvis's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Dispels enemy spells and retaliates with glintblades

item:carian-retaliation-unused-1.name: Carian Retaliation (Unused 1)
item:carian-retaliation-unused-1.location:
**Purchase:** Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 9,000 Runes by Preceptor Seluvis.
- Should Seluvis die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Seluvis's Bell Bearing.

item:carian-retaliation-unused-2.name: Carian Retaliation (Unused 2)
item:carian-retaliation-unused-2.location:
**Purchase:** Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 9,000 Runes by Preceptor Seluvis.
- Should Seluvis die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Seluvis's Bell Bearing.

item:carian-slicer.name: Carian Slicer
item:carian-slicer.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.
item:carian-slicer.location: Sold by Sellen, or her corpse if her line is finished.

stats.Effect: Performs swift sweeping slash using magical sword

item:carian-sorcery-sword.name: Carian Sorcery Sword

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int D

item:carian-sorcery-sword.location: This item can be found in a chest in Castle Ensis after dropping down from Scadu Altus.

item:carian-thrusting-shield.name: Carian Thrusting Shield

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int D

item:carian-thrusting-shield.location: Found on a corpse in the Shadow Keep's Specimen Storehouse's back section, reached from the Church District. The shield is found by going past the tall ladder. It is guarded by a Fire Knight.

item:catch-flame.name: Catch Flame
item:catch-flame.location:
**Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
- Sold for  600 Runes by Brother Corhyn.
- Should Corhyn die before purchasing this incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.
- Starting equipment for the Prophet Origin.

item:cave-moss.name: Cave Moss
item:cave-moss.description: Faintly luminescent moss that grows in dark caves. Material used in crafting items. A fundamental ingredient for medicinal boluses.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:cave-moss.location:
- Harvestable Cave Moss is found in caves throughout the Lands Between:
  - Groveside Cave
  - Stillwater Cave
  - Abandoned Cave

item:celebrant-s-cleaver.name: Celebrant's Cleaver
item:celebrant-s-cleaver.description: Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.
item:celebrant-s-cleaver.location: The Celebrant's Cleaver is obtained by farming dancing celebrating women enemies in Dominula, Windmill Village located at the northern edge of the Altus Plateau.

item:celebrant-s-rib-rake.name: Celebrant's Rib-rake
item:celebrant-s-rib-rake.description: Rake decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.
item:celebrant-s-rib-rake.location: The Celebrant's Rib-Rake is a rare drop found by defeating specific dancing celebrant enemies in Windmill Village (Dominula) located in the northern Altus Plateau.

item:celebrant-s-sickle.name: Celebrant's Sickle
item:celebrant-s-sickle.description: Sickle decorated with flowers and many-coloured fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.
item:celebrant-s-sickle.location: You can get the Celebrant's Sickle in Elden Ring as a rare drop from blue-garbed dancing enemies at Dominula, Windmill Village on the northern Altus Plateau.

item:celebrant-s-skull.name: Celebrant's Skull
item:celebrant-s-skull.description: Large bludgeon ecorated with flowers and many-colored fabrics.  Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.   The striking end is a skull too large in size to be human. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.
item:celebrant-s-skull.location: The Celebrant's Skull in Elden Ring is found on a corpse at Dominula, Windmill Village in the Altus Plateau.

item:celestial-dew.name: Celestial Dew
item:celestial-dew.description: A hidden Tear found in the Eternal City. Also known as a Night Tear.

stats.Effect: Carry out Absolution at the Church of Vows

item:celestial-dew.location: **NOTE**: Only 10 Celestial Dew can be acquired per playthrough. 1. Liurnia of the Lakes (Main Academy Gate): Behind the southern gate of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, guarded by a Bloodhound Knight. 1. Liurnia of the Lakes (Caria Manor): Purchase from Pidia, Carian Servant (×1, 5000 Runes). 1. Ainsel River (Ainsel River Sluice Gate): On a corpse hanging from a ledge, west of the Site of Grace. 1. Ainsel River (Uhl Palace Ruins): Above the entrance to the Uhl Palace Ruins. 1. Ainsel River (Ainsel River Downstream): Purchase from Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River) (×1, 7500 Runes) 1.

item:cerulean-amber-medallion.name: Cerulean Amber Medallion
item:cerulean-amber-medallion.description: A medallion with cerulean amber inlaid. Boosts maximum FP.

stats.Effect: Raises maximum FP

item:cerulean-amber-medallion.location: - Obtained by defeating the Bloodhound Knight in Lakeside Crystal Cave in southern Liurnia of the Lakes

item:cerulean-crystal-tear.name: Cerulean Crystal Tear
item:cerulean-crystal-tear.description: A special crystallization formed over the course of many moons within a tear of life, a blessing of the Erdtree. Can be mixed in a flask of wondrous physick. The resulting concoction restores 20 half of one's max FP.

stats.Effect: Restores half of total FP in mixed physick.

item:cerulean-crystal-tear.location:
A total of two can be acquired by defeating the Erdtree Avatar at the following locations:
- Minor Erdtree in Liurnia of the Lakes western region.
- Minor Erdtree in Mountaintops of the Giants eastern region.

item:cerulean-hidden-tear.name: Cerulean Hidden Tear
item:cerulean-hidden-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Eliminates all FP consumption in mixed physick

item:cerulean-hidden-tear.location: Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit at the Minor Erdtree on Mt. Gelmir.

item:cerulean-seed-talisman.name: Cerulean Seed Talisman
item:cerulean-seed-talisman.description: A cerulean-colored talisman patterned after an Erdtree seed. Boosts FP restoration from the Flask of Cerulean Tears.

stats.Effect: Boosts FP restoration from Flask of Cerulean Tears

item:cerulean-seed-talisman.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Carian Study Hall, in easter Liurnia of the Lakes, without the Carian Inverted Statue placed on the altar. The corpse can be found on the upper-most level of rafters in the tower, which you can climb to with ladders.

item:cerulean-tear-scarab.name: Cerulean Tear Scarab
item:cerulean-tear-scarab.description: Blue scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of cerulean tears during their labors.

stats.Negation: Physical -5 · Strike -5 · Slash -5 · Pierce -5 · Magic -4 · Fire -4 · Lightning -4 · Holy -5

item:cerulean-tear-scarab.location:
**Location**: Sellia, Town of Sorcery
- The Cerulean Tear Scarab is found on a corpse on the rooftops in the northeastern section of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

item:chain-armor.name: Chain Armor
item:chain-armor.description: Armor made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, it offers dependable protection.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 8 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 7 · Fire 10 · Lightning 6 · Holy 8

item:chain-coif.name: Chain Coif
item:chain-coif.description: Coif made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, it offers dependable protection.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:chain-coif.location:
**Location**: Church of Elleh
- The Chain Coif is purchased from Merchant Kalé at the Church of Elleh for  1,000 runes.
- Alternatively, it can be purchased for the same price from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold after giving them Kalé's Bell Bearing.

item:chain-draped-tabard.name: Chain-draped Tabard
item:chain-draped-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with a chainmail shawl draped over the shoulders. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 10 · Slash 9 · Pierce 9 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 10

item:chain-draped-tabard.location: Chance to drop from Godrick Foot Soldier enemies that wear it.

item:chain-gauntlets.name: Chain Gauntlets
item:chain-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, they offer dependable protection.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 1 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 1

item:chain-gauntlets.location: - The Chain Gauntlets can be purchased from Merchant Kalé for  1,000 runes.

item:chain-leggings.name: Chain Leggings
item:chain-leggings.description: Leggings made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, they offer dependable protection.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 6 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:chainlink-flail.name: Chainlink Flail
item:chainlink-flail.description: A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads. Especially large for a flail, wielding it requires more strength than it does dexterity.
item:chainlink-flail.location: The Chainlink Flail drops from Lesser Mad Pumpkin Head enemies who wield it.

item:champion-bracers.name: Champion Bracers
item:champion-bracers.description: Bracers reserved for the bandlands' bravest.  Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes.  Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 1 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:champion-bracers.location:
- The Champion Bracers are the starting armwear of the Hero Origin.
- The Champion Bracers can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid) for  1,000 runes.

item:champion-gauntlets.name: Champion Gauntlets
item:champion-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 1 · Fire 1 · Lightning 1 · Holy 1

item:champion-headband.name: Champion Headband
item:champion-headband.description: Headband reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:champion-headband.location:
- The Champion Headband is starting equipment for the Hero origin.
- Purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in southern Caelid for  1,000 runes.

item:champion-pauldron.name: Champion Pauldron
item:champion-pauldron.description: Pauldron reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 8 · Slash 6 · Pierce 7 · Magic 7 · Fire 8 · Lightning 9 · Holy 8

item:champion-pauldron.location:
Starting gear for the Hero class.

Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid).

item:charge-forth.name: Charge Forth
item:charge-forth.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Charge Forth: Quickly charge forward with the armament at the hip, carrying the momentum into a thrust. Hold to cover a greater distance."Usable on polearms capable of thrusting, heavy thrusting swords, and twinblades.
item:charge-forth.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
