- Drops from a Teardrop Scarab in Liurnia of the Lakes. North of the Fallen Ruins of the Lake Site of Grace, hanging from the ceiling in an archway above a bunch of poison-spewing Land Squirt.  A bow is advised to hit the scarab and make it fall.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:cherishing-fingers.name: Cherishing Fingers
item:cherishing-fingers.location:
**Loot:** Scadu Altus
- Found in the small graveyard attached to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr after completing Count Ymir's questline.

item:chilling-mist.name: Chilling Mist
item:chilling-mist.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Cold affinity and the following skill:"Chilling Mist: Coat armament in frost, and then slash, spreading frigid mist forwards. The armament retains its frost for a while."Usable on melee armaments (whips, fists, and claws excepted).
item:chilling-mist.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Drops from a Scarab found in the Ruins southeast of Renna's Rise behind Caria Manor.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:chilling-perfume-bottle.name: Chilling Perfume Bottle
item:chilling-perfume-bottle.location: Found on a corpse inside the Lamenter's Gaol.

item:chrysalids-memento.name: Chrysalids' Memento
item:chrysalids-memento.description: Memento left by the chrysalids sacrificed for grafting. A brooch wrapped in red velvet. Traces of blood are visible.

stats.Effect: Broach wrapped in red velvet

item:cinquedea.name: Cinquedea
item:cinquedea.description: Short sword given to high ranking clergymen of Farum Azula. Raises potency of bestial incantations. The design celebrates a beast's five fingers, symbolic of the intelligence once granted upon their kind.
item:cinquedea.location: The Cinquedea is located on a broken statue at the bottom of the exterior cliffs behind the Bestial Sanctum in Caelid.

item:cipher-pata.name: Cipher Pata
item:cipher-pata.description: One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage. The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.
item:cipher-pata.location: The Cipher Pata is located in the Roundtable Hold.

item:clarifying-boluses.name: Clarifying Boluses
item:clarifying-boluses.description: Yellow boluses made of cave moss. Craftable item. Alleviates madness buildup. Madness accumulates slowly, inflicting heavy damage and reducing FP once the threshold is reached. Take one of these in timely fashion to avoid such events.

stats.Effect: Alleviates madness buildup

item:clarifying-boluses.location: Craftable — Dewkissed Herba x2, Crystal Cave Moss x1, Eye of Yelough x1

item:clarifying-cured-meat.name: Clarifying Cured Meat
item:clarifying-cured-meat.description: Cured strip of meat, dried out after pickling in a purple medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily boosts focus. Higher focus helps to mitigate the buildup of sleep and madness.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts focus

item:clarifying-cured-meat.location: Craftable — Rimed Rowa x5, Sliver of Meat x1, Slumbering Egg x1, Eye of Yelough x1

item:clarifying-horn-charm.name: Clarifying Horn Charm
item:clarifying-horn-charm.description: An accoutrement worn by the ancestral followers. Raises focus. (Focus governs resistance to sleep and madness.)

stats.Effect: Raises Focus

item:clarifying-horn-charm.location: - Obtained from a corpse, lying on the stairs in northern Siofra River, near the Beneath the Well Sites of Grace (this is the entrance area to the region if using the Deep Siofra Well in Caelid).

item:clarifying-white-cured-meat.name: Clarifying White Cured Meat
item:clarifying-white-cured-meat.description: A white sliced meat, dried out after pickling in a purple medicinal solution. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts focus

item:claw-talisman.name: Claw Talisman
item:claw-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a claw and an assassin. Enhances jump attacks.

stats.Effect: Enhances jump attacks.

item:claw-talisman.location: Found on a corpse on the Stormveil cliffside route.

item:clawmark-seal.name: Clawmark Seal
item:clawmark-seal.description: A sacred seal given by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. A rare trinket which allows incantations to be scaled with strength.  The claw mark represents Gurranq's wrath. Enhances bestial incantations learned from Gurranq.
item:clawmark-seal.location: You get the Clawmark Seal by taking a Deathroot to Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman, located at the Bestial Sanctum in Caelid.

item:claws-of-night.name: Claws of Night
item:claws-of-night.location: Dropped by Swordhand of Night Anna in the Finger Ruins of Miyr.

item:clayman-ashes.name: Clayman Ashes
item:clayman-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two claymen. Bowed with age, these spirits are sluggish but hard to stagger. The warped remains of priests who searched for revelation in service of the ancient dynasty, they employ two sorceries that produce smaller and larger bubbles.

stats.Effect: Summons two clayman spirits

item:clayman-ashes.location: Found in the northern Uhl Palace Ruins on a corpse at the top of the waterfall.

item:clayman-s-harpoon.name: Clayman's Harpoon
item:clayman-s-harpoon.description: Harpoon with a tip made from a sharpened meteorite shard. Wielded by the claymen who infest dynastic remains. The blade emits a faint light and deals magic damage.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:clayman-s-harpoon.location: The Clayman's Harpoon is a rare drop farmed from Clayman enemies wielding spears.

item:claymore.name: Claymore
item:claymore.description: A large sword with a long, straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient. In addition to the heavy sweeping attacks, it can also make a heavy piercing thrust making this a versatile weapon.
item:claymore.location: The Claymore is located in Castle Morne, situated at the southernmost tip of the Weeping Peninsula.

item:cleanrot-armor.name: Cleanrot Armor
item:cleanrot-armor.description: Armor of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering. The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles fiercest of all.

stats.Negation: Physical 14 · Strike 13 · Slash 16 · Pierce 17 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 11 · Holy 13

item:cleanrot-armor.location: Chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

item:cleanrot-armor-altered.name: Cleanrot Armor (altered)
item:cleanrot-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Cleanrot Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 12 · Slash 14 · Pierce 16 · Magic 11 · Fire 12 · Lightning 10 · Holy 13

item:cleanrot-armor-altered.location: Chance to drop unaltered from Cleanrot Knight enemies. It can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:cleanrot-gauntlets.name: Cleanrot Gauntlets
item:cleanrot-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering. The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles fiercest of all.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:cleanrot-gauntlets.location: - The Cleanrot Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

item:cleanrot-greaves.name: Cleanrot Greaves
item:cleanrot-greaves.description: Greaves of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 7 · Slash 9 · Pierce 10 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 6 · Holy 7

item:cleanrot-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

item:cleanrot-helm.name: Cleanrot Helm
item:cleanrot-helm.description: Winged helm of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:cleanrot-helm.location: - The Cleanrot Helm has a 3.0% chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

item:cleanrot-helm-altered.name: Cleanrot Helm (altered)
item:cleanrot-helm-altered.description: Lighter version of the Cleanrot Helm

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:cleanrot-helm-altered.location: - Obtained by altering the Cleanrot Helm at a Site of Grace or through Boc the Seamster. The Cleanrot Helm has a 3.00% chance to drop from Cleanrot Knights.

item:cleanrot-knight-finlay-ashes.name: Cleanrot Knight Finlay Ashes
item:cleanrot-knight-finlay-ashes.description: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of the Cleanrot Knight Finlay. Finlay was one of the few survivors of the Battle of Aeonia, who in an unimaginable act of heroism carried the slumbering demigod Malenia all the way back to the Haligtree. She managed the feat alone, fending off all manner of foes along the way.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Cleanrot Knight Finlay

item:cleanrot-knight-finlay-ashes.location: In a treasure chest at Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, guarded by a Cleanrot Knight. Located north of the Prayer Room grace on a rooftop that you need to jump down to from a rafter.

item:cleanrot-knight-s-sword.name: Cleanrot Knight's Sword
item:cleanrot-knight-s-sword.description: Piercing sword of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Mainly used as a backup weapon, in combination with a long- handled armament.
item:cleanrot-knight-s-sword.location: The Cleanrot Knight's Sword drops from non-boss Cleanrot Knights, most notably in the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid or outside the Prayer Room in Elphael.

item:cleanrot-spear.name: Cleanrot Spear
item:cleanrot-spear.description: Spear of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Melania, Blade of Miquella. The winged golden blade deals holy damage. The diminutive shieldd is blessed with an incnantation that wards off rot.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:cleanrot-spear.location: The Cleanrot Spear is a random drop from spear-wielding Lesser Cleanrot Knights.

item:clinging-bone.name: Clinging Bone
item:clinging-bone.description: Horrific weapon made of a hardened skeletal arm. Wielded by Ensha of the Royal Remains. Fitted by placing one's hands into the fists' grips until they dig in. ""O clinging creature. A king relinquishes not the hand.""

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Arc D

item:clinging-bone.location: To get the Clinging Bone in Elden Ring, you must trigger an invasion by Ensha of the Royal Remains in the Roundtable Hold.

item:cloth-garb.name: Cloth Garb
item:cloth-garb.description: Clothing made of coarse material, commonly worn in the Lands Between.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 4 · Slash 2 · Pierce 4 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 11 · Holy 12

item:cloth-garb.location: Found in a chest inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

item:cloth-trousers.name: Cloth Trousers
item:cloth-trousers.description: Trousers made of coarse material, commonly worn in the Lands Between.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 2 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 6 · Holy 7

item:cloth-trousers.location: Found in a chest inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

item:club.name: Club
item:club.description: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength and persistence to hammer your foe into the ground.
item:club.location: Club: Can be purchased for 600 runes from the Nomadic Merchant on the northwestern beach of West Limgrave.

item:coded-sword.name: Coded Sword
item:coded-sword.description: Hidden sword once granted to the Tarnished of the Roundtable by the Two Fingers. A formless cipher comprises its blade, which deals holy damage no shield can repel. Champions would gather at the Roundtable Hold in days long past, when the Two Fingers were masters of oration, their flesh yet full of vigor.
item:coded-sword.location: The Coded Sword is located in the Leyndell, Royal Capital on the ground floor of a dark, abandoned replica of the Roundtable Hold.

item:coil-shield.name: Coil Shield
item:coil-shield.description: An extremely odd shield adorned with a coiled bronze snake. An excellent choice for attention-seekers. This Shield provides an effective defense against poison - after all, how does one poison a poisonous snake?
item:coil-shield.location: Found on a corpse within one of the tunnel rooms in Volcano Cave on Mt. Gelmir. Take the tunnel to the right of the chamber past the grace and drop down the ledge to find the tunnel to the shield.

item:collapsing-stars.name: Collapsing Stars
item:collapsing-stars.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.
item:collapsing-stars.location:
**Loot:** War-Dead Catacombs
- Acquired from a treasure chest in the middle of the scarlet swamp water in the lower levels of the large hall where all the phantoms are fighting each other.

stats.Effect: Pulls foes toward caster with gravity projectile volley

item:comet.name: Comet
item:comet.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires a great magical comet. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency. The greatest of the Karolos Conspectus's sorceries, that only a very few sorcerers have ever mastered.
item:comet.location:
**Loot:** Academy of Raya Lucaria
- Found on a corpse behind an Illusory Wall near the entrance to the Debate Parlor.

stats.Effect: Fires a great magic comet

item:comet-azur.name: Comet Azur
item:comet-azur.description: Legendary sorcery devised by Azur, primeval sorcerer. Fires a tremendous comet in a torrent akin to the distant starry expanse, the place said to be the origin of glintstone. Hold to continue releasing the sorcery's power. When Azur glimpsed into the primeval current, he saw darkness. He was left both bewitched and fearful of the abyss.
item:comet-azur.location: Primeval Sorcerer Azur on the cliff after Hermit Village. Starts Sellen’s primeval ending.

stats.Effect: Fires a tremendous comet within a starry torrent

item:commander-s-standard.name: Commander's Standard
item:commander-s-standard.description: A beaten red battle standard is furled around this time-worn halberd. Even after his lord was fled, Commander O'Neil continued to brandish this flag in the devastation of the rot-eaten field of battle, the sole veteran who remembers this battle with pride.
item:commander-s-standard.location: The Commander's Standard is dropped by Commander O'Neil, a world boss located in the heart of the Swamp of Aeonia in central Caelid.

item:commoner-s-garb.name: Commoner's Garb
item:commoner-s-garb.description: Garb with a thick embroidered cape attached. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:commoner-s-garb.location: Chance to drop for Commoner enemies.

item:commoner-s-garb-altered.name: Commoner's Garb (altered)
item:commoner-s-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the Commoner's Garb

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 5 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:commoner-s-garb-altered.location: Chance to drop unaltered for Commoner enemies. Can be altered at a Site of Grace or by Boc.

item:commoner-s-headband.name: Commoner's Headband
item:commoner-s-headband.description: A headband with the cloth removed. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

stats.Negation: Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:commoner-s-headband.location:
**Location**: Temple of Eiglay
- The Commoner's Headband is found on top of the head of a serpent statue in Volcano Manor, right after the  Temple of Eiglay grace.

item:commoner-s-headband-altered.name: Commoner's Headband (altered)
item:commoner-s-headband-altered.description: Lighter version of the Commoner's Headband

stats.Negation: Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:commoner-s-headband-altered.location: Chance to drop from Commoner enemies.

item:commoner-s-shoes.name: Commoner's Shoes
item:commoner-s-shoes.description: Modest shoes made of cloth. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between. Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 7 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 7

item:commoner-s-shoes.location: Chance to drop for Commoner enemies.

item:commoner-s-simple-garb.name: Commoner's Simple Garb
item:commoner-s-simple-garb.description: Garb with a modest cloth cape attached. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between. The board hung from the neck depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. This is a self-imposed shackle, a voluntary display of allegiance to the Erdtree that increases faith.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:commoner-s-simple-garb.location: Found on a corpse right next to the Gateside Chamber grace inside Stormveil Castle.

item:commoner-s-simple-garb-altered.name: Commoner's Simple Garb (altered)
item:commoner-s-simple-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the Commoner's Simple Garb

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 5 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:commoner-s-simple-garb-altered.location: Unaltered version can be found on a corpse right next to the Gateside Chamber grace inside Stormveil Castle. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:companion-jar.name: Companion Jar
item:companion-jar.description: A talisman given by the jars to their friends. Raises potency of thrown jars.

stats.Effect: Raises potency of throwing pots

item:companion-jar.location: - Obtained from Jar Bairn, in Jarburg, after completing his questline, by giving him Alexander's Innards.

item:composite-bow.name: Composite Bow
item:composite-bow.description: Bow composited from a mix of Materials.  Demands high attributes, and is tricky to wield, but is a fearsome tool when mastered.
item:composite-bow.location: The Composite Bow is sold by a Nomadic Merchant in the northern region of Liurnia of the Lakes for 3,500 Runes.

item:concealing-veil.name: Concealing Veil
item:concealing-veil.description: Talisman put together from dark cloth with a lustrous sheen

stats.Effect: Conceals wearer while crouching away from foes

item:concealing-veil.location: Dropped by a Black Knife Assassin in Liurnia.

item:confessor-armor.name: Confessor Armor
item:confessor-armor.description: Black leather armor for blending in with the darkness. Worn by church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 10 · Slash 8 · Pierce 9 · Magic 11 · Fire 11 · Lightning 12 · Holy 10

item:confessor-armor.location:
Starting gear for the Confessor class.

Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).

item:confessor-armor-altered.name: Confessor Armor (altered)
item:confessor-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Confessor Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 9 · Slash 7 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 11 · Holy 9

item:confessor-armor-altered.location:
Starting gear for the Confessor class (unaltered).

Purchased unaltered from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).

Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

item:confessor-boots.name: Confessor Boots
item:confessor-boots.description: Leather boots of the church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 5 · Slash 4 · Pierce 5 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 5

item:confessor-boots.location:
Starting gear for the Confessor class.

Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).

item:confessor-gloves.name: Confessor Gloves
item:confessor-gloves.description: Black leather gloves of the church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 3 · Holy 2

item:confessor-gloves.location:
- The Confessor Gloves are the starting armwear of the Confessor Origin.
- The Confessor Gloves can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir) for  1,000 runes.

item:confessor-hood.name: Confessor Hood
item:confessor-hood.description: Black hood for blending in with the darkness. Worn by church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:confessor-hood.location:
- The Confessor Hood is starting equipment for the Confessor class.
- Purchased from the Nomadic Merchant on Mt. Gelmir for  1,000 runes.

item:confessor-hood-altered.name: Confessor Hood (altered)
item:confessor-hood-altered.description: Lighter version of the Confessor Hood

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 2

item:confessor-hood-altered.location: - Obtained by altering the Confessor Hood at a Site of Grace or through Boc the Seamster.

item:consort-s-mask.name: Consort's Mask
item:consort-s-mask.description: Mask worn by Tanith, Lady of the Volcano Manor, in the image of a foreign queen.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 5 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:consort-s-mask.location:
**Location**: Volcano Manor
- The Consort's Mask is dropped by Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress upon her death at the  Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy Site of Grace in Volcano Manor.

item:consort-s-robe.name: Consort's Robe
item:consort-s-robe.description: Fine robe of white silk worn by Tanith, Lady of the Volcano Manor.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 5 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:consort-s-trousers.name: Consort's Trousers
item:consort-s-trousers.description: Fine white trousers, perfectly suited for wearing beneath a silk robe.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 3 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:consort-s-trousers.location:
- Can be bought from the Hermit Merchant in Altus Plateau
- Dropped upon ending Tanith's questline

item:corhyn-s-robe.name: Corhyn's Robe
item:corhyn-s-robe.description: Robe of Corhyn the cleric. Even after exile, Corhyn refused to recant his prophecies. And for this, he was blessed with the guidance of grace. Since then, the cart wheel draped on his neck has served as a reminder. That true guidance awaits those with iron wills. Those with unwavering faith.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:corhyn-s-robe.location:
- Dropped by Brother Corhyn if killed.
- If Corhyn's questline was not completed, it will appear at the last spot he was seen after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.
- If Corhyn was offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness it will be in his location in the Mountaintops of the Giants.
- If Corhyn was not offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness, it will appear in Leyndell, Ashen Capital after speaking to him and reloading the area.

item:crab-eggs.name: Crab Eggs
item:crab-eggs.description: Eggs of lare crabs which dwell in the shallows. Materials used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:cracked-crystal.name: Cracked Crystal
item:cracked-crystal.description: A cracked, impure, degraded, and altogether unremarkable crystal. Material used for crafting items

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:cracked-pot.name: Cracked Pot
item:cracked-pot.description: This empty pot somehow mends itself when broken.

stats.Effect: Container required for crafting cracked pot items

item:crafting-kit.name: Crafting Kit
item:crafting-kit.description: Leather bag containing a pestle and mortar, small blade, and various other tools. Enables item crafting from the main menu. Provides both means to fight and means to survive.

stats.Effect: Enables the practice of item Crafting

item:crafting-kit.location:
**Location**: Church of Elleh, Limgrave
- Purchased from Kalé for  300 Runes.

item:cranial-vessel-candlestand.name: Cranial Vessel Candlestand
item:cranial-vessel-candlestand.description: Candlestand used in worship of Birac, the most hallowed Monk Prelate of the Giants' Flame. Concerned over the lazy arrogance with which the monks treated the Flame, Birac severed his own head as a lesson to the others, intending it be used as a  candlestand. His faith yet smolders from within the cranial vessel.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:cranial-vessel-candlestand.location: The Cranial Vessel Candlestand is found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave dungeon in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:crepus-s-black-key-crossbow.name: Crepus's Black-key Crossbow
item:crepus-s-black-key-crossbow.description: Black crossbow featuring a long stock. Used for sniping, it has a very long range. Weapon of Crepus, who served the Two Fingers from the shadows of the Roundtable as the head confessor.
item:crepus-s-black-key-crossbow.location: You can find Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow at the Roundtable Hold, behind a Stonesword Key fog wall downstairs from the blacksmith.

item:crepus-s-vial.name: Crepus's Vial
item:crepus-s-vial.description: Small mysterious bottle with a dark mist sealed within.

stats.Effect: Eliminates all sound made by the wearer during movement

item:crepus-s-vial.location: - Obtained by killing Rileigh the Idle, in Altus Plateau, after invading their world to complete the second Volcano Manor assassination.

item:crescent-moon-axe.name: Crescent Moon Axe
item:crescent-moon-axe.description: Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia. Specializes in sweeping through foes by making use of its long handle.
item:crescent-moon-axe.location: The Crescent Moon Axe is a rare drop from the larger, axe-wielding Exile Soldiers in Stormveil Castle.

item:crimson-amber-medallion.name: Crimson Amber Medallion
item:crimson-amber-medallion.description: A medallion with Crimson amber inlaid. Boosts maximum HP. The Erdtree's old sap becomes amber, treasured as the most precious of jewels in the age of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. A primordial life energy resides inside

stats.Effect: Raises maximum HP

item:crimson-amber-medallion.location:
- May be chosen as a Keepsake when creating a new character.
- Purchased for 1,500 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace, north of Castle Morne in the Weeping Peninsula region.

item:crimson-bubbletear.name: Crimson Bubbletear
item:crimson-bubbletear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction automatically heals one's HP in the moment before death. However, this effect only occurs once, and will expire after a certain duration.

stats.Effect: Restores HP when near death in mixed physick.

item:crimson-bubbletear.location: Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in Mountaintops of the Giants, south-west of the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook Site of Grace.

item:crimson-crystal-tear.name: Crimson Crystal Tear
item:crimson-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction restores half of one's maximum HP.

stats.Effect: Restores half of total HP in mixed physick

item:crimson-crystal-tear.location:
- Left version: Third Church of Marika, found in a stone bowl together with the Flask of Wondrous Physick.
- Right version: Found in a basin under a Minor Erdtree in the Capital Outskirts in Altus Plateau, just north of Leyndell, Royal Capital. Found alongside the Twiggy Cracked Tear and guarded by an Omen and some Commoners.

item:crimson-hood.name: Crimson Hood
item:crimson-hood.description: A hooded cloak of vivid crimson.  Worn by expatriates royalty.  Increases vigor.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:crimson-hood.location:
- The Crimson Hood becomes available after Roderika becomes a Spirit Tuner or upon the player's arrival at Crumbling Farum Azula.
- It can be found near the  Rampart Tower Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle. It lies discarded on a mound of corpses in the courtyard adjacent to the room with the Grafted Scion, beneath a hanged troll.

item:crimson-seed-talisman.name: Crimson Seed Talisman
item:crimson-seed-talisman.description: A crimson-colored talisman patterned after an Erdtree seed. Boosts HP restoration from the Flask of Crimson Tears.

stats.Effect: Boosts HP regeneration from Flask of Crimson Tears

item:crimson-seed-talisman.location: - Obtained from a corpse, in Sainted Hero's Grave, in central Altus Plateau. This corpse lies behind a semi-transparent fog wall, near the beginning of the dungeon, which can be unlocked by inserting one Stonesword Key into the adjacent imp statue.

item:crimson-tear-scarab.name: Crimson Tear Scarab
item:crimson-tear-scarab.description: Red scarab worn directly on the head. The red scarabs roll clumps of crimson tears during their labors.

stats.Negation: Physical -5 · Strike -5 · Slash -5 · Pierce -5 · Magic -4 · Fire -4 · Lightning -4 · Holy -5

item:crimson-tear-scarab.location:
**Location**: Volcano Manor
- The Crimson Tear Scarab is found on a corpse on a ledge beyond the Temple of Eiglay. To reach it, jump off the bridge where a Man-Serpent is first encountered.

item:crimsonburst-crystal-tear.name: Crimsonburst Crystal Tear
item:crimsonburst-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's

stats.Effect: Steadily restores HP for a time in mixed physick

item:crimsonburst-crystal-tear.location: Erdtree Avatar at the Weeping Peninsula's Minor Erdtree.

item:crimsonspill-crystal-tear.name: Crimsonspill Crystal Tear
item:crimsonspill-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily raises one's maximum HP.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts max HP in mixed physick

item:crimsonspill-crystal-tear.location: Dropped by the Wormface miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in central Altus Plateau, west of the Woodfolk Ruins.

item:crimsonwhorl-bubbletear.name: Crimsonwhorl Bubbletear
item:crimsonwhorl-bubbletear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction converts incoming damage into recovered HP instead. However, physical damage cannot be converted. This effect is only brief and will quickly expire.

stats.Effect: Converts damage received into HP in mixed physick.

item:crimsonwhorl-bubbletear.location: On a cliff in the Mountaintops of the Giants area, north-west of the forge and north-east of the Foot of the Forge grace. The path to it is guarded by many Fingercreepers.

item:cross-naginata.name: Cross-naginata
item:cross-naginata.description: Weapon consisting of a three-pronged blade affixed to a long pole. The long central blade closely resembles a katana. A weapon of the Land of Reeds, known for its ability to be wielded as a spear while still being capable of performing slashing attacks.
item:cross-naginata.location: The Cross-Naginata is located in the Gael Tunnel in Caelid.

item:crossed-tree-towershield.name: Crossed-tree Towershield
item:crossed-tree-towershield.description: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Emblazoned with an old, interleaving tree. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel
item:crossed-tree-towershield.location: Purchased from the Nomadic Merchant near the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace in Altus Plateau for 3800 Runes.

item:crucible-axe-armor.name: Crucible Axe Armor
item:crucible-axe-armor.description: Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Worn by the knight Ordovis and his men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

stats.Negation: Physical 17 · Strike 13 · Slash 16 · Pierce 16 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 11 · Holy 13

item:crucible-axe-armor.location: Received after defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave, located on the Altus Plateau.

item:crucible-axe-armor-altered.name: Crucible Axe Armor (altered)
item:crucible-axe-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Crucible Axe Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 16 · Strike 13 · Slash 16 · Pierce 16 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 10 · Holy 13

item:crucible-axe-armor-altered.location: Received as Crucible Axe Armor after defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave, located on the Altus Plateau. Crucible Axe Armor be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:crucible-axe-helm.name: Crucible Axe Helm
item:crucible-axe-helm.description: Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The axe ornamentation is the knight Ordovis's mark, displayed also by his men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:crucible-axe-helm.location:
**Location**: Auriza Hero's Grave
- The Crucible Axe Helm is received upon defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis and Crucible Knight duo boss within Auriza Hero's Grave in the Capital Outskirts.

item:crucible-feather-talisman.name: Crucible Feather Talisman
item:crucible-feather-talisman.description: A talisman fashioned from feathers that embody the aspects of various creatures. Said to have grown on the human body long ago.

stats.Effect: Improves dodge rolling but increases damage taken

item:crucible-feather-talisman.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Auriza Hero's Grave in the Leyndell, Royal Capital region. Make your way to the area where two chariots ride side-by-side, up and down a slope. At the bottom of this slope is a corpse, hanging off of a ledge above a pit. Drop into the pit from where this corpse lies to land on a beam, and continue dropping down into this pit, until landing on the top of a thin stone archway. Walk to the end of this archway and climb a ladder to reach another ramp, guarded by a single chariot.

item:crucible-gauntlets.name: Crucible Gauntlets
item:crucible-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Hold the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthen Aspects of the Crucible incantations. In time, the strength shown by these knights, and even their appearance, was seen as chaotic and deserving of scorn.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:crucible-gauntlets.location:
**Location**: Auriza Hero's Grave
- The Crucible Gauntlets are obtained by defeating Crucible Knight Ordovis and the Crucible Knight in Auriza Hero's Grave in the Altus Plateau.
- The Crucible Gauntlets are also found in a chest behind Crucible Knight Siluria in the Deeproot Depths.

item:crucible-greaves.name: Crucible Greaves
item:crucible-greaves.description: Greaves of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Hold the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthen Aspects of the Crucible incantations. In time, the strength shown by these knights, and even their appearance, was seen as chaotic and deserving of scorn.

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 8 · Slash 9 · Pierce 9 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 6 · Holy 7

item:crucible-greaves.location:
- Received after defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave, located on the Altus Plateau.
- Found inside a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in Deeproot Depths.

item:crucible-hornshield.name: Crucible Hornshield
item:crucible-hornshield.description: Greatshield of red-tinged gold carried by Crucible Knights. Features a great horn. An ancient holiness dwells within. The crucible horn skewers foes when performing shield bashes.
item:crucible-hornshield.location: The Crucible Hornshield is received upon defeating the Crucible Knight at the Siofra Aqueduct, near the Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs site of grace.

item:crucible-knot-talisman.name: Crucible Knot Talisman
item:crucible-knot-talisman.description: A talisman fashioned from a bony knot that embodies that aspects of various creatures. Said to have grown on the human body long ago.

stats.Effect: Reduces damage and impact of headshots

item:crucible-knot-talisman.location: - Obtained by killing the Omenkiller boss in Village of the Albinaurics, in southern Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:crucible-scale-talisman.name: Crucible Scale Talisman
item:crucible-scale-talisman.description: A talisman fashioned from a scale that embodies the aspects of various creatures. Said to have grown on the human body long ago.

stats.Effect: Reduces damage taken from critical hits

item:crucible-scale-talisman.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Leyndell Catacombs, in the Leyndell, Royal Capital region. The corpse is guarded by an Omen, which can be reached by lowering a fire-breathing pillar, and riding it back upward to reach the upper-level of the room.

item:crucible-tree-armor.name: Crucible Tree Armor
item:crucible-tree-armor.description: Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Worn by the knight Siluria and her men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

stats.Negation: Physical 17 · Strike 13 · Slash 17 · Pierce 15 · Magic 13 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 14

item:crucible-tree-armor.location: Found inside a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in Deeproot Depths.

item:crucible-tree-armor-altered.name: Crucible Tree Armor (altered)
item:crucible-tree-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Crucible Tree Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 17 · Strike 13 · Slash 16 · Pierce 15 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 10 · Holy 14

item:crucible-tree-armor-altered.location: Received as Crucible Tree Armor after looting a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in the Deeproot Depths. Crucible Tree Armor be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:crucible-tree-helm.name: Crucible Tree Helm
item:crucible-tree-helm.description: Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The great tree ornamentation is the knight Siluria's mark, displayed also by her men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 5 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:crucible-tree-helm.location: The Crucible Tree Helm is found inside a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in the Deeproot Depths.

item:crystal-barrage.name: Crystal Barrage
item:crystal-barrage.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
item:crystal-barrage.location:
**Purchase:** Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold.
- Sold for 1,500 Runes by Sorceress  Sellen in any of her locations other than Witchbane Ruins.
- Should Sellen die before purchasing this Sorcery from her, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Sellen's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Fires a volley of glintstone crystal shards

item:crystal-bud.name: Crystal Bud
item:crystal-bud.description: A young plant, crystalized before it could mature. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:crystal-bud.location: - Found widely across Liurnia of the Lakes, typically near trees.

item:crystal-burst.name: Crystal Burst
item:crystal-burst.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires a burst of glintstone crystal shards. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging increases potency. A sorcery of the Crystal Cadre, a group of sorcerers who pursued the wisdom of stone - the secrets locked in the faint cogitation of the Crystalians.
item:crystal-burst.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Weeping Peninsula
- Acquired from defeating the Demi-Human Queen of the Demi-Human Forest Ruins.

stats.Effect: Fires a burst of glintstone crystal shards

item:crystal-cave-moss.name: Crystal Cave Moss
item:crystal-cave-moss.description: Faintly luminescent moss that grows in dark caves, laced with fine crystals. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:crystal-cave-moss.location:
- Crystal Cave Moss is harvested in various caves throughout the Lands Between:
  - Stillwater Cave
  - Academy Crystal Cave
  - Sellia Hideaway
  - Dragonbarrow Cave
  - Sage's Cave

item:crystal-dart.name: Crystal Dart
item:crystal-dart.description: Throwing knife chiseled from impure crystal. Craftable item. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to deal magic damage. Long ago, it is said that a golem crafter employed a similar crystal tool.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Throw to inflict magic damage.

item:crystal-knife.name: Crystal Knife
item:crystal-knife.description: A knife made by sharpening hard crystal. Signature weapon of glintstone miners.  Used as a tool to extract glintstone from broken rock, and as such a faint magic enwreathes the blade.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int D

item:crystal-knife.location: The Crystal Knife is located inside the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel in the northeastern part of Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:crystal-release.name: Crystal Release
item:crystal-release.description: Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians. Creates a mass of crystal, then shatters it to scour a wide area with a violent rain of crystal shards. This sorcery is used by high-ranking adepts among the Crystalians. Some also call this sorcery "the Crystal Sun."
item:crystal-release.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Academy Crystal Cave
- Acquired from defeating the Crystalian duo guarding the end of the Academy Crystal Cave.

stats.Effect: Scours area with violent rain of crystal shards

item:crystal-spear.name: Crystal Spear
item:crystal-spear.description: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int E

item:crystal-spear.location: The Crystal Spear is hidden in Sellia Hideaway in northeastern Caelid.

item:crystal-staff.name: Crystal Staff
item:crystal-staff.description: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enhances Crystalian sorceris. The Crystalian's faint cognition is know as the "wisdom of stone." This staff can only be weilded by those of intellect high enough to grasp such wisdom.
item:crystal-staff.location: The standard Crystal Staff is found inside the Academy Crystal Cave in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:crystal-sword.name: Crystal Sword
item:crystal-sword.description: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:crystal-sword.location: The Crystal Sword is located in the Village of the Albinaurics in the southwestern area of Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:crystal-torrent.name: Crystal Torrent
item:crystal-torrent.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Caelid
- Acquired from defeating the Putrid Crystalians the end of the Sellia Hideaway.

stats.Effect: Creates crystal mass that fires stream of crystal shards

item:crystalian-ashes.name: Crystalian Ashes
item:crystalian-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Crystalian. Spirit that wields round crystalline blades, both big and small. Its sturdy body, itself hewn from crystal long ago, is hard enough to blunt its opponent's blades, but blows from bludgeoning weapons can shatter it easily.

stats.Effect: Summons Crystalian spirit

item:crystalian-ashes.location: Found in Sellia Hideaway, in a chest guarded by Glintstone Sorcerers.

item:cuckoo-glintstone.name: Cuckoo Glintstone
item:cuckoo-glintstone.description: Lump of broken glintstone enwreathed with magic power. A "faux sorcery"used by the Knights of the Cuckoo. Craftable item. Launched straight ahead, using FP. A magic bolt springs forth from the point of impact

stats.Effect: Uses FP to produce a magic bolt

item:cuckoo-greatshield.name: Cuckoo Greatshield
item:cuckoo-greatshield.description: Metal Greatshield painted with a peering cuckoo. Carried by the enchanted knights sworn to the academy. Boasting high magic damage negation, this shield is used to hunt down mages. Our Enemys is none other then caria itself
item:cuckoo-greatshield.location: - 4% chance to be dropped by Cuckoo Knights throughout Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:cuckoo-knight-armor.name: Cuckoo Knight Armor
item:cuckoo-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 14 · Pierce 13 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 8 · Holy 10

item:cuckoo-knight-armor.location: Chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

item:cuckoo-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Cuckoo Knight Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 14 · Pierce 13 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 8 · Holy 9

item:cuckoo-knight-armor-altered.location: Chance to drop unaltered from Cuckoo Knight enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:cuckoo-knight-gauntlets.name: Cuckoo Knight Gauntlets
item:cuckoo-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Time has yet to dull their luster.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:cuckoo-knight-gauntlets.location: - The Cuckoo Knight Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

item:cuckoo-knight-greaves.name: Cuckoo Knight Greaves
item:cuckoo-knight-greaves.description: Greaves worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Time has yet to dull their luster.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 8 · Pierce 7 · Magic 7 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:cuckoo-knight-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

item:cuckoo-knight-helm.name: Cuckoo Knight Helm
item:cuckoo-knight-helm.description: Helm worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Its brow is adorned with a single cuckoo's feather.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:cuckoo-knight-helm.location: Chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

item:cuckoo-surcoat.name: Cuckoo Surcoat
item:cuckoo-surcoat.description: Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. The surcoat depicts twinned cuckoos peering into a flourishing mass of glintstone. To a glintstone sorcerer, the body is a transient thing. The Cuckoo alone knows its insignificance, yet watches over it all the same.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 10 · Slash 13 · Pierce 12 · Magic 11 · Fire 10 · Lightning 7 · Holy 8

item:cuckoo-surcoat.location: Chance to drop from Raya Lucaria Soldier enemies.

item:cure-poison.name: Cure Poison
item:cure-poison.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
item:cure-poison.location:
**Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
- Cure Poison is sold for  800 Runes by Brother Corhyn.
- Should Corhyn die before purchasing this Incantation from him, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Cures Poison ailment and reduces poison build-up.

item:curseblade-s-cirque.name: Curseblade's Cirque
item:curseblade-s-cirque.location: It has a 3% chance to be dropped when defeating a Curseblade anywhere in the Realm of Shadow, except for the one perched up on a beam inside the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, which has a 2% to drop this item instead.

item:cursed-blood-pot.name: Cursed-blood Pot
item:cursed-blood-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Decorated with the crest of the Lord of Blood. Throw at enemies to douse them in accursed blood, causing summoned spirits to assail them with a rabid fervor. A childhood memory of the Lord of Blood.

stats.Effect: Throw to douse enemy with accursed blood.

item:cursed-blood-pot.location: Craftable — Mushroom x2, Beast Blood x1, Bloodrose x1, Ritual Pot x1

item:cursemark-of-death.name: Cursemark Of Death
item:cursemark-of-death.description: Cursemark carved into the discarded flesh of Ranni the Witch. Also known as the half-wheel wound of the centipede.

stats.Effect: Cursemark carved into Lunar Princess Ranni's discarded flesh

item:curved-club.name: Curved Club
item:curved-club.description: Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded instead of a curved sword by Albinaurics lacking dexterity. The only point of similarity between the two is the shape.
item:curved-club.location: The Curved Club is a farmable weapon dropped by Albinaurics wielding it in the Liurnia of the Lakes region.

item:curved-great-club.name: Curved Great Club
item:curved-great-club.description: Large curved club of hard wood, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded by Albinaurics lacking the dexterity demanded by a curved sword, and who prefer the added weight and destructive force.
item:curved-great-club.location: The Curved Great Club is a farmable drop from the larger Second-Generation Albinaurics (the big gray frog-like creatures) in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:curved-sword-talisman.name: Curved Sword Talisman
item:curved-sword-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a curved sword and a swordsman. Enhances guard counters.

stats.Effect: Enhances guard counters.

item:curved-sword-talisman.location: Found on a corpse inside Stormveil Castle.

item:daedicar-s-woe.name: Daedicar's Woe
item:daedicar-s-woe.description: Disturbing likeness of a woman whose skin was flayed. She smiles with a serene tenderness.

stats.Effect: Increases damage taken

item:daedicar-s-woe.location:
**Quest Item:** Volcano Manor
- Obtained from Rya towards the end of her questline, after she realizes the truth of her origin and requests the player to kill her.
- She will drop it if she is killed.
- It can also be found lying on the floor after Rya leaves the room:
- Either after giving her the Tonic of Forgetfulness (received from Tanith after completing the Volcano Manor Assassination questline).
- Or by not listening to her request, defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, and returning to the room, where it can be found alongside a letter written by Rya to the Tarnished.

item:dagger.name: Dagger
item:dagger.description: A standard dagger with a straight blade.  Though modest in reach and capacity fo harm, this weapon is light enough to jab in rapid succession and delivers devastating critical hits.
item:dagger.location: You can purchase the basic Dagger for 400 runes from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.
related: Decide whether to hand D the Weathered Dagger

item:dagger-talisman.name: Dagger Talisman
item:dagger-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a dagger and a surgeon. Enhances critical hits.

stats.Effect: Enhances critical hits.

item:dagger-talisman.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Volcano Manor, in the Mt. Gelmir region. From the throne room, just before the waygate leading to Audience Pathway, head west up the stairs, and unlock the semi-transparent fog wall there, by inserting 2 Stonesword Keys into the adjacent imp statue. Upon reaching the edge of a wooden catwalk, turn immediately right and drop onto a catwalk below. Follow the path out of this room and around it, until you re-enter the room from the opposite side. The corpse is dangling from a wooden catwalk, nearby.

item:dancing-blade-of-ranah.name: Dancing Blade of Ranah
item:dancing-blade-of-ranah.location: Can be obtained when dropped by the Dancer of Ranah at the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

item:dane-s-footwork.name: Dane's Footwork
item:dane-s-footwork.location: Looted from Dryleaf Dane's corpse after the battle in the Cleansing Chamber of Enir-Ilim. He lies next to the door forward.

item:dappled-cured-meat.name: Dappled Cured Meat
item:dappled-cured-meat.description: Cured strip of meat, dried out after pickling in a dappled medicinal solution. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts Immunity, Robustness, and Focus

item:dappled-cured-meat.location: Craftable — Golden Rowa x5, Sliver of Meat x1, Budding Horn x1, Nascent Butterfly x1

item:dappled-white-cured-meat.name: Dappled White Cured Meat
item:dappled-white-cured-meat.description: A white sliced meat, dried out after pickling in a dappled medicinal solution. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts immunity, robustness, and focus

item:dappled-white-cured-meat.location: Craftable — Golden Rowa x5, Strip of White Flesh x1, Budding Horn x1, Nascent Butterfly x1

item:dark-moon-greatsword.name: Dark Moon Greatsword
item:dark-moon-greatsword.description: A Moon Greatsword, bestowed by a Carian queen upon her spouse to honor long-standing tradition. One of the legendary armaments. Ranni's sigil is a full moon, cold and leaden, and this sword is but a beam of its light.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int C

item:dark-moon-ring.name: Dark Moon Ring
item:dark-moon-ring.description: Ring depicting a leaden full moon. Symbolic of a cold oath, the ring is supposed to be given by Lunar Princess Ranni to her consort.

stats.Effect: Ring of Lunar Princess Ranni's cold oath

item:darkness.name: Darkness
item:darkness.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' servants, who once served as the
item:darkness.location: **Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants - Sold for 3,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Assassin's Prayerbook. - Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Creates area of darkness that conceals caster

item:death-knight-s-longhaft-axe.name: Death Knight's Longhaft Axe

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:death-knight-s-longhaft-axe.location: This weapon is dropped after defeating the Death Knight of the Scorpion River Catacombs.

item:death-knight-s-twin-axes.name: Death Knight's Twin Axes

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:death-knight-s-twin-axes.location:
**Location**: Fog Rift Catacombs
- Dropped by the Death Knight boss.

item:death-lightning.name: Death Lightning
item:death-lightning.description: Incantation that channels the power of the ancient dragon
item:death-lightning.location:
- Trade the Remembrance of the Lichdragon, gained by defeating Lichdragon Fortissax, with Finger Reader Enia.
- Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

stats.Effect: Strikes surroundings with storm of death lightning

item:death-ritual-spear.name: Death Ritual Spear
item:death-ritual-spear.description: Ritual spear used by priests of old who were permitted to come among the Deathbirds. The priests became guardians of the birds through the rite of Death, which also serves as an oath sworn to their distant resurrection.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int D

item:death-ritual-spear.location: The Death Ritual Spear is dropped by the Death Rite Bird boss in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:death-s-poker.name: Death's Poker
item:death-s-poker.description: Barbed rod carried by Deathbirds. The birds are graveyard fire keepers; it is said they rake out the ashen remains of the dead from their kilns.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int E

item:death-s-poker.location: The Death's Poker is a guaranteed drop from the Death Rite Bird located in Caelid.

item:deathbed-dress.name: Deathbed Dress
item:deathbed-dress.description: Extremely thin and sheer white dress worn by the Deathbed Companion as she embraces the dead. Slowly replenishes the HP of nearby allies, but not that of the wearer. The touch of the fabric is exceedingly soft, so as not to harm even the most withered corpse, while still sharing her warmth.

stats.Negation: Strike 2 · Magic 11 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 12

item:deathbed-dress.location: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace, located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:deathbed-smalls.name: Deathbed Smalls
item:deathbed-smalls.description: Skirt worn by Phia, the Deathbed Companion.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 7

item:deathbed-smalls.location: - It is Unused Content from Deathbed Set. It cannot be obtained through normal means.

item:deathroot.description: A source that gives rise to Those Who Live in Death.

stats.Effect: Beast Clergyman seeks and devours these

Deathtouched Catacombs at Stormhill in Limgrave, in a chest after defeating the Black Knife Assassin boss. 1. Defeating the Tibia Mariner in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes. 1. Black Knife Catacombs in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes, in a chest after defeating the Cemetery Shade boss. 1. Defeating the Tibia Mariner in western Altus Plateau near Wyndham Catacombs. 1.
