item:dectus-medallion-left.name: Dectus Medallion (Left)
item:dectus-medallion-left.description: Left half of a split medallion depicting the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Join medallions to operate Grand Lift of Dectus

item:dectus-medallion-right.name: Dectus Medallion (Right)
item:dectus-medallion-right.description: Right half of a split medallion depicting the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Join medallions to operate Grand Lift of Dectus

item:demi-human-ashes.name: Demi-human Ashes
item:demi-human-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five demi-humans.

stats.Effect: Summons five demi-human spirits

item:demi-human-ashes.location: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog in Impaler's Catacombs.

item:demi-human-queen-s-staff.name: Demi-human Queen's Staff
item:demi-human-queen-s-staff.description: Glintstone staff styled as a scepter. A gift once given to the demi-humans to foster peace, it can be wielded even by those of low intelligence. Sneered at by fools in the academy.
item:demi-human-queen-s-staff.location: You can get the Demi-Human Queen's Staff in Elden Ring by defeating the Demi-Human Queen boss at the Demi-Human Forest Ruins in the Weeping Peninsula.

item:depraved-perfumer-carmaan-ashes.name: Depraved Perfumer Carmaan Ashes
item:depraved-perfumer-carmaan-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Carmaan, the depraved perfumer. Depraved perfumers practice their art for themselves alone. Carmaan was a notably formidable perfumer whose strength rivaled that of heroes, and it is said that he was in search of a secret physick of revivification.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Depraved Perfumer Carmaan

item:depraved-perfumer-carmaan-ashes.location: Found in Volcano Manor, in a room only accessible by going through the secret passage behind the illusory wall near the start of the dungeon.

item:depraved-perfumer-gloves.name: Depraved Perfumer Gloves

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:depraved-perfumer-gloves.location: - The Depraved Perfumer Gloves have a 3.00% chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

item:depraved-perfumer-headscarf.name: Depraved Perfumer Headscarf

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:depraved-perfumer-headscarf.location: Chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

item:depraved-perfumer-robe.name: Depraved Perfumer Robe
item:depraved-perfumer-robe.description: Robe worn by depraved perfumers. The embroidery on the apron is itself a curse upon the Erdtree. These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is  what earned them their name.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:depraved-perfumer-robe.location: Chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

item:depraved-perfumer-robe-altered.name: Depraved Perfumer Robe (altered)
item:depraved-perfumer-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Depraved Perfumer Robe

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 4 · Pierce 2 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:depraved-perfumer-robe-altered.location: Chance to drop unaltered from Depraved Perfumer enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:depraved-perfumer-trousers.name: Depraved Perfumer Trousers

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:depraved-perfumer-trousers.location: Chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

item:deserter-s-cookbook-1.name: Deserter's Cookbook [1]
item:deserter-s-cookbook-1.description: A fugitive deserter's record of crafting techniques. Contains knowledge for surviving in the face of utter scarcity.

item:deserter-s-cookbook-2.name: Deserter's Cookbook [2]
item:deserter-s-cookbook-2.description: A fugitive deserter's record of crafting techniques. Contains knowledge for surviving in the face of utter scarcity.

item:determination.name: Determination
item:determination.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Determination: A knightly skill. Hold the flat of the armament to your face and pledge your resolve, powering up your next attack."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:determination.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Limgrave
- Drops from a Scarab found on the stone bridge north of Agheel Lake.
(A Night's Cavalry will patrol this bridge during night time)
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:devonia-s-hammer.name: Devonia's Hammer

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Fai D

item:devonia-s-hammer.location: - Defeat Crucible Knight Devonia at the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Devonia is found near the  Rauh Ancient Ruins, East Site of Grace.

item:devourer-s-scepter.name: Devourer's Scepter
item:devourer-s-scepter.description: Scepter in the shape of a serpent devouring the world. This weapon will one day become the very symbol of the Lord of  Blasphemy. One of the legendary armaments. A vision of the future briefly seen by Rykard in his final moments before being devoured by the great serpent.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:dewkissed-herba.name: Dewkissed Herba
item:dewkissed-herba.description: A herb that grows in the false night in and around the Eternal City. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:dewkissed-herba.location:
- Dewkissed Herba grows underground along the Ainsel and Siofra Rivers.
- It can be found near the Eternal City.

item:dexterity-knot-crystal-tear.name: Dexterity-knot Crystal Tear
item:dexterity-knot-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts dexterity in mixed physick

item:dexterity-knot-crystal-tear.location: Found in a bowl on a small island in the southern Liurnia of the Lakes, immediately north-west of the Scenic Isle grace, not far from the southern cliffs. Guarded by some Second-Generation Albinaurics.

item:diallos-mask.name: Diallos's Mask
item:diallos-mask.description: Replica of a twin-tailed silver helm with flowery adornments. Only, without the twin tails.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:digger-s-staff.name: Digger's Staff
item:digger-s-staff.description: Staff of a sorcerer-miner who extracts glintstone from crystal tunnels. The staff itself is a tool used to mine, and the ferrule is also embedded with a glintstone.   Boosts the power of Stonedigger sorceries
item:digger-s-staff.location: The Digger's Staff drops from Glintstone Miner enemies in locations like the Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid, the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel in Liurnia, and the Altus Tunnel.

item:dirty-chainmail.name: Dirty Chainmail
item:dirty-chainmail.description: Chainmail worn by young Albinaurics. The appearance of a protruding belly provides no benefits worthy of note.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 8 · Slash 11 · Pierce 11 · Magic 8 · Fire 8 · Lightning 6 · Holy 8

item:dirty-chainmail.location: - ?.??% chance to drop from Young Albinaurics enemies that wear it

item:discarded-palace-key.name: Discarded Palace Key
item:discarded-palace-key.description: A key discarded by Lunar Princess Ranni alongside her very flesh. Opens a treasure chest passed down to Carian Princesses. It is said to be found in the Grand Library of Raya Lucaria with her mother Rennala.

stats.Effect: Key to treasure chest for Carian Princesses

item:discarded-palace-key.location:
**Location**: Nokstella Waterfall Basin, Ainsel River Main
- Automatically received upon defeating the Baleful Shadow during Ranni the Witch's questline.

item:discus-of-light.name: Discus Of Light
item:discus-of-light.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
item:discus-of-light.location:
**Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
- Sold for 11,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn after he moves to Goldmask's location in Altus.
- Should Corhyn die before purchasing this incantation after moving to Goldmask's location, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.
  - <font color="red">WARNING:</font> If Corhyn dies before this incantation appears in his inventory then it will become unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.

stats.Effect: Fires ring of light before the caster

item:dismounter.name: Dismounter
item:dismounter.description: This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blades of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet.  A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.
item:dismounter.location: The Dismounter is a curved greatsword dropped by Kaiden Sellswords.

item:distinguished-greatshield.name: Distinguished Greatshield
item:distinguished-greatshield.description: Greatshield featuring sumptuous ornamentation used by the scions of great families. Due to their excessive size, these shields were at times seen as the hallmark of little lordlings who were too timid to earn a few nicks and scratches.
item:distinguished-greatshield.location:
**Location**: Hermit Merchant's Shack
- Purchased from the Hermit Merchant at the Hermit Merchant's Shack in Capital Outskirts for  5,500 runes.

item:divine-beast-tornado.name: Divine Beast Tornado
item:divine-beast-tornado.location: **Loot:** Ancient Ruins of Rauh - Drops from the Divine Beast Dancing Lion found by heading east-northeast across the bridge beginning at the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway Site of Grace. - The temple's location is just northeast of the Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace but isn't reachable from that spot. - The Grand Stairway grace can be found by heading into the temple southwest of the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West Site of Grace and taking a left after the stairs down to find an elevator.

item:divine-bird-feathers.name: Divine Bird Feathers
item:divine-bird-feathers.location: Divine Bird Feathers is looted from a body at the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. It is found in a body of water just east of the Church of the Bud, Main Entrance site of grace. To reach it, head north from the grace and keep to the right in the temple to arrive at the pool, where it's on a body just past a stone gazebo.

item:divine-fortification.name: Divine Fortification
item:divine-fortification.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
item:divine-fortification.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Weeping Peninsula
- Divine Fortification is obtained upon defeating the Teardrop Scarab found atop a fallen ruin near the Tombsward Ruins.

stats.Effect: Increases holy damage negation.

item:dolores-the-sleeping-arrow-puppet.name: Dolores The Sleeping Arrow Puppet
item:dolores-the-sleeping-arrow-puppet.description: One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Spirit of a handsome archer who dressed in the style of a man. Called the Silent Hunter by some, she fires St. Trina's arrows from her shortbow. Dolores once belonged to the Roundtable Hold, where she was both a critic and a friend of Gideon the All-Knowing. It was because of her that he and Seluvis went their separate ways.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Solores the Sleeping Arrow

item:dolores-the-sleeping-arrow-puppet.location: Can be obtained from Preceptor Seluvis after discovering his secret room and agreeing to take Seluvis's Potion to Nepheli Loux, Warrior. If a different puppet is selected, this one can be bought for 5 Starlight Shards from Seluvis. It can later be found on Pidia's body if the potion was given to someone else.

item:double-slash.name: Double Slash
item:double-slash.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Double Slash:Skill of superior swordsmen. Perform a crossing slash attack from a low stance. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks."Usable on swords and polearms capable of slashing (colossal weapons excepted).
item:double-slash.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Caelid
- Drops from a Scarab found on top of a large root near the rooftops in the southwestern quarter of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:dragon-communion-seal.name: Dragon Communion Seal
item:dragon-communion-seal.description: Formless drakeblood seal with a dragon communion crest. Enhances Dragon Communion incantations. The sacrificial devouring of the heart gives power. Indeed, Dragon Communion is too primal in nature for the term "incantation" to be appropriate. This seal scales incantations with one's arcane attribute.
item:dragon-communion-seal.location: The Dragon Communion Seal is located in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave dungeon in West Limgrave.

item:dragon-greatclaw.name: Dragon Greatclaw
item:dragon-greatclaw.description: Weapon said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Erdtree. The claw is enwreathed with lightning,and tears through the dragons' feeble descendants with ease.

item:dragon-halberd.name: Dragon Halberd
item:dragon-halberd.description: Halberd shaped like a dragon, enwreathed with both ice and lightning. Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.
item:dragon-halberd.location: The Dragon Halberd is dropped by the Dragonkin Soldier boss in the Siofra River underground region.

item:dragon-heart.name: Dragon Heart
item:dragon-heart.description: Dragon heart seized by a dragon tracker. It has a bizarre shape, mottled by gravel, and it continues to beat vivaciously. An offering used in the Dragon Communion. Consume a dragon's heart at the altar to make its power yours. While a terrible and savage-looking thing, the heart has a peculiar beauty to it.

stats.Effect: Gain power of the dragon at the Dragon Communion altar.

item:dragon-heart.location:
There are a total of 23 Dragon Hearts that can be obtained in the base game.

- Various Dragons:
  - 3 unnamed Glintstone Dragons (×1 each)
  - Borealis the Freezing Fog (×1)
  - Decaying Ekzykes (×1)
  - Elder Dragon Greyoll (×5)
  - Flying Dragon Agheel (×1)
  - Flying Dragon Greyll (×1)
  - Glintstone Dragon Adula (×3)
  - Glintstone Dragon Smarag (×1)

- Various Magma Wyrms:
  - 3 unnamed Magma Wyrms (×1 each)
  - Great Wyrm Theodorix (×3)
  - Magma Wyrm Makar (×1)

item:dragon-hunter-s-great-katana.name: Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana
item:dragon-hunter-s-great-katana.location:
**Location**: Dragon's Pit
- The Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana is obtained upon defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man at the bottom of the Dragon's Pit.

item:dragon-king-s-cragblade.name: Dragon King's Cragblade
item:dragon-king-s-cragblade.description: Piercing Gravel Stone sword containing primeval lightning. A portion of the Dragonlord's power, gained from a remembrance. This weapon commands great power over the paltry, mortal dragons of today.

item:dragon-towershield.name: Dragon Towershield
item:dragon-towershield.description: Tower shield engraved with a dragon, symbol of protection. Heavy even among greatshields, it possesses exceptional guarding ability The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock.
item:dragon-towershield.location: Found in Crumbling Farum Azula, guarded by a Banished Knight. From the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace, proceed down to the open area with the already wounded ancient dragon. Drop down a set of ledges to the dragon's left, enter the building and climb a ladder to find the chest.

item:dragonbolt-blessing.name: Dragonbolt Blessing
item:dragonbolt-blessing.description: Superior incantation of the capital's ancient dragon cult. Summons lightning to bolster the caster's body. Attacks become easier to deflect and resistance to all ailments is increased. However, lightning damage negation will be reduced. Only those loved by dragons can survive the ordeal of cladding their bodies in lightning.
item:dragonbolt-blessing.location:
**Loot:** Altus Plateau
- Dragonbolt Blessing is found in a treasure chest within Stormcaller Church.

stats.Effect: Bolsters caster's body with lightning

item:dragonbolt-of-florissax.name: Dragonbolt of Florissax
item:dragonbolt-of-florissax.location: **Quest Item:** Jagged Peak - Given by the Dragon Communion Priestess at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after giving her Thiollier's Concoction at night and waiting for her to wake up (and then repeatedly talking to her), and then finally defeating Bayle the Dread. - This item is mutually exclusive with the Priestess Heart and Flowerstone Gavel. - Continue talking to her and both confess to be the one that put her to sleep and accept her into your service to receive the Ancient Dragon Florissax Spirit Ash.

item:dragonclaw.name: Dragonclaw
item:dragonclaw.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
item:dragonclaw.location:
**Dragon Communion:** Limgrave / Caelid / Jagged Peak
- Acquired from the altar at the Church of Dragon Communion in Limgrave, the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid, or the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion in the Realm of Shadow for 1 Dragon Heart.

stats.Effect: Channels dragon to rend foes with dragon claws

item:dragonclaw-shield.name: Dragonclaw Shield
item:dragonclaw-shield.description: Greatshield said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Edrtree. Imbued with lightning.
item:dragonclaw-shield.location: Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel boss in Altus Plateau, outside Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:dragoncrest-greatshield-talisman.name: Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman
item:dragoncrest-greatshield-talisman.description: Legendary talisman of wrought iron depicting a massive ancient dragon. Enormously boosts physical damage negation.

stats.Effect: Enormously boosts physical damage negation

item:dragoncrest-greatshield-talisman.location: Elphael drainage beam run. Best physical absorb in the game.

item:dragoncrest-shield-talisman.name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman
item:dragoncrest-shield-talisman.description: Wrought iron talisman depicting a trio of ancient dragons. Boosts physical damage negation.

stats.Effect: Boosts physical damage negation

item:dragoncrest-shield-talisman.location: - Obtained from a corpse that lies on the ground, near Bestial Sanctum, in northern Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. Equipping the Longtail Cat Talisman here, or using Soft Cotton is very helpful, as there are several parkour drops coming up that will deal unavoidable damage, and there are Bat enemies in the area. From the front door of the sanctum, head southwest around the side of the sanctum, until reaching a cliff that overlooks a large tree root, close enough to drop to.

item:dragonfire.name: Dragonfire
item:dragonfire.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
item:dragonfire.location:
**Dragon Communion:** Limgrave / Caelid / Jagged Peak
- Acquired from the altar at the Church of Dragon Communion in Limgrave, the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid, or the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak for 1 Dragon Heart.

stats.Effect: Channels dragon to spew flame breath

item:dragonice.name: Dragonice
item:dragonice.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
item:dragonice.location:
**Dragon Communion:** Caelid / Jagged Peak
- Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 1 Dragon Heart.

stats.Effect: Channels dragon to spew icy breath

item:dragonmaw.name: Dragonmaw
item:dragonmaw.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
item:dragonmaw.location: Bought at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion with a dragon heart.

stats.Effect: Channels dragon to bite foes before caster

item:dragonscale-blade.name: Dragonscale Blade
item:dragonscale-blade.description: A weapon made by sharpening a Gravel Stone scale, thought to be the source of ancient dragon immortality, into an unclouded blade. Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.
item:dragonscale-blade.location: The Dragonscale Blade is dropped by a Dragonkin Soldier in the Lake of Rot.

item:dragonwound-grease.name: Dragonwound Grease
item:dragonwound-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of gravels stones. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, granting special dragon attacks

item:dragonwound-grease.location: - Abandoned Cave - Altus Plateau – looted from a corpse on the collapsed Forest-Spanning Greatbridge, near Goldmask. - Deeproot Depths – beside a Ravaged Gargoyle near the The Nameless Eternal City Site of Grace. - Divine Tower of Caelid – looted from a corpse at the base of the tower. - Fringefolk Hero's Grave – guarded by the spirit of a Banished Knight in the room atop the second ramp. - Leyndell, Royal Capital – near the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace. - Liurnia of the Lakes – guarded by Glintstone Dragon Smarag north of Temple Quarter - Sage's Cave – stored within a treasure chest.

item:drake-knight-armor.name: Drake Knight Armor
item:drake-knight-armor.description: Black iron armor worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partake of communion. The cape is crafted with dragon wing membrane.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 9 · Slash 11 · Pierce 11 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 8 · Holy 10

item:drake-knight-armor.location: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set.

item:drake-knight-armor-altered.name: Drake Knight Armor (altered)
item:drake-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Drake Knight Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 8 · Slash 11 · Pierce 10 · Magic 8 · Fire 9 · Lightning 6 · Holy 8

item:drake-knight-armor-altered.location: Found unaltered in Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:drake-knight-gauntlets.name: Drake Knight Gauntlets
item:drake-knight-gauntlets.description: Black iron gauntlets worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion. From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:drake-knight-gauntlets.location:
**Location**: Crumbling Farum Azula
- The Drake Knight Gauntlets are found in a chest near the  Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace, alongside the rest of the Drake Knight Set.

item:drake-knight-greaves.name: Drake Knight Greaves
item:drake-knight-greaves.description: Greaves wrapped in thick leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands. Has a fur lining which excels at keeping the cold at bay.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:drake-knight-greaves.location: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set.

item:drake-knight-helm.name: Drake Knight Helm
item:drake-knight-helm.description: Black iron helm worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion. From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:drake-knight-helm.location: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set.

item:drake-knight-helm-altered.name: Drake Knight Helm (altered)
item:drake-knight-helm-altered.description: Lighter version of the Drake Knight Helm.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:drake-knight-helm-altered.location: Found unaltered in Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

item:drawing-room-key.name: Drawing-room Key
item:drawing-room-key.description: Key to Volcano Manor's drawing room.

stats.Effect: Key to the Volcano Manor drawing room

item:drawstring-blood-grease.name: Drawstring Blood Grease

stats.Effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting blood loss

item:drawstring-blood-grease.location: Craftable — Root Resin x1, Bloodrose x1, String x1

item:drawstring-fire-grease.name: Drawstring Fire Grease
item:drawstring-fire-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of incendiary materials. Craftable item. A smallish lump with a short string attached. Quickly coats armament, inflicting fire damage. However, the effects are only brief.

stats.Effect: Quickly coats weapon, inflicting  Fire Damage

item:drawstring-fire-grease.location: Craftable — Root Resin x1, Smoldering Butterfly x1, String x1

item:drawstring-holy-grease.name: Drawstring Holy Grease
item:drawstring-holy-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of holy resonant materials. Craftable item. A short string is attached to this lump. Quickly coats armament, inflicting holy damage, but with a brief effect, owing to its small size.

stats.Effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting holy damage

item:drawstring-lightning-grease.name: Drawstring Lightning Grease
item:drawstring-lightning-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of fulminating materials. Craftable item. A short string is attached to this lump.

stats.Effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting lightning damage.

item:drawstring-magic-grease.name: Drawstring Magic Grease
item:drawstring-magic-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of magically resonant materials. Craftable item. A short string is attached to this lump. Quickly coats armament, inflicting magic damage, but with a brief effect, owing to its small size.

stats.Effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting magic damage

item:drawstring-rot-grease.name: Drawstring Rot Grease
item:drawstring-rot-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of rotten materials. Craftable item. A short string is attached to this lump. Quickly coats armament, inflicting scarlet rot, but with a brief effect, owing to its small size.

stats.Effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting scarlet rot, but with a brief effect, owing to its small size.

item:dryleaf-arts.name: Dryleaf Arts
item:dryleaf-arts.location: Dropped by Dryleaf Dane after the spar at Moorth Ruins.

item:dryleaf-seal.name: Dryleaf Seal
item:dryleaf-seal.location: Found on a corpse near the  Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace. Go north until you find a ledge with several Gravebirds. The seal lies on a ledge just below Dane's message.

item:dueling-shield.name: Dueling Shield
item:dueling-shield.location: Found on a corpse inside the Shadow Keep's Specimen Storehouse. From the Site of Grace, proceed upstairs until you reach the original position of the feet of the humanoid specimen. Then, jump over the railing to the left to take a path to a ledge where the shield awaits.

item:duelist-greataxe.name: Duelist Greataxe
item:duelist-greataxe.description: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. A weapon reserved for duelist champions, the charge attack is particularly ferocious.
item:duelist-greataxe.location: The Duelist Greataxe can be farmed from the Grave Warden Duelist wielding it in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:duelist-greaves.name: Duelist Greaves
item:duelist-greaves.description: Greaves encircles by bronze snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes. The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 7 · Slash 8 · Pierce 7 · Magic 5 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:duelist-greaves.location: Can only be obtained as a rare drop from Duelist-type enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore.

item:duelist-helm.name: Duelist Helm
item:duelist-helm.description: Bronze helm decorated with innumerable snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes. The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:duelist-helm.location: Can only be obtained as a rare drop from Duelist enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, as they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore.

item:duelist-s-furled-finger.name: Duelist's Furled Finger
item:duelist-s-furled-finger.description: Item for online play. Creates a summon sign for competitive multiplayer. Your objective will be to defeat the Host of Fingers of the world to which you were summoned. A finger of corpse wax, furled like a hook. The bronze adornments are the mark of a duelist.

stats.Effect: Creates competitive multiplayer summon sign.

item:dung-eater-puppet.name: Dung Eater Puppet
item:dung-eater-puppet.description: One of Seluvis's puppets. Use to summon the spirit of the Dung Eater. Spirit of a man who murdered thousands and defiled their corpses with the Seedbed Curse. Wields a spine greatsword and hurls curses. The Dung Eater despaired at how he met his end. How hideous and sinister this puppet is, and yet, its utter despair invites one to care for it.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of the Dung Eater

item:dung-eater-puppet.location:
Free the Dung Eater from beneath Leyndell, Royal Capital, then defeat him at the pond where you found Blackguard Big Boggart and then return to the Dung Eater in his cell with Seluvis's Potion.

Costs 5 Starlight Shards and is only available after doing the steps above and buying Preceptor Seluvis's first two puppets, then reloading the area by teleporting or exiting to the main menu and re-entering. Exhaust Seluvis's dialogue to reset the area, and the dialogue option "I want a new puppet" should be available", which will unlock him.

item:dusk-medallion.name: Dectus Medallion (right)
item:dusk-medallion.description: Right half of a split medallion depicting the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Join medallions to operate Grand Lift of Dectus

item:earthshaker.name: Earthshaker
item:earthshaker.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Earthshaker: Thrust armament into the ground, then gather strength to unleash an earth-shaking shockwave. Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike."Usable on greataxes, warhammers, and colossal weapons.
item:earthshaker.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Altus Plateau
- Drops from an invisible Scarab found  south the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace. The scarab moves slowly in a straight line and generates dirt particles around it, which are easier to detect at night.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:eccentric-s-armor.name: Eccentric's Armor
item:eccentric-s-armor.description: Unusually colorful armor. Worn by the knight Jerren. Jerren preferred a nomadic existence, but after spending time as guest of the Carian royals, he became a guest commander for General Radahn. And for the first time, the restless tumbleweed would be bound by honorable oath

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 10 · Slash 12 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 7 · Holy 9

item:eccentric-s-armor.location: Received after defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren during Sellen's questline.

item:eccentric-s-breeches.name: Eccentric's Breeches
item:eccentric-s-breeches.description: The knight Jerren's breeches. Jerren preferred a nomadic existence, but after spending time as a guest of the Carian royals, he became the guest commander for General Radahn. And for the first time, the restless tumbleweed would be bound by honorable oath.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 4 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 5 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:eccentric-s-breeches.location: Received after defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren during Sellen's questline.

item:eccentric-s-hood.name: Eccentric's Hood
item:eccentric-s-hood.description: A pointy, ragged hood. Worn by the knight Jerren. The hood hides an aged, bearded mask. Jerren served General Radahn as a guest commander, and they are said to have sworn an oath of honorable death to one another.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:eccentric-s-hood.location: Received after defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren during Sellen's questline.

item:eccentric-s-hood-altered.name: Eccentric's Hood (altered)
item:eccentric-s-hood-altered.description: Lighter version of the Eccentric's Hood

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:eccentric-s-hood-altered.location: Received (unaltered) after defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren during Sellen's questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

item:eccentric-s-manchettes.name: Eccentric's Manchettes
item:eccentric-s-manchettes.description: The knight Jerren's manchettes. Jerren preferred a nomadic existence, but after spending time as a guest of the Carian royals, he became the guest commander for General Radahn. And for the first time, the restless tumbleweed would be bound by honorable oath.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 1

item:eccentric-s-manchettes.location: - The Eccentric's Manchettes are obtained by defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren during Sorceress Sellen's questline.

item:eclipse-crest-greatshield.name: Eclipse Crest Greatshield
item:eclipse-crest-greatshield.description: Metal greatshield painted with a sun in eclipse. Carried by the headless mausoleum knights. The eclipsed sun, drained of color, is the protective star of soulless demigods. It aids the mausoleum knights by keeping Destined Death at bay. No skill. This armament has no skill. If the armament in the other hand has a skill, that skill will be used instead.
item:eclipse-crest-greatshield.location: 4% chance to be dropped by Mausoleum Knights near Wandering Mausoleums, in the Nameless Eternal City and outside the Black Knife Catacombs.

item:eclipse-crest-heater-shield.name: Eclipse Crest Heater Shield
item:eclipse-crest-heater-shield.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The sun in eclipse is said to be the symbol of the Wandering Mausoleum where the soulless demigods slumber.
item:eclipse-crest-heater-shield.location: - Found on a corpse atop a large stone archway protruding from a cliff northwest of the Minor Erdtree in the Weeping Peninsula.

item:eclipse-shotel.name: Eclipse Shotel
item:eclipse-shotel.description: Storied sword and treasure of Castle Sol that depicts an eclipsed sun drained of color. One of the legendary armaments. In Sol, the sight of an eclipse inspires a dreadful awe, preventing an onlooker from averting his gaze.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Fai D

item:eclipse-shotel.location: Found on a corpse in the chapel

item:ekzyke-s-decay.name: Ekzyke's Decay
item:ekzyke-s-decay.description: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Ekzykes, the Decaying.

stats.Effect: Spews scarlet rot breath of Ekzykes from above.

item:ekzykes-s-decay.name: Ekzykes's Decay
item:ekzykes-s-decay.description: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Ekzykes, the Decaying.
item:ekzykes-s-decay.location:
**Dragon Communion:** Caelid
- Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 2 Dragon Hearts after defeating Decaying Ekzykes in Caelid.

stats.Effect: Spews scarlet rot breath of Ekzykes from above

item:elden-lord-armor.name: Elden Lord Armor
item:elden-lord-armor.description: Armor of Godfrey the first Elden Lord. The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield. He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 10 · Slash 11 · Pierce 12 · Magic 8 · Fire 11 · Lightning 7 · Holy 8

item:elden-lord-armor.location:
**Location**: Roundtable Hold
- The Elden Lord Armor is purchased from Finger Reader Enia for  20,000 runes after defeating Hoarah Loux, Warrior.

item:elden-lord-armor-altered.name: Elden Lord Armor (altered)
item:elden-lord-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Elden Lord Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 9 · Slash 10 · Pierce 11 · Magic 7 · Fire 10 · Lightning 6 · Holy 6

item:elden-lord-armor-altered.location: - The Elden Lord Armor (Altered) is acquired by performing Armor Adjustment on the Elden Lord Armor.

item:elden-lord-bracers.name: Elden Lord Bracers
item:elden-lord-bracers.description: Bracers of Godfrey the first Elden Lord. The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield. He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 1

item:elden-lord-bracers.location:
**Location**: Roundtable Hold
- The Elden Lord Bracers are purchased from Finger Reader Enia for  12,000 runes after defeating Hoarah Loux, Warrior.

item:elden-lord-crown.name: Elden Lord Crown
item:elden-lord-crown.description: Crown of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield. He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 4 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:elden-lord-crown.location:
**Location**: Roundtable Hold
- The Elden Lord Crown is purchased from Finger Reader Enia for  12,000 runes after defeating Hoarah Loux, Warrior.

item:elden-lord-greaves.name: Elden Lord Greaves
item:elden-lord-greaves.description: Greaves of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield. He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 6 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:elden-lord-greaves.location:
**Location**: Roundtable Hold
- The Elden Lord Greaves is purchased from Finger Reader Enia for  12,000 runes after defeating Hoarah Loux, Warrior.

item:elden-remembrance.name: Elden Remembrance
item:elden-remembrance.description: Remembrance of the Elden Beast, hewn into the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

related: Radagon of the Golden Order / Elden Beast

item:elden-stars.name: Elden Stars
item:elden-stars.description: This legendary incantation is the most ancient of those that derive from the Erdtree.
item:elden-stars.location:
**Loot:** Deeproot Depths
- Elden Stars can be looted from a body at the end of a cave filled with giant ants in the Deeproot Depths, located immediately west of the Great Waterfall Crest grace, after climbing up one of the large roots.

stats.Effect: Creates a steam of golden shooting stars that assail the area.

item:electrify-armament.name: Electrify Armament
item:electrify-armament.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.
item:electrify-armament.location: **Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants - Sold for 4,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Dragon Cult Prayerbook. - Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Enchants right-hand armament with lightning damage

item:electrocharge.name: Electrocharge
item:electrocharge.location:
**Loot:** Fog Rift Catacombs
- Found by dropping down a hole in the second cubicle on the left at the third dropping spike-roof and then taking a left twice to find it in the same rooms as a Catacombs Sorcerer, some Fulgurbloom, and a few Skeletal Slimes.

item:eleonora-s-poleblade.name: Eleonora's Poleblade
item:eleonora-s-poleblade.description: Twinned naginata forged in the Land of Reeds. Chosen weapon of Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger. Her mastery of the sword was such that her onslaught was likened to a whirlwind, but now her legacy is stained by accursed blood.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Arc D

item:eleonora-s-poleblade.location: Eleonora's Poleblade is dropped by the invader Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger at the Second Church of Marika in the Altus Plateau.

item:enchanted-shot.name: Enchanted Shot
item:enchanted-shot.description: This ash of war grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Enchanted Shot: Archery skill that enlivens the arrow with spiritual essence. The resulting shot will fly faster than regular shots and change its trajectory to follow the target."Usable on light bows and longbows.
item:enchanted-shot.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Nokron, Eternal City
- Dropped by a Scarab next to a rock near the northern shore cliff of the Ancestral Woods, south-east of a nearby Hallowhorn Brazier.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:endure.name: Endure
item:endure.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Endure: Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise. Damage taken while using this skill is reduced."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:endure.location:
**Purchase:** Stormhill / Volcano Manor
- 1x Sold for 600 Runes from Bernahl at either the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill or the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor.
- Should Bernahl be killed before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Bernahl's Bell Bearing.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:entwining-umbilical-cord.name: Entwining Umbilical Cord
item:entwining-umbilical-cord.description: Mysterious circular object that's oddly warped. Changes the demeanour of the wearer's actions.

stats.Effect: Changes demeanour of wearer's actions

item:envoy-crown.name: Envoy Crown
item:envoy-crown.description: The soft bundle worn on the head by Oracle Envoys. Densely wrapped in several layers of cloth. Raises the potency of bubble-based skills. No one knows what the cloth hides, but some claim to have heard a faint whimpering from inside. It must have been their imagination.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 5 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:envoy-crown.location: Found on a corpse behind a Giant Oracle Envoy enemy near the Haligtree Canopy site of grace in Miquella's Haligtree.

item:envoy-s-greathorn.name: Envoy's Greathorn
item:envoy-s-greathorn.description: Fanned golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:envoy-s-greathorn.location: To get the Envoy's Greathorn in Elden Ring, you must farm Giant Oracle Envoys located on the upper tree branches of Miquella's Haligtree.

item:envoy-s-horn.name: Envoy's Horn
item:envoy-s-horn.description: Golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:envoy-s-horn.location: The standard Envoy's Horn is obtained by farming Oracle Envoys in Leyndell, Royal Capital, specifically near the East Capital Rampart site of grace.

item:envoy-s-long-horn.name: Envoy's Long Horn
item:envoy-s-long-horn.description: Long golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai C

item:envoy-s-long-horn.location: To get the Envoy's Long Horn in Elden Ring, you must farm large Oracle Envoy enemies located at the East Capital Rampart site of grace.

item:erdleaf-flower.name: Erdleaf Flower
item:erdleaf-flower.description: A dusky-yellow flower that has started to fade and wilt. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:erdleaf-flower.location:
- Erdleaf Flowers are harvested from plants growing on the Altus Plateau
- Harvested in Limgrave

item:erdsteel-dagger.name: Erdsteel Dagger
item:erdsteel-dagger.description: An erdsteel dagger with a grass crest engraved upon its blade. Carried by the Erdtree royalty for self-defense in times of peace.  Though forged to a high standard, the weapon is difficult to wield.  Attack power also scales with faith.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:erdsteel-dagger.location: You can obtain the Erdsteel Dagger through two different methods in a single playthrough: as a quest reward from Kenneth Haight in Limgrave or looted from a corpse in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:erdtree-bow.name: Erdtree Bow
item:erdtree-bow.description: Longbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Arrow. Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Fai D

item:erdtree-bow.location: The standard Erdtree Bow is located in Leyndell, Royal Capital on the Altus Plateau.

item:erdtree-greatbow.name: Erdtree Greatbow
item:erdtree-greatbow.description: Greatbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Great Arrow. Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Fai D

item:erdtree-greatbow.location: The Erdtree Greatbow is obtained by destroying the mechanical chariot in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave dungeon in Limgrave.

item:erdtree-greatshield.name: Erdtree Greatshield
item:erdtree-greatshield.description: Weighty greatshield forged of gold carried by the order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights. Blessed by an old incantation of protection. The living rampart of the Erdtree, the Tree Sentinels are the standard to which all defenders of the Erdtree aspire.
item:erdtree-greatshield.location: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel duo in Altus Plateau at the southern entrance to the Capital Outskirts.

item:erdtree-heal.name: Erdtree Heal
item:erdtree-heal.description: One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.
item:erdtree-heal.location:
**Loot:** Leyndell, Ashen Capital
- Erdtree Heal is located near the Queen's Bedchamber Site of Grace in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

stats.Effect: Vastly heals HP for self and nearby allies

item:erdtree-s-favor.name: Erdtree's Favor
item:erdtree-s-favor.description: A talisman depicting a special blessing of the Erdtree. Slightly raises maximum HP, stamina, and equip load.

stats.Effect: Raises maximum HP, stamina and equip load

item:erdtree-s-favor.location: - Obtained from an altar in Fringefolk Hero's Grave, in western Limgrave. This dungeon is accessed from Stranded Graveyard after inserting 2 Stonesword Keys into the nearby imp statue, to unlock the semi-transparent fog wall. Proceed down the ladder and across the poison pond, to reach a ramp, patrolled by an invincible chariot. Proceed down the ramp by hiding in alcoves on the side, to avoid the chariot. When the ramp turns into a bridge, with gaps on either side, drop from either side of the highest point of the bridge, to reach a lower platform.

item:erdtree-seal.name: Erdtree Seal
item:erdtree-seal.description: A formless sacred seal decorated with an Erdtree crest, once the focus of religion in the Lands Between. Even though the Elden Ring is shattered, and the Erdtree has dulled from its former radiance, earnest faith continues to hold the answers.
item:erdtree-seal.location: The Erdtree Seal is located in Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmer.

item:erdtree-surcoat.name: Erdtree Surcoat
item:erdtree-surcoat.description: Armor worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. The surcoat bears a majestic likeness of the Erdtree. Its golden backing is an honor bestowed on no other soldiers.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 11 · Slash 12 · Pierce 12 · Magic 9 · Fire 10 · Lightning 8 · Holy 9

item:erdtree-surcoat.location: Chance to drop from Leyndell Soldier enemies.

item:errant-sorcerer-boots.name: Errant Sorcerer Boots
item:errant-sorcerer-boots.description: Commonplace leather boots, sturdy enough to withstand a long journey.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:errant-sorcerer-boots.location: Found on a corpse inside the beastmen-invaded village near the Craftman's Shack site of grace located in Mt. Gelmir.

item:errant-sorcerer-manchettes.name: Errant Sorcerer Manchettes
item:errant-sorcerer-manchettes.description: Commonplace leather manchettes. Their hands are inlaid with dulled glintstone.

stats.Negation: Slash 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:errant-sorcerer-manchettes.location:
**Location**: Hermit Village
- The Errant Sorcerer Manchettes are found on a corpse in the Hermit Village near the  Craftsman's Shack in Mt. Gelmir.

item:errant-sorcerer-robe.name: Errant Sorcerer Robe
item:errant-sorcerer-robe.description: Commonplace robe made of thick cloth. Worn by the Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm, one of the first Tarnished to visit Roundtable Hold. A silent seeker of sorcery, who had gone so far as to make contact with the primeval current, Wilhelm was led by guidance into confrontation with his friend Vargram, and it is said that he was then taken prisoner in Roundtable Hold.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 6 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:errant-sorcerer-robe.location: Found altered on a corpse inside the beastmen-invaded village near the Craftman's Shack site of grace located in Mt. Gelmir. Can be unaltered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:errant-sorcerer-robe-altered.name: Errant Sorcerer Robe (altered)
item:errant-sorcerer-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Errant Sorcerer Robe.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 6 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:errant-sorcerer-robe-altered.location: Found on a corpse inside the Hermit Village near the  Craftman's Shack site of grace located in Mt. Gelmir.

item:eruption.name: Eruption
item:eruption.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Fire affinity and the following skill:"Eruption: Skill of the knights who serve at Volcano Manor. Slam armament into the ground, spawning roiling lava which spouts up upon release."Usable on large and colossal swords, axes, and hammers.
item:eruption.location:
**Purchase:** Volcano Manor
- 1x Sold for 8,000 Runes by Recusant Bernahl in the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:estoc.name: Estoc
item:estoc.description: Large piercing sword with a long, hard bladed edge which is also capable of slashing attacks.  For its large size, it can be wirleded rather nimbly, leaving little opportunity for the enemy to counter.
item:estoc.location: You can purchase the Estoc thrusting sword from the Nomadic Merchant in southeastern Liurnia of the Lakes for 3,000 Runes.

item:eternal-darkness.name: Eternal Darkness
item:eternal-darkness.description: Forbidden sorcery of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
item:eternal-darkness.location:
**Loot:** Caelid
- Acquired from a corpse inside the Swamp Lookout Tower.

stats.Effect: Creates a dark space that draws in spells

item:euporia.name: Euporia

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:euporia.location: This armament can be found in Belurat, Tower Settlement. However, reaching it can only be done through Enir-Ilim. On the stairs past the lightning-aspected Divine Beast Warrior, jump off the path onto a lower staircase and then follow the ledges down until you reach a platform with a Fireproof Pickled Liver. Jump into the nearby window (sprinting is advised), and then go out to the balcony and follow the path to the right down the lifts, past the Inquisitors and the Divine Beast Warrior. Euporia lies at the end of this path.

item:exalted-flesh.name: Exalted Flesh
item:exalted-flesh.description: A lump of animal pickled in a medicinal solution mixed with fiery spices. Craftable item. Temporarily Boosts physical attack Considered a delicacy in the badlands, this invigorating repast was for the exclusive benefit of those who they called heroes.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts physical attack

item:exalted-flesh.location: - Morne Tunnel (Weeping Peninsula region): inside the chest in the shack.

item:executioner-s-greataxe.name: Executioner's Greataxe
item:executioner-s-greataxe.description: Bulky cleaver welded to a long haft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated armies, felling them like timber. Perhaps that is the reason it excels at critical hits.
item:executioner-s-greataxe.location: To get the Executioner's Greataxe, you need to farm axe-wielding skeletons.

item:exile-armor.name: Exile Armor
item:exile-armor.description: Damaged armor draped with a large deep-red cloth. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 9 · Slash 12 · Pierce 12 · Magic 8 · Fire 10 · Lightning 6 · Holy 9

item:exile-armor.location: Chance to drop from Exile Soldier enemies.

item:exile-gauntlets.name: Exile Gauntlets
item:exile-gauntlets.description: Damaged iron gauntlets. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 1 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 2

item:exile-gauntlets.location: - The Exile Gauntlets have a 1.50% chance to drop from Exile Soldier enemies.

item:exile-greaves.name: Exile Greaves
item:exile-greaves.description: Damaged iron greaves. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.
