- Flame, Cleanse Me can be looted from a corpse at the Fire Monk campsite located south of the Church of Vows in eastern Liurnia.

item:flame-crest-wooden-shield.name: Flame Crest Wooden Shield
item:flame-crest-wooden-shield.description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Carried by soldiers of the village that is afflicted by frenzy. The yellow flame is the symbol of the affliction, serving as a warning to those who might approach the village.
item:flame-crest-wooden-shield.location:
**Location**: Ailing Village
- Found on a corpse in one of the cabins at the Ailing Village in the Weeping Peninsula region.

item:flame-fall-upon-them.name: Flame, Fall Upon Them
item:flame-fall-upon-them.description: One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the
item:flame-fall-upon-them.location: **Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants - Sold for 10,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Giant's Prayerbook. - Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Hurls several balls of fire at once

item:flame-fortification.name: Flame Fortification
item:flame-fortification.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
item:flame-fortification.location:
**Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
- Sold for  3,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn.
- Should Corhyn die before purchasing this Incantation from him, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Increases fire damage negation.

item:flame-grant-me-strength.name: Flame Grant Me Strength
item:flame-grant-me-strength.location: Behind Fort Gael, two flame pillars. Caelid.

item:flame-of-the-fell-god.name: Flame Of The Fell God
item:flame-of-the-fell-god.description: This legendary incantation is one of several that draws directly from the power of the Fire Giants. Releases a ball of raging fire said to be inhabited by a fell god. The fireball floats toward enemies and explodes, setting the area ablaze. Arghanthy, the chief guardian of the Flame, had kept this incantation a well-kept secret until it was stolen by Adan. The fell god still lurks within the Fire Giants.
item:flame-of-the-fell-god.location:
**Guaranteed Drop**: Liurnia of the Lakes
- Received upon defeating Adan, Thief of Fire, the boss trapped in the Malefactor's Evergaol.

stats.Effect: Summons raging fireball that explodes and sets the area ablaze

item:flame-of-the-redmanes.name: Flame Of The Redmanes
item:flame-of-the-redmanes.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Fire affinity and the following skill:"Flame of the Redmanes: Skill of the Redmanes, who fought alongside General Radahn. Produce a powerful burst of flames in a wide frontward arc."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:flame-of-the-redmanes.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Caelid
- Drops from an invisible Scarab rolling around northeast of the Fort Gael North Site of Grace.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:flame-protect-me.name: Flame, Protect Me
item:flame-protect-me.description: The most ancient of the Fire Monks' incantations.
item:flame-protect-me.location:
**Loot**: Mountaintops of the Giants
- Flame, Protect Me can be found in the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave in the Mountaintops of the Giants. It is located behind an imp statue fog wall right next to the dungeon's grace. One Stonesword Key is required to access it.

stats.Effect: Greatly increases fire damage negation

item:flame-shrouding-cracked-tear.name: Flame-shrouding Cracked Tear
item:flame-shrouding-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily boosts the power of one's fire attacks.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts the power of one's fire attacks.

item:flame-shrouding-cracked-tear.location: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in Caelid, on the cliffs north-east of the Smoldering Church.

item:flame-sling.name: Flame Sling
item:flame-sling.location:
**Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
- Sold for  800 Runes by Brother Corhyn.
- Should Corhyn die before purchasing this Incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.

item:flamedrake-talisman.name: Flamedrake Talisman
item:flamedrake-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a red ancient dragon. Boosts fire damage negation.

stats.Effect: Boosts fire damage negation.

item:flamedrake-talisman.location: - Obtained from the Groveside Cave in northwestern Limgrave, by defeating the Beastman of Farum Azula boss.

item:flaming-strike.name: Flaming Strike
item:flaming-strike.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Fire affinity and the following skill:"Flaming Strike: Skill that emits flame in a wide frontward arc. Follow up with a strong attack to perform a lunging, sweeping strike. This will also coat the armament in fire."Usable on melee armaments (colossal weapons and whips excepted).
item:flaming-strike.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Caelid
- Drops from a Scarab found in the graveyard outside of Redmane Castle's southern wall.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:flask-of-cerulean-tears.name: Flask Of Cerulean Tears
item:flask-of-cerulean-tears.description: A sacred flask modelled after a golden holy chalice that was once graced by a tear of life. Filled with cerulean tears, this flask restores FP with use. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. It is said that a Finger Maiden will bestow two such chalices upon the chosen Tarnished when they meet.

stats.Effect: Restores FP

item:flask-of-cerulean-tears.location: Obtained after reaching the Stranded Graveyard at the start of the game.

item:flask-of-crimson-tears.name: Flask Of Crimson Tears
item:flask-of-crimson-tears.description: A sacred flask modelled after a golden holy chalice that was once graced by a tear of life. Filled with crimson tears, this flask restores HP with use. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. It is said that a Finger Maiden will bestow two such chalices upon the chosen Tarnished when they meet.

stats.Effect: Restores HP

item:flask-of-crimson-tears.location: Obtained after reaching the Stranded Graveyard at the start of the game.

item:flask-of-wondrous-physick.name: Flask Of Wondrous Physick
item:flask-of-wondrous-physick.description: A relic of the physick chemists, priests of the Erdtree. Harnesses the powers of crystal tears, which only form after the passage of many moons. Various specials effects are bestowed upon the drinker, dependent on the specific mixture of crystal tears. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. It is said that in the Lands Between, pools of crystal tears amass at the bases of Minor Erdtrees.

stats.Effect: Bestows various special effects

item:flask-of-wondrous-physick.location: Found in a basin in the Third Church of Marika, together with one of the two Crimson Crystal Tears.

item:fleeting-microcosm.name: Fleeting Microcosm
item:fleeting-microcosm.location:
**Purchased**: Cathedral of Manus Metyr
- Fleeting Microcosm may be purchased from Count Ymir for  20,000 Runes after ringing the bell at the Finger Ruins of Dheo. He sits on the throne in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr on the Scadu Altus, located in the Realm of Shadow.

item:flight-pinion.name: Flight Pinion
item:flight-pinion.description: Flight feather of a bird of prey. Material used for crafting items. Commonly used for arrow fletchings.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:flock-canvas-talisman.name: Flock's Canvas Talisman
item:flock-canvas-talisman.description: A talisman bearing an icon that depicts a mass of masked figures. Greatly raises potency of incantations.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises potency of Incantations.

item:flowerstone-gavel.name: Flowerstone Gavel

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Arc D

item:flowerstone-gavel.location:
**Location**: Foot of the Jagged Peak
- If she was not given Thiollier's Concoction, the Dragon Communion Priestess will drop this item at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after Bayle the Dread is defeated.

item:flowing-curved-sword.name: Flowing Curved Sword
item:flowing-curved-sword.description: Legends speak of a master of the sword garbed in blue, and his curved blade that was patterned after flowing water. Strong attack unleashes a series of strikes akin to a dance, offering a glimpse into the legend. Skill: Spinning Slash Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
item:flowing-curved-sword.location: The Flowing Curved Sword weapon can be found at the following location.

item:foot-soldier-cap.name: Foot Soldier Cap
item:foot-soldier-cap.description: Flanged iron cap widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:foot-soldier-cap.location: Chance to drop from Godrick Foot Soldier enemies that wear it.

item:foot-soldier-gauntlets.name: Foot Soldier Gauntlets
item:foot-soldier-gauntlets.description: Metal gauntlets covered in nicks and dents. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:foot-soldier-gauntlets.location: - The Foot Soldier Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Godrick Foot Soldier enemies.

item:foot-soldier-greaves.name: Foot Soldier Greaves
item:foot-soldier-greaves.description: Metal Graves that have already been mended countless times. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 6 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 6

item:foot-soldier-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Foot Soldier enemies that wear it.

item:foot-soldier-helm.name: Foot Soldier Helm
item:foot-soldier-helm.description: Wholly unembellished iron helm. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:foot-soldier-helm.location: Chance to drop from Radahn Foot Soldier enemies.

item:foot-soldier-helmet.name: Foot Soldier Helmet
item:foot-soldier-helmet.description: Helmet with a protective metal plate. Widely issued to foot soldiers in lord's army.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:foot-soldier-helmet.location: Chance to drop from Raya Lucaria Foot Soldier enemies.

item:foot-soldier-tabard.name: Foot Soldier Tabard
item:foot-soldier-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with more than a few stains. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 9 · Slash 10 · Pierce 10 · Magic 11 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 10

item:foot-soldier-tabard.location: Chance to drop from Raya Lucaria Foot Soldier enemies.

item:forked-greatsword.name: Forked Greatsword
item:forked-greatsword.description: Oddly shaped greatsword wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue"                   and causes blood loss.
item:forked-greatsword.location: The Forked Greatsword in Elden Ring is farmed from Fanged Imps wielding it, with the best location being the Road's End Catacombs in western Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:forked-hatchet.name: Forked Hatchet
item:forked-hatchet.description: Peculiar hatchet wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.
item:forked-hatchet.location: The Forked Hatchet in Elden Ring drops randomly from Fanged Imps wielding this weapon in catacomb dungeons, with early farming available at Stormfoot Catacombs or Murkwater Catacombs in Limgrave.

item:forked-tongue-hatchet.name: Forked-Tongue Hatchet
item:forked-tongue-hatchet.location: This weapon has a 2% chance to be dropped by hatchet-wielding Imps in catacombs in the Realm of Shadow. It can be farmed in the Scorpion River Catacombs.

item:formic-rock.name: Formic Rock
item:formic-rock.description: Rock formed from solidified giant ant venom. Highly acidic. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:fortissax-s-lightning-spear.name: Fortissax's Lightning Spear
item:fortissax-s-lightning-spear.description: Incantation that channels the power of the ancient dragon Fortissax.
item:fortissax-s-lightning-spear.location:
- Trade the Remembrance of the Lichdragon, gained by defeating Lichdragon Fortissax, with Finger Reader Enia.
- Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

stats.Effect: Stabs from above with two red lightning spears in tandem

item:founding-rain-of-stars.name: Founding Rain Of Stars
item:founding-rain-of-stars.description: The eldest primeval sorcery, said to have been discovered by an
item:founding-rain-of-stars.location:
**Loot:** Heretical Rise, Mountaintops of the Giants
- You'll need to walk over an invisible bridge across the valley directly east of the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook Site of Grace.

stats.Effect: Releases a downpour of star rain for a while

item:four-toed-fowl-foot.name: Four-toed Fowl Foot
item:four-toed-fowl-foot.description: Foot of a four-toed fowl. Material used for crafting items. In the Lands Between, having three digits is seen as a bad omen. As such, the rarer four-toed fowl's is a gift of great luck indeed.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:freezing-grease.name: Freezing Grease
item:freezing-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of frozen materials.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting frost

item:freezing-grease.location:
The Freezing Grease can be crafted with the Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [2] and the following Crafting Materials:
- Root Resin x1
- Rimed Crystal Bud x1

item:freezing-mist.name: Freezing Mist
item:freezing-mist.description: Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch.
item:freezing-mist.location:
**Purchase:** Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 6,000 Runes by Preceptor Seluvis.
- Should Seluvis die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Seluvis's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Releases cold mist before caster

item:freezing-pot.name: Freezing Pot
item:freezing-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Engraved with the crest of the Carian Royals. Throw at enemies to cause buildup of frost. Originates from the cold, dark moon of Ranni, the Carian princess.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of frost.

item:freezing-pot.location: Craftable — Empty Ritual Pot x1, Rimed Crystal Bud x2

item:frenzied-burst.name: Frenzied Burst
item:frenzied-burst.description: Incantations originating from the maddening Three Fingers.
item:frenzied-burst.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Frenzied Burst drops from a Scarab guarded by Frenzied Rats in the middle of a small forest, directly south of the Church of Inhibition in Liurnia.

stats.Effect: Emits concentrated blast of yellow flame of frenzy from eyes

item:frenzied-cookbook.name: Frenzied Cookbook
item:frenzied-cookbook.description: A record of crafting techniques left by those afflicted by the madness of the flame of frenzy.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:frenzied-flame-seal.name: Frenzied Flame Seal
item:frenzied-flame-seal.description: Formless sacred seal bestowed by the maiden of the Three Fingers. Enhances incantations of the frenzied flame. This seal is the mark of the Lord of Frenzied Flame. Scales incantations using strength, dexterity, intelligence, and faith all together.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Int E · Fai D

item:frenzied-flame-seal.location: The Frenzied Flame Seal is obtained at the very bottom of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds sewer system beneath Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:frenzied-s-cookbook-1.name: Frenzied's Cookbook [1]
item:frenzied-s-cookbook-1.description: A record of crafting techniques left by those afflicted by the madness of the flame of frenzy. Contains techniques discovered in desperation.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:frenzied-s-cookbook-1.location: Found on a corpse in a house in the Frenzied Flame Village in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:frenzyflame-perfume-bottle.name: Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int E · Fai E

item:frenzyflame-perfume-bottle.location: Found on a corpse inside the Abandoned Church in the southeastern Abyssal Woods.

item:frenzyflame-stone.name: Frenzyflame Stone
item:frenzyflame-stone.description: Ruin fragment blessed with an incantation of the Three Fingers. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to continuously heal chaos followers

item:frenzyflame-stone.location: **Loot:** Liurnia of the Lakes - Found on a ledge southeast of the Ruined Labyrinth Site of Grace, southwest of the Minor Erdtree of East Liurnia. - Found on a corpse sitting in a ring of chairs southeast of the Frenzied Flame Village Outskirts Site of Grace. **Quest Item:** Subterranean Shunning-Grounds - x5 received from Lightseeker Hyetta after letting her translate the message of the Three Fingers. **Crafting:** Frenzied's Cookbook [2] - Can be crafted using Yellow Embers and Sanctuary Stones through the recipes offered by the Frenzied's Cookbook [2].

item:freyja-s-greatsword.name: Freyja's Greatsword
item:freyja-s-greatsword.location:
This weapon can be obtainable wherever Redmane Freyja dies.
- If you gave her Freyja's Letter, you can find Freyja's Greatsword on her body after defeating her during the boss against Needle Knight Leda and her allies.
- Otherwise, it can be found by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Sites of Grace after defeating Leda and her allies.

item:frozen-armament.name: Frozen Armament
item:frozen-armament.description: Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch. Enchants armament held in the right hand with frost. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. The snowy crone taught the young Ranni to fear the dark moon as she imparted her cold sorcery.
item:frozen-armament.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Acquired from felling a Scarab on the road northwest of the Behind Caria Manor Site of Grace.

stats.Effect: Enchants right-hand armament with frost

item:frozen-lightning-spear.name: Frozen Lightning Spear
item:frozen-lightning-spear.description: Incantation that channels the power of the Dragonkin Soldiers. Creates a spear of ice lightning and stabs it into the ground from above. On impact, the spear will burst into trails of lightning advancing forwards. The Dragonkin were born in the Eternal City, where they knew no true sky, nor true lightning. Instead, ice lightning was their weapon.
item:frozen-lightning-spear.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Ainsel River
- Frozen Lightning Spear is acquired after defeating the Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella.

stats.Effect: Stabs with ice lightning spear from above

item:frozen-needle.name: Frozen Needle
item:frozen-needle.description: A razor-thin piercing blade of ice. Forged by Ijii, the carian Royal Blackmith. Can inflict frost upon enemies, and launch its blade with a strong attack.  The blade immediately regenerates.
item:frozen-needle.location: The Frozen Needle is found inside a treasure chest at the Kingsrealm Ruins in Liurnia of the Lakes.

stats.Effect: On horseback, feed to Torrent to vastly restore HP

item:fulgurbloom.name: Fulgurbloom
item:fulgurbloom.description: Yellow flower that grows in lightning-struck lands. Material used for crafting items. Imbued with traces of lightning's essence.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:fulgurbloom.location: - Fulgurbloom grows abundantly in spots where lightning strikes regularly. These spots can be found in every major area. - The earliest accessible spot of 14 Fulgurbloom is in Limgrave, on the hill just north of the Agheel Lake North site of grace. - In Weeping Peninsula a group of 8 can be found east from the MInor Erdtree in a small ravine accessible via Tombstones embedded in the side of the cliff. - In Altus Plateau, the largest collection, with 3 groups, can be found near the Rampartside Path site of grace, east of the Sainted Hero's Grave.

item:full-moon-crossbow.name: Full Moon Crossbow
item:full-moon-crossbow.description: One-of-a-kind enchanted crossbow of exquisitely detailed craftsmanship. Made to celebrate the matrimonial union, and reconciliation, between the houses of the Erdtree and the Full Moon, Leyndell and Raya Lucaria. The two rings dance when reloading the weapon. Reveals true worth when used with holy- infused bolts.
item:full-moon-crossbow.location: The Full Moon Crossbow is located in a treasure chest at the top of a bell tower in the Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes).

item:fur-leggings.name: Fur Leggings
item:fur-leggings.description: Leggings fashioned from bristly pelts. Worn by ancestral follower warriors. The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 5 · Holy 4

item:fur-leggings.location: Fur Leggings have a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Warriors.

item:fur-raiment.name: Fur Raiment
item:fur-raiment.description: Raiment fashioned from a bristly pelt. Worn by ancestral follower warriors. The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

stats.Negation: Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 6 · Fire 7 · Lightning 8 · Holy 7

item:fur-raiment.location: Fur Raiment has a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Warriors.

item:furious-blade-of-ansbach.name: Furious Blade of Ansbach
item:furious-blade-of-ansbach.location:
**Loot:** Enir-Ilim
- Complete Sir Ansbach's questline while siding with him against Needle Knight Leda and defeat Promised Consort Radahn and then this Incantation (as well as Ansbach's Set and the Obsidian Lamina) can be found on his body, just to the right after entering the boss arena again.

item:furlcalling-finger-remedy.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
item:furlcalling-finger-remedy.description: Item for online play. Craftable item. Reveals cooperative and competitive multiplayer signs. Co-op summoning signs will be shown in gold, while hostile summoning signs will be shown in red. Multiplayer begins when you summon a player from another world through their sign.

stats.Effect: Reveals co-op and hostile summoning signs

item:furled-finger-s-trick-mirror.name: Furled Finger's Trick-mirror
item:furled-finger-s-trick-mirror.description: A small, clouded mirror that reflects a flesh-and-blood figure. Makes the bearer take on the appearance of a Host of Fingers One of the ritual implements created by the Tarnished to deceive invaders.

stats.Effect: Take on appearance of a Host of Fingers

item:furled-finger-s-trick-mirror.location: - Purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

item:gargoyle-s-black-axe.name: Gargoyle's Black Axe
item:gargoyle-s-black-axe.description: Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyle, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:gargoyle-s-black-axe.location: You can get the Gargoyle's Black Axe in Elden Ring by defeating the Black Blade Kindred boss guarding the Grand Lift of Rold.

item:gargoyle-s-black-blades.name: Gargoyle's Black Blades
item:gargoyle-s-black-blades.description: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyle, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Fai D

item:gargoyle-s-black-blades.location: The Gargoyle's Black Blades drops from the Black Blade Kindred boss guarding the Grand Lift of Rold.

item:gargoyle-s-black-halberd.name: Gargoyle's Black Halberd
item:gargoyle-s-black-halberd.description: Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyle, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:gargoyle-s-black-halberd.location: To get the Gargoyle's Black Halberd in Elden Ring, you must defeat the Black Blade Kindred boss guarding the Bestial Sanctum in Dragonbarrow, Caelid.

item:gargoyle-s-blackblade.name: Gargoyle's Blackblade
item:gargoyle-s-blackblade.description: Broze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyle mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.  Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:gargoyle-s-blackblade.location: To get the Gargoyle's Blackblade in Elden Ring, you must defeat the Black Blade Kindred boss guarding the Bestial Sanctum in Dragonbarrow, Caelid.

item:gargoyle-s-great-axe.name: Gargoyle's Great Axe
item:gargoyle-s-great-axe.description: Description  "Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyle. Just like the wielder, the missing part have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions."
item:gargoyle-s-great-axe.location: The Gargoyle's Great Axe in Elden Ring is dropped by a Valiant Gargoyle in the Capital Outskirts of the Altus Plateau.

item:gargoyle-s-greatsword.name: Gargoyle's Greatsword
item:gargoyle-s-greatsword.description: Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyle.  Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

item:gargoyle-s-halberd.name: Gargoyle's Halberd
item:gargoyle-s-halberd.description: Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyle Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.
item:gargoyle-s-halberd.location: To get the Gargoyle's Halberd in Elden Ring, you must defeat the Valiant Gargoyle located near the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:gargoyle-s-twinblade.name: Gargoyle's Twinblade
item:gargoyle-s-twinblade.description: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyle.  just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

item:gavel-of-haima.name: Gavel Of Haima
item:gavel-of-haima.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Creates a magical greathammer and slams it down. Allows one follow-up attack. Drawn from the scholarly conspectus of Haima, the adjudicator of the academy, this sorcery employs might as a means to quell conflict.
item:gavel-of-haima.location: Same way as Cannon of Haima, by breaking the seal at the Converted Fringe Tower via Erudition gesture while wearing a glintstone crown.

stats.Effect: Attacks using a magic greathammer

item:gazing-finger.name: Gazing Finger

stats.Scaling: Str C · Int D · Fai E

item:gazing-finger.location: The weapon can be obtained by trading the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers to Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.

item:gelmir-glintstone-staff.name: Gelmir Glintstone Staff
item:gelmir-glintstone-staff.description: Staff with a forked tip, embedded with red glintstones. Enhances lava sorceries.  The Man-Serpents of Mt. Gelmir draw from faith in addition to intelligence to enhance the potency of their sorcery.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Int D · Fai D

item:gelmir-glintstone-staff.location: The Gelmir Glintstone Staff in Elden Ring is a rare drop from the Man-Serpent Sorcerer located in the throne room above Volcano Manor on Mount Gelmir.

item:gelmir-knight-armor.name: Gelmir Knight Armor
item:gelmir-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by knights once royal to Praector Rykard.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 14 · Pierce 13 · Magic 10 · Fire 12 · Lightning 10 · Holy 10

item:gelmir-knight-armor.location: Gelmir Hero's Grave, right where the Bloodhound Knight with the Bloodhound Knight set is.

item:gelmir-knight-armor-altered.name: Gelmir Knight Armor (altered)
item:gelmir-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Gelmir Knight Armor.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 13 · Pierce 13 · Magic 10 · Fire 12 · Lightning 9 · Holy 10

item:gelmir-knight-armor-altered.location: Gelmir Hero's Grave, right where the Bloodhound Knight with the Bloodhound Knight set is. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:gelmir-knight-gauntlets.name: Gelmir Knight Gauntlets
item:gelmir-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard. Time has yet to dull their luster.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:gelmir-knight-gauntlets.location:
**Location**: Gelmir Hero's Grave
- The Gelmir Knight Gauntlets are found in Gelmir Hero's Grave, near the Bloodhound Knight that drops the Bloodhound Knight Set.

item:gelmir-knight-greaves.name: Gelmir Knight Greaves
item:gelmir-knight-greaves.description: Greaves worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard. Time has yet to dull their luster.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 8 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 7 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:gelmir-knight-greaves.location: Gelmir Hero's Grave, right where the Bloodhound Knight with the Bloodhound Knight set is.

item:gelmir-knight-helm.name: Gelmir Knight Helm
item:gelmir-knight-helm.description: Helm worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard. Its crest of red feathers symbolizes Rykard's pedigree as Lord Radagon's son.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:gelmir-knight-helm.location: Gelmir Hero's Grave, right where the Bloodhound Knight with the Bloodhound Knight set is.

item:gelmir-s-fury.name: Gelmir's Fury
item:gelmir-s-fury.description: One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir.
item:gelmir-s-fury.location:
**Quest Item:** Volcano Manor
- Acquired from Knight Bernahl in the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor after successfully defeating Vargram the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm with him.
- This sorcery will be left unobtainable for the rest of the playthrough should Bernahl die before the player joins Volcano Manor.

stats.Effect: Covers area with surge of magma from the earth

item:ghiza-s-wheel.name: Ghiza's Wheel
item:ghiza-s-wheel.description: Great iron wheel lined with flesh-flaying blades. Device of torture used by Inquisitor Ghiza. As the wheel spins it causes severe pain and blood loss. The design was adopted for use as the iconic weapon wielded by Iron Virgins.
item:ghiza-s-wheel.location: Ghiza's Wheel is a colossal weapon (not a staff) found in Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir.

item:ghost-glovewort-1.name: Ghost Glovewort [1]
item:ghost-glovewort-1.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. A spirit nestles close to it. Strengthens renowned ashes to +1. Ashes which keep their renown even after death cannot be strengthened by merely corporal glovewort.

stats.Effect: Strengthens renowned ashes to +1.

item:ghost-glovewort-2.name: Ghost Glovewort [2]
item:ghost-glovewort-2.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. A spirit nestles close to it.

stats.Effect: Strengthen renowned ashes to +2

item:ghost-glovewort-3.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. A spirit nestles close it.

stats.Effect: Strengthen renowned ashes to +3

stats.Effect: Strengthen renowned ashes to +4

item:ghost-glovewort-5.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. A spirit nestles close to it.

- Several are found in northern Uhl Palace Ruins and Ainsel River Main
- 2 are found in Nokstella, Eternal City
- 2 are found in Deeproot Depths

- One can be found in Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs

- Dropped by Spirit Eels

item:ghost-glovewort-8.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs.

stats.Effect: Stengthened renowed ashes to +8

item:ghost-glovewort-9.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs.  A spirit nestles close to it.

stats.Effect: Stengthened renowed ashes to +9

item:ghostflame-breath.name: Ghostflame Breath
item:ghostflame-breath.location:
**Dragon Communion:** Limgrave / Caelid / Jagged Peak
- Acquired from the altar at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak for 3 Dragon Hearts.

item:ghostflame-torch.name: Ghostflame Torch
item:ghostflame-torch.description: Metal torch that burns with cold ghostflame. Tool of the Fallen Hawks who prowl the underground rivers. When the band's last embers were used up in their long search, they began to burn the bones of their fellows, acquiring the cold ghostflame, but sealing their fate as dwellers of the underground for all eternity.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Int D

item:ghostflame-torch.location: The Ghostflame Torch in Elden Ring is found on a corpse in Nokron, Eternal City, which you can access after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

item:giant-crusher.name: Giant-crusher
item:giant-crusher.description: A hammer made from a boulder, used in the War against the Giants. One of the heftiest weapons in the entire Lands Between. After the giants were quelled, and man turned against man in violence, this weapon was all but forgotten. Man has grown feeble in comparison to his forebears.
item:giant-crusher.location: The Giant-Crusher colossal weapon is located in an unmarked military camp south of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace in the Altus Plateau (Capital Outskirts).

item:giant-golden-arc.name: Giant Golden Arc
item:giant-golden-arc.location:
**Loot:** Scadu Altus
- Found in the Ruins of Unte, within the courtyard blocked by a deactivated Furnace Golem. Reactivate the Furnace Golem with a Hefty Furnace Pot thrown from the top of one of the outer ruins in order to enter the courtyard. The incantation can be found  in a chest within the courtyard shrine.

item:giant-hunt.name: Giant Hunt
item:giant-hunt.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Giant Hunt: Skill developed for confronting gigantic foes. Step forward from a low stance, carrying the momentum into a sudden upward thrust."Usable on large and colossal weapons capable of thrusting, spears and twinblades.
item:giant-hunt.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Drops from a Night's Cavalry patrolling the Bellum Highway at night.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:giant-rat-ashes.name: Giant Rat Ashes
item:giant-rat-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three giant rats.

stats.Effect: Summons three giant rat spirits

item:giant-rat-ashes.location: Found on a corpse in the stable just northeast of the West Windmill Pasture.

item:giant-s-red-braid.name: Giant's Red Braid
item:giant-s-red-braid.description: Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant. Every giant is red of hair, and Radagon was said to have despised his own red locks. Perhaps that was a curse of their kind.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:giant-s-red-braid.location: Remembrance of the Fire Giant (Fire Giant)

item:giant-s-seal.name: Giant's Seal
item:giant-s-seal.description: Sacred seal depicting the one eyed god of the Fire Giants, adorned with braids of red hair. Sacred seal wielded by Fire Monks and Prelates, this catalyst enhances Giants' Flame incantations.
item:giant-s-seal.location: The Giant's Seal is located on a corpse in the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave dungeon in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:giantsflame-fire-pot.name: Giantsflame Fire Pot
item:giantsflame-fire-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Enchanted by incantations of the Giants' Flame. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy fire damage. Damage scales with faith.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy fire damage.

item:giantsflame-take-thee.name: Giantsflame Take Thee
item:giantsflame-take-thee.description: One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the
item:giantsflame-take-thee.location: **Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants - Sold for 13,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Giant's Prayerbook. - Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Hurls massive ball of raging fire

item:gilded-foot-soldier-cap.name: Gilded Foot Soldier Cap
item:gilded-foot-soldier-cap.description: Flanged cap made from gilded iron. Issued to foot soldiers protecting the royal capital of Leyndell.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:gilded-foot-soldier-cap.location: Chance to drop from Leyndell Foot Soldier enemies.

item:gilded-greatshield.name: Gilded Greatshield
item:gilded-greatshield.description: Metal greatshield coated with gold. Carried by knights loyal to Godrick. The red tinge in the gold coat mirrors the primordial matter that became the Erdtree. The color of homeward yearning.
item:gilded-greatshield.location: - 4% chance to be dropped by shield-wielding Godrick Knights, including the Bloodcrazed Knight at Fort Haight.

item:gilded-iron-shield.name: Gilded Iron Shield
item:gilded-iron-shield.description: Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. Though the gold leaf is peeling and the effect is slight, it still boosts holy damage negation.
item:gilded-iron-shield.location: Found on a corpse in the graveyard outside the Church of Pilgrimage on the Weeping Peninsula.

item:glaive.name: Glaive
item:glaive.description: Weapon comprised of a sharp blade affixed to a long grip. It is in fact a sickle repurposed to be a tool of war. This far-reaching weapon excels at slashing attacks.
item:glaive.location: To get the standard Glaive, you need to farm the Graveyard Skeletons wielding this weapon.

item:glass-shard.name: Glass Shard

stats.Effect: Shard of filthy glass. Worthless rubbish

item:glass-shard.location:
- Patches in Murkwater Cave (unlimited stock)
- Found scattered throughout the Lands Between, often as bait to lure the player into ambushes

item:glintblade-phalanx.name: Glintblade Phalanx
item:glintblade-phalanx.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.
item:glintblade-phalanx.location: **Purchase:** Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold - Sold for 2,500 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Royal House Scroll. - Should the scroll be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Sorcery, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Forms a defensive arch of magic glintblades

item:glintstone-arc.name: Glintstone Arc
item:glintstone-arc.description: Fires a horizontal arc of magic that spreads outward. This sorcery can be cast repeteadly and while in motion.
item:glintstone-arc.location:
**Purchase:** Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold
- One of the starting spells of the Astrologer Origin.
- x1 Sold for 1,500 Runes by Sorceress  Sellen in any of her locations other than Witchbane Ruins.
- x1 Sold for 1,500 Runes by Sorcerer Thops at Church of Irith.
- Should Sellen or Thops die before purchasing this Sorcery from them, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Fires a horizontally-widening magic arc

item:glintstone-breath.name: Glintstone Breath
item:glintstone-breath.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
item:glintstone-breath.location:
**Dragon Communion:** Caelid
- Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 1 Dragon Heart.

stats.Effect: Channels dragon to spew icy breath.

item:glintstone-cometshard.name: Glintstone Cometshard
item:glintstone-cometshard.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires a magical comet with a trailing tail. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency. A sorcery of the Karolos Conspectus, the most venerable of the academy.
item:glintstone-cometshard.location: **Purchase:** Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold - Sold for 12,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Conspectus Scroll. - Should the scroll be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Sorcery, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Fires a magic comet with a trailing tail

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-1.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [1]
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-1.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the academy. Contains information on "faux sorceries,"such as they were called.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-1.location: On a corpse at a soldier camp northwest of the Lake-Facing Cliffs Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-2.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [2]
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-2.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the Academy.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-2.location: On a corpse right next to the Laskyar Ruins Site of Grace.

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-3.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [3]
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-3.description: Contains a record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the Academy. Contains information on "faux sorceries,"such as they were called.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-3.location: In a chest in the Highway Lookout Tower in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-4.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [4]
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-4.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the academy. Contains information on "faux sorceries,"such as they were called. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: -Magic Pot -Roped Magic Pot -Shield Grease

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-4.location: In a chest in a tower north-west of the Academy Gate Town Site of Grace.

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-5.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [5]
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-5.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the academy.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-5.location: In a chest in a room in the Academy of Raya Lucaria, left of the door after the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace.

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-6.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [6]
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-6.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the academy.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-6.location: Found in a room in the south-eastern wall of Caria Manor.

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-7.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook (7)
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-7.description: A record ofcrafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the Academy. Contains information on "faux sorceries,"such as they were called.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire.

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-8.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [8]
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-8.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the Academy. Contains information on "faux sorceries,"such as they were called. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Academy Magic Pot

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire.

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-8.location: Found in the Consecrated Snowfield, southwest of Albinauric's Rise.

item:glintstone-firefly.name: Glintstone Firefly
item:glintstone-firefly.description: A firefly whose glowing tail has hardened into glintstone, widely found in Liurnia Lake. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:glintstone-firefly.location: - Found near large, blue crystals found in Liurnia of the Lakes and Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. - In Liurnia of the Lakes, well over a dozen can be found by heading to the Folly on the Lake Site of Grace near the Village of the Albinaurics and heading southwest. There are some Crystalians throughout the path but it is otherwise largely dangerfree. - At the eastern edge of Greyoll's Dragonbarrow, south of Lenne's Rise, is a collection of glintstone crystals carrying these Fireflies. Be aware of the large boulder that will spawn behind you if you stray too far down the path.

item:glintstone-icecrag.name: Glintstone Icecrag
item:glintstone-icecrag.description: Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch.
item:glintstone-icecrag.location:
**Purchase:** Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 7,500 Runes by Preceptor Seluvis.
- Should Seluvis die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Seluvis's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Fires mass of cold magic from glintstone

item:glintstone-kris.name: Glintstone Kris
item:glintstone-kris.description: Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace. Though the weapon is embedded with precious glintstones and features Erdtree ornamentation, the undulating blade is symbolic of an ancient ritual.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int D

item:glintstone-kris.location: The Glintstone Kris is rewarded at the conclusion of Sorceress Sellen's questline.

item:glintstone-nail.name: Glintstone Nail
item:glintstone-nail.location:
**Purchased**: Cathedral of Manus Metyr
- Glintstone Nail may be purchased from Count Ymir for  12,000 Runes after ringing the bell in the Finger Ruins of Rhia.

item:glintstone-nails.name: Glintstone Nails
item:glintstone-nails.location:
**Purchased**: Cathedral of Manus Metyr
- Glintstone Nails may be purchased from Count Ymir for  12,000 Runes after ringing the bell in the Finger Ruins of Rhia.

item:glintstone-pebble.name: Glintstone Pebble
item:glintstone-pebble.description: The most basic glintstone sorcery of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
item:glintstone-pebble.location:
**Purchase:** Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold
- One of the starting spells of the Astrologer Origin.
- x1 Sold for 1,000 Runes by Sorceress  Sellen in any of her locations other than Witchbane Ruins.
- x1 Sold for 1,000 Runes by Sorcerer Thops at Church of Irith.
- Should Sellen or Thops die before purchasing this Sorcery from them, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Fires magic projectiles from glintstone

item:glintstone-scarab.name: Glintstone Scarab
item:glintstone-scarab.description: Blue-green scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of sorcery during their labors.

stats.Negation: Physical -5 · Strike -5 · Slash -5 · Pierce -5 · Magic -4 · Fire -4 · Lightning -4 · Holy -5

item:glintstone-scarab.location: **Location**: Academy of Raya Lucaria - The Glintstone Scarab is found inside a chest in the tower where the Giant Silver Tear spawns and drops onto the ramp, located beyond the Debate Parlor Site of Grace. The area is accessible through the courtyard containing Moongrum, Carian Knight. Pass through the south gate onto a small balcony with a Glintstone Sorcerer and Wandering Nobles and follow the eastern wall. Jump over the balcony railing onto a small ledge, follow the path to an alcove, and climb the ladder.

item:glintstone-scrap.name: Glintstone Scrap
item:glintstone-scrap.description: Piece of glintstone tinged with unstable magic. Found in crystal tunnels. Break gem, using FP to produce a magic bolt. Poor quality and thereby easily broken, a sorcerer wouldn't give it a second look.

stats.Effect: Break gem, using FP to produce a magic bolt.

item:glintstone-scrap.location: - Some can be found in the Limgrave Tunnels.

item:glintstone-sorcerer-ashes.name: Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes
item:glintstone-sorcerer-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a glintstone sorcerer.

stats.Effect: Summons glintstone sorcerer spirit

item:glintstone-sorcerer-ashes.location: Dropped by the Spiritcaller Snail in Road's End Catacombs.

item:glintstone-staff.name: Glintstone Staff
item:glintstone-staff.description: Staff with a glintstone embedded at the tip. A catalyst for casting sorceries.  Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.
item:glintstone-staff.location: For a solid all-around weapon, you can find the standard Glintstone Staff at the King's Realm Ruins in Liurnia of the Lakes by farming the teleporting sorcerer enemies.

item:glintstone-stars.name: Glintstone Stars
item:glintstone-stars.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
item:glintstone-stars.location:
**Purchase:** Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Caelid / Roundtable Hold
- x1 Sold for 3,000 Runes by Sorceress  Sellen in any of her locations other than Witchbane Ruins.
- x1 Sold for 3,000 Runes by Sage Gowry after he has repaired the snapped Unalloyed Gold Needle.
- Should Sellen or Gowry die before purchasing this Sorcery from them, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Fires three shooting stars that pursue foes

item:glintstone-whetblade.name: Glintstone Whetblade
item:glintstone-whetblade.description: Glintstone whetblade with a cipher engraved. Can be used as a whetstone knife.

stats.Effect: Grants choice of affinity upgrade to weapon

item:glintstone-whetblade.location:
**Location**: Academy of Raya Lucaria
- Found on a corpse in the side room west of the  Debate Parlor Site of Grace, guarded by two Glintstone Sorcerers.

item:glowstone.name: Glowstone
item:glowstone.description: Polished Ruin Fragment that shines brighter than a Rainbow Stone. Craftable item. Emits light from the location it is placed, illuminating surroundings. However, the effect is short-lived, and it lacks the diverse colors of rainbow stones. May serve some benefit in dark places, or at night.

stats.Effect: Emits a faint light from the location it is placed

item:glowstone.location: Craftable — Ruin Fragment x1, Dewkissed Herba x1

item:godfrey-icon.name: Godfrey Icon
item:godfrey-icon.description: A legendary talisman depicting the Elden Lord Godfrey. Raises charge attack power of sorceries, incantations, and skills.

stats.Effect: Enhances charged spells and skills.

item:godfrey-icon.location: Goldfrey (Golden Lineage) at the Village of the Albinaurics plateau, charged-attack/spell talisman.

item:godksin-noble-robe.name: Godksin Noble Robe
item:godksin-noble-robe.description: Robe made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Subcutaneous fat makes it plump and soft. Worn by Godskin Nobles known for their seven-face aprons. Strengthens the Noble Presence incantation. Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

stats.Negation: Physical 6.1 · Strike 9.5 · Slash 6.7 · Pierce 6.1 · Magic 13 · Fire 12.4 · Lightning 12.6 · Holy 14.1

item:godrick-knight-armor.name: Godrick Knight Armor
item:godrick-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by knights loyal to Godrick The Grafted.

item:godskin-peeler.name: Godskin Peeler
item:godskin-peeler.description: Unique twinblade wielded by Godskin Apostles characterized by its disturbing design. One end features a sickle for slicing attacks while the other boasts a winding spike for boring into flesh. Much skill is required to wield this weapon due to its asymmetric nature.
item:godskin-peeler.location: To get the Godskin Peeler, travel to Dominula, Windmill Village at the northernmost peak of the Altus Plateau.

item:godskin-stitcher.name: Godskin Stitcher
item:godskin-stitcher.description: Elegant piercing sword with a celadon colored blade wielded by Godskin Nobles. The nobles possess skill with the sword unmatched by any lowborn. Despite its size, successive attacks from this weapon are swifter than the eye can follow.
item:godskin-stitcher.location: You can get the Godskin Stitcher in Elden Ring by defeating the Godskin Noble boss at the Temple of Eiglay in Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir.

item:godskin-swaddling-cloth.name: Godskin Swaddling Cloth
item:godskin-swaddling-cloth.description: Sacred cloth of the Godskin Apostles, made from supple skin sewn together.

stats.Effect: Successive attacks restore HP

item:godskin-swaddling-cloth.location: - Obtained from the Spiritcaller's Cave in northeastern Mountaintops of the Giants, by defeating all of the bosses at the end of the dungeon.

item:godslayer-s-greatsword.name: Godslayer's Greatsword
item:godslayer-s-greatsword.description: Sacred sword of the Dusk-Eyed Queen who controlled the Godskin Apostles before her defeat at the hands of Maliketh. The black flames wielded by the apostles are channeled from this sword.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:godslayer-s-greatsword.location: The Godslayer's Greatsword is located in the basement of the Divine Tower of Caelid in the Dragonbarrow region.

item:godslayer-s-seal.name: Godslayer's Seal
item:godslayer-s-seal.description: Sacred seal of the Godskin Apostles, inlaid with obsidian. Said to represent the manipulation of black flame, this catalyst enhances godslayer incantations.
item:godslayer-s-seal.location: The Godslayer's Seal is located in Stormveil Castle.

item:gold-bracelets.name: Gold Bracelets
item:gold-bracelets.description: Bracelets made in the image of Erdtree branches. Minimal adornments made my Lord Goldmask's disciples. Those disciples have long since left him.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:gold-bracelets.location: - The Gold Bracelets are obtained by completing Goldmask's questline.

item:gold-firefly.name: Gold Firefly
item:gold-firefly.description: Firefly that gives off a golden light. Material used in crafting items. Found near bodies of water close to Minor Erdtrees. The light of fireflies is believed to have an alluring magic. Golden light is considered to invite runes.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:gold-pickled-fowl-foot.name: Gold-pickled Fowl Foot
item:gold-pickled-fowl-foot.description: Four-toed foot of a fowl, pickled in a golden medicinal solution. Craftable item. Boosts the amount of runes obtained from defeating enemies for a certain duration Since old times, the needy would scrape the meat clean even from a fowl's claw.

stats.Effect: Boosts rune acquisition for a time (30%)

item:gold-pickled-fowl-foot.location: Crafted. Rowa fruit + gold firefly + fowl foot. Farm Lake of Rot / Siofra fireflies.

item:gold-scarab.name: Gold Scarab
item:gold-scarab.description: A talisman facsimile of a scarab, the carrier of treasures and precious things.

stats.Effect: Increases runes obtained from

item:gold-scarab.location: - Obtained by defeating the dual Cleanrot Knight in the Abandoned Cave in central Caelid. This cave can be reached by heading east of the Smoldering Wall, and using a large dead tree root to traverse a canyon.

item:gold-tinged-excrement.name: Gold-tinged Excrement
item:gold-tinged-excrement.description: Someone's excrement. It has a golden tinge. Material used for crafting items. Often hidden in woods and thickets. Gold-tinged excrement is a highly stable substance; it doesn't dry out, nor does it lose its customary warmth or scent. For better or for worse, it remains as it is.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:gold-tinged-excrement.location: - Gold-Tinged Excrement is found hidden in forests and thickets throughout the Lands Between.

item:gold-waistwrap.name: Gold Waistwrap

item:golden-beast-crest-shield.name: Golden Beast Crest Shield

item:golden-beast-crest-shield.location: Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation. If you are not able to defeat it during your first visit, you can reattempt the fight later by going through the "Precipice of Anticipation" sending gate at the Four Belfries.

item:golden-centipede.description: The golden, desiccated remains of a centipede.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:golden-epitaph.location: The Golden Epitaph straight sword is located in the Auriza Hero's Grave on the Altus Plateau, just northeast of the Capital Outskirts.

item:golden-greatshield.name: Golden Greatshield

item:golden-greatshield.location: 4% chance to be dropped by Leyndell Knights throughout Altus Plateau and in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:golden-halberd.name: Golden Halberd
item:golden-halberd.description: Weighty halberd forged of gold. Wielded by the Order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights.  Deals holy damage. A masterfully crafted weapon that lives up to its heft, but is difficult for one mere human strength to wield.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:golden-land.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Deeproot Depths
- Drops from a Scarab guarded by a group of Giant Ants south of the Erdtree Avatar near the Great Waterfall Crest Site of Grace.

item:golden-order-seal.location: In Elden Ring, the Golden Order Seal is located on a corpse behind the Minor Erdtree Church in the Altus Plateau (near the Capital Outskirts).

item:golden-parry.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Golden Parry: Perform an Erdtree incantation and swing the shield to deflect enemy attacks and break their stance. Effective even at a slight distance."Usable on small and medium shields.
item:golden-parry.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Capital Outskirts

item:golden-slam.location:

item:golden-tailoring-tools.name: Golden Tailoring Tools

stats.Effect: Allows demigod garb alteration at sites of grace

item:golden-tailoring-tools.location:
**Location**: Church of Vows, Liurnia of the Lakes
- Found inside a treasure chest near the Basin of Atonement, alongside the Golden Sewing Needle.

item:golden-vow.name: Golden Vow
item:golden-vow.location: Corpse-finger ruins north of the Altus highway, or the shared ash of war version from Knight Bernahl.
item:golden-vow.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Golden Vow: Skill passed down from antiquity among the knights of the capital. Raise armament aloft and pledge to honor the Erdtree in battle, granting self and nearby allies increased attack power and defense."Usable on all melee armaments.

item:golden-vow-spell.name: Golden Vow (spell)
item:golden-vow-spell.location:
**Loot:** Mt. Gelmir
- Located inside the Corpse-Stench Shack east of the broken stone bridge on the Road of Iniquity. Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater will also invade at this same spot.

stats.Effect: Increases attack and defense for self and allies

item:goldmask-s-rags.name: Goldmask's Rags
item:goldmask-s-rags.description: Worn rags that just barely cover the body. Lord Goldmask felt no draw to the vain excess of clothing; what use is finery to one who seeks greater brilliance?

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Magic 11 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 12

item:goldmask-s-rags.location: Complete Goldmask's questline, then reload the area to loot the armor set from where you found him.

item:golem-fist.name: Golem Fist

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Int E · Fai E

item:golem-fist.location: - 3% chance to be dropped by Golem Smiths in Taylew's Ruined Forge.

item:golem-greatbow.name: Golem Greatbow
item:golem-greatbow.description: Greatbow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Weapon of the Guardian Golem. Extremely heavy, this greatbow requires enormous strength just to draw, suggesting it was not designed for human use.
item:golem-greatbow.location: The Golem Greatbow is a random drop (not guaranteed) from specific Archer Golems.

item:golem-s-halberd.name: Golem's Halberd
item:golem-s-halberd.description: A great halberd of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Wielded by the Guardian Golem.
item:golem-s-halberd.location: The Golem's Halberd is a random drop from Guardian Golems wielding this weapon, with the best early farming location being the bridge leading to the Divine Tower of Limgrave.

item:grace-mimic.name: Grace Mimic
item:grace-mimic.description: A fetish indicating the guidance of grace.

stats.Effect: Light shows the path, but without order

item:grafted-blade-greatsword.name: Grafted Blade Greatsword
item:grafted-blade-greatsword.description: The storied sword of Castle Morne. A revenger's weapon, it is burdened with oceans of anger and regret.  One of the legendary armaments.  A lone surviving champion from a country now vanished was so determined to continue fighting that he claimed the swords of an entire clan of warriors.

item:grafted-dragon.name: Grafted Dragon
item:grafted-dragon.description: The embodiment of the power that still remained in the dragon's head that was granted to Godrick's left arm. The wielder's arm will take the form of a small dragon, sprouting sharp dragon fangs at the fist. This weapon cannot be two-handed.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:grafted-dragon.location: Remembrance of the Grafted (Godrick the Grafted)

item:grass-hair-ornament.name: Grass Hair Ornament
item:grass-hair-ornament.description: A headdress made from wildflowers. Wearing this might make you less easy to spot.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:grass-hair-ornament.location: - The Grass Hair Ornament is  cut content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay.

item:grave-glovewort-1.name: Grave Glovewort [1]
item:grave-glovewort-1.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits. Strengthens ashes to +1. The art of strengthening ashes is known as spirit tuning. only a spirit tuner may perform this deed.

stats.Effect: Strengthen ashes to +1.

item:grave-glovewort-2.name: Grave Glovewort [2]
item:grave-glovewort-2.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits. Strengthens ashes to +2. Spirit tuning is not merely the simple act of imbuing strength. It is an art that lies somewhere between tuning an instrument and conducting a conversation, leaving both parties enriched.

stats.Effect: Strengthen ashes to +2.

item:grave-glovewort-3.name: Grave Glovewort [3]
item:grave-glovewort-3.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.

stats.Effect: Strengthen ashes to +3

item:grave-glovewort-4.name: Grave Glovewort [4]
item:grave-glovewort-4.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each soundless bell used to summon spirits.

stats.Effect: Strengthens ashes to +4

item:grave-glovewort-5.name: Grave Glovewort [5]
item:grave-glovewort-5.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.

stats.Effect: Strengthens ashes to +5

item:grave-glovewort-5.location:
- 2 in Wyndham Catacombs
- 2 in Minor Erdtree Catacombs
- 3 in Unsightly Catacombs
- 3 in Sainted Hero's Grave
- 2 in Caelid Catacombs
- 2 in Auriza Hero's Grave
- Can be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing 2

item:grave-glovewort-6.name: Grave Glovewort [6]
item:grave-glovewort-6.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.

stats.Effect: Strengthens ashes to +6

item:grave-glovewort-7.name: Grave Glovewort [7]
item:grave-glovewort-7.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.

stats.Effect: Strengthens ashes to +7

item:grave-glovewort-8.name: Grave Glovewort [8]
item:grave-glovewort-8.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.

stats.Effect: Strengthens ashes to +8

item:grave-glovewort-9.name: Grave Glovewort [9]
item:grave-glovewort-9.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.

stats.Effect: Strengthens ashes to +9

item:grave-scythe.name: Grave Scythe
item:grave-scythe.description: Greatscythe comprised of a large blade affixed to a crooked stick. Weapon wielded by the aged grave keepers who tend the forgotten graveyards throughout the Lands Between. This weapon is said to have served as a charm against evil spirits in times of old.
item:grave-scythe.location: To get the Grave Scythe in Elden Ring, you need to farm Gravekeeper Skeletons that wield the weapon.

item:grave-violet.name: Grave Violet
item:grave-violet.description: A purple flower than blooms in graveyards. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:grave-violet.location:
- Grave Violets can be harvested in catacombs throughout the Lands Between.
- Jarburg
- Subterranean Shunning-Grounds

item:gravekeeper-cloak.name: Gravekeeper Cloak
item:gravekeeper-cloak.description: Defensive wear encircled by bronze snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes. The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 8 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 8 · Fire 9 · Lightning 10 · Holy 8

item:gravekeeper-cloak.location: Can only be obtained as a rare drop from Duelist-type enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore.

item:gravekeeper-cloak-altered.name: Gravekeeper Cloak (altered)
item:gravekeeper-cloak-altered.description: Lighter version of the Gravekeeper Cloak.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 8 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 7 · Fire 8 · Lightning 9 · Holy 8

item:gravekeeper-cloak-altered.location: Can only be obtained unaltered as a rare drop from Duelist-type enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:gravel-stone.name: Gravel Stone
item:gravel-stone.description: A small clump of sharp, pointed stones. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:gravel-stone-seal.name: Gravel Stone Seal
item:gravel-stone-seal.location: The Gravel Stone Seal is found in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:graven-mass-talisman.name: Graven-mass Talisman
item:graven-mass-talisman.description: A talisman depicting the first school of graven mages — a nightmare that would continue to haunt the academy.  Greatly raises potency of sorceries.  The primeval current is a forbidden tradition of glintstone sorcery. To those who cleave to its teachings, the act of collecting sorcerers to fashion them into the seeds of stars is but another path of scientific inquiry.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises potency of sorceries.

item:graven-mass-talisman.location: Reward from the Raya Lucaria sorcery chain.

item:graven-school-talisman.name: Graven-school Talisman
item:graven-school-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a school of graven mages, the nightmare of the academy.

stats.Effect: Raises potency of sorceries

item:gravitas.name: Gravitas
item:gravitas.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following Skill:Gravitas A Skill from a great white king with stone skin.Pierce the ground with your armament to damage foes as a surge of gravity draws them in.It can be used on melee armaments that are not small.
item:gravitas.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Limgrave
- Drops from an Alabaster Lord on the beach southeast of the Stranded Graveyard.
To reach it, go southeast from Seaside Ruins Site of Grace (just south of Dragon-Burnt Ruins) and look for a Spiritspring to the right of it. The Alabaster Lord will be patrolling from under an archway on the sands.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:gravitational-missile.name: Gravitational Missile
item:gravitational-missile.location: Dropped by the Fallingstar Beast found in the crater north of the Finger Ruins of Dheo.

item:gravity-stone-chunk.name: Gravity Stone Chunk
item:gravity-stone-chunk.description: Shard of rock found in the wake of a meteorite strike.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to cause a gravitational explosion

item:gravity-stone-chunk.location:
- Chest in Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid
- Dropped by Starcallers
- Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks after giving Gravity Stone Peddler's Bell Bearing
- Sold by the Hermit Merchant in Ainsel River

item:gravity-stone-fan.name: Gravity Stone Fan
item:gravity-stone-fan.description: Shard of rock found in the wake of a meteorite strike.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to emit fan-shaped gravitational shockwave

item:gravity-stone-fan.location:
- Chest in Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid
- This item may be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them the Gravity Stone Peddler's Bell Bearing.

item:gravity-well.name: Gravity Well
item:gravity-well.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces. Fires a projectile of condensed gravitational force. Those struck by it will be pulled toward the caster. Charging enhances potency. A gravitational technique studied by the young Radahn. His master was an Alabaster Lord with skin of stone.
item:gravity-well.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Academy of Raya Lucaria
- Acquired from defeating the Alabaster Lord that appears at the end of the graveyard, by the elevator that leads up to the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace.

stats.Effect: Pulls foes toward caster with gravity projectile

item:great-club.name: Great Club
item:great-club.description: An enormous club of hardwood. Wildly hammering foes with this striking weapon requires no dexterity; only brute force. While it may seem sacrilegious, this weapon is said to be a withered branch of the Erdtree. Imbued with holy power, this weapon will never snap.
item:great-club.location: The Great Club weapon can be found at the following location: Dropped by the Stonedigger Troll boss in Old Altus Tunnel, the tunnel requires two Stonesword Keys.

item:great-dragonfly-head.name: Great Dragonfly Head
item:great-dragonfly-head.description: Head of a large dragonfly. Material used for crafting items. Long believed to have the ability to neutralize poisons.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:great-epee.name: Great Epee
item:great-epee.location: The Great Épée is located in West Limgrave, inside a chest in an enemy encampment.

item:great-ghost-glovewort.name: Great Ghost Glovewort
item:great-ghost-glovewort.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. A spirit nestles close to this grand specimen.

stats.Effect: Strengthens renowned ashes to +10

item:great-glintstone-shard.name: Great Glintstone Shard
item:great-glintstone-shard.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching large magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.
item:great-glintstone-shard.location: **Purchase:** Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold - Sold for 2,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Academy Scroll. - Should the scroll be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Sorcery, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Fires larger magic projectiles from glintstone

item:great-grave-glovewort.name: Great Grave Glovewort
item:great-grave-glovewort.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. An especially large specimen.

stats.Effect: Strengthens ashes to +10

item:great-heal.name: Great Heal
item:great-heal.description: Superior incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
item:great-heal.location:
**Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
- Sold for  9,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn after he moves to Altus Plateau.
- Should Corhyn die before purchasing this Incantation from him, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.
- <font color="red">WARNING:</font> If the player lights the Forge of the Giants before this incantation appears in Corhyn's inventory, it will become unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.

stats.Effect: Greatly Heals HP for self and nearby allies

item:great-horned-headband.name: Great Horned Headband
item:great-horned-headband.description: Headband decorated by a pair of great horns.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:great-horned-headband.location: - The Great Horned Headband has a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Warriors.

item:great-jar-s-arsenal.name: Great-jar's Arsenal
item:great-jar-s-arsenal.description: A charm that resembles a great jar overflowing with weaponry. Vastly boosts maximum equipment load.

stats.Effect: Vastly Raises maximum equip load (~19%)

item:great-jar-s-arsenal.location: Reward for the three Great-Jar duels in Dragonbarrow.

item:great-katana.name: Great Katana
item:great-katana.location: Found on a corpse in the lake on the northern Gravesite Plain where the Ghostflame Dragon is fought.

item:great-knife.name: Great Knife
item:great-knife.description: Large knife with a broad, curved blade. This weapon is designed to Spinning Slash and rend, inflicting blood loss upon the recipient.
item:great-knife.location: The Great Knife is the starting weapon for the Bandit class.

item:great-mace.name: Great Mace
item:great-mace.description: Huge bludgeon with sharp protrusions. An enlarged version of its smaller cousin. Maintains all the advantages of smaller bludgeons, boasting few deficiencies while being very capable at breaking enemy guards and stances. A shrewd choice for simple slugging matches.
item:great-mace.location: The Great Mace is located inside a chest at a soldier camp southwest of the Grand Lift of Dectus in northern Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:great-omenkiller-cleaver.name: Great Omenkiller Cleaver
item:great-omenkiller-cleaver.description: The blade of this huge, loathsome cleaver comprises a row of amputated Omen horns. Weapon of slaughter wielded by Omen ktillers. The hideous horns cause blood loss, adding vibrant colors to the ongoing mayhem.
item:great-omenkiller-cleaver.location: The Great Omenkiller Cleaver is dropped by an Omenkiller mini-boss inside Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir.

item:great-oracular-bubble.name: Great Oracular Bubble
item:great-oracular-bubble.description: Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient
item:great-oracular-bubble.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Siofra River
- Acquired from felling a Scarab surrounded by Claymen inside of a large building on the southwestern quarter of the level with the Dragonkin Soldier.
  - The level can be accessed from Siofra river through a Portal found on some ruins south of the Worshippers' Woods Site of Grace.
  - It can also be accessed from above, from Nokron, through the use of some careful platforming on the northeastern end of the long bridge after the Mimic Tear bossfight.

stats.Effect: Launches a large magic bubble

item:great-p-e.name: Great Épée
item:great-p-e.description: Large rapier featuring a thin, sharp blade.  Commonly used in life or death duels. Like its smaller counterparts, its made for thrusting attacks, and can be used while guarding with a shield.
item:great-p-e.location: Found inside a chest east of the Agheel Lake South grace located in Limgrave.

item:great-stars.name: Great Stars
item:great-stars.description: Huge bludgeon with three stars at the striking end. Though primarily a striking weapon, the stars' spikes cause blood loss. A blood-stained star is an ill omen, a fact not lost upon those against whom this weapon is brought to bear. Landing attacks slightly restores HP.
item:great-stars.location: The Great Stars is located in the Altus Plateau, inside a chest on the back of a large carriage pulled by two trolls.

item:great-turtle-shell.name: Great Turtle Shell
item:great-turtle-shell.description: Shield fashioned from a great turtle shell. The natural curve helps it contend with foes' attacks. The turtle is a symbol of tirelessness, and this shield boosts stamina recovery speed.
item:great-turtle-shell.location: - Found in the tower to the south of Oridys's Rise. Reachable by using the spiritspring near the Nomadic Merchant, jumping towards the tower.

item:greataxe.name: Greataxe
item:greataxe.description: Greatxe akin to a huge lump of iron. Recognized as the weapon of choice of badland chieftains. Too heavy to be wielded by those of merely ordinary strength, blows from this axe will flatten enemies, and the force of its charged attack is a sight to behold.
item:greataxe.location: The standard Greataxe can be found early in West Limgrave, in a chest at the rear of a moving carriage pulled by two trolls.

item:greatblade-phalanx.name: Greatblade Phalanx
