item:greatblade-phalanx.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family. Creates a defensive arch of larger magic glintblades overhead, which automatically attack nearby foes. Used by the enchanted troll knights. They were the comrades of the young Rennala, bound by oath.
item:greatblade-phalanx.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Acquired from defeating Bols, Carian Knight in the Cuckoo's Evergaol.

stats.Effect: Forms a defensive arch of larger magic glintblades

item:greatbow.name: Greatbow
item:greatbow.description: Enormous greatbow larger than any man. Can not be drawn with any ordinary level of strength, but the force of its shots is extraordinary. A greatbow can only fire great arrows.
item:greatbow.location: You can find the standard Greatbow inside a chest at the top of the Highway Lookout Tower in the northeastern Altus Plateau.

item:greathelm.name: Greathelm
item:greathelm.description: Sturdy greathelm made from iron. Though it is uncomfortably heavy and obstructs the vision of the wearer, it provides considerable damage negation.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:greathelm.location:
**Location**: Caelid
- The Greathelm is purchased from the Nomadic Merchant near the  Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank Site of Grace in southern Caelid for  1,800 runes.
- Alternatively, it can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for the same price after giving them the [[Nomadic Merchant's Bell Bearing 10|Nomadic Merchant's Bell Bearing [10]]].

item:greathood.name: Greathood
item:greathood.description: Hood far larger than the head it is meant to cover. A burial shroud of sorts for those who discover, at long last, the truth they sought.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:greathood.location:
**Location**: Mountaintops of the Giants
- The Greathood is the reward for completing the "Sorcerer" Painting. The puzzle solution is on a bridge located northwest of the Stargazer's Ruins on the Mountaintops of the Giants. The item appears on the ground after reaching the Painter Spirit.

item:greathorn-hammer.name: Greathorn Hammer
item:greathorn-hammer.description: Huge thick horn carved with tree ring-like markings adapted into a bludgeoning weapon. Wielded by ancestral follower warriors. The ancient horn is imbued with the power of ancestral spirits. A small amount of HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.
item:greathorn-hammer.location: The Greathorn Hammer in Elden Ring is acquired by farming Ancestral Follower Warriors who wield the weapon in the Siofra River underground region.

item:greatshield-soldier-ashes.name: Greatshield Soldier Ashes
item:greatshield-soldier-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon five greatshield soldier spirits.

stats.Effect: Summons five greatshield soldier spirits

item:greatshield-soldier-ashes.location: Found on a corpse in Nokron, Eternal City, south-east of the Nokron, Eternal City Site of Grace.

item:greatshield-talisman.name: Greatshield Talisman
item:greatshield-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a knight holding a greatshield. Boosts guarding ability.

stats.Effect: Boosts guarding ability.

item:greatshield-talisman.location: Carriage chest east of the Erdtree-Gazing Hill site of grace, watched by three fire-arrow ballistae.

item:greatsword.name: Greatsword
item:greatsword.description: A coarse iron lump of an ultra greatsword. Mows down foes by utilizing its incredible weight. Though handling it likely requires the wielder to have surpassed the realm of the merely human, it is precisely for this reason the weapon is used to slaughter even inhuman foes.
item:greatsword.location: The iconic Greatsword (often called the "Guts" sword) is located in the region of Caelid.
related: Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame
Remembrance of a God and a Lord

item:greatsword-of-damnation.name: Greatsword of Damnation

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:greatsword-of-damnation.location: Trade the Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame with Finger Reader Enia in Roundtable Hold.

item:greatsword-of-radahn-light.name: Greatsword of Radahn (Light)

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int E

item:greatsword-of-radahn-light.location: Can be obtained upon trading the Remembrance of a God and a Lord with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.

item:greatsword-of-solitude.name: Greatsword of Solitude
item:greatsword-of-solitude.location: - Defeat the Knight of the Solitary Gaol in the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

item:green-turtle-talisman.name: Green Turtle Talisman
item:green-turtle-talisman.description: A talisman in the shape of a green turtle. Raises stamina recovery speed.

stats.Effect: Raises stamina recovery speed.

item:greenburst-crystal-tear.name: Greenburst Crystal Tear
item:greenburst-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction gradually restores stamina recovery speed.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts stamina recovery speed in mixed physick.

item:greenburst-crystal-tear.location: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar at the north-western Minor Erdtree in Caelid, near the Smouldering Church where you fight Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater.

item:greenspill-crystal-tear.name: Greenspill Crystal Tear
item:greenspill-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts stamina in mixed physick

item:greenspill-crystal-tear.location: - Found at an altar near Mistwood's Minor Erdtree, along with Spiked Cracked Tear

item:greyoll-s-roar.name: Greyoll's Roar
item:greyoll-s-roar.description: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Greyoll, the Elder Dragon. An incantation of legendary status.
item:greyoll-s-roar.location: Bought at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion with a dragon heart.

stats.Effect: Emits the roar of Elder Dragon Greyoll.

item:grossmesser.name: Grossmesser
item:grossmesser.description: Curved sword boasting a large blade.  This weapon is designed to make use of its weight in combination with its sharp cutting edge.  A thoroughly reliable choice of weapon for those who can master its particulars.
item:grossmesser.location: To get the Grossmesser, you must farm specific skeleton enemies (those that wield the sword and have no shield).

item:ground-slam.name: Ground Slam
item:ground-slam.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Ground Slam: Jump up high into the air and crash down on the ground ahead. The resulting pratfall sends a powerful shockwave in all directions."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:ground-slam.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Limgrave
- Drops from a Scarab found southwest of the Minor Erdtree of Mistwood.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:guardian-bracers.name: Guardian Bracers
item:guardian-bracers.description: Engraved golden bracers. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtree.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:guardian-bracers.location: - The Guardian Bracers have a 1.50% chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies.

item:guardian-garb.name: Guardian Garb
item:guardian-garb.description: Engraved golden garb. Worn by guardians of the Minor Erdtree.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 9 · Slash 8 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 10 · Holy 10

item:guardian-garb.location: Chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies that wear it. Cannot be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:guardian-garb-full-bloom.name: Guardian Garb (full Bloom)
item:guardian-garb-full-bloom.description: Engraved golden garb. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees. Raises the HP recovery effects of the Flask of Crimson Tears, but greatly lowers fire damage negation. It is said that the blood-red flowers blooming on their backs mark the senescence of their ancient pact. Perhaps the guardians are part tree already

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 10 · Slash 9 · Pierce 9 · Magic 11 · Fire -2 · Lightning 11 · Holy 11

item:guardian-garb-full-bloom.location: Chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies that wear it, such as the ones in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Cannot be unaltered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:guardian-greaves.name: Guardian Greaves
item:guardian-greaves.description: Engraved golden greaves. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 6

item:guardian-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies.

item:guardian-mask.name: Guardian Mask

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:guardian-mask.location: Chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies.

item:guardian-s-swordspear.name: Guardian's Swordspear
item:guardian-s-swordspear.description: Weapon comprising a long handle and broad blade sharpened from the hard wood of old trees.  Wielded by guardians of the Minor Erdtrees, known as experts in the arts of combat. The power of this weapon scales greatly with dexterity.
item:guardian-s-swordspear.location: The Guardian's Swordspear is a random drop obtained by defeating Erdtree Guardians found near Minor Erdtree locations across the Lands Between.

item:guilty-hood.name: Guilty Hood
item:guilty-hood.description: Coarse hooded cloak of olive brown. The garb of those accused of lesser crimes, indicated by the collar of sharpened branches.

stats.Negation: Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:guilty-hood.location:
- Found on a corpse in a ditch near the  Avenue Balcony site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
- Sold by the Nomadic Merchant on Mt. Gelmir for  500 runes.

item:gurrang-s-beast-claw.name: Gurrang's Beast Claw
item:gurrang-s-beast-claw.description: Superior incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.

stats.Effect: Creates beast claws to rend surroundings with shockwaves

item:gurranq-s-beast-claw.name: Gurranq's Beast Claw
item:gurranq-s-beast-claw.location:
**Quest Item:** Bestial Sanctum, Greyoll's Dragonbarrow
- Gurranq's Beast Claw is rewarded from Gurranq after giving him the eight Deathroot. (However, only after Gurranq has been calmed down after he turns hostile on the player's return to him after consuming the fourth Deathroot.)

item:haima-glintstone-crown.name: Haima Glintstone Crown
item:haima-glintstone-crown.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:haima-glintstone-crown.location:
**Location**: Altus Plateau
- The Haima Glintstone Crown is dropped by a Battlemage the first time it is defeated, north of the  Road of Iniquity Side Path Site of Grace, on a hill behind the bridge where Goldmask is first encountered.

item:halberd.name: Halberd
item:halberd.description: A long-handed polearm that combines the functions of both axe and spear.  Can be used to press a single enemy with continuous thrusting attacks or swept at groups, taking advantage of its great reach and cleaving blade. A versatile weapon for any situation.
item:halberd.location: To get the standard Halberd, you can buy it from the Nomadic Merchant in East Limgrave for 1,200 Runes.

item:haligdrake-talisman.name: Haligdrake Talisman
item:haligdrake-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a golden ancient dragon. Boosts holy damage negation.

stats.Effect: Boosts holy damage negation.

item:haligdrake-talisman.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Stranded Graveyard, in western Limgrave. This corpse can be seen from the beginning of the game, hanging from a cliff behind where the player wakes up after dying at the Chapel of Anticipation, but cannot be accessed from inside the cave. Instead, start from Seaside Ruins and head southeast along the cliff to a spot where several cliffs and broken pillars lie below. These, along with a Spiritspring can be used to drop down to the beach below. A hole in the cliff wall here leads to the corpse.

item:haligtree-crest-greatshield.name: Haligtree Crest Greatshield
item:haligtree-crest-greatshield.description: Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation. Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.
item:haligtree-crest-greatshield.location: The Haligtree Crest Greatshield has a 4% chance to be dropped by a Haligtree Knight outside the chapel beyond the  Drainage Channel Site of Grace in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

item:haligtree-crest-surcoat.name: Haligtree Crest Surcoat
item:haligtree-crest-surcoat.description: Armor worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. The surcoat bears the crest of the Haligtree. Though watered with Miquella's own blood since it was a sapling, the Haligtree ultimately failed to grow into an Erdtree.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 11 · Slash 12 · Pierce 12 · Magic 9 · Fire 10 · Lightning 8 · Holy 10

item:haligtree-crest-surcoat.location:
Chance to drop from Haligtree Soldiers.

Easily farmable northeast of Prayer Room grace.

item:haligtree-gauntlets.name: Haligtree Gauntlets
item:haligtree-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Str 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 2

item:haligtree-gauntlets.location:
- The Haligtree Gauntlets have a 4.00% chance to drop from Haligtree Soldier enemies.
- They can be easily farmed northeast of the Prayer Room .

item:haligtree-greaves.name: Haligtree Greaves
item:haligtree-greaves.description: Greaves worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:haligtree-greaves.location:
Chance to drop from Haligtree Soldier enemies.

Easily farmable northeast of Prayer Room grace.

item:haligtree-helm.name: Haligtree Helm
item:haligtree-helm.description: Helm worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. An iron helm graced by a crown of unalloyed gold. Increases faith.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:haligtree-helm.location:
Chance to drop from Haligtree Soldier enemies.

Easily farmable northeast of Prayer Room grace.

item:haligtree-knight-armor.name: Haligtree Knight Armor
item:haligtree-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by knights sworn the Haligtree.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 12 · Slash 13 · Pierce 13 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 9 · Holy 11

item:haligtree-knight-armor.location: Chance to drop from Haligtree Knight enemies.

item:haligtree-knight-armor-altered.name: Haligtree Knight Armor (altered)
item:haligtree-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Haligtree Knight Armor.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 12 · Slash 13 · Pierce 13 · Magic 9 · Fire 11 · Lightning 9 · Holy 11

item:haligtree-knight-armor-altered.location: Chance to drop unaltered from Haligtree Knight enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:haligtree-knight-gauntlets.name: Haligtree Knight Gauntlets
item:haligtree-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Time has yet to dull their luster.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:haligtree-knight-gauntlets.location: - The Haligtree Knight Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Haligtree Knight enemies.

item:haligtree-knight-greaves.name: Haligtree Knight Greaves
item:haligtree-knight-greaves.description: Greaves worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Time has yet to dull their luster.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 7 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 5 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:haligtree-knight-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Haligtree Knight enemies.

item:haligtree-knight-helm.name: Haligtree Knight Helm
item:haligtree-knight-helm.description: Helm worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Graced by a crown of unalloyed gold.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:haligtree-knight-helm.location: Found on a corpse up a ladder near the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

item:haligtree-medallion-left.name: Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left)
item:haligtree-medallion-left.description: Left half of a split medallion depicting the Haligtree. Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Lift of Rold, granting access to a hidden path. In other words, this secret medallion will guide the bearer to the land of Miquella's Haligtree.

stats.Effect: Join medallions to operate Grand Lift of Rold

item:haligtree-medallion-right.name: Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right)
item:haligtree-medallion-right.description: Right half of a split medallion depicting the Haligtree. Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Lift of Rold, granting access to a hidden path. In other words, this secret medallion will guide the bearer to the land of Miquella's Haligtree.

stats.Effect: Join medallions to operate Grand Lift of Rold

related: Meet Latenna at the Slumbering Wolf’s Shack

item:haligtree-secret-medallion.name: Haligtree Secret Medallion (left)
item:haligtree-secret-medallion.description: Left half of a split medallion depicting the Haligtree. Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Lift of Rold, granting access to a hidden path. In other words, this secret medallion will guide the bearer to the land of Miquella's Haligtree.

stats.Effect: Join medallions to operate Grand Lift of Rold

item:haligtree-soldier-ashes.name: Haligtree Soldier Ashes
item:haligtree-soldier-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of four Haligtree soldiers. Spirits of common soldiers who carry the sacred light. When weakened, they explode to deliver a last-ditch attack. This was the bitter revelation discovered by the desperate soldiers who awaited the return of their lord to the rotted Haligtree. May the flash of our deaths guide Miquella's return.

stats.Effect: Summons four Haligtree soldier spirits

item:haligtree-soldier-ashes.location:
Found in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, under a large chalice on a balcony on the north side of the dungeon.

From the Prayer Room Site of Grace, take the third beam on the right to a small chapel then take the opposite beam to the outer wall. There is a room below the left end of the wall with several Cleanrot Knights and past the left exit is the chalice.

item:halo-scythe.name: Halo Scythe
item:halo-scythe.description: War scythe of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. This was the weapon of commanders in Malenia's army, and the half-halo blade deals holy damage.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai E

item:halo-scythe.location: The Halo Scythe is a rare random drop from Cleanrot Knights that wield it.

item:hammer.name: Hammer
item:hammer.description: Hammer comprised of a large stone affixed to a metal handle. Originally a blacksmith's tool.  The art of smithing is said to have originated among the giants. This weapon's striking attacks boast ample weight behind them.
item:hammer.location: The standard Hammer is located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:hammer-talisman.name: Hammer Talisman
item:hammer-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a hammer and a knight. Enhances stamina-reducing attacks against a blocking opponent.

stats.Effect: Enhances stamina-reducing attacks against blockers.

item:hammer-talisman.location:
- Obtained by defeating Recusant Henricus in northern Stormhill near the coliseum, north of Stormhill Shack.
  - Beware that progressing through the game can prevent this invasion from happening, more specifically by defeating all the major Limgrave bosses (Flying Dragon Agheel, Mad Pumpkin Head, Margit, the Fell Omen, Tibia Mariner, and Tree Sentinel).
  - Joining Henricus's faction, Volcano Manor, will also prevent him from invading anymore.

item:hand-axe.name: Hand Axe
item:hand-axe.description: Commonly known as a hatchet, this smaller variety of axe is an everyday work tool. Despite its short reach, it is easy to handle, exceling in successive attacks.
item:hand-axe.location: Buy the Hand Axe from the Nomadic Merchant in East Limgrave.

item:hand-ballista.name: Hand Ballista
item:hand-ballista.description: An unconventional ballistic device modeled on a weapon used to besiege castles. Only capable of firing greatbolts.  Perfect for reckless acts such as storming a castle on facing an entire army alone.
item:hand-ballista.location: The Hand Ballista is located in the Weeping Peninsula, south of Limgrave.

item:hand-of-malenia.name: Hand Of Malenia
item:hand-of-malenia.description: Blade built into Malenia's prosthetic arm. Through consecration it is resistant to rot. Malenia's war prosthesis symbolized her victories. Some claim to have seen wings when the weapon was raised aloft; wings of fierce determination that have never known defeat.
item:hand-of-malenia.location: Remembrance of the Rot Goddess (Malenia, Blade of Miquella)

item:harp-bow.name: Harp Bow
item:harp-bow.description: Bow fashioned from a minstrel's harp. Sonorous tones still resound when firing arrows. Troubadours sing tales of champions, both in the honorable service of the Erdtree, and the one who spurns honor for blasphemy.
item:harp-bow.location: The Harp Bow is acquired by solving the "Champion's Song Painting" puzzle.

item:hawk-crest-wooden-shield.name: Hawk Crest Wooden Shield
item:hawk-crest-wooden-shield.description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Adorned with a long-forgotten crest of Stormveil, ancient in design.
item:hawk-crest-wooden-shield.location: Found in Stormveil Castle, in a room that requires a Stonesword Key to open, near the Grafted Scion and the elevator shortcut back up the the Ramparts Site of Grace.

item:heal.name: Heal
item:heal.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
item:heal.location:
**Equipped:**
- Heal is a starting spell for the Prophet origin.

**Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
- Sold for  1,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn.
- Should Corhyn die before purchasing this Incantation from him, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Heals HP for you and nearby allies.

item:heal-from-afar.name: Heal from Afar
item:heal-from-afar.location:
**Loot:** Scadu Altus
- North of Moorth Ruins there are two small bodies of water. At the northern edge of the southern body of water is a small cave tunnel with a Miranda Blossom and three Perfumers, with the incantation lying under a glowing tree at the end.

item:heater-shield.name: Heater Shield
item:heater-shield.description: A medium-sized metal shield, comparatively easy to handle. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.
item:heater-shield.location:
- Purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,500 Runes.
- Starting equipment of the Vagabond class.

item:heavy-crossbow.name: Heavy Crossbow
item:heavy-crossbow.description: Heavy crossbow with iron limbs, increasing damage dealt. Commonly employed in the Shattering.
item:heavy-crossbow.location: The Heavy Crossbow in Elden Ring is a random drop obtained by defeating Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers, Leyndell Soldiers, Haligtree Soldiers, or Messmer Soldiers who are actively wielding it.

item:hefty-beast-bone.name: Hefty Beast Bone
item:hefty-beast-bone.description: Thick, solid beast bones. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting particularly large beasts. Commonly Used to make disposable weapons.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:hefty-beast-bone.location:
- Bears
- Can be purchased in unlimited quantity from the Twin Maiden Husks, for 250 runes each, after giving them Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing.

item:helphen-s-steeple.name: Helphen's Steeple
item:helphen-s-steeple.description: Greatsword patterned after the black steeple of the Helphen, the lampwood which guides the dead of the spirit world. The lamplight is similar to grace in appearance, only it is said that it can only be seen by those who met their death in battle.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:helphen-s-steeple.location: Helphen's Steeple is a greatsword dropped by a Tibia Mariner in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:herba.name: Herba
item:herba.description: Evergreen leaves that give off a faith light. Material used for crafting items. This very common medicinal plant can be found in thickets and elsewhere.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:herba.location: - Can be found in thickets and other common areas in the Lands Between.

item:hero-s-rune-1.name: Hero's Rune [1]
item:hero-s-rune-1.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;

stats.Effect: Use to gain an abundance of runes.

item:hero-s-rune-1.location:
**Hero's Rune [1] can be dropped by the following enemies:**
- Tree Sentinel
**Hero's Rune [1] can be looted from the following locations:**
- Hidden Path to the Haligtree

item:hero-s-rune-5.name: Hero's Rune [5]
item:hero-s-rune-5.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;

stats.Effect: Use to gain an abundance of runes.

item:hero-s-rune-5.location:
**Hero's Rune [5] can be looted from the following locations:**
-

item:hidden-plumage.name: Hidden Plumage
item:hidden-plumage.description: Rarely-seen dark plumage found inside the wing. Material used for crafting items. Death's bearers were once said to have taken the form of birds, symbolized by these black feathers.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:hidden-plumage.location:
- Hidden Plumage is  **unobtainable** and can't be acquired through normal means.
- It is unclear which enemies would have dropped Hidden Plumage, though Giant Crows are the most likely candidates due to their black feathers and narrow drop table.
  - Other feathered candidates:  Burial Crow, Dragon, Eagle, Gravebird, Guillemot, Mausoleum Knight, Owl, Stormhawk, Warhawk, Winged Misbegotten.

item:hierodas-glintstone-crown.name: Hierodas Glintstone Crown
item:hierodas-glintstone-crown.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy. Increases intelligence and endurance to the detriment of FP. The crown of Hierodas was granted to scholars who engaged in nomadic study away from the academy.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:hierodas-glintstone-crown.location:
**Location**: Hermit Village
- The Hierodas Glintstone Crown is found on a corpse behind a house in the Hermit Village on Mt. Gelmir.

item:high-page-clothes.name: High Page Clothes
item:high-page-clothes.description: Clothes of a page selected for special privileges by the noble they serve.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:high-page-clothes.location: Chance to drop from High Page enemies that wear it, such as the one near the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:high-page-clothes-altered.name: High Page Clothes (altered)
item:high-page-clothes-altered.description: Lighter version of the High Page Clothes.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 6 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:high-page-clothes-altered.location: Chance to drop unaltered from High Page enemies that wear it, such as the one near the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:high-page-hood.name: High Page Hood
item:high-page-hood.description: Hood of a page selected for special privilege by the noble they serve.

stats.Negation: Strike 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:high-page-hood.location: Chance to drop from High Page enemies that wear it, such as the one near the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:highland-axe.name: Highland Axe
item:highland-axe.description: Single-sided axe used by the warriors of the highlands.  Brave combatants begin battle by crying out their names. Roars are enhanced by this weapon.
item:highland-axe.location: The Highland Axe is located in Stormveil Castle in Limgrave.

item:highwayman-cloth-armor.name: Highwayman Cloth Armor
item:highwayman-cloth-armor.description: Hideously stained and ragged cloth armor. Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 10 · Slash 8 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 11 · Holy 10

item:highwayman-cloth-armor.location: Chance to drop from Highwayman enemies, such as the ones inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

item:highwayman-gauntlets.name: Highwayman Gauntlets
item:highwayman-gauntlets.description: Hideously stained and dented gauntlets. Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:highwayman-gauntlets.location: - The Highwayman Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Highwayman enemies, such as those found in Murkwater Cave in Limgrave.

item:highwayman-hood.name: Highwayman Hood
item:highwayman-hood.description: Hideously stained and ragged hood. Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:highwayman-hood.location: Chance to drop from Highwayman enemies such as the ones inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

item:hoarah-loux-s-earthshaker.name: Hoarah Loux's Earthshaker
item:hoarah-loux-s-earthshaker.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy and the following skill:"Hoarah Loux's Earthshaker: Slam both hands onto the ground to violently shake the earth and unleash a shockwave. Follow up with an additional input to slam the ground again."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:hoarah-loux-s-earthshaker.location:
**Remembrance Item:**
- Trade the Remembrance of Hoarah Loux with Finger Reader Enia, which can be obtained by defeating Hoarah Loux, Warrior.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:hoarfrost-stomp.name: Hoarfrost Stomp
item:hoarfrost-stomp.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Cold affinity and the following skill:"Hoarfrost Stomp: Stomp hard to spread a trail of freezing mist on the ground. The mist applies the frost status effect."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:hoarfrost-stomp.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Dropped by an invisible Scarab east of Caria Manor in the pond above the ravine.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:holy-ground.name: Holy Ground
item:holy-ground.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Holy Ground: Raise shield to create an Erdtree-consecrated area that continuously restores HP and boosts defense for self and allies inside it."Usable on all shields.

item:holy-shrouding-cracked-tear.name: Holy-shrouding Cracked Tear
item:holy-shrouding-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts holy attacks in mixed physick

item:holy-shrouding-cracked-tear.location: Dropped by one of the two Erdtree Avatars in Liurnia of the Lakes, specifically the one in the north-east, alongside the Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear.

item:holy-water-pot.name: Holy Water Pot
item:holy-water-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Enchanted by incantations of the Golden Order.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Throw at enemies to inflict holy damage

item:holy-water-pot.location: - Can be crafted after purchasing the Missionary's Cookbook [1] from Merchant Kalé for 1000 runes at the Church of Elleh.

item:holyproof-dried-liver.name: Holyproof Dried Liver
item:holyproof-dried-liver.description: Cured animal liver, dried out after pickling in a golden medicinal solution. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts holy damage negation

item:holyproof-dried-liver.location:
- Can be crafted after acquiring the Missionary's Cookbook 6 from a cell in the bottom of dark tower in Volcano Manor. The tower is found beside the lava lake after the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace, and is entered through an open window before descending further down through ladders and stairs.
- 2 are found on the rafters of the Inverted Carian Study Hall.
- Found in a dark sewer room under the wing of the great dragon Gransax's corpse in Leyndell, Royal Capital. The area is guarded by a Broken Gargoyle Statue in an opening and also contains one Erdsteel Dagger.

item:honed-bolt.name: Honed Bolt
item:honed-bolt.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.
item:honed-bolt.location: **Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants - Sold for 7,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Dragon Cult Prayerbook. - Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Strikes foe with lightning bolt from above

item:hookclaws.name: Hookclaws
item:hookclaws.description: Weapon worn on the fist comprised of sharp parallel blades favored by those who lurk in the dark. Lacerations cause blood loss with great effect.  Claw weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.
item:hookclaws.location: The Hookclaws are located inside Stormveil Castle in West Limgrave.

item:horn-bow.name: Horn Bow
item:horn-bow.description: Longbow made from animal horn. Wielded by the master hunters of the ancestral followers.  Imbues arrows fired with magic damage. Reveals its true worth when used magic-infused arrows.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int E

item:horn-bow.location: The Horn Bow is located in the Siofra River underground region.

item:horned-warrior-s-greatsword.name: Horned Warrior's Greatsword

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:horned-warrior-s-greatsword.location: Can be dropped from the Wind-aspected Horned Warrior towards the end of Enir-Ilim on the bridge to the  Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace.

item:horned-warrior-s-sword.name: Horned Warrior's Sword

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai E

item:horned-warrior-s-sword.location:
- This can be obtained by eliminating the Horned Warrior in the swamp at Belurat Tower Settlement.
- Drops from Horned Warriors who wield them (an easy one to farm is located just up the stairs from the  Small Private Altar Site of Grace in Belurat, Tower Settlement.
- Drops from a Horned Warrior who wields them, located just by  Ravine North Site of Grace.

item:horse-crest-wooden-shield.name: Horse Crest Wooden Shield
item:horse-crest-wooden-shield.description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. The circular horsehead design evokes a swift gallop.
item:horse-crest-wooden-shield.location: - Purchased for 1,000 Runes from Patches in Murkwater Cave or from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Patches' Bell Bearing.

item:hoslow-s-armor.name: Hoslow's Armor
item:hoslow-s-armor.description: Garish silver armor decorated with red embellishments. Passed down through the Hoslow family. When Juno Hoslow received an invitation to the Volcano Manor, he discreetly refused. "I have already walked many a road drenched in blood, yet never would I consider myself a champion."

stats.Negation: Physical 14 · Strike 11 · Slash 13 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 10 · Holy 10

item:hoslow-s-armor.location: Reward for completing an NPC invasion of the Volcano Manor questline that sends you to the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:hoslow-s-armor-altered.name: Hoslow's Armor (altered)
item:hoslow-s-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Hoslow's Armor.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 12 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 8 · Holy 8

item:hoslow-s-armor-altered.location: Reward for completing an NPC invasion of the Volcano Manor questline that sends you to the Mountaintops of the Giants. Altered by Boc.

item:hoslow-s-gauntlets.name: Hoslow's Gauntlets
item:hoslow-s-gauntlets.description: Garish silver gauntlets decorated with red embellishments. Passed down through the Hoslow family.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:hoslow-s-gauntlets.location: - Hoslow's Gauntlets are obtained by defeating Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood near the Shack of the Lofty after receiving the Red Letter.

item:hoslow-s-greaves.name: Hoslow's Greaves
item:hoslow-s-greaves.description: Garish silver greaves decorated with red embellishments. Passed down through the Hoslow family.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:hoslow-s-greaves.location: Murder Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood.

item:hoslow-s-helm.name: Hoslow's Helm
item:hoslow-s-helm.description: A twin-tailed silver helm decorated with flowery adornments. Symbol of the head of the head of the revered House of Hoslow.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:hoslow-s-helm.location: Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood.

item:hoslow-s-petal-whip.name: Hoslow's Petal Whip
item:hoslow-s-petal-whip.description: Metal whip formed of razor-sharp chain-link blades that have the appearance of flower petals. This work of art is handed down though the generations of the illustrious House Hoslow. High dexterity is required to wield this weapon, but it excels at inflicting devastation
item:hoslow-s-petal-whip.location: Hoslow's Petal Whip in Elden Ring can be obtained by completing the final Volcano Manor assassination contract for Juno Hoslow or by finishing Diallos's Questline in Jarburg.

item:host-s-trick-mirror.name: Host's Trick-mirror
item:host-s-trick-mirror.description: A small, clouded mirror that reflects a flesh-and-blood figure.

stats.Effect: Take on appearance of a cooperator

item:host-s-trick-mirror.location: - Purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

item:hosts-trick-mirror.name: Hosts' Trick-mirror
item:hosts-trick-mirror.description: A small, clouded mirror that reflects a flesh-and-blood figure.

stats.Effect: Take on appearance of a cooperator

item:hosts-trick-mirror.location: - Purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

item:howl-of-shabriri.name: Howl Of Shabriri
item:howl-of-shabriri.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.
item:howl-of-shabriri.location:
**Loot:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Howl of Shabriri is located in a treasure chest on the second floor of the Frenzy-Flaming Tower located southeast of the Grand Lift of Dectus.

stats.Effect: Shrieks, building up madness in nearby foes

item:human-bone-shard.name: Human Bone Shard
item:human-bone-shard.description: Fragment of bone with dun mottling. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting Those Who Live in Death.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:ice-crest-shield.name: Ice Crest Shield
item:ice-crest-shield.description: Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. The ice crest originates from a Carian princess. Thogh the effect is slight, it boosts magic damage negation and resistance to frost.
item:ice-crest-shield.location: Looted from a corpse on a rock formation in the lowest level of Caria Manor in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:ice-spear.name: Ice Spear
item:ice-spear.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Cold affinity and the following skill:"Ice Spear: Skill of the warriors who served Lunar Princess Ranni. Spin armament to release cold magic, then channel it into a piercing spear of ice."
item:ice-spear.location:
**Guaranteed Drops:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Drops from a Night's Cavalry just north of the Liurnia Highway North Site of Grace, past the army of Puppets.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:icerind-hatchet.name: Icerind Hatchet
item:icerind-hatchet.description: A hatchet with a frost-coated blade. One of several gifts given by Castle Sol in the distant north. Known as "freezing fog," the blade is thought to be a dragon's scale. Inflicts a powerful frost effect.
item:icerind-hatchet.location: The Icerind Hatchet is found in Liurnia of the Lakes in Elden Ring.

item:icon-shield.name: Icon Shield
item:icon-shield.description: Greatshield painted with a divine scene; the recipients of a blessed tear from the Erdtree. An item that looks back fondly on the age of plenty. The divine scene acts in and of itself as a sacred invocation; gradually restoring the carrier's HP.
item:icon-shield.location: Looted from a corpse within the Woodfolk Ruins in Altus Plateau.

item:igon-s-greatbow.name: Igon's Greatbow
item:igon-s-greatbow.location: Reward for completing Igon's quest, found on his corpse at the Foot of the Jagged Peak near the dueling Jagged Peak Drakes.

item:iji-s-mirrorhelm.name: Iji's Mirrorhelm
item:iji-s-mirrorhelm.description: Helm fashioned from a crystal looking-glass, said to have never left War Counselor Iji's head. Easily broken and weak against striking attacks.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 6 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:iji-s-mirrorhelm.location: Can be looted from War Counselor Iji after completing Blaidd's questline.

item:imbued-sword-key.name: Imbued Sword Key
item:imbued-sword-key.description: Stone key shaped like a sword. A special item, imbued with rich blue magic.

stats.Effect: Unseals sending gate, but disappears upon use

item:imbued-sword-key.location:
A total of **four** Imbued Sword Keys can be found per playthrough.

1. The Four Belfries: Found in a chest near the  The Four Belfries Site of Grace.
1. Academy of Raya Lucaria: Located on the rooftop section of Raya Lucaria, northwest of the  Debate Parlor Site of Grace.
1. Caelid: Found in a chest guarded by a Twinsage Scholar outside Sellia, Town of Sorcery, nearest the  Sellia Under-Stair Site of Grace.
1. Castle Ensis: Found in a chest in a tower southwest of the  Castle-Lord's Chamber Site of Grace. Take the lower western opening from the grace and use the elevator to reach it.

item:immunizing-cured-meat.name: Immunizing Cured Meat
item:immunizing-cured-meat.description: Cured strip of meat, dried out after pickling in a green medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily boosts immunity Higher immunity helps to mitigate the buildup of various poisons and scarlet rot

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts Immunity

item:immunizing-horn-charm.name: Immunizing Horn Charm
item:immunizing-horn-charm.description: An accountrement worn by the ancestral followers. Raises immunity. (Immunity governs resistance to poison and rot.)

stats.Effect: Raises Immunity

item:immunizing-horn-charm.location: - Found on a corpse in an ant's nest in southwest Ainsel River, near Ainsel River Downstream.

item:immunizing-white-cured-meat.name: Immunizing White Cured Meat
item:immunizing-white-cured-meat.description: A white sliced meat, dried out after pickling in a green medicinal solution.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts immunity

item:immutable-shield.name: Immutable Shield
item:immutable-shield.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
item:immutable-shield.location:
**Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
- Sold by Brother Corhyn for 10,000 Runes after telling Goldmask that Radagon is Marika.
- Should Corhyn die but before purchasing this Incantation after solving Goldmask's puzzle, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.
  - <font color="red">WARNING:</font> If Corhyn dies before this incantation appears in his inventory then it will become unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.

stats.Effect: Increases left-hand shield's affinity/ailment resistance

item:imp-head-cat.name: Imp Head (cat)
item:imp-head-cat.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling a cat, it holds trace amounts of feline intelligence.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:imp-head-cat.location: Cat-headed Imps have a chance to drop this item. They can be found in various catacombs in the Lands Between, including the Stormfoot Catacombs to the northwest of the Church of Elleh.

item:imp-head-corpse.name: Imp Head (corpse)
item:imp-head-corpse.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling the visage of a corpse, it holds trace amounts of lingering faith.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:imp-head-corpse.location: Found on a corpse on the streets of Leyndell, Royal Capital. Can be accessed by going south from the giant door leading to the area where the Grand Lift of Rold is located.

item:imp-head-elder.name: Imp Head (elder)
item:imp-head-elder.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling an elder, it holds trace amounts of arcane knowledge.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:imp-head-elder.location: Found on a corpse in front of an Erdtree Burial Watchdog enemy inside the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.

item:imp-head-fanged.name: Imp Head (fanged)
item:imp-head-fanged.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling a fanged demon, it holds trace amounts of bestial strength.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:imp-head-fanged.location: Chance to drop from Imp enemies with the same face, such as the ones inside the Cliffbottom Catacombs located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:imp-head-long-tongued.name: Imp Head (long-tongued)
item:imp-head-long-tongued.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:imp-head-long-tongued.location: Chance to drop from Imp enemies with the same face, such as the ones in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.

item:imp-head-wolf.name: Imp Head (wolf)
item:imp-head-wolf.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling a wolf, it holds trace amounts of lupine endurance.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:imp-head-wolf.location: Found on a corpse inside the Minor Erdtree Catacombs located in Caelid. Dropped by Imp enemies with the same face.

item:impaling-thrust.name: Impaling Thrust
item:impaling-thrust.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Impaling Thrust: Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard."Usable on armaments capable of thrusting (colossal weapons excepted).
item:impaling-thrust.location:
**Purchase:** Stormhill / Volcano Manor
- 1x Sold for 1,000 Runes from Bernahl at either the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill or the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor.
- Should Bernahl be killed before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Bernahl's Bell Bearing.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:impenetrable-thorns.name: Impenetrable Thorns
item:impenetrable-thorns.location:
**Loot**: Scadu Altus
- Impenetrable Thorns is found in the Shadow Keep. Before ascending the stairs to the bridge leading to Messmer's tower, drop down to a balcony with a single Man-Bat. The sorcery is located on a corpse against the wall.

item:incantation-scarab.name: Incantation Scarab
item:incantation-scarab.description: Golden scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of incantations during their labors. Slightly reduces the FP costs of incantations, but increases damage taken. As a scarab approaches death, it abandons its rolled treasure and stretches its wings wide for long journey to its home nest.

stats.Negation: Physical -5 · Strike -5 · Slash -5 · Pierce -5 · Magic -4 · Fire -4 · Light -4 · Holy -5

item:incantation-scarab.location:
**Location**: Dragon-Burnt Ruins
1. Obtain the "Homing Instinct" Painting from the Artist's Shack in Limgrave.
1. Interact with the Painter Spirit southwest of the Dragon-Burnt Ruins, beside a gravestone.

item:inescapable-frenzy.name: Inescapable Frenzy
item:inescapable-frenzy.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.
item:inescapable-frenzy.location:
**Loot:** Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
- Inescapable Frenzy is found on top of a coffin near the bottom of the Frenzied Flame Proscription which can be reached after defeating Mohg, the Omen.

stats.Effect: Latches onto foes to spread madness

item:inquisitor-s-girandole.name: Inquisitor's Girandole
item:inquisitor-s-girandole.description: Instrument of torture used on nobles behind the curtain at the  Volcano Manor of Mt. Gelmir. Its numerous spikes pierce the flesh, then singe the wounds with flame. The smell of burnt blood induces despair in the victim. A candlestick conveived by a thorough mind.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:inquisitor-s-girandole.location: The Inquisitor's Girandole spear is dropped by the Abductor Virgin duo boss fight located deep underground near Volcano Manor, which can be reached early via Raya Lucaria Academy or later from the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber site of grace.

item:inseparable-sword.name: Inseparable Sword

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai C

item:inseparable-sword.location: The Inseparable Sword is a greatsword that requires 18 Strength, 18 Dexterity, and 20 Faith.

item:intelligence-knot-crystal-tear.name: Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear
item:intelligence-knot-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts intelligence in mixed physick.

item:intelligence-knot-crystal-tear.location:
Found in a bowl at the bottom of a cliff south of the Caria Manor in Liurnia of the Lakes, guarded by several small Fingercreepers and one large one.

From the Sorcerer's Isle Site of Grace, right next to Testu's Rise, head north along the coast until a low-lying and forested area is found and then continue north. Be careful with approaching, as the large Fingercreeper is hiding in the ground right next to the bowl.

item:inverted-hawk-heater-shield.name: Inverted Hawk Heater Shield
item:inverted-hawk-heater-shield.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The inverted hawk is the emblem of the company of slaves ordered to explore the Eternal City.
item:inverted-hawk-heater-shield.location: Obtained in Siofra River, on a hill near the steps leading to Hallowhorn Grounds.

item:inverted-hawk-towershield.name: Inverted Hawk Towershield
item:inverted-hawk-towershield.description: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Features an inverted hawk crest. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
item:inverted-hawk-towershield.location: 1.00% chance to be dropped by greatshield-wielding Fallen Hawk Soldiers in Nokron, Eternal City.

item:invigorating-cured-meat.name: Invigorating Cured Meat
item:invigorating-cured-meat.description: Cured strip of meat, dried out after pickling in a red medicinal solution. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts Robustness

item:invigorating-cured-meat.location: The Invigorating Cured Meat can be crafted with the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [2].

item:invigorating-white-cured-meat.name: Invigorating White Cured Meat
item:invigorating-white-cured-meat.description: A white sliced meat, dried out after pickling in a red medicinal solution. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts Robustness

item:irina-s-letter.name: Irina's Letter
item:irina-s-letter.description: Letter given by Irina, addressed to her father, the commander of Castle Morne. Gorgeous silken handkerchief, lightly stained with blood. Words can be made out within

stats.Effect: Letter addressed to the commander of Castle Morne

item:irina-s-letter.location:
**Location**: Bridge of Sacrifice, Weeping Peninsula
- Speak with Irina of Morne twice and select **Deliver the letter**. Alternatively, it can be looted from her body if she dies.

item:iron-ball.name: Iron Ball
item:iron-ball.description: Iron manifer of spherical shape. Big Boggart the blackguard's weapon of choice. Not a weapon to be taken lightly, as its weighty blows shatter bones with ease.
item:iron-ball.location: The Iron Ball fist weapon is dropped by Blackguard Big Boggart.

item:iron-cleaver.name: Iron Cleaver
item:iron-cleaver.description: Fairly large iron cleaver, commonly used by the maltreated Misbegotten.  Steeped in resentment, these weapons are swung wildly and relentlessly, often after rushing up to foes.
item:iron-cleaver.location: The Iron Cleaver drops from Misbegotten enemies wielding it.

item:iron-gauntlets.name: Iron Gauntlets

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 1

item:iron-gauntlets.location: - The Iron Gauntlets can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant (Castle Morne Rampart) in the Weeping Peninsula for  1,500 runes.

item:iron-greatsword.name: Iron Greatsword
item:iron-greatsword.description: Greatsword with a blade of unusually thick steel. A coarse weapon to which polishing is a foreign concept. Weighty even among others of its class, the impact of each strike is sure to be felt.
item:iron-greatsword.location: The Iron Greatsword is a rare, farmable weapon in Elden Ring that drops from Red-Maned Misbegotten Warriors in Leyndell or the Haligtree.

item:iron-helmet.name: Iron Helmet
item:iron-helmet.description: An iron helmet showing rust on its edges. Cloth covering the mouth and neck provides some resistance to poison and other irritants.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:iron-helmet.location: Sold by Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula.

item:iron-kasa.name: Iron Kasa
item:iron-kasa.description: Iron kasa of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Crafted to imitate the woven straw hats worn in the Land of Reeds.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 3 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:iron-kasa.location: Dropped by Yura only once he his possessed by Shabriri during his questline.

item:iron-roundshield.name: Iron Roundshield
item:iron-roundshield.description: An ordinary small roundshield made of metal. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. Finely balanced, this shield is easy to use.
item:iron-roundshield.location: - Sold for 900 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant southeast of the Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.

item:iron-spear.name: Iron Spear
item:iron-spear.description: Commonly used iron spear with no notable traits. The blade is severely rusted.
item:iron-spear.location: The Iron Spear is not found as a static pickup in Elden Ring.

item:iron-whetblade.name: Iron Whetblade
item:iron-whetblade.description: Iron whetblade with a cipher engraved. Can be used as a whetstone knife.

stats.Effect: Grants choice of affinity upgrade to weapon

item:iron-whetblade.location:
**Location**: Stormveil Castle
- The Iron Whetblade is looted from a corpse in an armory connected to the main hall with the Grafted Scion.
- The doorway is sealed by an Imp Statue that requires x1 Stonesword Key.

item:ivory-draped-tabard.name: Ivory-draped Tabard
item:ivory-draped-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with a shawl in the color of ivory draped over the shoulders. Worn by foot soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 10 · Slash 8 · Pierce 10 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 11 · Holy 11

item:ivory-draped-tabard.location: Chance to drop from Haligtree Foot Soldier enemies.

item:ivory-sickle.name: Ivory Sickle
item:ivory-sickle.description: Sickle fashioned form ivory.  Weapon carried by aged Albunaurics. These weapons re evidence of their dedication to the Haligtree, despite never having entered its presence.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int D

item:ivory-sickle.location: The Ivory Sickle is located in the Village of the Albinaurics in southwestern Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:jar.name: Jar
item:jar.description: Jar that fits cleanly over the head when upturned. Made with pride by Iron Fist Alexander. In a uniquely jarlike gesture of friendship, it boosts the power of throwing pot items.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 3 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:jar-cannon.name: Jar Cannon
item:jar-cannon.description: Jar cannon which uses explosives to fire greatbolts. Deals great damage but is slow to reload.  Experimental firearm brought to the assault on Volcano Manor, where it was discovered that no one knew how to use it.
item:jar-cannon.location: The Jar Cannon is dropped by Demi-Human Queen Margot, the boss at the end of the Volcano Cave dungeon.

item:jarwight-puppet.name: Jarwight Puppet
item:jarwight-puppet.description: One of Seluvis' puppets. Use to summon the spirit of a jarwight.

stats.Effect: Summons Jarwight spirit

item:jarwight-puppet.location:
Can be acquired from Seluvis once you confront him about his secret puppet workshop at the Three Sisters.

Either him or the Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet can be gained from Seluvis for free. If he isn't selected he costs 3 Starlight Shards to buy.

item:jawbone-axe.name: Jawbone Axe
item:jawbone-axe.description: Axe made from a herbivore's skull. Weapon of the ancestral followers who disdain metal. This axe is more of a bludgeon; it forgoes a bladed edge, instead using the beast's molar teeth to buffet foes, dealing strike damage.
item:jawbone-axe.location: The Jawbone Axe drops from Ancestral Follower Warriors wielding the weapon in Elden Ring.

item:jellyfish-shield.name: Jellyfish Shield
item:jellyfish-shield.description: The head of a spirit jellyfish, commonly found floating above sacred ground throughout the Lands Between, wielded without modification as a shield. The see-through head is extremely light, but its flesh is supple, providing absolutely no protection from piercing attacks
item:jellyfish-shield.location: Found on a dead body with four Spirit Jellyfish around it, north of the  Foot of the Four Belfries Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:juvenile-scholar-cap.name: Juvenile Scholar Cap
item:juvenile-scholar-cap.description: Cap worn by young academy scholars, the juveniles birthed anew by the amber egg of Queen Rennala, the head of Raya Lucaria Academy. Yet their rebirth is not without imperfections, and thus do they repeat the process, eventually becoming utterly dependent upon it. Rebirth is as sleep to them, and with each awakening, memory fades into oblivion.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:juvenile-scholar-cap.location:
**Location**: Liurnia of the Lakes
- The Juvenile Scholar Robe is acquired upon interacting with the Painter Spirit found in the graveyard outside Caria Manor, southeast of the  Behind Caria Manor Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.
- The Painter Spirit only appears if the player holds the "Resurrection" Painting found inside the Artist's Shack (Liurnia).
- The area is patrolled by Second-Generation Albinaurics.

item:juvenile-scholar-robe.name: Juvenile Scholar Robe
item:juvenile-scholar-robe.description: Robe worn by young academy scholars, the juveniles birthed anew by the amber egg of Queen Rennala, the head of Raya Lucaria Academy. Yet their rebirth is not without imperfections, and thus do they repeat the process, eventually becoming utterly dependent upon it. Rebirth is as sleep to them, and with each awakening, memory fades into oblivion.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 5 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:juvenile-scholar-robe.location:
**Location**: Liurnia of the Lakes
- The Juvenile Scholar Robe is acquired upon interacting with the Painter Spirit found in the graveyard outside Caria Manor, southeast of the  Behind Caria Manor Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.
- The Painter Spirit only appears if the player holds the "Resurrection" Painting found inside the Artist's Shack (Liurnia).
- The area is patrolled by Second-Generation Albinaurics.

item:kaiden-armor.name: Kaiden Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 8 · Slash 11 · Pierce 11 · Magic 8 · Fire 8 · Lightning 7 · Holy 8

item:kaiden-armor.location: - Kaiden Armor has a 3.00% chance to drop from Kaiden Sellsword enemies.

item:kaiden-gauntlets.name: Kaiden Gauntlets

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 1 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 1

item:kaiden-gauntlets.location: - The Kaiden Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Kaiden Sellsword enemies.

item:kaiden-helm.name: Kaiden Helm
item:kaiden-helm.description: Helm worn by Kaiden sellswords. These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the mountaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on horseback. Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:kaiden-helm.location: - Kaiden Helm has a 3.00% chance to drop from Kaiden Sellsword enemies.

item:kaiden-sellsword-ashes.name: Kaiden Sellsword Ashes
item:kaiden-sellsword-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirit of a Kaiden sellsword.

stats.Effect: Summons Kaiden Sellsword spirit.

item:kaiden-sellsword-ashes.location: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog in the Cliffbottom Catacombs, Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:kaiden-trousers.name: Kaiden Trousers

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 4 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:kaiden-trousers.location: - Kaiden Trousers have a 3.00% chance to drop from Kaiden Sellsword enemies.

item:katar.name: Katar
item:katar.description: Imported dagger design with a rather unique handle. The blade can be swung about as the extension of one's fist.
item:katar.location: The Katar can be found inside a treasure chest at Fort Gael in southwestern Caelid.

item:kick.name: Kick
item:kick.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Kick: Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:kick.location:
**Purchase:** Stormhill / Volcano Manor
- 1x Sold for 800 Runes from Bernahl at either the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill or the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor.
- Should Bernahl be killed before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Bernahl's Bell Bearing.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:kindred-of-rot-ashes.name: Kindred Of Rot Ashes
item:kindred-of-rot-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon a spirit of the Kindred of Rot. This spirit takes the form of a crawling pest, its chitinous body making a dry rustling sound. Attacks enemies by secreting sticky threads. The Kindred of Rot are the servants of the Goddess of Rot—servants that have been forsaken.

stats.Effect: Summons Kindred of Rot spirit

item:kindred-of-rot-ashes.location: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade in Caelid Catacombs.

item:kindred-of-rot-s-exultation.name: Kindred Of Rot's Exultation
item:kindred-of-rot-s-exultation.description: A talisman depicting the exultation of pests.

stats.Effect: Poisoning or rot in vicinity increases attack power

item:kindred-of-rot-s-exultation.location: - Kindred of Rot's Exultation is obtained by defeating the Kindred of Rot in Seethewater Cave in central Mt. Gelmir.

item:kite-shield.name: Kite Shield
item:kite-shield.description: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.
item:kite-shield.location: Purchased for 1,000 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant by the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace in southern Liurnia of the Lakes or from the Twin Maiden Husks upon giving them his bell bearing.

item:knight-armor.name: Knight Armor
item:knight-armor.description: Iron armor of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 11 · Slash 13 · Pierce 13 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 9 · Holy 8

item:knight-armor.location: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

item:knight-gauntlets.name: Knight Gauntlets
item:knight-gauntlets.description: Iron gauntlets of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:knight-gauntlets.location: - The Knight Gauntlets can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for  3,000 runes.

item:knight-greaves.name: Knight Greaves
item:knight-greaves.description: Iron greaves of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:knight-greaves.location: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

item:knight-helm.name: Knight Helm
item:knight-helm.description: Iron helm of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:knight-helm.location: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

item:knight-s-greatsword.name: Knight's Greatsword
item:knight-s-greatsword.description: Greatsword bestowed upon skilled swordsmen in the demigods' service, and yet had no rank or title. Featuring a long grip enabling a dual-handed use, this weapon was designed to dispatch larger foes. Being charged with such a duty was undoubtedly a great honor.
item:knight-s-greatsword.location: The Knight's Greatsword is not a guaranteed drop, but it is farmed by killing wandering knights throughout the Lands Between.

item:knight-s-lightning-spear.name: Knight's Lightning Spear
item:knight-s-lightning-spear.location: Scorpion River Catacombs chest, Realm of Shadow.

item:kukri.name: Kukri
item:kukri.description: A large knife used for throwing.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to inflict damage and build up onset of blood loss

item:kukri.location: - Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region

item:lamenting-visage.name: Lamenting Visage
item:lamenting-visage.location: Found on a corpse within the Lamenter's Gaol behind an illusory wall and a gate needing the Gaol Lower Level Key to unlock.

item:lance.name: Lance
item:lance.description: Considered a type of greatspear, this weapon has no blade, but instead features a long, conical body designed to pierce. Though heavy and hard to wield, this weapon displays its worth in horseback combat whether mounted or even on foot.
item:lance.location: The Lance is located in northern Limgrave on a ruined structure within an enemy camp, situated just northeast of the Warmaster's Shack.

item:lance-talisman.name: Lance Talisman
item:lance-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a lance and a knight. Enhances attacks while on horseback.

stats.Effect: Enhances attacks on horseback

item:lance-talisman.location: - Obtained from the northeastern-most tip of Stormhill directly west of the Divine Tower of Limgrave.

item:land-octopus-ovary.name: Land Octopus Ovary
item:land-octopus-ovary.description: Puffy, milky white ovary of a land octopus. Material used for crafting items. Land octopuses eat humans in order to bear young, and theirs is the blood that runs through these ovaries.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:land-of-reeds-armor.name: Land Of Reeds Armor
item:land-of-reeds-armor.description: Armor made from strips of iron fastened together. Worn by warriors of the Land of Reeds. The Land of Reeds has long been locked in a miserable civil war, during which time it has remained alienated from the cultures of its neighbors. Little wonder that the entire nation has succumbed to blood-soaked madness, or so it is said.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 9 · Slash 11 · Pierce 9 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 10

item:land-of-reeds-armor.location:
Starting gear for the Samurai class.

Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow).

item:land-of-reeds-gauntlets.name: Land Of Reeds Gauntlets
item:land-of-reeds-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets wrapped in tough leather. Worn by the warriors of the Land of Reeds

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:land-of-reeds-gauntlets.location:
- The Land of Reeds Gauntlets are the starting armwear of the Samurai Origin.
- The Land of Reeds Gauntlets can be purchased from the Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow) for  1,000 runes.

item:land-of-reeds-greaves.name: Land Of Reeds Greaves

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 5 · Magic 5 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 6

item:land-of-reeds-greaves.location:
Starting gear for the Samurai class.

Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow).

item:land-of-reeds-helm.name: Land Of Reeds Helm
item:land-of-reeds-helm.description: Helm made from strips of iron fastened together. Worn by warriors of the Land of Reeds. The Land of Reeds has long been locked in a miserable civil war, during which time it has remained alienated from the cultures of its neighbors. Little wonder that the entire nation has succumbed to blood-soaked madness, or so it is said.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:land-of-reeds-helm.location:
Starting gear for Samurai origin.

Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow).

item:land-squirt-ashes.name: Land Squirt Ashes
item:land-squirt-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three land squirts Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. These spirits appear some distance from the summoner. The firm, fleshy tubes of the creatures remain rooted to the spot, spraying poisonous liquid over their surroundings

stats.Effect: Summons three land squirts

item:land-squirt-ashes.location: Found in Liurnia of the Lakes, at the foot of the cliffs east of Academy Gate Town.

item:lands-between-rune.name: Lands Between Rune
item:lands-between-rune.description: Grace said to have once dwelled in the eyes of the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering residue of gold.

stats.Effect: Use to gain many runes

item:lands-between-rune.location: The Lands Between Rune can only be acquired as a Keepsake during character creation.

item:lansseax-s-glaive.name: Lansseax's Glaive
item:lansseax-s-glaive.description: Incantation that channels the powr of the ancient dragon Lansseax.
item:lansseax-s-glaive.location: - Lansseax's Glaive is obtained by defeating Ancient Dragon Lansseax on the Altus Plateau, south of the Rampartside Path site of grace outside of the wall to the Capital Outskirts.

stats.Effect: Sweeps from above with red lightning glaive.

item:lantern.name: Lantern
item:lantern.description: A small waist-worn lantern that illuminates surroundings. Use once to turn on, and again to turn off. While its light is dimmer than that of a torch, it has the advantage of freeing up the user's hands.

stats.Effect: Attach to waist to illuminate surroundings

item:lantern.location:
- Isolated Merchant in his shack in the Weeping Peninsula region (x1)
- Nomadic Merchant at the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace in the Liurnia of the Lakes region (x1)

item:large-club.name: Large Club
item:large-club.description: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength to swing about.
item:large-club.location: The Large Club is hidden in the southern tip of West Limgrave, just below the Forlorn Hound Evergaol.

item:large-glintstone-scrap.name: Large Glintstone Scrap
item:large-glintstone-scrap.description: Large piece of glintstone tinged with unstable magic. Found in crystal tunnels.

stats.Effect: Break gem and use FP to produce many magic bolts

item:large-leather-shield.name: Large Leather Shield
item:large-leather-shield.description: A round shield covered in leather. One of the larger categories of medium-sized shield. Though its damage negation may be lacking compared to a metal shield, it can handle wider range of attack affinities.
item:large-leather-shield.location:
- Starting gear for the Hero class.
- Purchased for 600 Runes from Kalé, or from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Kalé's Bell Bearing.

item:larval-tear.name: Larval Tear
item:larval-tear.description: Core of a creature of mimicry known as a silver tear.

stats.Effect: Material needed by Rennala to grant rebirth

item:larval-tear.location: Silver sphere enemies and a few static corpses. Needed for Rennala respec and Boc.

item:latenna-the-albinauric.name: Latenna The Albinauric
item:latenna-the-albinauric.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Latenna the Albinauric.

stats.Effect: Summons the spirit of Latenna the Albinauric

item:latenna-the-albinauric.location: Obtained after talking to Latenna the Albinauric (NPC) at Slumbering Wolf's Shack and accepting her request.

item:law-of-causality.name: Law Of Causality
item:law-of-causality.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
item:law-of-causality.location:
Given by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing after defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood and choosing to talk "About the Lord of Blood's Cocoon".

Can also be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for 5,000 Runes after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

stats.Effect: Retaliates upon receiving a number of blows

item:law-of-regression.name: Law Of Regression
item:law-of-regression.description: Incantation of the Golden Order fundamentalists. One of the key fundamentals. Heals all negative statuses, dispels special effects, and reveals mimicry in all its forms. The fundamentalists describe the Golden Order through the powers of regression and causality. Regression is the pull of meaning; that all things yearn eternally to converge.
item:law-of-regression.location: **Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants - Sold for 10,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Golden Order Principia. - Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Heals all ailments and dispels all special effects

item:lazuli-glintstone-crown.name: Lazuli Glintstone Crown
item:lazuli-glintstone-crown.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:lazuli-glintstone-crown.location:
**Location**: Academy of Raya Lucaria
- The Lazuli Glintstone Crown is dropped by a Crystal Crab inside a tower accessible from the rooftops of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, after jumping down onto wooden platforms.

item:lazuli-glintstone-sword.name: Lazuli Glintstone Sword
item:lazuli-glintstone-sword.description: A sword with a glintstone in its handguards. Wielded by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus who seek to master Carian sorcery. Deals magic damage. Apparently once used as a staff of sorcery, this sword is made of wood.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:lazuli-glintstone-sword.location: The Lazuli Glintstone Sword is a rare drop (roughly a 2% drop rate) from Lazuli Sorcerers wielding swords and shields.

item:lazuli-robe.name: Lazuli Robe
item:lazuli-robe.description: Robe worn by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus, singular among the greater Raya Lucaria Academy. These scholars, who sought to master Carian sorcery, instead learned to see the moon as equal to the stars. This robe, in the hue of the full moon, signifies their heresy.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 4 · Pierce 2 · Magic 13 · Fire 11 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:lazuli-robe.location: Chance to drop from Lazuli Sorcerer enemies that wear it.

item:leaden-hardtear.name: Leaden Hardtear
item:leaden-hardtear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts poise in mixed physick

item:leaden-hardtear.location: Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in Mt. Gelmir, east of the Road of Iniquity Site of Grace.

item:leather-armor.name: Leather Armor
