item:leather-armor.description: Lightweight and battle-proven leather armor worn by a savvy soldier.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 9 · Slash 8 · Pierce 8 · Magic 9 · Fire 9 · Lightning 10 · Holy 10

item:leather-boots.name: Leather Boots
item:leather-boots.description: Lightweight and battle-proven leather boots worn by a savvy soldier. Many admire the wearer of this armor for his chivalrous and forthright spirit.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 5 · Slash 4 · Pierce 5 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:leather-draped-tabard.name: Leather-draped Tabard
item:leather-draped-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with a leather shawl draped over the shoulders.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 10 · Slash 8 · Pierce 10 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 12 · Holy 10

item:leather-draped-tabard.location: Chance to drop from Leyndell Foot Soldier enemies.

item:leather-gloves.name: Leather Gloves
item:leather-gloves.description: Lightweight and battle-proven leather gloves worn by a savvy soldier. Many admire the wearer of this armor for his chivalrous and forthright spirit.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:leather-gloves.location: - The Leather Gloves are obtained by defeating Patches.

item:leather-trousers.name: Leather Trousers
item:leather-trousers.description: Well-made leather trousers. The lower legs are each bound in cord for ease of movement.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:leather-trousers.location: - Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region

item:leda-s-sword.name: Leda's Sword

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Fai D

item:leda-s-sword.location: The weapon can be obtained after defeating Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim.

item:leyndell-knight-armor.name: Leyndell Knight Armor
item:leyndell-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Its left breast is emblazoned with a symbol of Erdtree Worship, said to have once been imbued with an incantation of protection.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 12 · Slash 13 · Pierce 13 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 10

item:leyndell-knight-armor.location: Chance to drop from Leyndell Knight enemies.

item:leyndell-knight-armor-altered.name: Leyndell Knight Armor (altered)
item:leyndell-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Leyndell Knight Armor.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 12 · Slash 13 · Pierce 13 · Magic 9 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 9

item:leyndell-knight-armor-altered.location: Chance to drop from Leyndell Knight enemies.

item:leyndell-knight-gauntlets.name: Leyndell Knight Gauntlets
item:leyndell-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Time has yet to dull their luster

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:leyndell-knight-gauntlets.location: - The Leyndell Knight Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Leyndell Knight enemies.

item:leyndell-knight-greaves.name: Leyndell Knight Greaves
item:leyndell-knight-greaves.description: Greaves worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Time has yet to dull their luster.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 7 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 5 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:leyndell-knight-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Leyndell Knight enemies.

item:leyndell-knight-helm.name: Leyndell Knight Helm
item:leyndell-knight-helm.description: Helm worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:leyndell-knight-helm.location: Chance to drop from Leyndell Knight enemies.

item:leyndell-soldier-ashes.name: Leyndell Soldier Ashes
item:leyndell-soldier-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two Leyndell soldiers. Spirits of soldiers each equipped with a spear and greatshield. The soldiers of Leyndell fight their battles defensively. During the Shattering, they were the ramparts that fortified the royal capital.

stats.Effect: Summons two Leyndell soldier spirits

item:leyndell-soldier-ashes.location: Found on a corpse in Sainted Hero's Grave, after falling through a collapsing floor.

item:leyndell-soldier-gauntlets.name: Leyndell Soldier Gauntlets
item:leyndell-soldier-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:leyndell-soldier-gauntlets.location: - The Leyndell Soldier Gauntlets have a 1.50% chance to drop from Leyndell Soldier enemies.

item:leyndell-soldier-greaves.name: Leyndell Soldier Greaves
item:leyndell-soldier-greaves.description: Greaves worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:leyndell-soldier-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Leyndell Soldier enemies.

item:leyndell-soldier-helm.name: Leyndell Soldier Helm
item:leyndell-soldier-helm.description: Helm worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Made from durable iron, layered with a chainmail coif beneath.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:leyndell-soldier-helm.location: Chance to drop from Leyndell Soldier enemies.

item:lhutel-the-headless.name: Lhutel The Headless
item:lhutel-the-headless.description: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Lhutel the Headless.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Lhutel the Headless

item:lhutel-the-headless.location:
**Location**: Tombsward Catacombs
- Defeat the Cemetery Shade in the Tombsward Catacombs in central Weeping Peninsula to obtain the Lhutel the Headless.

item:lifesteal-fist.name: Lifesteal Fist
item:lifesteal-fist.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:"Lifesteal Fist: Skill that demonstrates mastery of the art of controlling vital energies.A slow, controlled punch with an energy-infused fist that renders foes unconscious and steals their HP. Only effective against foes of human build."Usable on fists and claws.
item:lifesteal-fist.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Caelid
- Dropped by a Scarab northwest of the Astray from Caelid Highway North Site of Grace.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:light-crossbow.name: Light Crossbow
item:light-crossbow.description: Ranged weapoon made from a bow fixed to a stock. Deals good damage and is simple to use, but requires reloading after firing. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.
item:light-crossbow.location: The Light Crossbow in Elden Ring can be purchased for 1,500 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant located at the Castle Morne Rampart site of grace in the Weeping Peninsula

item:light-of-miquella.name: Light of Miquella
item:light-of-miquella.location:
**Trade:** Remembrance of a God and a Lord
- Trade with Finger Reader Enia.
- Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate the remembrance (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

item:lightning-fortification.name: Lightning Fortification
item:lightning-fortification.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
item:lightning-fortification.location:
**Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
- Sold for  7,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn after he moves to Altus Plateau.
- Should Corhyn die before purchasing this Incantation from him, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.
  - <font color="red">WARNING:</font> If the player lights the Forge of the Giants before this incantation appears in Corhyn's inventory, it will become unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.

stats.Effect: Increass lighting damage negation

item:lightning-grease.name: Lightning Grease
item:lightning-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of fulminating materials. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting lightning damage

item:lightning-grease.location: Craftable — Root Resin x1, Fulgurbloom x1

item:lightning-perfume-bottle.name: Lightning Perfume Bottle
item:lightning-perfume-bottle.location: Found on a corpse amongst the Lightning Rams north of the Cerulean Coast.

item:lightning-ram.name: Lightning Ram
item:lightning-ram.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Lightning affinity and the following skill:"Lightning Ram: Skill inspired by tumbling rams. Let out a bleat, then tumble forwards, clad in lightning. Tumbles can be repeated in rapid succession."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:lightning-ram.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Altus Plateau
- Drops from a Scarab found near the Sword Monument southeast of the entrance to Sainted Hero's Grave.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:lightning-scorpion-charm.name: Lightning Scorpion Charm
item:lightning-scorpion-charm.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that sparks with lightning.

stats.Effect: Raises lightning attack, but lowers damage negation

item:lightning-scorpion-charm.location: Wyndham Catacombs, in a room sealed by an imp statue — bring a Stonesword Key.

item:lightning-shrouding-cracked-tear.name: Lightning-shrouding Cracked Tear
item:lightning-shrouding-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts lightning attacks in mixed physick

item:lightning-shrouding-cracked-tear.location: Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar found at the Minor Erdtree in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes, along with the Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear and the Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear.

item:lightning-slash.name: Lightning Slash
item:lightning-slash.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Lightning affinity and the following skill:"Lightning Slash: Call down a bolt of lightning into armament, then swing it down to create an explosive shock. The armament retains the lightning enchantment for a while."Usable on swords, axes, and hammers.
item:lightning-slash.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Altus Plateau
- Drops from a Scarab found in the middle of an enemy campsite, past the gate north of the Outer Wall Battleground Site of Grace, yet southeast of the Highway Lookout Tower.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:lightning-spear.name: Lightning Spear
item:lightning-spear.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. Summons a lightning spear and hurls it before the caster. Charging causes a lightning bolt to strike the point ofimpact. Long ago, Godwyn the Golden defeated the ancient dragon Fortissax, and befriended his fallen foe — an event that gave rise to the ancient dragon cult in the capital.
item:lightning-spear.location: **Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants - Sold for 6,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Dragon Cult Prayerbook. - Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Hurls lightning spear before caster

item:lightning-strike.name: Lightning Strike
item:lightning-strike.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.
item:lightning-strike.location:
- **Guaranteed Drop:** Weeping Peninsula
- Lightning Strike is received upon defeating the Scarab at the bottom of the ravine splitting the Weeping Peninsula region in half. The stone platforms on either side of this can be used to descend safely. Note that it's surrounded by large bats and that lightning strikes constantly hit around this area.

stats.Effect: Summons lightning bolt that spreads from impact.

item:lightningproof-dried-liver.name: Lightningproof Dried Liver
item:lightningproof-dried-liver.description: Cured animal liver, dried out after pickling in an yellow medicinal

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts lightning damage negation

item:lightningproof-dried-liver.location: - Can be crafted after acquiring the Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [4] from a round building atop floating stone walls making a bridge upwards in Crumbling Farum Azula. It is found past the Dragon Temple Lift Site of Grace, straight across the courtyard and jumping atop two buildings on the right to get across a gap. Following across the ascending pseudo-bridge, it is guarded by 2 Giant Skeleton Beastmen. - 2 found in Leyndell, Royal Capital, on the stairs leading to the Fortified Manor.

item:lion-greatbow.name: Lion Greatbow
item:lion-greatbow.description: Greatbow of black iron wielded by General Radahn. Decorated with a lion mane motif. Imbued with gravitational power of the Starscourge, when used along with .  Radahn's Spear, it becomes a true weapon of a champion.

item:lion-s-claw.name: Lion's Claw
item:lion-s-claw.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Lion's Claw: Skill of the Redmanes, who fought alongside General Radahn. Somersault forwards, striking foes with armament."Usable on swords, axes, and hammers (small armaments and thrusting swords excepted).
item:lion-s-claw.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Caelid
- Drops from the Elder Lion found in Fort Gael.
  - Note that since it can't move from the dirt floor of the Fort, it's possible to kill it safely by using ranged attacks.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:lionel-s-armor.name: Lionel's Armor
item:lionel-s-armor.description: Round iron armor with a banner extending from its back. Worn by the Lionel the Lionhearted.

stats.Negation: Physical 17 · Strike 16 · Slash 19 · Pierce 19 · Magic 13 · Fire 14 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:lionel-s-armor.location: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:lionel-s-armor-altered.name: Lionel's Armor (altered)
item:lionel-s-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Lionel's Armor.

stats.Negation: Physical 17 · Strike 15 · Slash 18 · Pierce 19 · Magic 13 · Fire 14 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:lionel-s-armor-altered.location: Gained by altering Lionel's Armor, which is found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:lionel-s-gauntlets.name: Lionel's Gauntlets

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 5 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:lionel-s-gauntlets.location:
**Location**: Leyndell, Royal Capital
- Lionel's Gauntlets are found on a corpse on a bed inside the  Lower Capital Church in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:lionel-s-greaves.name: Lionel's Greaves
item:lionel-s-greaves.description: Rounded iron greaves. Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted.

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 9 · Slash 11 · Pierce 11 · Magic 7 · Fire 8 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:lionel-s-greaves.location: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:lionel-s-helm.name: Lionel's Helm
item:lionel-s-helm.description: Round iron helm with a distinctive large brim. Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 4 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:lionel-s-helm.location: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:litany-of-proper-death.name: Litany Of Proper Death
item:litany-of-proper-death.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
item:litany-of-proper-death.location: - Sold by D, Hunter of the Dead for 2500 runes.

stats.Effect: Creates image of Order to deal holy damage

item:living-jar-shard.name: Living Jar Shard
item:living-jar-shard.description: A fragment of a living jar, hardened after its death. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:lizard-greatsword.name: Lizard Greatsword
item:lizard-greatsword.location: This weapon can be dropped by Lion Imps (2% chance) in the Scorpion River Catacombs and Fog Rift Catacombs.

item:lone-wolf-ashes.name: Lone Wolf Ashes
item:lone-wolf-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three lone wolves.

stats.Effect: Summons three lone wolf spirits.

item:lone-wolf-ashes.location:
Given by Renna the Witch in the Church of Elleh, after the player receives the Spectral Steed Whistle from Melina.

If the player misses this encounter, both the Lone Wolf Ashes and the Spirit Calling Bell will be added to the Twin Maiden Husks shop inventory.

item:longbow.name: Longbow
item:longbow.description: Longbow made to fire arrows over great distances. Compared to a shortbow, arrows fired reach further and deal more damage. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.
item:longbow.location: You can easily purchase the Longbow for 1,200 Runes from the Twin Maiden Husks NPC at the Roundtable Hold.

item:longhaft-axe.name: Longhaft Axe
item:longhaft-axe.description: Large iron axe with a long handle. Weapon of the maltreated Misbegotten. Making use of the force generated by its length, this weapon's resentment-charged blows are difficult to stop.
item:longhaft-axe.location: You can find the standard Longhaft by farming Misbegotten enemies.

item:longsword.name: Longsword
item:longsword.description: A straight sword with a double-edged blade. In addition to its easily-inflicted standard damage, this well- balanced weapon can also perform powerful piercing attacks.
item:longsword.location: The Longsword can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,000 Runes.

item:longtail-cat-talisman.name: Longtail Cat Talisman
item:longtail-cat-talisman.description: A brooch depicting Lacrima, the long-tailed cat.

stats.Effect: Renders the wearer immune to fall damage

item:longtail-cat-talisman.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Raya Lucaria Academy, in central Liurnia of the Lakes. From School House Classroom, head back outside and ride the lift down to the bottom (jump off the lift to the platform, near the bottom, because falling off the lift, even at its lowest point, is a lethal fall). The corpse can be found within the Iron Virgin's fight arena, at the bottom of this area.

item:lord-of-blood-s-exultation.name: Lord Of Blood's Exultation
item:lord-of-blood-s-exultation.description: A talisman depicting the exultation of the Lord of Blood.

stats.Effect: Enhances critical hits

item:lord-of-blood-s-exultation.location: Esgar, Priest of Blood in Leyndell Catacombs.

item:lord-of-blood-s-robe.name: Lord Of Blood's Robe
item:lord-of-blood-s-robe.description: Attire of Mohg, Lord of Blood, embroidered with an extravagant gold emblem on black cloth. The dress of a Luminary, the reigning lord and hierarch of the coming dynasty of Mohgwyn. Or perhaps, of a raving lunatic.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 10 · Slash 8 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:lord-of-blood-s-robe.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood.

item:lord-of-blood-s-robe-altered.name: Lord Of Blood's Robe (altered)
item:lord-of-blood-s-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Lord Of Blood's Robe.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 10 · Slash 8 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:lord-of-blood-s-robe-altered.location: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood. Can be altered at a Site of Grace or by Boc.

item:lord-s-aid.name: Lord's Aid
item:lord-s-aid.description: Incantation bestowed by the Two Fingers upon the Tarnished
item:lord-s-aid.location: **Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants - Lord's Aid is sold for 2,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Two Fingers' Prayerbook. - Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Alleviates poison / blood loss / sleep buildup for self / allies

item:lord-s-divine-fortification.name: Lord's Divine Fortification
item:lord-s-divine-fortification.description: Incantation taught to Gideon the All-Knowing by the Two
item:lord-s-divine-fortification.location:
**Quest Item / Purchase:** Roundtable Hold
- Received from Gideon after discussing the haligtree roots, once Malenia, Blade of Miquella has been defeated.
- Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks for 3,500 Runes if the player does not talk to Gideon about the roots before unleashing the Rune of Death.

stats.Effect: Greatly increases holy damage negation incl. allies

item:lord-s-heal.name: Lord's Heal
item:lord-s-heal.description: Incantation bestowed by the Two Fingers upon the Tarnished
item:lord-s-heal.location: **Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants - Sold for 8,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows, after giving either of them the Two Fingers' Prayerbook. - Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this incantation, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's bell bearing.

stats.Effect: Massively heals HP for self and nearby allies

item:lord-s-rune.name: Lord's Rune
item:lord-s-rune.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;

stats.Effect: Use to gain an enormous abundance of runes

item:lord-s-rune.location:
**Lord's Rune can be dropped by the following enemies:**
- Erdtree Avatar (Leyndell, Royal Capital)

**Lord's Rune can be looted from the following locations:**
- Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum

item:lordsworn-s-greatsword.name: Lordsworn's Greatsword
item:lordsworn-s-greatsword.description: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Through blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.
item:lordsworn-s-greatsword.location: To get the Lordsworn's Greatsword in Elden Ring, travel to the Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave, clear the nearby guards, and open the chest inside the back of the large horse-drawn carriage.

item:lordsworn-s-shield.name: Lordsworn's Shield
item:lordsworn-s-shield.description: Wooden tower shield. Lightweightfor a greatshield and easy to handle. Commonly used in the Shattering. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
item:lordsworn-s-shield.location: 2% chance to be dropped by various greatshield-wielding enemy soldiers, such as Godrick Soldiers.

item:lordsworn-s-straight-sword.name: Lordsworn's Straight Sword
item:lordsworn-s-straight-sword.description: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Though blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a servicable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.
item:lordsworn-s-straight-sword.location: The Lordsworn's Straight Sword is a random drop obtained by defeating Godrick Soldiers or Mausoleum Soldiers.

item:loretta-s-greatbow.name: Loretta's Greatbow
item:loretta-s-greatbow.description: Sorcery used by Royal Knight Loretta. Creates a magic greatbow and fires a great arrow. Charging enhances potency. Hold to keep the great arrow nocked. It is said that the bow was Loretta's favored weapon.
item:loretta-s-greatbow.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Acquired from defeating the apparition of Royal Knight Loretta guarding the Royal Moongazing Grounds of Caria Manor.

stats.Effect: Fires great arrow from a magic greatbow

item:loretta-s-mastery.name: Loretta's Mastery
item:loretta-s-mastery.description: Sorcery used by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Creates a magic greatbow and fires four great arrows simultaneously. Charging enhances potency. Hold to keep the great arrows nocked. Developed by Loretta after her long, bloody journey to seek out a place where the Albinaurics could live in peace.
item:loretta-s-mastery.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Miquella's Haligtree
- Acquired from defeating Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree standing guard at the Haligtree Promenade.

stats.Effect: Fires four great arrow from a magic greatbow at once

item:loretta-s-slash.name: Loretta's Slash
item:loretta-s-slash.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:"Loretta's Slash: Skill of Loretta the Royal Knight. Leap forward, imbuing the blade with glintstone, then descend, accelerating into a sweeping slash."Usable on polearms and twinblades.
item:loretta-s-slash.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Drops from Royal Knight Loretta in Caria Manor.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:loretta-s-war-sickle.name: Loretta's War Sickle
item:loretta-s-war-sickle.description: Intricately crafted silver war sickle wielded by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Originally given for service as a personal guard to Carian royalty, the weapon's blue glintstone has been replaced with unalloyed gold.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int D

item:loretta-s-war-sickle.location: Drop from Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree

item:lost-ashes-of-war.name: Lost Ashes Of War
item:lost-ashes-of-war.description: Empty ashes of war, devoid of any memories of battle.Unable to apply any kind of affinity in their current state, but can be used by Smithing Master Hewg of the Roundtable Hold to recreate other ashes.Thus does the copy pass into becoming the genuine article.
item:lost-ashes-of-war.location: A total of **15** Lost Ashes of War can be obtained per playthrough. **Purchased:** - x1 sold by the Isolated Merchant (Weeping Peninsula) in his shack in the Weeping Peninsula. - x1 sold by the Isolated Merchant (Liurnia of the Lakes) south of the Main Academy Gate Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes. - x2 sold by the Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow) at the top of the mountain in northwestern Dragonbarrow. - x1 sold by the Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River) at the Uhl Palace Ruins. - x1 sold by the Imprisoned Merchant in Mohgwyn Palace.

item:lucerne.name: Lucerne
item:lucerne.description: This polearm features a hard, sharpened beak-like spike attached to its head, designed to pierce armor. Though designed mainly as a thrusting weapon, its long handle can be utilized to get around an enemy's guard with a sideward sweeping attack.
item:lucerne.location: To get the Lucerne halberd in Elden Ring, travel to the Liurnia Highway North Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes, head north up the road to a ghost battlefield, and loot it from a corpse near a broken cart on the right.

item:lucidity.name: Lucidity
item:lucidity.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.
item:lucidity.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Acquired from defeating Preceptor Miriam in the inverted version of Carian Study Hall.

stats.Effect: Alleviates buildup of sleep and madness

item:lump-of-flesh.name: Lump Of Flesh
item:lump-of-flesh.description: A lump of beast flesh filled with rich juices. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting carnivorous beast. Meat suitable for a rustic feast.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:lump-of-flesh.location:
- Bears
- Boars
- Wolves
- Dogs
- Lesser Runebears

item:lusat-s-glintstone-crown.name: Lusat's Glintstone Crown
item:lusat-s-glintstone-crown.description: The giant blue glintstone crown worn by Lusat, primeval current sorcerer.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 5 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:lusat-s-glintstone-crown.location:
**Location**: Sellia Hideaway
- Lusat's Glintstone Crown is obtained upon completing Sorceress Sellen's questline, then returning to the spot where Primeval Sorcerer Lusat was found in the Sellia Hideaway to loot the Lusat's Set.

item:lusat-s-glintstone-staff.name: Lusat's Glintstone Staff
item:lusat-s-glintstone-staff.description: Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Lusat. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom ofstone may wield it. Enhances power ofall sorceries, but consumes additional FP.
item:lusat-s-glintstone-staff.location: To get Lusat's Glintstone Staff in Elden Ring, travel to Sellia, Town of Sorcery in Caelid.

item:lusat-s-manchettes.name: Lusat's Manchettes
item:lusat-s-manchettes.description: Manchettes corroded by blue glintstones. Worn by Lusat, primeval current sorcerer.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Slash 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 2 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:lusat-s-manchettes.location:
**Location**: Sellia Hideaway
- Lusat's Manchettes are obtained by completing Sorceress Sellen's questline, then returning to the location where Lusat was found in Sellia Hideaway.

item:lusat-s-robe.name: Lusat's Robe
item:lusat-s-robe.description: A robe reserved for grand masters at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Corroded by blue glintstones.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 6 · Slash 8 · Pierce 6 · Magic 15 · Fire 12 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:lusat-s-robe.location: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Lusat in the Sellia Hideaway cave to loot the Lusat armor set.

item:mace.name: Mace
item:mace.description: An iron bludgeon with sharp protrusions. Strinking attacks have few drawbacks, potent as they are at breaking through guards and stances, Most suited to head on slugging matches.
item:mace.location: The standard Mace can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 800 Runes.

item:mad-pumpkin-head-ashes.name: Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes
item:mad-pumpkin-head-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a mad pumpkin head. Spirit of a mad soldier with a large, brawny physique. Though he has stifled his panic within the dark confines of his helmet, he rampages as if driven mad when agitated by bloodshed or the humming of insects. This mad soldier is all that is left of a broken gladiator.

stats.Effect: Summon the spirit of a mad pumpkin head

item:mad-pumpkin-head-ashes.location: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog duo in the Minor Erdtree Catacombs.

item:madding-hand.name: Madding Hand

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int E · Fai E

item:madding-hand.location: Dropped by Madding Hand in the Abyssal Woods.

item:magic-downpour.name: Magic Downpour
item:magic-downpour.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.
item:magic-downpour.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Acquired from defeating Preceptor Miriam in the normal version of Carian Study Hall.

stats.Effect: Summon a magic mass that sprays projectiles over area

item:magic-fortification.name: Magic Fortification
item:magic-fortification.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful. Increases magic damage negation. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Follow the path that has been set for you, and you will make enemies of all others: the monks, the sorcerers, the ancient dragon knights, and the scions of gold. Heed me – the Lands Between offers no welcome to the Tarnished.
item:magic-fortification.location:
**Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
- Sold for  3,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn.
- Should Corhyn die before purchasing this Incantation from him, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Increases magic damage negation

item:magic-glintblade.name: Magic Glintblade
item:magic-glintblade.description: An old sorcery of the Carian Royal Family.
item:magic-glintblade.location:
**Purchase:** Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 3,000 Runes by Miriel, Pastor of Vows.
- Should Miriel die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Miriel's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Creates sigil that forms a projectile glintblade after delay

item:magic-grease.name: Magic Grease
item:magic-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of magically resonant materials.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting magic damage

item:magic-grease.location: Craftable — Root Resin x1, Crystal Bud x1

item:magic-scorpion-charm.name: Magic Scorpion Charm
item:magic-scorpion-charm.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that shimmers with magic.

stats.Effect: Raises magic attack, but lowers damage negation

item:magic-scorpion-charm.location: Given by Preceptor Seluvis after his quest.
related: Buy out his puppet stock before Nokron

item:magic-shrouding-cracked-tear.name: Magic-shrouding Cracked Tear
item:magic-shrouding-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts magic attacks in mixed physick

item:magic-shrouding-cracked-tear.location: Dropped by one of the two Erdtree Avatars in Liurnia of the Lakes, specifically the one in the north-east.

item:magma-blade.name: Magma Blade
item:magma-blade.description: Curved sword with a blade fashioned from the lava of Mt. Gelmir. An armament of the man-serpents, impossible for a human to have made. Deals fire damage.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:magma-blade.location: The Magma Blade is a rare drop from Man-Serpent enemies wielding bright orange glowing swords in Volcano Manor.

item:magma-breath.name: Magma Breath
item:magma-breath.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
item:magma-breath.location:
**Dragon Communion:** Limgrave / Caelid / Jagged Peak
- Acquired from the altar at the Church of Dragon Communion in Limgrave, Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid, and the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak for 1 Dragon Heart after defeating the Magma Wyrm south of Fort Laiedd at Mt. Gelmir.

stats.Effect: Channels wyrm to spew magma breath

item:magma-shot.name: Magma Shot
item:magma-shot.description: One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir.
item:magma-shot.location:
**Quest Item:** Volcano Manor
- Acquired from Tanith after successfully felling the first assassination target, Old Knight Istvan.

stats.Effect: Fire lump of magma that explodes on contact

item:magma-whip-candlestick.name: Magma Whip Candlestick
item:magma-whip-candlestick.description: This ritual implement is a three pronged candlestick with solid flames formed of the magma of Mt. Gelmir. When wielded as a weapon, the flames become supple whips of lava.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Fai D

item:magma-whip-candlestick.location: To get the Magma Whip Candlestick in Elden Ring, you must progress Patches' questline inside Volcano Manor and complete an assassination assignment for him.

item:magma-wyrm-s-scalesword.name: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword
item:magma-wyrm-s-scalesword.description: Curved greatsword wielded by Magma Wyrms. The shape resembles a dragon's jaw and is covered in hard scales. It's said these land-bound dragons were once humans heroes who partook in dragon communication, a grave transgression for which they were cursed to crawl the earth upon their bellies, shadows of their former selves.

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex D · Fai D

item:main-gauche.name: Main-gauche
item:main-gauche.location: Found inside of Shadow Keep. From the Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace, head up the western stairs and take a right after the first stair, then take a right again in the corridor to arrive in a small room with a Black Knight. The dagger can be found  on a body in the left corner.

item:malenia-s-armor.name: Malenia's Armor
item:malenia-s-armor.description: Armor made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk. "My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god - he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 7 · Slash 11 · Pierce 9 · Magic 6 · Fire 7 · Lightning 4 · Holy 7

item:malenia-s-armor.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

item:malenia-s-armor-altered.name: Malenia's Armor (altered)
item:malenia-s-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Maleinia's Armor.

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 6 · Slash 10 · Pierce 8 · Magic 5 · Fire 6 · Lightning 2 · Holy 6

item:malenia-s-armor-altered.location: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:malenia-s-gauntlet.name: Malenia's Gauntlet
item:malenia-s-gauntlet.description: Gauntlet made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk. "My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god—he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 1 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 2

item:malenia-s-gauntlet.location: - Malenia's Gauntlet can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for  12,000 runes after defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

item:malenia-s-greaves.name: Malenia's Greaves
item:malenia-s-greaves.description: Greaves made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk. "My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god—he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 5 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 5 · Lightning 3 · Holy 6

item:malenia-s-greaves.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

item:malenia-s-winged-helm.name: Malenia's Winged Helm
item:malenia-s-winged-helm.description: Winged helm made of unalloyed gold.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:malenia-s-winged-helm.location: - Purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for  12,000 runes after defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

item:malformed-dragon-armor.name: Malformed Dragon Armor
item:malformed-dragon-armor.description: Malformed golden armor. Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels. After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was to become dragons themselves.

item:man-serpent-ashes.name: Man-serpent Ashes
item:man-serpent-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a man-serpent. Spirit of a deformed man-serpent that wields a whip of magma. It is said that long ago, the elder serpent that dwelled on Mt. Gelmir devoured a demigod, and the birth of the man-serpents followed.

stats.Effect: Summons man-serpent spirit

item:man-serpent-ashes.location: Found in the hall containing several Wandering Nobles and Man-Serpents in Volcano Manor, before the sending gate leading to Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

item:man-serpent-s-shield.name: Man-serpent's Shield
item:man-serpent-s-shield.description: Small copper dome-shaped roundshield carried by the man-serpents of Mt. Gelmir. Said to have been tempered in lava, it boasts great resistance to fire.
item:man-serpent-s-shield.location: 4% chance to be dropped by Man-Serpents in Volcano Manor.

item:manor-towershield.name: Manor Towershield
item:manor-towershield.description: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Depicts the Roundtable Hold, gathering place of champions. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
item:manor-towershield.location: Found in Stormveil Castle, from the Secluded Cell Site of Grace, head back towards the Living Jars, then follow the wall to the right upon reaching the next level up the ramp. The Tarnished must jump to the windows from the ledge and enter the door to the right afterward. Following this path will lead to a storeroom full of Commoners with the Manor Shield being under the stairs.

item:mantis-blade.name: Mantis Blade
item:mantis-blade.description: A curved sword with a blade at both ends wielded by the Cemetery Shades, the insect-ridden grave keepers.  The blade is thin and sharp, and strong attack unleashes a far-reaching slash.
item:mantis-blade.location: To get the Mantis Blade in Elden Ring, travel to the Gelmir Hero's Grave in Mt. Gelmir.

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Arc D

item:marais-mask.name: Marais Mask
item:marais-mask.description: Mask in the image of a white-haired young noble. Customarily worn by the head of House Marais. Increases arcane. The Marais family has a dual history spanning generations, serving as both executioners and castellans of the Shaded Castle. This mask bears the likeness of the first of their line.

**Location**: The Shaded Castle

item:marais-robe.name: Marais Robe
item:marais-robe.description: Robe with a black mantle across the shoulders. Customarily worn by the head of House Marais. The sons of House Marais are all sickly born. Little wonder that Maleigh Marais would be so beguiled by the beautiful and fierce goddess who was born into rot.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 4 · Pierce 2 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:marais-robe.location: Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan.

item:margit-s-shackle.name: Margit's Shackle
item:margit-s-shackle.description: A fetish bathed in golden magic. Shackles were used to bind the accursed people called the Omen, and these ones were made to keep a particular Omen under strictest confinement. Though faint, the shackles still retain vestiges of power — enough to trap the once-bound Margit on earth, if only for a short time.

stats.Effect: Binds Margit and Morgott two times per battle

item:margit-s-shackle.location:
**Location**: Murkwater Cave
- Margit's Shackle is sold by Patches in Murkwater Cave.

item:marika-s-hammer.name: Marika's Hammer
item:marika-s-hammer.description: Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it. The hammer partially broke upon shattering the Ring, becoming splintered with rune fragments.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:marika-s-scarseal.location: - Obtained from a corpse in northwestern Siofra River, at the base of a waterfall behind the Dragonkin Soldier boss fight arena.

item:marika-s-soreseal.name: Marika's Soreseal

stats.Effect: Greatly raises attributes, but also increases damage taken.

item:marika-s-soreseal.location: - Obtained from a chalice in southeastern Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. The chalice resides inside a room locked by a semi-transparent fog wall, which can be unlocked by inserting one Stonesword Key into the adjacent imp statue. - From Elphael Inner Wall, head east to the courtyard once guarded by an Erdtree Avatar, and climb down the ladder at the southeast end of this area. Proceed southeast/clockwise through this lowermost level of Elphael to reach the fog wall.

item:marred-leather-shield.location: Looted from a corpse on the wooden stairs along the exterior wall past the Stormveil Cliffside Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle.

item:marred-wooden-shield.name: Marred Wooden Shield
item:marred-wooden-shield.description: "Wooden shield of the Stormveil soldiers. Much like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns. item:mask-of-confidence.description: Mask with the mouth sewn shut with gold thread. Increases arcane. When Radagon married Rennala, he ordered the Carian magic preceptors to don these masks. To make it clear that all of their matters were to be kept strictly private.

item:memory-stone.name: Memory Stone

stats.Effect: Increases memory slots

item:memory-stone.location: A total of 8 Memory Stones can be acquired: - **Purchased** - Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 3,000 Runes. - **Found in chests at the top of rises** - Oridys's Rise in the Weeping Peninsula (solve the three tortoise puzzle). - Testu's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes (solve the three tortoise puzzle). - Lenne's Rise in northeastern Caelid (access via Torrent's wind draft jump to the balcony). - Converted Tower in Liurnia (perform the Erudition gesture in front of the statue; requires an Academy Glintstone Key given to Thops at the Church of Irith).

item:messmer-s-orb.name: Messmer's Orb
item:messmer-s-orb.location:
**Trade:** Remembrance of the Impaler
- Exchange the Remembrance with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.
  - The remembrance is acquired by defeating Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame.
  - After the Remembrance is acquired, a Wandering Mausoleum or Remembrance Duplication Coffins can be used to duplicate it. The spell can only be acquired once per new game cycle, regardless of how many remembrances are held.

item:messmer-soldier-s-axe.name: Messmer Soldier's Axe
item:messmer-soldier-s-axe.location: There is a 2% chance that axe-wielding Messmer Soldiers can drop this weapon.

item:messmer-soldier-s-spear.name: Messmer Soldier's Spear
item:messmer-soldier-s-spear.location: 2.00% chance to be dropped by spear-wielding Messmer Soldiers, such as the three found at a camp to the west from  Moorth Ruins site of grace.

item:meteoric-ore-blade.name: Meteoric Ore Blade
item:meteoric-ore-blade.description: Katana forged from meteoric ore to dispatch lifeforms born of falling stars. Deals magic damage. The blade is weighty, known to deliver slashes of such ferocity that the impact is said to resemble the crash of a falling meteor.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:meteoric-ore-blade.location: To get the Meteoric Ore Blade in Elden Ring, travel to the cellar beneath the Caelid Waypoint Ruins in southern Caelid.

item:meteorite.name: Meteorite
item:meteorite.description: A glintstone sorcery that draws on gravitational force, used by a great white king with stone skin. Calls small meteorites down from the sky. The meteor shower continues for as long as the sorcery is in effect. It is said that, in the Eternal City, now lost in ruin underground, meteorites held the same import as stars.
item:meteorite.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Acquired from defeating the Onyx Lord at the Royal Grave Evergaol.

stats.Effect: Calls small meteors down from the sky.

item:meteorite-of-astel.name: Meteorite Of Astel
item:meteorite-of-astel.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces. Summons a void that emits a hail of meteorites. Hold to continue the effect. A manifestation of the power with which Astel leveled the Eternal City.
item:meteorite-of-astel.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Consecrated Snowfield
- Acquired from defeating the Astel, Stars of Darkness bossfight that lurks at the end of Yelough Anix Tunnel.

stats.Effect: Calls a hail of small meteorites from the void.

item:meteorite-staff.name: Meteorite Staff
item:meteorite-staff.description: Staff embedded with a dark purple glintstone, said to be the fragment of a meteorite. Boasts high sorcery scaling and boosts gravity sorceries as well. However, this staff cannot be strengthened in any way.
item:meteorite-staff.location: To get the Meteorite Staff, travel to the Street of Sages Ruins in the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid.

item:midra-s-flame-of-frenzy.name: Midra's Flame of Frenzy
item:midra-s-flame-of-frenzy.location:
**Trade:** Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame
- Exchange the Remembrance with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.
  - The remembrance is acquired by defeating Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame.
  - After the Remembrance is acquired, a Wandering Mausoleum or Remembrance Duplication Coffins can be used to duplicate it. The spell can only be acquired once per new game cycle, regardless of how many remembrances are held.

item:mighty-shot.name: Mighty Shot
item:mighty-shot.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Mighty Shot: Archery skill performed from an oblique stance. Ready the bow, then pull the bowstring to its limit to enhance the power of the shot, penetrating the enemy's guard."Usable on light bows and longbows.
item:mighty-shot.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Weeping Peninsula
- Drops from a Scarab found in the crossroads northwest of the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:milady.name: Milady
item:milady.location: The Milady can be found inside a chest in a watchtower at Castle Ensis.

item:millicent-prosthesis.name: Millicent's Prosthesis
item:millicent-prosthesis.description: Part of the golden prosthesis used by Millicent. The hand is locked into a fist that once raised a sword aloft.

stats.Effect: Boosts dexterity, raises attack power with successive attacks

item:millicent-s-gloves.name: Millicent's Gloves
item:millicent-s-gloves.description: Gloves worn by Millicent the Rotting

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 2 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:millicent-s-gloves.location: - The playable version of Millicent's Gloves is  cut content and cannot be acquired.

item:mimic-s-veil.name: Mimic's Veil

stats.Effect: Uses FP to mimic nearby objects.

item:mimic-s-veil.location:
**Location**: Stormveil Castle
- The Mimic's Veil is found at Stormveil Castle inside a treasure chest within a room that is patrolled by a single Banished Knight.

item:mimic-tear-ashes.name: Mimic Tear Ashes
item:mimic-tear-ashes.description: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of a mimic tear. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP.

stats.Effect: Summons mimic tear spirit

item:miniature-ranni.name: Miniature Ranni
item:miniature-ranni.description: A doll resembling Ranni the Witch.

stats.Effect: Doll resembling Ranni the Witch

item:minor-erdtree.name: Minor Erdtree
item:minor-erdtree.location:
**Loot:** Scaduview
- Found in Shaman Village, under a very, very small Minor Erdtree among a field of golden flowers. The path is guarded by a Tree Sentinel.

item:miquella-s-lily.name: Miquella's Lily
item:miquella-s-lily.description: A delicate water lily of unalloyed gold that has started to fade and wilt. Material used for crafting items. Exeedingly rare to find.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:miquella-s-lily.location: Miquella's Lilies are scattered across the Lands Between, particularly around sacred areas associated with Miquella or the Haligtree. These flowers do not respawn once harvested until the next playthrough.

item:miquellan-knight-s-sword.name: Miquellan Knight's Sword
item:miquellan-knight-s-sword.description: Sword forged by servants of Miquella of the Haligtree, with a design modeled after those carried by Carian knights. Instead of glintstone however, amber from the Haligtree is embedded in the blade. A sumptuous piece, yet it has never been offered to any knight — an ill-starred sword with no master. Skill: Sacred Blade

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai E

item:miquellan-knight-s-sword.location: The Miquellan Knight's Sword is located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

item:mirage-riddle.name: Mirage Riddle
item:mirage-riddle.description: A riddle concerning a rise that vanishes like a mirage.

stats.Effect: Simple map taken from an imp statue.

item:mirage-riddle.location:
**Location**: Altus Plateau
- The **Mirage Riddle** is acquired from the Imp Statue at Mirage Rise, west of the  Bower of Bounty.

item:miranda-powder.name: Miranda Powder
item:miranda-powder.description: Pollen from a man-eating miranda flower. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:miranda-powder.location: - Obtained by defeating miranda blossoms and miranda sprouts.

item:miranda-sprout-ashes.name: Miranda Sprout Ashes
item:miranda-sprout-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five miranda sprouts. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. Spirits of sweet little miranda flowers, carnivorous blossoms that feed upon human flesh. They creep slowly, scattering toxic pollen. Vulnerable to fire—do take care of the little darlings

stats.Effect: Summons five miranda sprouts

item:miranda-sprout-ashes.location: Found behind an illusory wall in Caelid Catacombs.

item:miriam-s-vanishing.name: Miriam's Vanishing
item:miriam-s-vanishing.location: Available for purchase from Count Ymir upon first meeting him in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr.

item:mis-ricorde.name: Miséricorde
item:mis-ricorde.description: Dagger favored by military physicians in white.  The pointed blade is hard and sharp, making critical hits especially potent.  Medicine is mercy. and mercy upon the battlefield is ruthless. Beware the killers clothes as men of compassion
item:mis-ricorde.location: Found behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open, near the roaming Grafted Scion inside Stormveil Castle and the elevator shortcut back up to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.

item:misbegotten-shortbow.name: Misbegotten Shortbow
item:misbegotten-shortbow.description: Shortbow wielded by Winged Misbegotten. Fine fur clings to it. Designed to inflict additional damage by sacrificing range.
item:misbegotten-shortbow.location: The Misbegotten Shortbow is a rare random drop from Winged Misbegotten archer enemies found in the Weeping Peninsula and other regions.

item:misericorde.name: Misericorde
item:misericorde.location: To get the Misericorde in Elden Ring, travel to Stormveil Castle and unlock the fog door in the armory room using one Stonesword Key.

item:missionary-s-cookbook-1.name: Missionary's Cookbook [1]
item:missionary-s-cookbook-1.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to become a Finger Maiden, instead became a missionary, and went forth to spread holy teachings.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:missionary-s-cookbook-1.location: Sold by Merchant Kalé in the Church of Elleh.

item:missionary-s-cookbook-3.name: Missionary's Cookbook [3]
item:missionary-s-cookbook-3.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:missionary-s-cookbook-3.location: Found on a corpse in Smoldering Church.

item:missionary-s-cookbook-4.name: Missionary's Cookbook [4]
item:missionary-s-cookbook-4.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to become a Finger Maiden, instead became a missionary, and went forth to spread holy teachings. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: -Holy Grease -Drawstring Holy Grease -Haligbone Arrow -Haligbone Arrow (Fletched) -Haligbone Bolt

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:missionary-s-cookbook-4.location: Found in the Minor Erdtree Church in Altus Plateau.

item:missionary-s-cookbook-5.name: Missionary's Cookbook [5]
item:missionary-s-cookbook-5.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to become a Finger Maiden, instead became a missionary, and went forth to spread holy teachings.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:missionary-s-cookbook-5.location: Found in the Siofra Aqueduct, in a circular room across a bridge patrolled by a Crucible Knight.

item:missionary-s-cookbook-7.name: Missionary's Cookbook [7]
item:missionary-s-cookbook-7.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to become a Finger Maiden, instead became a missionary, and went forth to spread holy teachings. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: -Rejuvenating Boluces

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:missionary-s-cookbook-7.location: Sold by Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).

item:mohg-s-shackle.name: Mohg's Shackle
item:mohg-s-shackle.description: A fetish bathed in golden magic.

stats.Effect: Briefly binds Mogh, once imprisoned, to earth

item:mohg-s-shackle.location: In the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath Leyndell, Royal Capital. At the bottom of the large room full of pipes where imps will ambush you.

item:mohgwyn-s-sacred-spear.name: Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear
item:mohgwyn-s-sacred-spear.description: Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty. As well as serving as a weapon, it is an instrument of communion with an outer god who bestows power upon accursed blood. The mother of truth desires a wound.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Arc D

item:mohgwyn-s-sacred-spear.location: Remembrance of the Blood Lord (Mohg, Lord of Blood)

item:monk-s-flameblade.name: Monk's Flameblade
item:monk-s-flameblade.description: Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants. The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.
item:monk-s-flameblade.location: The Monk's Flameblade is a rare drop farmed by defeating a specific Fire Monk inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave dungeon in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:monk-s-flamemace.name: Monk's Flamemace
item:monk-s-flamemace.description: Warhammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants.  The unique strong attack rouses fiery combative spirit.
item:monk-s-flamemace.location: The Monk's Flamemace is a rare random drop obtained by defeating specific Flame Monks who wield this mace.

item:moon-egg.name: Moon Egg
item:moon-egg.description: Owl eggs that will never hatch. Material used for crafting items. Prized as a symbol of the most sublime slumber.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:moon-of-nokstella.name: Moon Of Nokstella
item:moon-of-nokstella.description: This legendary talisman is a treasure of Nokstella, the Eternal City.

stats.Effect: Increases memory slots by 2

item:moon-of-nokstella.location:
**Location**:  Nokstella, Eternal City
- The Moon of Nokstella is the end of dungeon reward for Nokstella, Eternal City. It is looted from a treasure chest in the base of a Chair-Crypt housed within a cathedral located in the upper northwestern section of the city.
- It is protected by a Nox Swordstress and two Mimic Tears.

item:moonrithyll-s-knight-sword.name: Moonrithyll's Knight Sword

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int D

item:moonrithyll-s-knight-sword.location: This item can be obtained after defeating the NPC Moonrithyll, Carian Knight.

item:moonveil.name: Moonveil
item:moonveil.description: Katana forged of glintstone. Masterpiece of a Sellian wordsmith.  Light enwreathes the blade when sheathed, explaining its Moonveil moniker.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int C

item:moonveil.location: To get the Moonveil Katana, you need to defeat the Magma Wyrm boss inside Gael Tunnel, located on the border between Limgrave and Caelid.

item:morgott-s-cursed-sword.name: Morgott's Cursed Sword
item:morgott-s-cursed-sword.description: Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King.  The accused blood that Morgott recanted and sealed away reformed into this blade.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Arc D

item:morning-star.name: Morning Star
item:morning-star.description: Warhammer comprised of a globe attached to a handle. Though a bludgeon dealing strike damage, the appellative star covered. in spikes which cause blood loss. Ironic given its grace name, this weapon often reeks of blood.
item:morning-star.location: To get the Morning Star, head to the Weeping Peninsula, just south of Limgrave.

item:mottled-necklace.name: Mottled Necklace
item:mottled-necklace.description: A vividly-colored accoutrement precious to the ancestral followers.

stats.Effect: Raises Robustness, Immunity, and Focus

item:mottled-necklace.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Siofra River, which lies at the end of a broken bridge, leading to Nokron, Eternal City. This area can only be reached from a waygate at one of The Four Belfries, next to a message that reads "Night Sky Unceasing".

item:multilayered-ring-of-light.name: Multilayered Ring of Light
item:multilayered-ring-of-light.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Stone Coffin Fissure
- Defeat the Phantom Misbegotten Warrior found past the Fissure Waypoint Site of Grace along the main path through the area.

item:mushroom.name: Mushroom
item:mushroom.description: A fungal growth that thrives in damp thickets and elsewhere. Material used for crafting items. Its thick, spongy flesh makes it a key component in throwing pots.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:mushroom.location: - Mushrooms grow throughout the Lands Between, especially in wetlands, making them fairly common in Liurnia of the Lakes and Limgrave. - The Stormfoot Catacombs have two just outside the entrance, hidden in the grass. - The Folly on the Lake site of grace in southern Liurnia of the Lakes has two just east of the Grace, with four more a bit to the north under a fallen stone structure. - Ten are given by Boc the Seamster after freeing him from his bush form just north of the Agheel Lake North site of grace. - Radahn Soldiers and Exile Soldiers have a 15% drop rate.

item:mushroom-arms.name: Mushroom Arms
item:mushroom-arms.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the arms.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 1 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:mushroom-arms.location:
**Location**: Seethewater Cave
- The Mushroom Arms are found on a corpse alongside the rest of the Mushroom Set in Seethewater Cave on Mt. Gelmir.

item:mushroom-body.name: Mushroom Body
item:mushroom-body.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the torso. To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestments that root one to the earth.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 7 · Slash 2 · Pierce 5 · Magic 13 · Fire 5 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:mushroom-body.location: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave located in Mt. Gelmir.

item:mushroom-crown.name: Mushroom Crown
item:mushroom-crown.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushrooms form a towering headpiece. Raises attack power when something nearby suffers from poison or rot. Long ago, great lords served the scarlet rot. Perhaps such fungal bodies served as their crowns.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 7 · Magic 4 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:mushroom-crown.location: Found on a corpse up a pillar inside ruins located south-east of Lake of Rot.

item:mushroom-head.name: Mushroom Head
item:mushroom-head.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the head.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 1 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:mushroom-head.location: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave located in Mt. Gelmir.

item:mushroom-legs.name: Mushroom Legs
item:mushroom-legs.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the Legs.  To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestments that root one to the earth.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 4 · Slash 1 · Pierce 3 · Magic 7 · Fire 3 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:mushroom-legs.location: Found on a corpse alongside the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave, located in Mt. Gelmir.

item:nagakiba.name: Nagakiba
item:nagakiba.description: Katana with a ferociously long blade. Signature weapon of Yura, hunter of Bloody Fingers. Reminiscent of a reinforced spear, its imposing lenth can be put to good use with powerful thrusting attacks.
item:nagakiba.location: To get the Nagakiba, an exceptionally long katana in Elden Ring, you can either defeat the NPC Bloody Finger Hunter Yura early in the game or complete his questline.
related: Help him again at the Liurnia invasion

item:nanaya-s-torch.name: Nanaya's Torch

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Int E · Fai E

item:nanaya-s-torch.location:
**Location**: Midra's Manse
- Nanaya's Torch is found in the arms of Nanaya, who sits in a chair on the upper balcony in the western wing of Midra's Manse.

item:nascent-butterfly.name: Nascent Butterfly
item:nascent-butterfly.description: An arcane butterfly with translucent wings. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:nascent-butterfly.location:
- Found throughout the Lands Between, but will not respawn until .
- Sold by the Abandoned Merchant in the Siofra River region for  1,500 runes (stock: 5).
- Ancestral Follower Shamans have a 20% chance to drop Nascent Butterflies. The best farming spot is the Ancestral Woods.

item:navy-hood.name: Navy Hood
item:navy-hood.description: A hooded cloak of deep navy. Worn by expatriated royalty. Increases mind. Such cloaks were gifted to those who departed on missions to faraway lands, from which they would never return. But what choice did they have, having seen the guidance of grace?

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:navy-hood.location:
**Location**: East Windmill Pasture
- The Navy Hood is found on a corpse near the East Windmill Pasture in the Altus Plateau.

item:nepheli-loux-puppet.name: Nepheli Loux Puppet
item:nepheli-loux-puppet.description: One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Nepheli Loux. Puppet of a warrior who was betrayed by her pure heart. Wields a Stormhawk Axe in both hands and uses the Thunderstorm skill. A diamond in the rough, deserving of special care lest its potential be squandered. Nepheli Loux truly was a warrior.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Nepheli Loux

item:nepheli-loux-puppet.location: Can be obtained through Preceptor Seluvis's questline, if Seluvis's Potion is given to Nepheli Loux.

item:neutralizing-boluses.name: Neutralizing Boluses
item:neutralizing-boluses.description: Green boluses made from cave moss. Craftable item. Alleviates poison buildup and cures poison ailment. Poison accumulates gradually, coming into effect once the threshold is reached. Poison ailment lowers HP in steady increments for a period.

stats.Effect: Alleviates poison buildup and cures poison

item:night-comet.name: Night Comet
item:night-comet.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
item:night-comet.location: Sellia Town of Sorcery — chest after lighting the braziers. Need the Sellia sealed-town puzzle.

stats.Effect: Fires semi-invisible magic comet

item:night-maiden-armor.name: Night Maiden Armor
item:night-maiden-armor.description: Armor worn by the nightmaidens of the Eternal City. Indicates the highest clerical rank, and includes a silk cape. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 9 · Slash 8 · Pierce 10 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 12

item:night-maiden-armor.location: Chance to drop from Nox Nightmaiden enemies.

item:night-maiden-s-mist.name: Night Maiden's Mist
item:night-maiden-s-mist.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
item:night-maiden-s-mist.location:
**Purchase:** Caelid / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 5,000 Runes by Sage Gowry after he has repaired the snapped Unalloyed Gold Needle.
- Should Gowry die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Gowry's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Releases life-sapping silver mist before caster

item:night-maiden-twin-crown.name: Night Maiden Twin Crown
item:night-maiden-twin-crown.description: Twin crowns worn by the nightmaidens of the Eternal City. Indicates the highest clerical rank, and hides the eyes with silk. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 3 · Magic 4 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:night-maiden-twin-crown.location: Chance to drop from Night Maiden enemies.

item:night-s-cavalry-armor.name: Night's Cavalry Armor
item:night-s-cavalry-armor.description: Pitch-black armor thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

stats.Negation: Physical 14 · Strike 12 · Slash 14 · Pierce 13 · Magic 10 · Fire 12 · Lightning 10 · Holy 12

item:night-s-cavalry-armor.location: Received upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield.

item:night-s-cavalry-armor-altered.name: Night's Cavalry Armor (altered)
item:night-s-cavalry-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Night's Cavalry Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 14 · Strike 12 · Slash 14 · Pierce 13 · Magic 10 · Fire 12 · Lightning 10 · Holy 12

item:night-s-cavalry-armor-altered.location: Received unaltered upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:night-s-cavalry-gauntlets.name: Night's Cavalry Gauntlets
item:night-s-cavalry-gauntlets.description: Pitch-black gauntlets thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:night-s-cavalry-gauntlets.location: - The Night's Cavalry Gauntlets are obtained by defeating the Night's Cavalry duo in the Consecrated Snowfield.

item:night-s-cavalry-greaves.name: Night's Cavalry Greaves
item:night-s-cavalry-greaves.description: Pitch-black greaves thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 7 · Slash 8 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 7 · Lightning 6 · Holy 7

item:night-s-cavalry-greaves.location: Received upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield.

item:night-s-cavalry-helm.name: Night's Cavalry Helm
item:night-s-cavalry-helm.description: Pitch-black helm with flowing black hair. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:night-s-cavalry-helm.location: Received upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield.

item:night-s-cavalry-helm-altered.name: Night's Cavalry Helm (altered)
item:night-s-cavalry-helm-altered.description: Lighter version of the Night's Cavalry Helm.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:night-s-cavalry-helm-altered.location: Received unaltered upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:night-shard.name: Night Shard
item:night-shard.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
item:night-shard.location:
**Purchase:** Caelid / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 4,000 Runes by Sage Gowry after he has repaired the snapped Unalloyed Gold Needle.

item:official-s-attire.name: Official's Attire
