stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 5 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:official-s-attire.location: Hidden within a room that you can only reach from the elevator ride that leads down to the Forbidden Lands grace.

item:oil-pot.name: Oil Pot
item:oil-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of oil-infused materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to soak them in oil, making them heavily susceptible to fire damage.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to soak them in oil.

item:okina-mask.name: Okina Mask
item:okina-mask.description: A wooden mask that depicts an old man bearing his teeth. The source of the sobriquet of the great swordman of the Land of Reeds. Raises dexterity as it lowers focus.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:okina-mask.location: Dropped by Bloody Finger Okina at the Church of Repose on the Mountaintops.

item:old-aristocrat-cowl.name: Old Aristocrat Cowl
item:old-aristocrat-cowl.description: Cowl made of soft cloth. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 2

item:old-aristocrat-cowl.location: - The Old Aristocrat Cowl has a 1.50% chance to drop from the Wandering Noble wearing it. Two can be found in the vicinity of the  Agheel Lake South Site of Grace in Limgrave. One walks up the hill to the east, while the other travels north along the road carrying a large banner and bearing a horn. Allowing the Kaiden Sellsword to pass will allow the The Tarnished to kill the nobles uncontested.

item:old-aristocrat-gown.name: Old Aristocrat Gown
item:old-aristocrat-gown.description: Gown of soft cloth adorned with fine gold embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 7 · Slash 6 · Pierce 7 · Magic 9 · Fire 10 · Lightning 9 · Holy 7

item:old-aristocrat-gown.location: Dropped by the Wandering Noble wearing the cowl, walking with a large banner and bearing a horn. There are two in the vicinity of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. One will be up the hill to the east, and the other will be north along the road. Allowing the Kaiden Sellsword to pass will allow the Tarnished to kill the noble uncontested.

item:old-aristocrat-shoes.name: Old Aristocrat Shoes
item:old-aristocrat-shoes.description: Hard-wearing shoes made of leather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 4 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:old-aristocrat-shoes.location:
Dropped by Wandering Nobles wearing a cowl, walking with a large banner and bearing a horn.
- There are two in the vicinity of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. One will be up the hill to the east, and the other will be north along the road. Allowing the Kaiden Sellsword to pass will allow the Tarnished to kill the noble uncontested.

item:old-fang.name: Old Fang
item:old-fang.description: A rarely-seen specimen of beast fang.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:old-lord-s-talisman.name: Old Lord's Talisman
item:old-lord-s-talisman.description: A legendary talisman depicting the ancient king whose seat lies at the heart of the storm beyond time.

stats.Effect: Extends spell effect duration

item:old-lord-s-talisman.location: Found on a corpse in Crumbling Farum Azula.

item:old-sorcerer-legwraps.name: Old Sorcerer Legwraps
item:old-sorcerer-legwraps.description: Ragged waistcloth that extends to the thighs. Common amongst old-fashioned sorcerers.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 1 · Slash 3 · Pierce 1 · Magic 8 · Fire 6 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:olivinus-glintstone-crown.name: Olivinus Glintstone Crown
item:olivinus-glintstone-crown.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy. Increases intelligence to the detriment of HP. The lineage of the Olivinus Conspectus began with the sorcerer Lusat, and its adherents continue his study of meteors.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:olivinus-glintstone-crown.location:
**Location**: Academy of Raya Lucaria
- The Olivinus Glintstone Crown is found on a corpse behind an illusory wall near the  Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace.

item:omen-armor.name: Omen Armor
item:omen-armor.description: Malformed armor resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

stats.Negation: Physical 18 · Strike 15 · Slash 18 · Pierce 18 · Magic 13 · Fire 14 · Lightning 14 · Holy 13

item:omen-armor.location:
**Location**: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
- The Omen Armor is looted from Dung Eater following his death at the end of his questline.

item:omen-bairn.name: Omen Bairn

stats.Effect: Uses FP to unleash wraiths that chase down foes

item:omen-bairn.location:
**Location**: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
- The Omen Bairn is guaranteed drop from a specific, cleaver-wielding Omen in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath Leyndell.
- The Omen guards the base of a ladder that leads to the wooden, double-door shortcut to the  Underground Roadside Site of Grace.

item:omen-cleaver.name: Omen Cleaver
item:omen-cleaver.description: Heavy-bladed curved sword of colossal size awarded to Omen as a tool of war. This weapon is made to take advantage of brute strength.  The pattern etched upon the blade is the remnant of a deteriorating malediction. Indeed, when bestowing a weapon, preparations must be made for taking it away.
item:omen-cleaver.location: To get the standard Omen Cleaver, you need to farm the large Omen enemy wielding the curved greatsword in Stormveil Castle.

item:omen-gauntlets.name: Omen Gauntlets
item:omen-gauntlets.description: Malformed Gauntlets resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:omen-gauntlets.location: - The Omen Gauntlets are dropped by the Dung Eater in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.

item:omen-greaves.name: Omen Greaves
item:omen-greaves.description: Malformed greaves resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 8 · Slash 10 · Pierce 10 · Magic 7 · Fire 8 · Lightning 8 · Holy 7

item:omen-greaves.location: Received at the of Dung Eater's questline once you kill him.

item:omen-helm.name: Omen Helm
item:omen-helm.description: Malformed helm resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 5 · Lightning 5 · Holy 4

item:omen-helm.location:
**Location**: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
- The Omen Helm is looted from the Dung Eater at the end of his questline.

item:omenkiller-boots.name: Omenkiller Boots
item:omenkiller-boots.description: Long, stiff leather gloves worn by the Omenkillers.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 5 · Lightning 6 · Holy 5

item:omenkiller-boots.location: Received upon defeating an Omenkiller inside the Perfumer's Ruins located in Altus Plateau.

item:omenkiller-long-gloves.name: Omenkiller Long Gloves
item:omenkiller-long-gloves.description: Long,stiff leather gloves worn by the Omenkillers.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:omenkiller-long-gloves.location:
**Location**: Perfumer's Ruins
- The Omenkiller Long Gloves are obtained by defeating the Omenkiller in the Perfumer's Ruins on the Altus Plateau.

item:omenkiller-robe.name: Omenkiller Robe
item:omenkiller-robe.description: Robe worn by the Omenkillers, butchers of twisted conscience.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 8 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 8 · Fire 9 · Lightning 11 · Holy 10

item:omenkiller-robe.location: Received upon defeating an Omenkiller inside the Perfumer's Ruins located in Altus Plateau.

item:omenkiller-rollo.name: Omenkiller Rollo
item:omenkiller-rollo.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Omenkiller Rollo.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Omenkiller Rollo

item:omenkiller-rollo.location: Dropped by the Fell Twins who are encountered on the bridge leading to the Divine Tower of East Altus.

item:omensmirk-mask.name: Omensmirk Mask
item:omensmirk-mask.description: Mask with long, hideously twisted horns worn by the Omenkillers. Increases strength. Bears the smirking face of an elder, twisted in wicked delight. This visage is carved in the image of the evil spirits that haunt the Omen in their nightmares.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:omensmirk-mask.location: Dropped by an Omenkiller enemy right outside the Lower Capital Church grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:one-eyed-shield.name: One-eyed Shield
item:one-eyed-shield.description: Tricksome shield made from white stone depicting a malformed one-eyed god. The barrel of a firearm pokes through the open mouth. Once worshipped by the giants, this evil deity is believed to have been slain by Queen Marika.
item:one-eyed-shield.location: Dropped by Chief Guardian Arghanthy at the Guardians' Garrison in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:onyx-lord-s-greatsword.name: Onyx Lord's Greatsword
item:onyx-lord-s-greatsword.description: Greatsword forged from golden-hued meteoric ore.  The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic. A weapon unique to the Onyx Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:onyx-lord-s-greatsword.location: To get the Onyx Lord's Greatsword, head to the Sealed Tunnel in the Altus Plateau, navigate past hidden walls to the bottom of the cavern, and defeat the Onyx Lord boss.

item:opaline-bubbletear.name: Opaline Bubbletear
item:opaline-bubbletear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Significantly negates damage in mixed physick

item:opaline-bubbletear.location: Erdtree Avatar at the Weeping Peninsula's Minor Erdtree

item:opaline-hardtear.name: Opaline Hardtear
item:opaline-hardtear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily boosts all forms of damage negation.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts all damage negations in physick

item:opaline-hardtear.location: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow, north of Fort Faroth.

item:oracle-bubble.name: Oracle Bubble
item:oracle-bubble.description: Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient dynasty.
item:oracle-bubble.location: - Siofra River region: in the ruins near the Mistwood entrance (Siofra River Well) to the underground region. It's on top of the large, broken statue. To get to it, head to the next level up in the ruins, then carefully traverse the ruins' beams to get to the area above the statue, drop down on the Teardrop Scarab and kill it to get the drop.

stats.Effect: Launches several bubbles of magic.

item:oracle-bubbles.name: Oracle Bubbles
item:oracle-bubbles.description: Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient
item:oracle-bubbles.location: - Siofra River region: in the ruins near the Mistwood entrance (Siofra River Well) to the underground region. It's on top of the large, broken statue. To get to it, head to the next level up in the ruins, then carefully traverse the ruins' beams to get to the area above the statue, drop down on the Teardrop Scarab and kill it to get the drop.

stats.Effect: Launches several small magic bubbles.

item:oracle-envoy-ashes.name: Oracle Envoy Ashes
item:oracle-envoy-ashes.description: Ashen Remains in which spirits yet dwell.

stats.Effect: Summons four Oracle Envoy spirits

item:oracle-envoy-ashes.location: Found near the start of Miquella's Haligtree, guarded by several Oracle Envoys.

item:order-healing.name: Order Healing
item:order-healing.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
item:order-healing.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Nokron, Eternal City
- Drops from a Scarab found in the circular room in the southeastern quarter of Siofra Aqueduct, past the Crucible Tree Knight.

stats.Effect: Alleviates death blight buildup

item:order-s-blade.name: Order's Blade
item:order-s-blade.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Used by hunters of Those Who Live in Death. Enchants armament held in the right hand with holy-affinity attacks. This incantation is especially damaging to Those Who Live in Death. Any felled by this incantation cannot be revived. The role of the hunters is to stamp out defiled reason - all for the perfection of the Golden Order.
item:order-s-blade.location:
**Purchase**: Roundtable Hold
- Sold by D, Hunter of the Dead for 3,000 Runes after initiating his quest at the Roundtable Hold.

stats.Effect: Enchanted right-hand armament with holy damage

item:ordovis-s-greatsword.name: Ordovis's Greatsword
item:ordovis-s-greatsword.description: Greatsword of Ordovis, one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights. This sword is imbued with an ancient holy essence. Its red tint exemplifies the nature of primordial gold, said to be close in nature to life itself.

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Fai D

item:ordovis-s-greatsword.location: To get Ordovis's Greatsword, you must defeat the duo boss Crucible Knight and Crucible Knight Ordovis at the end of the Auriza Hero's Grave on the Altus Plateau.

item:ornamental-straight-sword.name: Ornamental Straight Sword
item:ornamental-straight-sword.description: Slender straight sword patterned after an antique ornament. Superior swordsmen prefer to wield one in each hand. After falling from grace, the dregs of the golden lineage sought power and purpose in the past.

item:page-ashes.name: Page Ashes
item:page-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a page.

stats.Effect: Summons page spirit

item:page-ashes.location: Cliffbottom Catacombs, the same floor with the lever that opens the boss room.

item:page-garb.name: Page Garb
item:page-garb.description: Garb worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:page-garb.location: Chance to drop from Page enemies.

item:page-garb-altered.name: Page Garb (altered)
item:page-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the Page Garb.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:page-garb-altered.location: Chance to drop unaltered from Page enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:page-hood.name: Page Hood
item:page-hood.description: Hood worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way. The unassuming sack-like appearance befits their unseen and unknown stature.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:page-hood.location: Chance to drop from Page enemies.

item:page-trousers.name: Page Trousers
item:page-trousers.description: Trousers worn by pages who serve nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:page-trousers.location: Chance to drop from Page enemies.

item:parry.name: Parry
item:parry.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Parry: Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance. This provides an opening to perform a critical hit."Usable on daggers, curved swords, thrusting swords, fists, claws, and small and medium shields.
item:parry.location:
**Purchase:** Stormhill / Volcano Manor
- x1 Can be purchased for 600 from Bernahl at either the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill or the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor.
- Should Bernahl be killed before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Bernahl's Bell Bearing.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:parrying-dagger.name: Parrying Dagger
item:parrying-dagger.description: A knife with curved handguards. Designed to parry, turning foes' attacks against them.  For master of combat who anticipate every enemy strike and counter accordingly, this weapon is all they need.
item:parrying-dagger.location: The Parrying Dagger can be purchased from the NPC Patches for 1,600 runes.

item:partisan.name: Partisan
item:partisan.description: Spear with a wide tip. In addition to its thrusting attacks, this highly versatile weapon can be swing to sweep through foes.
item:partisan.location: To get the Partisan spear in Elden Ring, you need to farm and defeat specific faction knights like the Godrick Knight at the Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave.

item:pata.name: Pata
item:pata.location: Found on a corpse behind the Church of Benediction, overlooking the place where you spawn as you enter the Realm of Shadow.

item:pauper-s-rune.name: Pauper's Rune
item:pauper-s-rune.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of The Lands Between; the lingering residue of gold. Use to gain a few runes. For all that they may be feeble things, these runes will act as nourishment for the development of any Tarnished. Provided a Finger Maiden can be found...

stats.Effect: Use to gain a few runes

item:pauper-s-rune.location: The Pauper's Rune is  cut content and cannot be acquired.

item:pearldrake-talisman.name: Pearldrake Talisman
item:pearldrake-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a pearlescent ancient dragon. Boosts non-physical damage negation.

stats.Effect: Boosts non-physical damage negation.

item:pearldrake-talisman.location: - Obtained from a corpse on the north end of the western isolated platform in Crumbling Farum Azula. This area is only accessible via the waygate at the first of The Four Belfrys in western Liurnia of the Lakes, next to a message that reads "Crumbling Lands". After traveling through the waygate, drop down several platforms to reach a pair of Bestmen and drop from the northern edge of this platform to find the corpse.

item:perfume-bottle.name: Perfume Bottle
item:perfume-bottle.description: Glass bottles used by perfumers. Used to seal various scent compounds.

stats.Effect: Container required for crafting perfume items

item:perfume-bottle.location:
A total of 10 Perfume Bottles can be found per playthrough.

**Found:**
- x1 in Street of Sages Ruins.
- x2 in Perfumer's Ruins, one of which is guarded by an Omenkiller.
- x1 on a corpse in a camp guarded by Omen northwest of the  Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace.

item:perfumer-gloves.name: Perfumer Gloves
item:perfumer-gloves.description: Gloves of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 2 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:perfumer-gloves.location: - The Perfumer Gloves have a 3.00% chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

item:perfumer-hood.name: Perfumer Hood
item:perfumer-hood.description: Hood of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:perfumer-hood.location: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

item:perfumer-robe.name: Perfumer Robe
item:perfumer-robe.description: Robe of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 5 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:perfumer-robe.location: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

item:perfumer-robe-altered.name: Perfumer Robe (altered)
item:perfumer-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Perfurmer's Robe.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 5 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:perfumer-robe-altered.location: Chance to drop unaltered from Perfumer enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:perfumer-s-cookbook-1.name: Perfumer's Cookbook [1]
item:perfumer-s-cookbook-1.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a military perfumer. Contains martial techniques beyond the repertoire of an ordinary physician.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:perfumer-s-cookbook-1.location: In a treasure chest at the Perfumer's Ruins in south-west Altus Plateau. Guarded by an Omenkiller that drops the Omenkiller set.

item:perfumer-s-cookbook-2.name: Perfumer's Cookbook [2]
item:perfumer-s-cookbook-2.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a depraved perfumer.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:perfumer-s-cookbook-2.location: Found on a corpse on the rooftops of the Shaded Castle. Head north from the **Shaded Castle Inner Gate** Site of Grace and climb up a ladder, then enter the dark room and take the ladder inside to a small rooftop with a body on a chair holding the item.

item:perfumer-s-cookbook-3.name: Perfumer's Cookbook [3]
item:perfumer-s-cookbook-3.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a depraved perfumer.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:perfumer-s-cookbook-3.location: Found on a corpse in the Auriza Side Tomb.

item:perfumer-s-cookbook-4.name: Perfumer's Cookbook [4]
item:perfumer-s-cookbook-4.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a depraved perfumer. Contains perilous techniques no ordinary physician would attempt.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:perfumer-s-shield.name: Perfumer's Shield
item:perfumer-s-shield.description: Golden shield used by the perfumers of Leyndell during military service. Made to be thin and light of weight, even those lacking strength can employ this immunity-boosting shield.
item:perfumer-s-shield.location: 2% chance to be dropped by shield-wielding Perfumers and Depraved Perfumers.

item:perfumer-s-talisman.name: Perfumer's Talisman
item:perfumer-s-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a set of perfume bottles. Raises potency of perfume items.

stats.Effect: Raises potency of perfume items

item:perfumer-s-talisman.location: - Obtained from a chest in the cellar of Perfumer's Ruins, in southwestern Mt. Gelmir.

item:perfumer-s-traveling-garb.name: Perfumer's Traveling Garb
item:perfumer-s-traveling-garb.description: Garb of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:perfumer-s-traveling-garb.location: - Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside the Street of Sages Ruins located north of Aeonia Swamp in Caelid.

item:perfumer-s-traveling-garb-altered.name: Perfumer's Traveling Garb (altered)
item:perfumer-s-traveling-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the Perfumer's Traveling Garb.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:perfumer-s-traveling-garb-altered.location: - Found unaltered on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside the Street of Sages Ruins located north of Aeonia Swamp in Caelid. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:perfumer-sarong.name: Perfumer Sarong
item:perfumer-sarong.description: Sarong of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 7 · Fire 6 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:perfumer-sarong.location: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

item:pest-s-glaive.name: Pest's Glaive
item:pest-s-glaive.description: Glaive made from a hard, sharpened shell. Wielded by the pests who emerged from the Swamp of Aeonia. Slightly increases non-physical damage negation. Though men might recognize the keen intellect of the pests evidenced by this spear's uncanny design, it will never be understood by them.
item:pest-s-glaive.location: To get the Pest's Glaive in Elden Ring, you must farm it from Lesser Kindred of Rot (Pest) enemies found in Caelid, the Grand Cloister, or Elphael.

item:pest-thread-spears.name: Pest Threads
item:pest-thread-spears.description: Incantation of the servants of rot.
item:pest-thread-spears.location: Church of the Bud, after crossing the sealed woods approach.

stats.Effect: Launches countless sticky threads before caster

item:phantom-slash.name: Phantom Slash
item:phantom-slash.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Phantom Slash: Skill inspired by the fond remembrances of the Night's Cavalry. Creates an apparition of the knights' former instructor who guides a joint lunging upward swing. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack."Usable on polearms and twinblades (great spears excepted).
item:phantom-slash.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Forbidden Lands
- Drops from a Night's Cavalry patrolling the Forbidden Lands at night.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:pickaxe.name: Pickaxe
item:pickaxe.description: Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners. Not originally designed as a weapon, but very adept at piercing armor. "Little wretches, do you think your armor harder than stone?"
item:pickaxe.location: To get the Pickaxe in Elden Ring, travel to the Limgrave Tunnels (located north of Agheel Lake).

item:pickled-turtle-neck.name: Pickled Turtle Neck
item:pickled-turtle-neck.description: Turtle neck meat, pickled in a bitter medicinal solution.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts Stamina recovery

item:pickled-turtle-neck.location:
- Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Northern Limgrave) (x3).
- Castle Morne, in the prison cell (note: a Skeletal Slime is hanging above this).

item:piercing-fang.name: Piercing Fang
item:piercing-fang.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Piercing Fang: Skill used by Yura, the Bloody Finger Hunter. Starting with the blade held horizontally, make a powerful thrust that cannot be blocked."Usable on medium and large armaments capable of thrusting.
item:piercing-fang.location:
'''Guaranteed Drop/Quest Item: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau
- Found pre-equipped on the Nagakiba, which can be looted off the body of Bloody Finger Hunter Yura, either at the end of his questline or by killing him before that.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:pike.name: Pike
item:pike.description: A longspear featuring an especially length handle. Specialized for use from long distances, it boasts the longest reach of any melee weapon. Incrdibly useful even against foes on horseback, but hard to wield in cramped spaces.
item:pike.location: The Pike in Elden Ring is found on a corpse inside the main barricaded courtyard of Stormveil Castle.

item:pillory-shield.name: Pillory Shield
item:pillory-shield.description: Pillory made to punish serious felons, used as a shield. Though made of good, sturdy wood, it is only a makeshift tool and performs as such. Perhaps due to its use as a device with which the guilty were made to endure prolonged suffering, it raises vitality.
item:pillory-shield.location: Looted from a corpse inside one of the locked cells within the Gaol Cave in Caelid.

item:placidusax-s-ruin.name: Placidusax's Ruin
item:placidusax-s-ruin.description: Power gleaned form the remembrance of Dragonlord Placidusax.
item:placidusax-s-ruin.location: Sold by Remembrance of the Dragonlord

stats.Effect: Spews golden breath of Dragonlord Placidusax

item:poison-armament.name: Poison Armament
item:poison-armament.description: Incantation of the servants of rot. Enchants armament held in the right hand with poison. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Those who dwell within poison know rot all too well. The death that begets life, that comes to all equally. That is to say: it is the cycle of rebirth put into practice.
item:poison-armament.location: **Drop**: Poison Armament is received upon defeating an invisible Scarab roaming around south of Sellia Crystal Tunnel, along the Swamp of Aeonia area in Caelid.

item:poison-grease.name: Poison Grease
item:poison-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of poison-green materials.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting poison

item:poison-mist.name: Poison Mist
item:poison-mist.description: Incantation of the servants of rot.
item:poison-mist.location: **Loot**: Poison Mist is obtained upon defeating a Teardrop Scarab in the eastern Weeping Peninsula forest area south of the Nomadic Merchant (east of the pillar where the Weeping Peninsula map is found).

stats.Effect: Releases poison mist before caster.

item:poison-moth-flight.name: Poison Moth Flight
item:poison-moth-flight.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Poison affinity and thefollowing skill:"Poison Moth Flight: Slash with a poison-infused blade. If thefollow-up strike lands on a poisoned foe, it will deal significantdamage."Usable on small and medium swords (twinblades excepted).
item:poison-moth-flight.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Caelid
- Drops from the Night's Cavalry patrolling the southern highway in Caelid at night, northeast of the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:poison-pot.name: Poison Pot
item:poison-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of poisonous materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to cause buildup of poison.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of poison.

item:poison-pot.location: Craftable — Toxic Mushroom x1, Poisonbloom x1

item:poison-spraymist.name: Poison Spraymist
item:poison-spraymist.description: Forbidden art of depraved perfumers. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to release a poison mist from user's mouth, causing a buildup of poison. Perfumed powder is held in the mouth to dissolve before being expelled. It was once a restorative art, or so it is said.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to release poison mist from the mouth.

item:poisonbloom.name: Poisonbloom
item:poisonbloom.description: Flower that grows in toxic terrain. Material used for crafting items. Poisonous, but may also provide the cure.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:poisonbloom.location:
- Poisonbloom can be harvested in swamps around the Lands Between. The flowers glow pink.
- Dropped by miranda blossoms and miranda sprouts

item:poisonbone-dart.name: Poisonbone Dart
item:poisonbone-dart.description: Animal bone sharpened into a knife for throwing, with a poison-laced tip. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to inflict damage and build up poison

item:poisoned-hand.name: Poisoned Hand
item:poisoned-hand.location: Found in the sewers of Belurat, Tower Settlement. The weapon is on the far right side of the poison pond guarded by a Horned Warrior.

item:poisoned-stone.name: Poisoned Stone
item:poisoned-stone.description: A small stone with a poisoned core.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of poison

item:poisoned-stone-clump.name: Poisoned Stone Clump
item:poisoned-stone-clump.description: A clump of small stones with poison cores.

stats.Effect: Throw together to cause buildup of poison

item:poisonous-mist.name: Poisonous Mist
item:poisonous-mist.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Poison affinity and the following skill:"Poisonous Mist: Bathe armament in poison, and then slash, spreading toxic mist forwards. The armament retains its poison for a while."Usable on melee armaments (whips, fists, and claws excepted).
item:poisonous-mist.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Swamp of Aeonia
- Dropped by a teleporting Scarab in Caelid, found on a small island southeast of the Aeonia Swamp Shore Site of Grace.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:poleblade-of-the-bud.name: Poleblade of the Bud

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Arc D

item:poleblade-of-the-bud.location: - The weapon can be obtained after trading Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.

item:prattling-pate-apologies.name: Prattling Pate "apologies"
item:prattling-pate-apologies.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a voice that says "Apologies."

stats.Effect: Emits a voice that says "Apologies"

item:prattling-pate-apologies.location:
**Loot:** Altus Plateau
- Acquired from a corpse in the Unsightly Catacombs, it can be found near the lever that opens the heavy gate to the boss room.

item:prattling-pate-hello.name: Prattling Pate "hello"
item:prattling-pate-hello.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head.

stats.Effect: Emits a voice that says "Hello"

item:prattling-pate-hello.location:
**Loot:** Limgrave
- Acquired from a corpse hidden behind the first Flame Pillar in the Stormfoot Catacombs.

item:prattling-pate-please-help.name: Prattling Pate "please Help"
item:prattling-pate-please-help.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a voice that says "Please help."

stats.Effect: Emits a voice that says "Please help"

item:prattling-pate-please-help.location:
**Location**: Impaler's Catacombs
Prattling Pate "Please help" is found within the first flooded room at the Impaler's Catacombs, guarded by Putrid Corpses.

item:prattling-pate-thank-you.name: Prattling Pate "thank You"
item:prattling-pate-thank-you.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head.

stats.Effect: Emits a voice that says "Thank you"

item:prattling-pate-thank-you.location:
**Loot:** Weeping Peninsula
- Acquired from a corpse in Tombsward Catacombs towards the end of the path on the first level, in the room to the left of the flame pillar.

item:prattling-pate-wonderful.name: Prattling Pate "wonderful"
item:prattling-pate-wonderful.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a voice that says "Wonderful."

stats.Effect: Emits a voice that says "Wonderful"

item:prattling-pate-wonderful.location:
**Location**: Cliffbottom Catacombs
After descending the elevator, drop to the lower level. Prattling Pate "Wonderful" is found near an Omen.

item:prattling-pate-you-re-beautiful.name: Prattling Pate "you're Beautiful"
item:prattling-pate-you-re-beautiful.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a demi-human head. Emits a voice that says "You're beautiful."

stats.Effect: Emits a voice that says "You're beautiful"

item:prattling-pate-you-re-beautiful.location:
**Location**: Hermit Village
- Prattling Pate "You're Beautiful" can be looted from the body of a Demi-Human on the stoop of one of the stone houses in the Hermit Village on Mt. Gelmir.

item:prayerbook-ancient-dragon.name: Ancient Dragon Prayerbook
item:prayerbook-ancient-dragon.description: Prayerbook of the capital's ancient dragon cult. A lost tome that never reached the Lands Between.

stats.Effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

item:prayerbook-assassins.name: Assassin's Prayerbook
item:prayerbook-assassins.description: Prayerbook of the Roundtable Hold's assassins.

stats.Effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

item:prayerbook-dragon-cult.name: Dragon Cult Prayerbook
item:prayerbook-dragon-cult.description: Prayerbook of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

stats.Effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

item:prayerbook-fire-monks.name: Fire Monks' Prayerbook
item:prayerbook-fire-monks.description: Prayerbook of the Fire Monks, who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants far to the north.

stats.Effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

item:prayerbook-two-fingers.name: Two Fingers Prayerbook
item:prayerbook-two-fingers.description: Prayerbook containing incantations of the Two Fingers. An item once entrusted to Tarnished worthy of lordship.

stats.Effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

item:prayerful-strike.name: Prayerful Strike
item:prayerful-strike.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Prayerful Strike: Raise armament aloft in prayer, then slam it into the ground. This inspired blow restores HP to the self and nearby allies if it successfully hits."Usable on axes and hammers.
item:prayerful-strike.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Capital Outskirts
- Drops from an invisible Scarab found in the moat, east of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:preceptor-s-big-hat.name: Preceptor's Big Hat
item:preceptor-s-big-hat.description: Large hat with the movements of the stars drawn on the inside of the brim. Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 5 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:preceptor-s-big-hat.location:
**Location**: Seluvis's Rise
- Found after finishing Ranni's questline inside Seluvis's Rise at Three Sisters, located in northwestern Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:preceptor-s-gloves.name: Preceptor's Gloves
item:preceptor-s-gloves.description: Trousers of the magic preceptors who serve the Carian royals. Black and perfectly discreet.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:preceptor-s-gloves.location: - The Preceptor's Gloves are found in Seluvis's Rise after completing Ranni the Witch's questline.

item:preceptor-s-long-gown.name: Preceptor's Long Gown
item:preceptor-s-long-gown.description: A long, bright blue gown with the movements of the stars drawn upon it. Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals. Glintstone sorcerers are the descendants of astrologers, a fact that the Carians remain aware of. Even if their fate has been long severed from the stars.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 14 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:preceptor-s-long-gown.location: Found after finishing Ranni's questline inside Seluvis's Rise located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:preceptor-s-long-gown-altered.name: Preceptor's Long Gown (altered)
item:preceptor-s-long-gown-altered.description: Lighter version of the Preceptor's Long Gown.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 2 · Pierce 4 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 11 · Holy 12

item:preceptor-s-long-gown-altered.location: Found after finishing Seluvis' questline (unaltered) inside Seluvis's Rise located in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:preceptor-s-trousers.name: Preceptor's Trousers
item:preceptor-s-trousers.description: Trousers of the magic preceptors who serve the Carian royals. Black and perfectly discreet.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 8 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:preceptor-s-trousers.location: Located inside Seluvis's Rise at Three Sisters after completing Ranni's questline.

item:prelate-s-charge.name: Prelate's Charge
item:prelate-s-charge.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Flame affinity and the following skill:"Prelate's Charge: Slam armament into the ground to create a surge of flames, then charge in. Hold to continue the charge."Usable on large and colossal axes and hammers.
item:prelate-s-charge.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Mountaintops of the Giants
- Drops from a Scarab hanging on a large, thorned stake found near a cliff south of the Guardians' Garrison. Can alternatively be approached from the Giants' Gravepost Site of Grace found south of the nearby chain-bridge.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:prelate-s-inferno-crozier.name: Prelate's Inferno Crozier
item:prelate-s-inferno-crozier.description: Colossal hammer with the appearance of roiling flames. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. Its heft represents the weight of their guardianship.  The hammer's head is unusually substantial, and strong attacks' will fling foes into the air.
item:prelate-s-inferno-crozier.location: To get the Prelate's Inferno Crozier in Elden Ring, you need to defeat the Fire Prelate wielding it inside Fort Laiedd in Mt. Gelmir.

item:preserving-boluses.name: Preserving Boluses
item:preserving-boluses.description: Scarlet boluses made of cave moss. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Alleviates scarlet rot buildup and cures rot

item:preserving-boluses.location:
- Craftable
- Nomadic Merchant near the Caelid Highway North Site of Grace (x???)

item:primal-glintstone-blade.name: Primal Glintstone Blade
item:primal-glintstone-blade.description: An old glintstone blade that has been stained with blood.

stats.Effect: Spells consume less FP, but maximum HP is reduced

item:primal-glintstone-blade.location: - Obtained from a chest in the cellar of Stargazer's Ruins in central Mountaintops of the Giants. The cellar is locked by a seal, which can be dispelled by summoning the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes near the NPC jellyfish that speaks, near the center of the ruins. Note that the NPC jellyfish does respawn, if killed.

item:prince-of-death-s-cyst.name: Prince Of Death's Cyst
item:prince-of-death-s-cyst.description: A fetid, overgrown cyst taken from facial flesh. Greatly raises vitality. (Vitality governs resistance to the effects of Death.)

stats.Effect: Greatly raises vitality

item:prince-of-death-s-cyst.location:
**Location**: Deeproot Depths
- The Prince of Death's Cyst is obtained upon defeating the Runebear miniboss at the Deeproot Depths. It is in a cave hidden behind a waterfall, found northeast of the  Deeproot Depths site of grace.

item:prince-of-death-s-pustule.name: Prince Of Death's Pustule
item:prince-of-death-s-pustule.description: A fetid pustule taken from facial flesh. Raises vitality. (Vitality governs resistance to the effects of Death.)

stats.Effect: Raises Vitality

item:prince-of-death-s-pustule.location: - Obtained from a corpse next to the giant root-like face underneath Stormveil Castle.

item:prince-of-death-s-staff.name: Prince of Death's Staff

stats.Scaling: Str E · Int D · Fai D

item:prince-of-death-s-staff.location: The Prince of Death's Staff is located in the Deeproot Depths area.

item:prince-of-death-s-star.name: Prince Of Death's Star
item:prince-of-death-s-star.description: Staff embedded with sullied amber, said to be a very part of the Prince of Death. Enhances death sorceries. One of the staves deemed heretical by the academy for its ability to allow sorceries to be augmented through faith in addition to intelligence.

item:prisoner-clothing.name: Prisoner Clothing
item:prisoner-clothing.description: Tattered clothing. Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. Never once washed, every fiber is filthy.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 11 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 12

item:prisoner-clothing.location:
Starting gear for the Prisoner class.

Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River).

item:prisoner-iron-mask.name: Prisoner Iron Mask
item:prisoner-iron-mask.description: Iron mask forced on a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. Thick, heavy, and utterly stifling. A foul creation designed to torment the wearer, either slowly fermenting hatred within their heart, or a spiritual fervor that is near indistinguishable from it.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:prisoner-iron-mask.location:
- Starting equipment for the Prisoner class.
- Purchased from the Hermit Merchant in Uhl Palace Ruins for  1,000 runes.

item:prisoner-trousers.name: Prisoner Trousers
item:prisoner-trousers.description: Tattered trousers. Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. Never once washed, every fiber is filthy. The smell is beyond belief.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 7

item:prisoner-trousers.location:
Starting gear for the Prisoner class.

Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River).

item:prophet-blindfold.name: Prophet Blindfold
item:prophet-blindfold.description: Blindfold of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune — and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. Why hesitate, if the path leading to the future is clear? Just close your eyes, and walk.

stats.Negation: Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:prophet-blindfold.location:
- Starting equipment for the Prophet class.
- Purchased from the Hermit Merchant at the Hermit Merchant's Shack for  1,000 runes.

item:prophet-robe.name: Prophet Robe
item:prophet-robe.description: Robe of exiled prophets who foresaw that their faith would end in flames — and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. Its fabric scrapes against their skin like a file, and the rickety cart wheel around the neck warns passers-by not to lend an ear to their meandering sermons.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 6 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:prophet-robe.location:
Starting gear for the Prophet class.

Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts).

item:prophet-robe-altered.name: Prophet Robe (altered)
item:prophet-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Prophet Robe.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 6 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:prophet-robe-altered.location:
Starting gear for the Prophet class (unaltered).

Purchased unaltered from Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts).

Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

item:prophet-trousers.name: Prophet Trousers
item:prophet-trousers.description: Trousers of the exiled prophets who foresaw that their faith would end in flames — and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. Its fabric scrapes against their skin like a file, and the rickety cart wheel around the neck warns passers-by not to lend an ear to their meandering sermons.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:prophet-trousers.location:
Starting gear for the Prophet class.
Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts).

item:protection-of-the-erdtree.name: Protection Of The Erdtree
item:protection-of-the-erdtree.description: A superior incantation of Erdtree Worship. Increase damage negation for all affinities except physical, for both the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation. In the beginning, everything was in opposition to the Erdtree. But through countless victories in war, it became the embodiment of Order.
item:protection-of-the-erdtree.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Altus Plateau
- Protection of the Erdtree is obtained upon defeating a Teardrop Scarab located on a square platform upon a hill southeast of the Road of Iniquity Side Path Site of Grace.

stats.Effect: Increases affinity damage negation for self & allies

item:pulley-crossbow.name: Pulley Bow
item:pulley-crossbow.description: Longbow which utilizes a series of pulleys and strings. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order Fundamentalism.  Enhances precision while shooting, enabling arrows to fly much further distances.
item:pulley-crossbow.location: The Pulley Bow is located on a corpse at the top of a siege tower in Mt. Gelmir, in the Altus Plateau region.

item:pumpkin-helm.name: Pumpkin Helm
item:pumpkin-helm.description: An oval helmet large enough to cover any head. Very heavy and very hard. Reduces damage from headshots and impacts. The inside of the helm is pitch black, keeping the crazed warrior within from panicking. Perhaps its rather roomy interior also helps alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 5 · Holy 4

item:pumpkin-helm.location: Chance to drop from Mad Pumpkin Head enemies.

item:purifying-crystal-tear.name: Purifying Crystal Tear
item:purifying-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the age where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wonderous Physick. The resulting conction purifies the curse from Mohg, Lord of Blood's terrifying rite of blood.

stats.Effect: Purifies the Lord of Blood's curse in a mixed physick

item:purifying-crystal-tear.location: Defeat Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger when advancing Yura's questline.

item:putrescence-cleaver.name: Putrescence Cleaver

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Arc D

item:putrescence-cleaver.location: Can be obtained after trading the Remembrance of Putrescence with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.

item:putrid-corpse-ashes.name: Putrid Corpse Ashes
item:putrid-corpse-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of four putrid corpses.

stats.Effect: Summons four putrid corpse spirits

item:putrid-corpse-ashes.location: Dropped by the Frenzied Duelist at the end of Gaol Cave.

item:queelign-s-greatsword.name: Queelign's Greatsword

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:queelign-s-greatsword.location: This weapon can be obtained in the Shadow Keep after giving Fire Knight Queelign the Iris of Occultation.

item:queen-s-bracelets.name: Queen's Bracelets
item:queen-s-bracelets.description: Bracelets indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:queen-s-bracelets.location: - The Queen's Bracelets can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for  7,000 runes after defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

item:queen-s-crescent-crown.name: Queen's Crescent Crown
item:queen-s-crescent-crown.description: A tall crown depicting the moon. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. Increases intelligence. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:queen-s-crescent-crown.location: - Purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for  7,000 runes after defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

item:queen-s-leggings.name: Queen's Leggings
item:queen-s-leggings.description: Leggings indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Magic 7 · Fire 6 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:queen-s-leggings.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

item:queen-s-robe.name: Queen's Robe
item:queen-s-robe.description: Robe indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:queen-s-robe.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

item:quickstep.name: Quickstep
item:quickstep.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Quickstep: Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:quickstep.location:
**Purchase:** Stormhill / Volcano Manor
- 1x Sold for 800 Runes from Bernahl at either the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill or the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor.
- Should Bernahl be killed before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Bernahl's Bell Bearing.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:rabbath-s-cannon.name: Rabbath's Cannon
item:rabbath-s-cannon.location: Found in a chest atop Rabbath's Rise northeast of the Cathedral of Manus Metyr in eastern Scadu Altus. To reach it, unseal the Spiritspring by breaking the sealing stones hidden behind the illusory wall on the rise's lower balcony.

item:radagon-icon.name: Radagon Icon
item:radagon-icon.description: A legendary talisman depicting the Elden Lord Radagon. Shortens the casting time of sorceries and incantations.

stats.Effect: Shortens spell casting time

item:radagon-icon.location: Debate Parlor side path, argument hall upstairs chest.

item:radagon-s-rings-of-light.name: Radagon's Rings Of Light
item:radagon-s-rings-of-light.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
item:radagon-s-rings-of-light.location: **Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants - Sold for 7,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Golden Order Principia. - Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Creates golden ring of light to attack wide area

item:radagon-s-scarseal.name: Radagon's Scarseal
item:radagon-s-scarseal.description: An eye engraved with an Elden Rune. Said to be the seal of King Consort Radagon.

stats.Effect: Raises attributes, but also increases damage taken.

item:radagon-s-scarseal.location:
- Weeping Peninsula (Fourth Church of Marika)
**Drop**: Ancient Hero of Zamor in the Weeping Evergaol.

item:radagon-s-soreseal.name: Radagon's Soreseal
item:radagon-s-soreseal.description: This legendary talisman is an eye engraved with an Elden Rune, said to be the seal of King Consort Radagon.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises attributes, but also increases damage taken

item:radiant-baldachin-s-blessing.description: Protection of a hidden temple in the guise of a bedchamber. This blessing is of the utmost rarity. Uses FP to temporarily raise poise. The effect lasts longer than a mere favor. It's said a deathbed companion will only produce a blessing of this kind for a champion but once in her entire life. The sole blessing which she imbues of her own volition.

item:radiant-gold-mask.description: A mask designed to resemble a blazing golden halo. Created and left behind by Lord Goldmask, a staunch pursuer of Golden Order fundamentalism. Strenthens Golden Order incantations. Its striking design represents both the brilliant inspiration that once shone upon him, and the vision of a ring that he will surely find at the end of his pursuit. "To you who seek to shine as I do, wear it well!"

item:rain-of-arrows.location:
Painting Treasure: Caelid
- Acquire the "Redmane" Painting in Sellia, Town of Sorcery and then go to the painting's depicted location on the edge of the Ancient Ruins bellow the cliffs south of Dragonbarrow's Minor Erdtree.

item:rain-of-fire.name: Rain of Fire
item:rain-of-fire.location:
**Drop:** Shadow Keep
- Dropped by a Fire Knight in Shadow Keep that uses this spell, together with Salza's Hood. He's found at the end of the bridge just west of the West Rampart Site of Grace in the westernmost part of the Keep, and will try to target the player for large sections of the bridge unless line-of-sight is broken or Torrent is used to outrun the fire rain.

item:rainbow-stone.name: Rainbow Stone
item:rainbow-stone.description: Ruin Fragment that has undergone some simple processing.

stats.Effect: Shines with colored light when placed, serving as a guide

item:rakshasa-s-great-katana.name: Rakshasa's Great Katana
item:rakshasa-s-great-katana.location: Gained by defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

item:rancor-pot.name: Rancor Pot
item:rancor-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Enchanted by the ancient death hex. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to spawn vengeful spirits that chase down foes. In times of old, the dead were burned with ghostflame, and from those cinders arose vengeful spirits.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Throw to summon vengeful spirits.

item:rancorcall.name: Rancorcall
item:rancorcall.description: Sorcery of the servants of Death.
item:rancorcall.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Stormveil Castle

stats.Effect: Summons vengeful spirits that chase down foes

item:ranni-s-dark-moon.name: Ranni's Dark Moon
item:ranni-s-dark-moon.description: Legendary sorcery associated with the Carian queen.
item:ranni-s-dark-moon.location: Chelona's Rise, in the south-west of the Moonfolk Ruins. You'll have to solve the puzzle with the three spirit turtles. One is right next to the Rise, the other at the cliff south-east of the Lunar Estate Ruins on a ledge and the third is flying above the evergaol portal in the north-west. You'll have to start at Chelona's Rise and travel to each location by foot/horse, otherwise the turtles don't spawn.

stats.Effect: Incarnate a cold, dark moon and launch it at foes.

item:rapier.name: Rapier
item:rapier.description: A piercing sword with a sharp, slender blade. In addition to this weapon's thrusting attack prowess, it also boasts the ability to be used while guarding with a shield.  As one of the smaller piercing swords, quick successive thrust area easy to perform, but without a cutting edge, it cannot be used for slashing attacks.
item:rapier.location: To get the standard Rapier in Elden Ring, you can simply purchase it for 1,000 Runes from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

item:raptor-of-the-mists.name: Raptor Of The Mists
item:raptor-of-the-mists.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Raptor of the Mists: Duck into a low stance, momentarily vanishing. If an enemy attack connects, avian wings will allow for a quick escape into the air."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:raptor-of-the-mists.location:
**Quest Item:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Automatically acquired after successfully assisting Yura in defeating Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin near the Main Academy Gate Site of Grace. Can be accessed by touching a red Summoning Sign near the edge of the broken bridge north of the grace. The sign will only appear after the player has talked to Yura after defeating Bloody Finger Nerijus.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:raptor-s-black-feathers.name: Raptor's Black Feathers
item:raptor-s-black-feathers.description: Robe crafted with the black feathers of a bird of prey. Worn by the assassin Ravenmount.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 8 · Slash 9 · Pierce 9 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 10 · Holy 9

item:raptor-s-black-feathers.location:

item:raptor-talons.name: Raptor Talons
item:raptor-talons.description: Claw comprised of two sharp, thin blades, wielded by the assassins of Ravenmount, this weapon allows them to imitate the attacks of Deathbirds. Besides excelling at airborne attacks, its charge attack mimics the vicious swoop of a bird of prey.
item:raptor-talons.location: To get the Raptor Talons in Elden Ring, travel to Sage's Cave in the Altus Plateau.

item:raw-meat-dumpling.name: Raw Meat Dumpling
item:raw-meat-dumpling.description: A pungent raw meatball, made succulent by virtue of being on the verge of turning.

item:red-branch-shortbow.description: Shortbow of polished red wood. Fashioned by a master craftsman and wielded by pages.  A bow which requires dexterity rather than strength to master.
item:red-branch-shortbow.location: To get the Red Branch Shortbow in Elden Ring, you need to farm and defeat Page enemies (the hooded human enemies) until it drops, with reliable spots at Tombsward Ruins in the Weeping Peninsula, Caria Manor in Liurnia, or the East Capital Rampart in Leyndell.

item:red-crest-heater-shield.name: Red Crest Heater Shield
item:red-crest-heater-shield.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest symbolizes red wings.
item:red-crest-heater-shield.location: Purchased for  2500 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant near the  Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace on Altus Plateau.

item:red-feathered-branchsword.name: Red-feathered Branchsword

item:red-feathered-branchsword.location:
**Location**: Liurnia of the Lakes
- Defeat the Deathbird that spawns at night near a fallen ruin northeast of the  Scenic Isle site of grace, located in central Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:red-thorn-roundshield.name: Red Thorn Roundshield
item:red-thorn-roundshield.description: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to use, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. Its emblem is an ancient red thorn design. Though it isn't much, it boosts fire damage negation.
item:red-thorn-roundshield.location:
- Starting gear for the Samurai class.
- Can be bought from the Nomadic Merchant (Castle Morne Rampart) for 600 Runes.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Arc D

item:remembrance-rot-goddess.description: Remembrance of Malenia, Goddess of Rot, hewn into the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-starscourge.name: Remembrance Of The Starscourge
item:remembrance-starscourge.description: Remembrance of Starscourge Radahn, hewn into the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:rennala-s-full-moon.name: Rennala's Full Moon
item:rennala-s-full-moon.description: Sorcery associated with the Carian queen. Uses the caster as a vessel to incarnate a full moon, then sends it floating toward foes. The full moon dispels all sorcery that touches it, and temporarily reduces magic damage negation for those it strikes. Queen Rennala encountered this enchanting moon when she was young, and later, it would bewitch the academy.
item:rennala-s-full-moon.location:
Trade the Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen, gained by defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, with Finger Reader Enia.

Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

stats.Effect: Incarnate a full moon and launch it at foes

item:repeating-crossbow.name: Repeating Crossbow
item:repeating-crossbow.location: Found on a body next to the Ghostflame Dragon in Scadu Altus.

item:repeating-thrust.name: Repeating Thrust
item:repeating-thrust.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following Skill:Repeating Thrust Twist to build power, then unleash a flurry of thrusts.This Skill takes some time to build up, but it is very powerful.It can be used on all thrusting armaments.
item:repeating-thrust.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Limgrave
- Drops from a the Night's Cavalry patrolling the bridge north of Agheel Lake during the night. Southeast of Gatefront Ruins and east of Limgrave Tunnels.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:rickety-shield.name: Rickety Shield
item:rickety-shield.description: A creaky old wooden shield, circular in shape. Roughly reinforced with vines or some such. There are countless other shields available of better make. This piece of scrap isn't worth the effort of equipping.
item:rickety-shield.location:
- Starting gear for the Prophet class.
- 2% chance to be dropped by various shield-wielding Demi-Humans.

item:rift-shield.name: Rift Shield
item:rift-shield.description: Small metal roundshiled depicting a sinister rift. An antiquated charm that glares back at an enemy, it boosts focus.
item:rift-shield.location:
- Starting gear for the Prisoner class.
- Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant near Bellum Church in Liurnia of the Lakes for  1800 Runes.

item:rimed-crystal-bud.name: Rimed Crystal Bud
item:rimed-crystal-bud.description: A young plant, frozen into a crystal before it could mature. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:rimed-crystal-bud.location:
- Rimed Crystal Buds are found widely across cold regions such as the Mountaintops of the Giants and Consecrated Snowfield.
- They are also found as loot around Caria Manor.

item:rimed-rowa.name: Rimed Rowa
item:rimed-rowa.description: A berry-like fruit, thought to be the original strain of Rowa. Material used for crafting items. Found in frigid highlands.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:rimed-rowa.location:
- Found throughout the Mountaintops of the Giants.
- Can be found in high-altitude bushes or as random drops near the coldest regions of the highlands.

item:ringed-finger.name: Ringed Finger
item:ringed-finger.description: Bludgeon made of an enormous finger sheathed in several heavy rings. Thought to have been cut from an ancestor of the Fingercreeper. Some life yet remains in this legacy of an ancient act of blasphemy, as evidenced by the barely perceptible warmth it still exudes.
item:ringed-finger.location: The Ringed Finger is a quirky, club-like weapon found inside Gelmir Hero's Grave in Mt. Gelmir.

item:rings-of-spectral-light.name: Rings of Spectral Light
item:rings-of-spectral-light.location: Found in Charo's Hidden Grave on top of the arch leading from the Site of Grace to the Death Rite Bird. Go east from the Site of Grace to find the path up. The sorcery lies on an altar surrounded by Gravebirds.

item:ripple-blade.name: Ripple Blade
item:ripple-blade.description: Unique weapon wielded by young Albinaurics, this sword is modelled after the ripples that are thought to be the origin of their species. Its attack power is greatly enhanced with one's arcane attribute.
item:ripple-blade.location: The Ripple Blade in Elden Ring can be purchased for 3,500 runes from Pidia, Carian Servant at Caria Manor in northern Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:ripple-crescent-halberd.name: Ripple Crescent Halberd
item:ripple-crescent-halberd.description: Weapon wielded by young Albinaurics. The blade is said to resemble a partial image of a ripple, and its attack power scales with one's arcane attribute.
item:ripple-crescent-halberd.location: To get the Ripple Crescent Halberd in Elden Ring, you must farm second-generation Albinaurics who wield the weapon in Liurnia of the Lakes, specifically around the Academy Gate Town or the Fallen Ruins of the Lake.

item:ritual-pot.name: Ritual Pot
item:ritual-pot.description: This empty pot somehow mends itself when broken. Special item with greater durability than a cracked pot.

stats.Effect: Container required for crafting ritual pot items

item:ritual-pot.location: A total of **10** Ritual Pots can be obtained per character. **Purchased** - x1 from Pidia, Carian Servant in Caria Manor ( 1,500 runes). - x1 from the Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow) in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow ( 3,000 runes). **Looted** - x1 in Laskyar Ruins (Liurnia of the Lakes), against the wall behind the northern arches. - x1 in Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes), in a chest guarded by three Glintstone Sorcerers and one Living Jar Warrior. - x2 in Jarburg (Liurnia of the Lakes): - One on an overhang near the third house on the left.

item:ritual-shield-talisman.name: Ritual Shield Talisman
item:ritual-shield-talisman.description: A talisman patterned after shields used in ritual combat held to honor the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Raises defense when HP is at maximum.

item:ritual-sword-talisman.name: Ritual Sword Talisman
item:ritual-sword-talisman.description: A talisman patterned after swords used in ritual combat held to honor the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Raises attack power when HP is at maximum.

item:ritual-sword-talisman.location: Altus, Lux Ruins chest after the demi-human queen.

item:rivers-of-blood.name: Rivers Of Blood
item:rivers-of-blood.description: Weapon of Okina, swordsman from the Land of Reeds. A cursed weapon that has felled countless men.  When Mohg, the Lord of Blood, first felt Okina's sword, and madness, upon his flesh, he had a proposal, to offer Okina the life of a demon, whose thirst would never go unsated.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Arc D

item:riveted-wooden-shield.name: Riveted Wooden Shield
item:riveted-wooden-shield.description: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield. The design riveted to the center represents both sword and tree.
item:riveted-wooden-shield.location:
- Starting gear for the Warrior class.
- Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in east Limgrave for 600 Runes.

item:roar-of-rugalea.name: Roar of Rugalea
item:roar-of-rugalea.location:
**Guaranteed drop**: Rugalea the Great Red Bear
- Roar of Rugalea is received upon defeating Rugalea in the woods in the northern part of the Rauh Base, northwest of the Ravine North Site of Grace.

item:rock-blaster.name: Rock Blaster
item:rock-blaster.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
item:rock-blaster.location:
**Loot:** Caelid
- Acquired from a corpse in a shed at the upper levels of Sellia Crystal Tunnel.

stats.Effect: Thurst staff into ground to emit a massive shockwave

item:rock-sling.name: Rock Sling
item:rock-sling.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.
item:rock-sling.location:
**Loot:** Swamp of Aeonia
- Acquired from a treasure chest found in the cellar of Street of Sages Ruins.

stats.Effect: Summons rocks from the earth and sends its flying

item:rogier-s-rapier.name: Rogier's Rapier
item:rogier-s-rapier.description: Piercing sword of superior quality, featuring intricate ornamentation. Signature weapon of the sorcerer Rogier. High dexterity is required to wield the blade to its full potential, but mastery is a sight to behold, characterized by a flowing style which excels in successive attacks.
item:rogier-s-rapier.location: To get Rogier's Rapier, first speak to Sorcerer Rogier in the chapel at Stormveil Castle.

item:roiling-magma.name: Roiling Magma
item:roiling-magma.description: One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir. Fires a lump of condensed magma that explodes a short delay after hitting the target. Charging enhances potency and further delays the explosion. After discovering the ancient hexes of Gelmir, Rykard, son of Queen Rennala, brought them back into practical use as new forms of sorcery.
item:roiling-magma.location:
**Loot:** Mt. Gelmir
- Acquired from a corpse located in the Hermit's Shack found of the southern side of Mt. Gelmir.

stats.Effect: Fires lump of magma that explodes after delay

item:rold-medallion.name: Rold Medallion
item:rold-medallion.description: Conjoined split medallion depicting the Flame Peak. Brandishing the medallion activates the Grand Lift of Rold, connecting Leyndell to the Mountaintops of the Giants. The forge of the flame of ruin is said to be found upon their peaks, and it is here Melina wishes to travel in resuming your journey together.

stats.Effect: Operates Grand Lift of Rold

item:rold-medallion.location: Opens the Grand Lift of Rold to the Mountaintops.

item:ronin-s-armor.name: Ronin's Armor
item:ronin-s-armor.description: Armor of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn.

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 10 · Slash 11 · Pierce 10 · Magic 11 · Fire 12 · Lightning 13 · Holy 11

item:ronin-s-armor.location: Dropped by Shabriri on death, or left in his place if the Tarnished meets the Three Fingers and inherits the Frenzied Flame. Will not be dropped by Yura if he is killed before Shabriri possesses him.

item:ronin-s-armor-altered.name: Ronin's Armor (altered)
item:ronin-s-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Ronin's Armor. The armor is not as sturdy as the original, but it still provides a decent amount of protection.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 8 · Slash 9 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 11 · Holy 10

item:ronin-s-armor-altered.location: Dropped by Yura (unaltered) only once he his possessed by Shabriri during his questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:ronin-s-gauntlets.name: Ronin's Gauntlets
item:ronin-s-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 2

item:ronin-s-gauntlets.location:
**Location**: Mountaintops of the Giants
- The Ronin's Gauntlets are dropped by Shabriri near the  Zamor Ruins Site of Grace if the player kills him or meets the Three Fingers.

item:ronin-s-greaves.name: Ronin's Greaves
item:ronin-s-greaves.description: Greaves of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 6 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 6

item:ronin-s-greaves.location: Dropped by Shabriri during his questline.

item:root-resin.name: Root Resin
item:root-resin.description: Resin secreted from the roots of the Great tree. Material used in crafting items. The roots of the Great tree drive far and wide through the earth of the Lands Between. They were once entwined with the roots of the Erdtree, or so they say.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:root-resin.location:
- Can easily be farmed from the Warmaster's Shack site of grace; there are three Root Resin spawns beneath a tree directly next to the grace.
- Can be purchased in unlimited quantity from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them the Greasemonger's Bell Bearing.

item:roped-fetid-pot.name: Roped Fetid Pot
item:roped-fetid-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of effluents is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Throw at rearward enemies to cause buildup of deadly poison. Beware though; those who carry these pots will slowly accumulate poison in their own bodies. Push someone in a privy; expect to get dung on your hands.

stats.Effect: Throw behind to cause buildup of deadly poison

item:roped-fetid-pot.location: Craftable — Mushroom x1, Gold-Tinged Excrement x1, String x1

item:roped-fire-pot.name: Roped Fire Pot
item:roped-fire-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot.

stats.Effect: Throw behind to inflict fire damage.

item:roped-fire-pot.location: Craftable — Mushroom x1, Smoldering Butterfly x1, String x1

item:roped-holy-water-pot.name: Roped Holy Water Pot
item:roped-holy-water-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Enchanted by incantations of the Golden Order, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Throw behind to inflict holy damage

item:roped-holy-water-pot.location: - Can be crafted after purchasing the Missionary's Cookbook [1] from Merchant Kalé for 1000 runes at the Church of Elleh.

item:roped-oil-pot.name: Roped Oil Pot
item:roped-oil-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of oil-infused materials is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Throw at rearward enemies to soak them in oil, making them heavily susceptible to fire damage.

stats.Effect: Throw behind to douse enemies in oil

item:roped-oil-pot.location: Craftable — Melted Mushroom x1, String x1

item:roped-poison-pot.name: Roped Poison Pot
item:roped-poison-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of poisonous materials is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Throw at rearward enemies to cause buildup of poison.

stats.Effect: Throw behind to cause buildup of poison

item:roped-poison-pot.location: Craftable — Toxic Mushroom x1, Poisonbloom x1, String x1

item:rosus-axe.name: Rosus' Axe
item:rosus-axe.description: Usher of Death, Rosus, who shows the path to the catacombs throughout the Lands Between, is depicted on this ritual axe. The dead easily lose their way, and have always been in sore need i of a guiding hand.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:rosus-axe.location: To get Rosus' Axe, travel to the Black Knife Catacombs in northeast Liurnia of the Lakes, use a Stonesword Key on the imp statue fog door near the entrance, and loot the weapon inside the room.

item:rot-grease.name: Rot Grease
item:rot-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of rotten materials.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting scarlet rot

item:rot-pot.name: Rot Pot
item:rot-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Decorated with the crest of scarlet wings. Throw at enemies to cause buildup of scarlet rot.  The rot bubbles up from the Swamp of Aeonia, and eats away at life like a vicious plague.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of scarlet rot.

item:rotted-wing.name: Unalloyed Gold Needle
item:rotted-wing.description: An intricately crafted needle of unalloyed gold, snapped in half.

stats.Effect: Snapped intricate needle of unalloyed gold

related: Meet Gowry at his shack in Sellia

item:rotten-battle-hammer.name: Rotten Battle Hammer
item:rotten-battle-hammer.description: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike. Skill: Braggart's Roar Declare your presence with a boastful roar. Raises attack power, defense, and stamina recovery speed.
item:rotten-battle-hammer.location: To get the Rotten Battle Hammer in Elden Ring, you must travel to the Concerated Snowfield and defeat the Rotten Duelist boss.

item:rotten-breath.name: Rotten Breath
item:rotten-breath.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
item:rotten-breath.location: Bought at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion with a dragon heart.

stats.Effect: Channels dragon to spew scarlet rot breath

item:rotten-butterflies.name: Rotten Butterflies
item:rotten-butterflies.location:
Trade the Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud, gained by defeating Romina, Saint of the Bud, with Finger Reader Enia.
