Alternatively, use one of the Remembrance Duplication Coffins to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

item:rotten-crystal-spear.name: Rotten Crystal Spear
item:rotten-crystal-spear.description: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. Though festering with scarlet rot, its magic remains potent.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int E

item:rotten-crystal-spear.location: The Rotten Crystal Spear is obtained as a random drop from lesser Crystalian enemies in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, specifically near the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace.

item:rotten-crystal-staff.name: Rotten Crystal Staff
item:rotten-crystal-staff.description: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot. Enhances Crystalian sorceries.
item:rotten-crystal-staff.location: To get the Rotten Crystal Staff, you must farm the Lesser Crystalian mage located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

item:rotten-crystal-sword.name: Rotten Crystal Sword
item:rotten-crystal-sword.description: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:rotten-crystal-sword.location: To get the Rotten Crystal Sword in Elden Ring, travel to Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, locate the chest guarded by three Crystalian enemies near the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace, and loot it.

item:rotten-duelist-greaves.name: Rotten Duelist Greaves
item:rotten-duelist-greaves.description: Greaves wrapped with bronze snakes, eaten through by scarlet rot. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:rotten-duelist-greaves.location: Dropped by the Rotten Duelist enemy located north west of Ordina, Liturgical Town in Consecrated Snowfield.

item:rotten-duelist-helm.name: Rotten Duelist Helm
item:rotten-duelist-helm.description: Bronze helm decorated with innumerable snakes, eaten through by scarlet rot. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:rotten-duelist-helm.location: Dropped by the Rotten Duelist enemy located north west of the Consecrated Snowfield site of grace.

item:rotten-gravekeeper-cloak.name: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak
item:rotten-gravekeeper-cloak.description: Thick, bristly cloak eaten through by scarlet rot. The symbol of an underground gravekeeper's station.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 8 · Fire 8 · Lightning 10 · Holy 8

item:rotten-gravekeeper-cloak.location: Dropped by the Putrid Grave Warden Duelist boss in the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.

item:rotten-gravekeeper-cloak-altered.name: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak (altered)
item:rotten-gravekeeper-cloak-altered.description: Lighter version of the Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 8 · Fire 8 · Lightning 10 · Holy 8

item:rotten-gravekeeper-cloak-altered.location: Dropped unaltered by the Putrid Grave Warden Duelist boss in the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:rotten-greataxe.name: Rotten Greataxe
item:rotten-greataxe.description: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.
item:rotten-greataxe.location: To get the Rotten Greataxe in Elden Ring, travel to the Consecrated Snowfield, locate the Rotten Duelist northwest of Ordina, Liturgical Town, and defeat him.

item:rotten-staff.name: Rotten Staff
item:rotten-staff.description: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. It festers with scarlet rot. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees.
item:rotten-staff.location: To get the Rotten Staff in Elden Ring, you must defeat the Putrid Avatar boss located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

item:rotten-stray-ashes.name: Rotten Stray Ashes
item:rotten-stray-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a rotten stray. Spirit of a stray dog corrupted by the scarlet rot.  Through it is only a small creature, it is as violent as it is nimble, and its fangs fester with poisonous rot

stats.Effect: Summon rotten stray spirit

item:rotten-stray-ashes.location: Found in a building in Sellia, Town of Sorcery, north of the Sellia Under-Stair Site of Grace.

item:round-shield.name: Round Shield
item:round-shield.description: A wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. Comparatively light for its size, this shield is easy to handle but lacks a true metal shield's ability to negate damage.
item:round-shield.location: - Bought for  1000 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant at  Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula, or from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them his Bell Bearing.

item:rowa-fruit.name: Rowa Fruit
item:rowa-fruit.description: Berry-like red fruits that grow in shrubs. Material used for crafting items. Easily found everywhere in the Lands Between, it is primarily used in preserved foods.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:rowa-fruit.location:
- An early farming point is at The First Step site of grace in Limgrave, where some can be found in the nearby bushes.
- A more efficient farming spot can be found at Jarburg, where Tarnished Golden Sunflowers, Grave Violets, Poisonbloom, Erdleaf Flowers, and Crystal Buds also can be found.

stats.Effect: On horseback, feed to spectral steed to restore HP

item:royal-greatsword.name: Royal Greatsword
item:royal-greatsword.description: Greatsword decorated in royal Carian Style. Favored weapon of Blaidd the Half-Wolf. In defiance of the fate he was born to, Blaidd swore to serve no master but Ranni. As proof. the sword was imbued with a cold magic at the moment oath was sworn.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:royal-greatsword.location: To get the Royal Greatsword, you must complete the extensive questline for Ranni the Witch.

item:royal-knight-armor.name: Royal Knight Armor
item:royal-knight-armor.description: Silver armor of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

stats.Negation: Physical 16 · Strike 14 · Slash 17 · Pierce 16 · Magic 14 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:royal-knight-armor.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

item:royal-knight-armor-altered.name: Royal Knight Armor (altered)
item:royal-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Royal Knight Armor. The armor is not as sturdy as the original, but it still provides a decent amount of protection.

stats.Negation: Physical 15 · Strike 14 · Slash 17 · Pierce 16 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:royal-knight-armor-altered.location: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:royal-knight-gauntlets.name: Royal Knight Gauntlets
item:royal-knight-gauntlets.description: Silver gauntlets of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:royal-knight-gauntlets.location: - Royal Knight Gauntlets can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for  4,000 runes after defeating Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

item:royal-knight-greaves.name: Royal Knight Greaves
item:royal-knight-greaves.description: Silver greaves of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 8 · Slash 10 · Pierce 9 · Magic 8 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:royal-knight-greaves.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

item:royal-knight-helm.name: Royal Knight Helm
item:royal-knight-helm.description: Silver helm of Loretta, a Knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:royal-knight-helm.location: - Purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for  4,000 runes after defeating Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

item:royal-knight-s-resolve.name: Royal Knight's Resolve
item:royal-knight-s-resolve.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Royal Knight's Resolve: Skill of the knights who once served the Elden Lord. Hold the flat of the armament to your face and pledge your resolve, greatly powering up your next attack."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:royal-knight-s-resolve.location: **Loot:** Volcano Manor - Located on a corpse in an isolated room of Volcano Manor, near the shortcut door back to the entrance of the manor (Stonesword Key is required). - To reach it, the player must start from the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace and take the elevator up to the upper level of the manor (where the Man-Serpent with Magma Blades patrol). Head northwest, past the Man-Serpent with the Magma Whip Candlestick, into the building and then rightwards into the throne room.

item:royal-remains-armor.name: Royal Remains Armor
item:royal-remains-armor.description: Armory graces with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 11 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 9 · Fire 10 · Lightning 8 · Holy 8

item:royal-remains-armor.location:
**Location**: Roundtable Hold
- Defeat Ensha of the Royal Remains' invasion at the Roundtable Hold after collecting the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right). The entire Royal Remains set is later found where he usually stands.

item:royal-remains-gauntlets.name: Royal Remains Gauntlets
item:royal-remains-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets graces with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 2

item:royal-remains-gauntlets.location:
**Location**: Roundtable Hold
- Defeat Ensha of the Royal Remains' invasion at the Roundtable Hold after collecting the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right). The entire Royal Remains set is later found where he usually stands.

item:royal-remains-greaves.name: Royal Remains Greaves
item:royal-remains-greaves.description: Greaves graced with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:royal-remains-greaves.location:
**Location**: Roundtable Hold
- Defeat Ensha of the Royal Remains' invasion at the Roundtable Hold after collecting the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right). The entire Royal Remains set is later found where he usually stands.

item:royal-remains-helm.name: Royal Remains Helm
item:royal-remains-helm.description: Helm graced with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:royal-remains-helm.location:
**Location**: Roundtable Hold
- Defeat Ensha of the Royal Remains' invasion at the Roundtable Hold after collecting the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right). The entire Royal Remains set is later found where he usually stands.

item:ruin-fragment.name: Ruin Fragment
item:ruin-fragment.description: Stone fragment found near places where ruins have fallen from the sky. Can be used for crafting, or simply for throwing at enemies. These shards of stone are believed to have once been part of a temple in the sky. They glow with a faint light from within.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items.

item:ruins-greatsword.name: Ruins Greatsword
item:ruins-greatsword.description: Originally rubble from a ruin which fell from the sky, this surviving fragment was honed into a weapon. One of the legendary armaments. The ruin it came from crumbled when struck by a meteorite, as such this weapon harbords its destructive power.
item:ruins-greatsword.location: Drop from Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight duo

item:ruler-s-mask.name: Ruler's Mask
item:ruler-s-mask.description: Mask in the image of a wizened sage. Customary dress among lords in a smaller nation. Increases faith. Such a mask illustrates the qualities of an ideal lord: chiefly, wise and possessing a certain defanged geniality. One at the center of society often finds these qualities most expedient.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:ruler-s-mask.location:
**Location**: Altus Plateau
- The Ruler's Mask is looted from a corpse atop a broken caravan near the  Abandoned Coffin site of grace in Altus Plateau.

item:ruler-s-robe.name: Ruler's Robe
item:ruler-s-robe.description: Luxurious robe worn by lords in a smaller nation. Its fine blue mantle serves to prove its wearer's status.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 2 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:ruler-s-robe.location: Found on a corpse on a broken Great Coffin, located near the Abandoned Coffin site of grace in Altus Plateau.

item:rune-arc.name: Rune Arc
item:rune-arc.description: A shard of the shattered Elden Ring.

stats.Effect: Grants the blessing of an equipped rune upon use

item:rune-arc.location: **Rune Arcs can be earned by completing online objectives**: - All summoned Furled Fingers gain one Rune Arc upon when the area Boss is defeated, regardless of contribution. - All present Invaders (Bloody Fingers and Recusants) gain one Rune Arc when the Host of Fingers dies, regardless of circumstances. - All present Hunters gain one Rune Arc whenever an Invader dies, regardless of circumstances. **Enemy Drops**: - Rats and Giant Rats have a 1.00% chance of dropping x1 Rune Arc.

item:ruptured-crystal-tear.name: Ruptured Crystal Tear
item:ruptured-crystal-tear.description: A special crystallization formed within a tear of life over the course of many moons. Causes concoction to explode when taken in mixed physick. A dangerous form of crystal tear which possesses absolutely no medicinal qualities. A lesson said to be learned the hard way for some; faith can be a volatile matter, after all.

stats.Effect: Causes concoction to explode in mixed physick

item:rusted-anchor.name: Rusted Anchor
item:rusted-anchor.description: A rusty anchor wielded as a weapon. Each of its four flukes is thick and sharp, enabling piercing attacks. While the Tarnished left the Lands Between with their Kird, one boat alone was said to have been left behind.
item:rusted-anchor.location: To get the Rusted Anchor in Elden Ring, travel to the Morne Tunnel in the Weeping Peninsula.

item:rusty-key.name: Rusty Key

stats.Effect: Opens a locked door in Stormveil Castle

item:rusty-key.location:
**Location**: Stormveil Castle
- Found inside a treasure chest within a dark room atop the staircase section in Stormveil Castle, between the  Stormveil Cliffside and  Rampart Tower Sites of Grace. This area is filled with explosive red barrels and Commoners throwing Fire Pots.

item:rykard-s-rancor.name: Rykard's Rancor
item:rykard-s-rancor.description: The terrible power of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.
item:rykard-s-rancor.location:
Trade the Remembrance of the Blasphemous, dropped by Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, with Finger Reader Enia.

Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

stats.Effect: Releases searing spirits that repeatedly explode after delay

item:sacramental-bud.name: Sacramental Bud
item:sacramental-bud.description: An immature bud containing fresh blood. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:sacramental-bud.location: Sacramental Buds can be found in the world. However, they do not respawn after dying or resting at a Site of Grace. They can only be obtained once per playthrough. Altus Plateau - x11 around the Writheblood Ruins: x9 inside and x2 southeast of the structure. - x10 near St. Trina's Hideaway (the location of the Amber Starlight), north of the Altus Highway Junction site of grace. - x4 east of the entrance to Wyndham Catacombs, near the Wyndham Ruins. - x1 far south of the Bower of Bounty site of grace. Caelid - x15 around the Church of the Plague: x7 inside and x8 in the surrounding graveyard.

item:sacred-blade.name: Sacred Blade
item:sacred-blade.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Sacred Blade: Grants armament's attacks holy essence and fires off a golden blade projectile. The armament retains its holy essence for awhile."Usable on all melee armaments (whips, fists, and claws excepted).
item:sacred-blade.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Limgrave
- Drops from a Scarab found on a hill, past the pond northwest of the Third Church of Marika. The Scarab is fairly close to the bottom of the hill.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:sacred-crown-helm.name: Sacred Crown Helm
item:sacred-crown-helm.description: Flanged iron cap adorned with a crown of unalloyed gold. Increases faith. Worn by foot soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. Who is it that Miquella shall bless, if not the low and the meek?

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:sacred-crown-helm.location: Chance to drop from Haligtree Foot Soldier enemies.

item:sacred-order.name: Sacred Order
item:sacred-order.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Sacred Order: Skill of the Golden Order fundamentalist knights. Perform a salute and grant the armament holy essence. Highly effective against Those Who Live in Death."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:sacred-order.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Altus Plateau
- Drops from a Scarab found on the western shore of the lake north of the Abandoned Coffin Site of Grace.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:sacred-order-pot.name: Sacred Order Pot
item:sacred-order-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Enchanted by incantations of the Golden Order. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy holy damage. Highly effective against Those Who Live in Death, even preventing them from rising again. The Golden Order has no mercy for those who trespass beyond life's bounds.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy holy damage.

item:sacred-order-pot.location: Can be crafted after acquiring the Missionary's Cookbook [5] from Siofra Aqueduct, in the offshoot tower guarded by a greatsword-wielding Crucible Knight.

item:sacred-relic-sword.name: Sacred Relic Sword
item:sacred-relic-sword.description: Sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal.  Thoughts on what the weapon portends are many and varied. Some consider it the mark of a great sin, or a sign of great devastation. Some think of it as the end of an age, while others; the beginning.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Fai D

item:sacred-ring-of-light.name: Sacred Ring Of Light
item:sacred-ring-of-light.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Sacred Ring of Light: Skill used by the commanders of the Cleanrot Knights. Gather a sacred ring of light in the armament, and then fire it forwards. Can be fired in rapid succession."Usable on polearms (great spears excepted).
item:sacred-ring-of-light.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Swamp of Aeonia
- Drops from a Scarab found on land, east of the Heart of Aeonia where Commander O'Neil is fought.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:sacred-scorpion-charm.name: Sacred Scorpion Charm
item:sacred-scorpion-charm.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart with a blessed glow.

stats.Effect: Raises holy attack, but lowers damage negation.

item:sacred-scorpion-charm.location: - Obtained by defeating Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater, who invades the player near the Smoldering Church in northwestern Caelid.

item:sacred-tear.name: Sacred Tear
item:sacred-tear.description: Blessing of the Erdtree, worshiped in the churches of all lands; this

stats.Effect: Improves Sacred Flask's potency

item:sacred-tear.location:
- Limgrave
  - Third Church of Marika
  - Callu Baptismal Church
  - Fourth Church of Marika
  - Church of Pilgrimage
- Liurnia of the Lakes
  - Church of Irith
  - Bellum Church
  - Church of Inhibition
- Caelid
  - Church of the Plague
- Altus Plateau
  - Second Church of Marika
  - Stormcaller Church
- Mountaintops of the Giants
  - Church of Repose
  - First Church of Marika

item:sacrificial-axe.name: Sacrificial Axe
item:sacrificial-axe.description: Hatchet used in ancient sacrificial rite. A Deathbird is depicted as a malevolent deity. The power of the rite yet lingers. A small amount of FP is restored upon slaying a foe.
item:sacrificial-axe.location: To get the Sacrificial Axe in Elden Ring, you must defeat the Deathbird boss located in the Weeping Peninsula at nighttime.

item:sacrificial-twig.name: Sacrificial Twig
item:sacrificial-twig.description: A talisman fashioned from a dried twig, so slender that it might snap at the slightest touch.

stats.Effect: Will be lost on death in place of runes.

item:sacrificial-twig.location: - Purchased for 5,000 runes from Patches, in Murkwater Cave in northern Limgrave, then later in Volcano Manor in central Mt. Gelmir. - Purchased for 3,000 runes each (up to 3) from the Isolated Merchant in southwestern Weeping Peninsula, in southwestern Limgrave. - Obtained from a corpse in eastern Limgrave, found lying in front of a large gravestone, on a cliff west of Mistwood Ruins. - Obtained from Edgar upon first speaking to him in Castle Morne, in southeastern Limgrave.

item:sage-hood.name: Sage Hood
item:sage-hood.description: A burgundy pointed hood. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical. Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:sage-hood.location:
**Loot**: Stillwater Cave
- The Sage Hood is found on a body inside Stillwater Cave, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:sage-robe.name: Sage Robe
item:sage-robe.description: Thick burgundy robe. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical. Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:sage-robe.location: Can be found on a body inside Stillwater Cave located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:sage-trousers.name: Sage Trousers
item:sage-trousers.description: Thick burgundy trousers. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical. Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 1 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:sage-trousers.location: Can be found on a body inside Stillwater Cave located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:sancrified-whetblade.name: Sancrified Whetblade
item:sancrified-whetblade.description: Sanctified whetblade with a cipher engraved. Can be used as a whetstone knife. When applying an affinity using physical or golden-type ashes of war, an additional affinity of sacred or lightning can be chosen.

stats.Effect: Grants choice of affinity upgrade to weapon.

item:sanctified-whetblade.name: Sanctified Whetblade
item:sanctified-whetblade.location:
**Location**: Fortified Manor, Leyndell, Royal Capital
- Found beside the Hammer on the second floor of the manor in the same location as Smithing Master Hewg at the Roundtable Hold.
related: Forge of the Giants / burning the Erdtree

item:sanctuary-stone.name: Sanctuary Stone
item:sanctuary-stone.description: A rare piece of stone fragment found near places where ruins have fallen from the sky. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:sanguine-noble-hood.name: Sanguine Noble Hood
item:sanguine-noble-hood.description: Hood of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery. Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood. Known to strike from pools of blood, these assassins are missionaries come to share the gospel of accursed blood.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:sanguine-noble-hood.location: Received upon defeating the Sanguine Noble (invader), near the white trees northwest of Consecrated Snowfield. He guards a Sending Gate that leads to the Mohgwyn Palace.

item:sanguine-noble-robe.name: Sanguine Noble Robe
item:sanguine-noble-robe.description: Robe of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery. Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood. The grand metallic pattern on the shoulder is a signifier of the noble rank they intend to claim upon the advent of the new dynasty they are working to install.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 13 · Fire 11 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:sanguine-noble-robe.location: Received upon defeating the Sanguine Noble invader, near the white trees in the northwestern Consecrated Snowfield.

item:scale-armor.name: Scale Armor
item:scale-armor.description: Armor reinforced with small metal scales. The cape covering the shoulders is made with treated rock lizard skin, and provides ample protection against fire.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 10 · Slash 12 · Pierce 10 · Magic 7 · Fire 10 · Lightning 6 · Holy 8

item:scale-armor.location: - Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region.

item:scaled-armor.name: Scaled Armor
item:scaled-armor.description: Armor worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it high effective against non-physical attacks.

stats.Negation: Physical 16 · Strike 14 · Slash 17 · Pierce 16 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:scaled-armor.location: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.

item:scaled-armor-altered.name: Scaled Armor (altered)
item:scaled-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Scaled Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 15 · Strike 13 · Slash 16 · Pierce 15 · Magic 12 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:scaled-armor-altered.location: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor to receive it unaltered. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:scaled-gauntlets.name: Scaled Gauntlets
item:scaled-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it high effective against non-physical attacks. Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survived to this day.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:scaled-gauntlets.location: - The Scaled Gauntlets are obtained by defeating Old Knight Istvan as part of the Volcano Manor questline.

item:scaled-greaves.name: Scaled Greaves
item:scaled-greaves.description: Gauntlets worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it high effective against non-physical attacks. Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survived to this day.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 8 · Slash 10 · Pierce 9 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:scaled-greaves.location: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.

item:scaled-helm.name: Scaled Helm
item:scaled-helm.description: Helm worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:scaled-helm.location: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.

item:scarlet-aeonia.name: Scarlet Aeonia
item:scarlet-aeonia.description: Technique of Malenia, the Goddess of Rot.
item:scarlet-aeonia.location:
Trade the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess, gained by defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella, with Finger Reader Enia.

Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

stats.Effect: Creates a giant flower that explodes with scarlet rot.

item:scarlet-tabard.name: Scarlet Tabard
item:scarlet-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with the telltale stains of the scarlet rot. Worn by foot soldiers in General Radahn's army

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 9 · Slash 8 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 10

item:scarlet-tabard.location: Chance to drop from Radahn Foot Soldier enemies.

item:scavenger-s-curved-sword.name: Scavenger's Curved Sword
item:scavenger-s-curved-sword.description: Unique curved sword, notched like shark's teeth. Weapon carried by corpse pillagers who prowl the sites of old battles. The blade is tacky with blood and covered in hefty nicks, making it totally uneven. Life can be sinister indeed.
item:scavenger-s-curved-sword.location: To get the Scavenger's Curved Sword in Elden Ring, head to the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite in Mt. Gelmir.

item:scepter-of-the-all-knowing.name: Scepter Of The All-knowing
item:scepter-of-the-all-knowing.description: Scepter in the form of a hand grasping a pearl. Signature weapon of Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. The pearl stands for the world, the heavens, and an eye, representing the many forms of knowledge, never fully attainable. Even knowing that, the All- Knowing's hand grasps for it.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int D

item:scepter-of-the-all-knowing.location: You can get the Scepter of the All-Knowing by defeating Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

item:scholar-s-armament.name: Scholar's Armament
item:scholar-s-armament.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
item:scholar-s-armament.location:
**Purchase:** Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 3,000 Runes by Sorceress  Sellen in any of her locations other than Witchbane Ruins.
- Should Sellen die before purchasing this Sorcery from her, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Sellen's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Enchants right-hand armament with magic damage

item:scholar-s-shield.name: Scholar's Shield
item:scholar-s-shield.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
item:scholar-s-shield.location:
**Purchase:** Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 2,500 Runes by Sorceress  Sellen in any of her locations other than Witchbane Ruins.
- Should Sellen die before purchasing this Sorcery from her, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Sellen's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Enhances left-handed shield damage negation

item:scimitar.name: Scimitar
item:scimitar.description: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against armor and hides covered in tough scales. Smaller in size than most curved swords, it carves into enemies with quick, sharp cuts.
item:scimitar.location: You can get the Scimitar in Elden Ring by purchasing it from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 600 runes, choosing the Warrior starting class, or farming it from skeleton enemies.

item:scorpion-kite-shield.name: Scorpion Kite Shield
item:scorpion-kite-shield.description: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. Emblazoned with a yellow scorpion, a warning of surprise attacks and sudden strikes.
item:scorpion-kite-shield.location: Purchased for  2,000 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant near the  Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace in Altus Plateau or from the Twin Maiden Husks upon giving them his Bell Bearing.

item:scorpion-s-stinger.name: Scorpion's Stinger
item:scorpion-s-stinger.description: Dagger fashioned from a great scorpion's tail, glistening with scarlet rot. A ceremonial tool used by heretics, crafted from the relic of a sealed outer god.
item:scorpion-s-stinger.location: To get the Scorpion's Stinger dagger, head to the Grand Cloister in the Lake of Rot.

item:scouring-black-flame.name: Scouring Black Flame
item:scouring-black-flame.description: A black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles. Sweeps a wide area before the caster with black flame. Charging enhances range. The black flame could once slay gods. But when Maliketh sealed Destined Death, the true power of the black flame was lost.
item:scouring-black-flame.location: Godskin Prayerbook, found at the Roundtable Hold.

stats.Effect: Sweeps area before caster with black flame

item:scriptstone.name: Scriptstone
item:scriptstone.description: Ruin fragment inscribed with letters.  Craftable item. Reveals additional messages from other worlds. Words are gregarious things, drawn to one another much as people are.

stats.Effect: Reveals more messages from other worlds

item:scriptstone.location: Craftable — Ruin Fragment x1, Human Bone Shard x1

item:scripture-wooden-shield.name: Scripture Wooden Shield
item:scripture-wooden-shield.description: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. An ancient cipher engraving linesd the circumference. Though it isn't much, it boosts holy damage negation.
item:scripture-wooden-shield.location:
- Starting gear for the Astrologer class.
- 2% chance to be dropped by the Skeletons wielding a Scimitar and Iron Roundshield.

item:scroll-academy.name: Academy Scroll
item:scroll-academy.description: Scroll of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, the glintstone sorcerers' place of study.

stats.Effect: Give to a learned sorcerer to acquire new sorceries
Give to Sorceress Sellen to unlock Glintstone Cometshard and Star Shower

item:scroll-royal-house.name: Royal House Scroll
item:scroll-royal-house.description: Sorcery scroll of the Carian royal family, the heads of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

stats.Effect: Give to a learned sorcerer to acquire new sorceries

item:scythe.name: Scythe
item:scythe.description: Large scythe featuring a long, slender blade. Designed to reap, this weapon is capable of rapidly inflicting blood loss while also slipping through an enemy's guard.  In the hands of a highly dexterous wielder it is capable of striking fear into the heart of any foe.
item:scythe.location: To get the standard Scythe in Elden Ring, head to the Cliffbottom Catacombs in the southeastern region of Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:seedbed-curse.name: Seedbed Curse
item:seedbed-curse.description: Curse grown on a corpse killed and defiled by the Dung Eater. A tender pox afflicted with omen horns.

stats.Effect: Curse grown on a body defiled by a Dung Eater

related: Dung Eater — defeated at the Leyndell moat
Give him the Seedbed Curses for the Mending Rune

item:seluvis-s-introduction.name: Seluvis's Introduction
item:seluvis-s-introduction.description: Scroll bearing a royal coat of arms.

stats.Effect: Letter of introduction addressed to Sellen

item:seluvis-s-introduction.location:
**Location**: Seluvis's Rise, Liurnia of the Lakes
- Obtained by selecting **Ask about Nokron** when speaking to Preceptor Seluvis after progressing Blaidd the Half-Wolf's quest in the Siofra River.

item:seluvis-s-potion.name: Seluvis's Potion
item:seluvis-s-potion.description: Small flask received from Preceptor Seluvis containing a cloudy tonic of bluish black.

stats.Effect: Small flask received from Preceptor Seluvis

item:seluvis-s-potion.location:
**Location**: Seluvis's Rise, Liurnia of the Lakes
- The potion is given by Preceptor Seluvis at his rise upon selecting **Accept the task** during his questline.

item:sentry-s-torch.name: Sentry's Torch
item:sentry-s-torch.description: Torch Given to protectors of the Erdtree. Its flames are bestowed with a special incantation which allows the bearer to see assassins cloaked in veils. Furnished on behalf of the Erdtree and the Grace-Given Lord such that a Night of Black Knives will never come again.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:sentry-s-torch.location: To get the Sentry's Torch in Elden Ring, purchase it from the Hermit Merchant in the Altus Plateau for 7,000 Runes.

item:seppuku.name: Seppuku
item:seppuku.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Blood and the following skill:"Seppuku: A forbidden technique used by swordsmen from the Land of Reeds. Plunge the blade into your stomach to stain it with blood. Increases attack power and improves ability to inflict blood loss."Usable on swords as well as polearms capable of thrusting (small and colossal weapons excepted).
item:seppuku.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Mountaintops of the Giants
- Drops from an invisible Scarab found on the northern side of the Frozen Lake at the Mountaintops of the Giants.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:serpent-bow.name: Serpent Bow
item:serpent-bow.description: Malformed bow in the shape of a pair of poisonous snakes. Imbues arrows with poison through pagan magic, revealing its true worth when used with poison-infused arrows. Used by assassins known as the Formless Serpents.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Arc D

item:serpent-bow.location: Serpent Bow can be found by a pool of rot in Abandoned Cave

item:serpent-crest-shield.name: Serpent Crest Shield
item:serpent-crest-shield.location:
**Quest**: Gravesite Plain, Realm of Shadow
- The Serpent Crest Shield is rewarded upon completing the "Incursion" Painting puzzle. Travel west from  Greatbridge North site of grace after receiving the item at the Artist's Shack (Gravesite Plain).

item:serpent-flail.name: Serpent Flail

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Fai D

item:serpent-flail.location: This weapon can be found in a chest in Fog Rift Fort. The chest is in the fort's courtyard, on the other end from Black Knight Garrew.

item:serpent-god-s-curved-sword.name: Serpent-god's Curved Sword
item:serpent-god-s-curved-sword.description: Curved sword fashioned in the image of an ancient serpent deity and tool of a forgotten religion practiced on Mt. Gelmir. Formerly used to offer up sacrifices, this sword restores HP upon slaying an enemy.
item:serpent-god-s-curved-sword.location: To get the Serpent-God's Curved Sword in Elden Ring, travel to the Ruin-Strewn Precipice dungeon in northern Liurnia of the Lakes, navigate up the chasm past the ladders and lifts, and find it on an outdoor ledge guarded by a large Land Octopus.

item:serpent-hunter.name: Serpent-hunter
item:serpent-hunter.description: Weapon that serves as both greatsword and spear. Thought to have been used to hunt an immortal great serpent in the distant past, it manifests a long blade of light when facing such a creature. When their master's heroic aspirations degenerated into mere greed, his men searched for a weapon with which they might halt their lord.
item:serpent-hunter.location: To get the Serpent-Hunter, travel to the Audience Pathway Site of Grace in Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir).

item:serpentbone-blade.name: Serpentbone Blade
item:serpentbone-blade.description: Sinister katana modeled after a serpent bone. The denely packed row of spines that jut away from the cutting edge are coated in a lethal poison
item:serpentbone-blade.location: To get the Serpentbone Blade, complete the second assassination contract given by Tanith at Volcano Manor in the Altus Plateau.

item:sewer-gaol-key.name: Sewer-gaol Key
item:sewer-gaol-key.description: Filthy key received from the Dung Eater.

stats.Effect: Unlocks sewer-gaol door beneath Leyndell

item:sewer-gaol-key.location:
**Location**: Roundtable Hold
- Speak to the Dung Eater at the Roundtable Hold with at least one Seedbed Curse in your inventory to receive the Sewer-Gaol Key.

item:sewing-needle.name: Sewing Needle
item:sewing-needle.description: A large sewing needle, curved like a fang. Boc the demi-human's prized possession.

stats.Effect: Boc the demi-human's prized sewing needle

item:shabriri-grape.name: Shabriri Grape
item:shabriri-grape.description: A yellowing, oozing eyeball of the infirm. The surface is shriveled, and the inside is squishy, not unlike a large, overly-ripe grape.

stats.Effect: Yellow, oozing eyeball of the infirm

item:shabriri-s-woe.name: Shabriri's Woe
item:shabriri-s-woe.description: Disturbing likeness of a man whose eyes have been gouged out. The corners of his mouth are upturned in an almost flirtatious manner.

stats.Effect: Constantly attracts enemies' aggression

item:shabriri-s-woe.location:
- Obtained from a corpse in Frenzied Flame Village, in northeastern Liurnia of the Lakes. The corpse is found on the steps of a building.
- Can be chosen as a starting gift when creating a new character.

item:shadow-bait.name: Shadow Bait
item:shadow-bait.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' sewants, who once served as the
item:shadow-bait.location:
**Loot:** Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
- Shadow Bait is found on a corpse guarded by an Omen, past the large gate to the right of the Underground Roadside Site of Grace.
- If the gate is locked, take the ladder ahead and to the left of the Grace, then continue to the doorway on the far right of the room filled with pipes.

stats.Effect: Creates shadow that lures the aggression of foes of human build

item:shadow-sunflower-blossom.name: Shadow Sunflower Blossom

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:shadow-sunflower-blossom.location: Can be obtained upon trading the Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.

item:shaman-furs.name: Shaman Furs
item:shaman-furs.description: Raiment fashioned from a bristly pelt. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 8 · Magic 8 · Fire 7 · Lightning 8 · Holy 6

item:shaman-furs.location: Shaman Furs have a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Shamans.

item:shaman-leggings.name: Shaman Leggings
item:shaman-leggings.description: Leggings fashioned from bristly pelts. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:shaman-leggings.location: Shaman Leggings have a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Shamans.

item:shamshir.name: Shamshir
item:shamshir.description: Curved sword with a thin blade of ample length. Light of weight despite its larger size, its slicing attacks come in rapid succession. A devastatingly powerful weapon in the hands of a skilled swordsman.
item:shamshir.location: To get the Shamshir in Elden Ring, travel to the Saintsbridge site of grace in Limgrave, use the spirit spring to drop into the ravine, and find it on a corpse guarded by bats at the bottom of Highroad Cave.

item:shard-of-alexander.name: Shard Of Alexander
item:shard-of-alexander.description: Shard of the late Alexander, a shattered warrior jar.

stats.Effect: Greatly boosts the attack power of skills.

item:shard-spiral.name: Shard Spiral
item:shard-spiral.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
item:shard-spiral.location:
**Quest Item/ Purchase:** Academy of Raya Lucaria
- Sold for 8,000 Runes by Sorceress  Sellen after choosing to side with her and help her vanquish Witch-Hunter Jerren at the Raya Lucaria Grand Library.
- Should Sellen die before this point in her questline, then this Sorcery will be left unavailable for the rest of the playthrough.

stats.Effect: Fire twin spiraling projectiles

item:shatter-earth.name: Shatter Earth
item:shatter-earth.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Imbues the ferrule of the caster's staff with magic, then thrusts it into the ground to create a magical shockwave. Allows one follow-up attack. A Stonedigger sorcery used by the glintstone miners of the crystal tunnel. At the academy, use of this sorcery was a stigma that marked out failed scholars.
item:shatter-earth.location:
**Loot:** Liurnia
- Acquired from a corpse in the section just before the final elevator of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.

stats.Effect: Thrust staff into ground to emit a shockwave

item:shattering-crystal.name: Shattering Crystal
item:shattering-crystal.description: Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians. Creates a mass of crystal, then shatters it in a forward burst. Charging enhances potency. The Crystalians are inorganic beings, yet they live. They cleave close to the ideals of the primeval current, and as such, they are revered guests of the sorcerers.
item:shattering-crystal.location:
**Loot:** Academy of Raya Lucaria
- Acquired from a corpse located on the second floor of the Church of the Cuckoo. The second floor can be accessed through careful platforming on the rooftops west of the plaza north of the Debate Parlor Site of Grace.

stats.Effect: Creates crystal mass that shatters in forward burst

item:shield-bash.name: Shield Bash
item:shield-bash.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Shield Bash: Brace behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance. Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered."Usable on all shields.
item:shield-bash.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Drops from a Scarab found on patch of land underneath the tall, stone bridge north of Raya Lucaria. Northeast of the East Gate Brdige Trestle Sites of Grace.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:shield-crash.name: Shield Crash
item:shield-crash.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Shield Crash: Two-hand the shield and charge forwards while maintaining guard. Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards and can even be staggered. Hold to extend the duration of the charge forwards."Usable on all shields.
item:shield-crash.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Altus Plateau
- Drops from a Scarab found within Lux Ruins.
On the northern side of the ruined church on top of the hill.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:shield-grease.name: Shield Grease
item:shield-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of magically resonant materials. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Boosts guarding ability and all damage negation.

item:shield-grease.location: Craftable — Root Resin x1, Silver Tear Husk x1, Crystal Bud x1

item:shield-of-night.name: Shield of Night
item:shield-of-night.location: Found on a corpse within Bonny Gaol. Before the bridge leading to the drop down to the boss room, there is a jar elevator that leads up to a ledge where the shield can be found inside a broken cell.

item:shield-of-the-guilty.name: Shield Of The Guilty
item:shield-of-the-guilty.description: Shield made to venerate a maiden whose eyes were crushed by Briars of Sin before being reborn in these lands. Venerating the repose of the soul, this shield boosts focus. The briars can be used to attack foes.
item:shield-of-the-guilty.location:
**Location**: Demi-Human Forest Ruins
- The Shield of the Guilty is found in a chest in the cellar of the Demi-Human Forest Ruins in the Weeping Peninsula. The cellar entrance will be visible behind in a hole in a wall behind some branches; however, you will need to jump into the building section to enter.

item:shining-horned-headband.name: Shining Horned Headband
item:shining-horned-headband.description: Headband decorated by a pair of shining horns. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:shining-horned-headband.location: - The Shining Horned Headband has a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Shamans.

item:short-spear.name: Short Spear
item:short-spear.description: A exceedingly plain spear of modest weight. Simple to wield compared to many of its peers, strong attack unleashes a series of successive piercing thrusts.
item:short-spear.location: You can get the Short Spear in Elden Ring by purchasing it from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 600 runes, choosing the Prophet starting class, or farming it from foot soldiers.

item:short-sword.name: Short Sword
item:short-sword.description: A short straight sword with a short blade.  In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks.  Lightweight amongst straight swords, this weapon is easy to wield, requiring only humble attributes.
item:short-sword.location: To get the Short Sword in Elden Ring, buy it from the Nomadic Merchant in North Limgrave for 600 Runes, start as the Astrologer class, or farm it from Highwaymen.

item:shortbow.name: Shortbow
item:shortbow.description: Small bow made to fire arrows over great distances. Other than its ability to fire off arrows in rapid succession, it is also well-suited for use on horseback. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.
item:shortbow.location: You can buy the standard Shortbow from the Nomadic Merchant on the West Limgrave beach for 600 Runes, or start the game as the Bandit class.

item:shotel.name: Shotel
item:shotel.description: Curved sword with a severely hooked blade. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.  Made to hunt down humans, this weapon requires high dexterity to wield efficiently.
item:shotel.location: To get the standard Shotel, buy it from the abandoned nomadic merchant near the Worshipper's Woods site of grace in Siofra River Well for 2,500 runes.

item:siluria-s-tree.name: Siluria's Tree
item:siluria-s-tree.description: Siluria's Tree, weapon of one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights. The primordial form of the Erdtree is close in nature to life itself, and this spear, modeled on its crucible, is imbued with ancient holy essence.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:siluria-s-tree.location: To get Siluria's Tree in Elden Ring, you must travel to the Deeproot Depths Wiki region, reach the Nameless Eternal City Site of Grace, and defeat the Crucible Knight Siluria boss.

item:silver-firefly.name: Silver Firefly
item:silver-firefly.description: Firefly that gives off a silvery light. Material used in crafting items. Found near bodies of cold water untouched by sunlight. The light of fireflies is believed to have an alluring magic. Silver light is considered to invite riches.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:silver-mirrorshield.name: Silver Mirrorshield
item:silver-mirrorshield.description: Shield of radiant silver, festooned with amber and carried by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. The shape is said to imitate that of a sacred drop of dew, which inspired the absurd rumor that Loretta herself was an Albinauric.
item:silver-mirrorshield.location: - Found inside the Apostate Derelict, located in Consecrated Snowfield.

item:silver-pickled-fowl-foot.name: Silver-pickled Fowl Foot
item:silver-pickled-fowl-foot.description: Four-toed foot of a fowl, pickled in a silvery medicinal solution.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts item discovery (+50)

item:silver-pickled-fowl-foot.location: One is found on a ledge behind the starting building in Limgrave (must drop down to get it).

item:silver-tear-husk.name: Silver Tear Husk
item:silver-tear-husk.description: A hardened husk shed by a formless life form known as the Silver Tear, found in and around the Eternal City. Material used for crafting items. The Silver Tear makes mockery of life, reborn again and again into imitation. Perhaps, one day, it will be reborn a lord...

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:silver-tear-mask.name: Silver Tear Mask
item:silver-tear-mask.description: Mask fashioned from the corpse of a formless Silver Tear, supported by its hardened, shed husk. Greatly increases arcane to the detriment of physical attack power. To imitate the imitator is a cunning play indeed.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:silver-tear-mask.location: Received upon defeating the Mimic Tear boss in Nokron, Eternal City.

item:skeletal-bandit-ashes.name: Skeletal Bandit Ashes
item:skeletal-bandit-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of a skeletal bandit.

stats.Effect: Summons skeletal bandit spirit

item:skeletal-bandit-ashes.location: Dropped by the Tibia Mariner in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:skeletal-mask.name: Skeletal Mask
item:skeletal-mask.description: Skeletal mask that tightly grips the face. Worn by the assassin's of Ravensmount.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:skeletal-mask.location:
**Location**: Sage's Cave
- The Skeletal Mask is looted from a chest within Sage's Cave in Altus Plateau.

item:skeletal-militiaman-ashes.name: Skeletal Militiaman Ashes
item:skeletal-militiaman-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two skeletal militiamen.

stats.Effect: Summons two skeletal militiaman spirits

item:skeletal-militiaman-ashes.location: - Dropped by the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village.

item:sleep-pot.name: Sleep Pot
item:sleep-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Filled with the incantations of St. Trina. Consumes FP. Throw at enemy to release a purple, soporific haze. Like a lullaby, or a quagmire, it irresistibly draws its victims down into sleep. Sweet dreams.

stats.Effect: Emits a Soporific purple haze

item:sleep-pot.location: Craftable — Mushroom x1, Trina's Lily x1

item:sliver-of-meat.name: Sliver Of Meat
item:sliver-of-meat.description: A slice of thinly carved beast flesh. Material used for crating items. Found by hunting herbivorous beast. The dried meat toughens the constitution.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:slumbering-egg.name: Slumbering Egg
item:slumbering-egg.description: Owl eggs that will never hatch. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:small-golden-effigy.name: Small Golden Effigy
item:small-golden-effigy.description: Online multiplayer item. Sends a summon sign for cooperative multiplayer to a nearby summoning pool. In cooperative multiplayer, you will be summoned to another world to help defeat the area boss.

stats.Effect: Send co-operative sign to summoning pool

item:small-golden-effigy.location:
**Location**: Varies
- The Small Golden Effigy can be looted once from any Summoning Pool.

item:small-red-effigy.name: Small Red Effigy
item:small-red-effigy.description: Item for online play. Sends a competitive sign to a nearby summoning pool. In competitive multiplayer, your objective will be to defeat the Host of Fingers of the world to which you were summoned.

stats.Effect: Sends competitive sign to summoning pool

item:small-red-effigy.location:
**Location**: Limgrave Colosseum
- The Small Red Effigy is found beside a Stranded Soul outside the Limgrave Colosseum.

item:smarag-s-glintstone-breath.name: Smarag's Glintstone Breath
item:smarag-s-glintstone-breath.location:
**Dragon Communion:** Caelid / Jagged Peak
- Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 2 Dragon Hearts after defeating Glintstone Dragon Smarag north of Temple Quarter in Liurnia.

stats.Effect: Spews magic breath of Glintstone Dragon Smarag from above

item:smithing-stone-1.name: Smithing Stone [1]
item:smithing-stone-1.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A shard found in plenty.

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +3.

item:smithing-stone-1.location:
- Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge (x3).
- Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold once given the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (x1).

item:smithing-stone-2.name: Smithing Stone [2]
item:smithing-stone-2.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A large shard found in plenty. Strengthens armaments up to +6. Smithing stone is found throughout the Lands Between, and mining galleries built to excavate it can be found everywhere

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +6.

item:smithing-stone-2.location:
- Nomadic Merchant at the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace in the Liurnia of the Lakes region (x3).
- Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold once given the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (x1).

item:smithing-stone-3.name: Smithing Stone [3]
item:smithing-stone-3.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A particularly hard specimen.

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +9.

item:smithing-stone-3.location:
- Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] to them
- Drops from miners, Radahn soldiers and Raya Lucaria soldiers
- Found in various locations around the world

item:smithing-stone-4.name: Smithing Stone [4]
item:smithing-stone-4.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A large and particularly hard specimen.

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +12.

item:smithing-stone-4.location:
- Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] to them
- Scattered across the Lands Between

item:smithing-stone-5.name: Smithing Stone [5]
item:smithing-stone-5.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armamemnts. A rare specimen, it is tinged with gold.

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +15.

item:smithing-stone-5.location: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3] to them

item:smithing-stone-6.name: Smithing Stone [6]
item:smithing-stone-6.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A larger rare specimen, it is tinged with gold.

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +18.

item:smithing-stone-6.location: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3] to them.

item:smithing-stone-7.name: Smithing Stone [7]
item:smithing-stone-7.description: Stone used to smith a variey of armaments. Found in a polar region, it is semi-vitrified.

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +21.

item:smithing-stone-7.location: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] to them

item:smithing-stone-8.name: Smithing Stone [8]
item:smithing-stone-8.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. Found in a polar region, it is semi-vitrified

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +24.

item:smithing-stone-8.location: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] to them

item:smithscript-axe.name: Smithscript Axe

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int E · Fai E

item:smithscript-axe.location: This weapon can be found at Taylew's Ruined Forge. Follow the path until you reach a crumbled floor. Jump over the gap and turn left to enter a room with a Golem Smith. The axe is at the far end of the room.

item:smithscript-cirque.name: Smithscript Cirque

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int E · Fai E

item:smithscript-cirque.location: It can be looted from a body located by the edge of the sewage waterfall in Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

item:smithscript-dagger.name: Smithscript Dagger

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Int E · Fai E

item:smithscript-dagger.location: Found at Ruined Forge Lava Intake. Proceed normally through the dungeon until you reach the lever that moves the lava pipe and then drop down to the floor below. The dagger can be found behind the Golem Smith.

item:smithscript-greathammer.name: Smithscript Greathammer

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int E · Fai E

item:smithscript-greathammer.location: The weapon can be found on a corpse at Taylew's Ruined Forge. After first jumping onto the pipe, simply cross over to the opposite side to find the hammer.

item:smithscript-shield.name: Smithscript Shield

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int E · Fai E

item:smithscript-shield.location: Found on a corpse in Taylew's Ruined Forge. After reaching the top of the pipe at its original position, jump over to the path leading to the lever, but instead climb the rubble in the room past the hallway to reach the shield. It is guarded by a Golem Smith.

item:smithscript-spear.name: Smithscript Spear

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int E · Fai E

item:smithscript-spear.location:
**Location**: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past
- On a corpse not far past the entrance. It is found to the right after crossing the bridge in the first room, near the ladder.

item:smoldering-butterfly.name: Smoldering Butterfly
item:smoldering-butterfly.description: An eternally burning butterfly found near wildfires and elsewhere. Material used for crafting items. Serves as the kindling for a number of items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:smoldering-butterfly.location: Smoldering Butterflies are harvested in abundance throughout the Lands Between: - They are almost always found at campfires and bonfires. - Near Bloody Finger Hunter Yura - Near Nomadic Merchants - On the burning pile of bodies in Castle Morne's courtyard - They swarm wildfires and Fire Slugs. - North of Warmaster's Shack is a swarm around 2 Slugs. - Southwest of the Eastern Tableland Site of Grace in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes is a Fire Monk camp that contains the gesture "Fire Spur Me". In the nearby area are 3 swarms of Butterflies.

item:smoldering-shield.name: Smoldering Shield
item:smoldering-shield.description: Small shield made upon Mt. Gelmir forged from uncooling lava. Resists frost with its heat, and can even be used to deal fire damage if wielded as a weapon.
item:smoldering-shield.location: Looted from a corpse in an low area filled with explosive Living Jars within Volcano Manor.

item:snow-witch-hat.name: Snow Witch Hat
item:snow-witch-hat.description: Witch's pointed hat, frigid and frozen through. Of a style associated with practitioners of heretical sorcery. Strengthens cold sorcery. Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her. That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:snow-witch-hat.location:
**Location**: Renna's Rise
- The Snow Witch Hat is looted from a chest on the upper floor of Renna's Rise at Three Sisters in Liurnia of the Lakes. The tower becomes accessible during Ranni the Witch's questline.

item:snow-witch-robe.name: Snow Witch Robe
item:snow-witch-robe.description: Witch's robe in the color of snow. Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her. That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:snow-witch-robe.location: Found inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline.

item:snow-witch-robe-altered.name: Snow Witch Robe (altered)
item:snow-witch-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Snow Witch Robe

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 3 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:snow-witch-robe-altered.location: Found unaltered inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:snow-witch-skirt.name: Snow Witch Skirt
item:snow-witch-skirt.description: Witch's skirt in the color of snow. Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her. That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:snow-witch-skirt.location: Found inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline.

item:soap.name: Soap
item:soap.description: A plant-based soap made from mushroom juice. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Removes filth and accumulations on the body

item:soap.location:
- Craftable (requires Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [17])
- Abandoned Merchant in the Siofra River region (x3)

item:soft-cotton.name: Soft Cotton
item:soft-cotton.description: A soft but sturdy cotton formed from splitting open Rowa fruit in a particular manner. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Temporarily reduces fall damage and sound

item:soft-cotton.location: - Can be crafted after acquiring the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [7], found at the end of a broken bridge towards Liurnia of the Lakes that is north of Stormhill Shack and to the east of Stormveil Castle. - Found in Woodfolk Ruins, near a wall surrounded by Slugs. - Found in a side tunnel at the end of Morne Tunnel, opposite the door to the boss. - Found on the first part of the bridge to the Divine Tower of Limgrave, behind the Waygate to the second part of the bridge. - 3 found under an archway in Nokron, Eternal City just before the building that holds the Fingerslayer Blade.

item:soldier-s-crossbow.name: Soldier's Crossbow
item:soldier-s-crossbow.description: A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.
item:soldier-s-crossbow.location: The Soldier's Crossbow is a random drop obtained by defeating specific foot soldiers and exile soldiers who wield it.

item:soldjars-of-fortune-ashes.name: Soldjars Of Fortune Ashes
item:soldjars-of-fortune-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three little living jars. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. These reckless spirits sacrifice themselves to vanquish their summoner's foes, and explode upon death. Though their bravery is admirable, their explosions can harm friend as well as foe, and they will also immediately explode on contact with fire. "Tell the others—tell them how brightly a fire jar burns."

stats.Effect: Summons three little living jar spirits

item:soldjars-of-fortune-ashes.location: Dropped by the Grave Warden Duelist at the end of Auriza Side Tomb.

item:somber-ancient-dragon-smithing-ston.name: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
item:somber-ancient-dragon-smithing-ston.description: Ancient dragonrock smithing stone drained of color. A scale of the Ancient Dragonlord, and hidden treasure of Farum Azula.

stats.Effect: Reinforce special armaments to +10

item:somber-ancient-dragon-smithing-ston.location: One from Gurranq after deathroot 9, one in Mohgwyn, others in Farum / Haligtree / SotE.

item:somber-smithing-stone-1.name: Somber Smithing Stone [1]
item:somber-smithing-stone-1.description: Shard of smithing stone drained of color. Strengthens special armaments to +1. Special armements with unique characteristics cannot be strengthened with colored smithing stones. Number of steps and amount strengthened differ from standard equipment.

stats.Effect: Reinforce special armaments to +1.

item:somber-smithing-stone-1.location: - 1x in Limgrave Tunnels. Before taking the third elevator fall down the edge on the left, and keep falling on the surfaces against the wall. There is a Golden Rune [1] on a platform with a dead body, the next one has a Somber Smithing Stone [1]. - x1 in Limgrave: Located on the field, on a dead body sitting on a chair. - 1x dropped by an exploding Teardrop Scarab south-west of the Artist's Shack (Limgrave) - x1 Church of Dragon Communion: At the lower cliff around the southern point dropped by a Teardrop Scarab. - x1 dropped by a Teardrop Scarab on top of a ruined building in Limgrave.

item:somber-smithing-stone-2.name: Somber Smithing Stone [2]
item:somber-smithing-stone-2.description: Large shard of smithing stone drained of color. Strengthens special armaments to +2. Special armements with unique characteristics cannot be strengthened with colored smithing stones. Number of steps and amount strengthened differ from standard equipment.

stats.Effect: Reinforce special armaments to +2.

item:somber-smithing-stone-3.name: Somber Smithing Stone [3]
item:somber-smithing-stone-3.description: Hard smithing stone drained of color.

stats.Effect: Reinforce special armaments to +3.

item:somber-smithing-stone-4.name: Somber Smithing Stone [4]
item:somber-smithing-stone-4.description: Large hard smithing stone drained of color.

stats.Effect: Reinforce special armaments to +4.

item:somber-smithing-stone-5.name: Somber Smithing Stone [5]
item:somber-smithing-stone-5.description: Gold smithing stone drained of color.

stats.Effect: Reinforce special armaments to +5.

item:somber-smithing-stone-6.name: Somber Smithing Stone [6]
item:somber-smithing-stone-6.description: Large gold smithing stone drained of color.

stats.Effect: Reinforce special armaments to +6.

item:somber-smithing-stone-7.name: Somber Smithing Stone [7]
item:somber-smithing-stone-7.description: Polar smithing stone drained of color.

stats.Effect: Reinforce special armaments to +7.

item:somber-smithing-stone-8.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8]
item:somber-smithing-stone-8.description: Large polar smithing stone drained of color.

stats.Effect: Reinforce special armaments to +8.

item:somber-smithing-stone-9.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9]
item:somber-smithing-stone-9.description: Ancient smithing stone drained of color

stats.Effect: Reinforce special armaments to +9.

item:soporific-grease.name: Soporific Grease
item:soporific-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of light-purple materials. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting sleep

item:soporific-grease.location: Craftable — Root Resin x1, Trina's Lily x1

item:sorcerer-leggings.name: Sorcerer Leggings
item:sorcerer-leggings.description: Leggings worn by Raya Lucaria's magic scholars. Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the legs.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 6 · Lightning 2 · Holy 5

item:sorcerer-leggings.location: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Sorcerer enemies.

item:sorcerer-manchettes.name: Sorcerer Manchettes
item:sorcerer-manchettes.description: Manchettes worn by Raya Lucaria's magic scholars. Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the forearms.

stats.Negation: Slash 1 · Magic 1 · Fire 1 · Lightning 1 · Holy 1

item:sorcerer-manchettes.location: - The Sorcerer Manchettes have a 1.50% chance to drop from Glintstone Sorcerer enemies.

item:spark-aromatic.name: Spark Aromatic
item:spark-aromatic.description: Art of the perfumers who fought In the Shattering. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to broadly scatter sparks in a wide arc straight ahead. Though fire was prohibited to those who served the Erdtree, this rule was forgotten as the war drew ever on.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to broadly scatter sparks in a wide arc straight ahead

item:spear.name: Spear
item:spear.description: Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long haft. A far-reaching piercing weapon, it can be wielded from behind the safety of a raised shield. Very effective against mounted foes.
item:spear.location: To get a basic Spear in Elden Ring early on, you can either buy a Shortspear from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 600 runes, or farm one from the Exile Soldiers in Stormveil Castle.

item:spear-of-the-impaler.name: Spear of the Impaler

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Fai D

item:spear-of-the-impaler.location: - Can be obtained after trading Remembrance of the Impaler with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.

item:spear-talisman.name: Spear Talisman
item:spear-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a spear and a soldier. Enhances the counterattacks that are unique to thrusting weapons.

stats.Effect: Enhances counterattacks unique to thrusting weapons

item:spear-talisman.location: Chest inside the Lakeside Crystal Cave, by a demi-human campfire.

item:speckled-hardtear.name: Speckled Hardtear
item:speckled-hardtear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily raises all resistances and heals all status ailments.

stats.Effect: Boosts resistance and heals status in mixed physick.

item:speckled-hardtear.location: Dropped by the Wormface miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in central Altus Plateau, west of the Woodfolk Ruins.

item:spectral-lance.name: Spectral Lance
item:spectral-lance.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:"Spectral Lance: Skill of the headless Mausoleum Knights. Hurl a phantasmic spear at foes."Usable on polearms (reapers excepted).
item:spectral-lance.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Academy of Raya Lucaria
- Drops from a Scarab found on a descending, curved slope past the roped bridge in the graveyard after the Church of Cuckoo Site of Grace.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:spectral-steed-whistle.name: Spectral Steed Whistle
item:spectral-steed-whistle.description: A delicate goldwork ring. Can be used as a finger whistle. Sound the whistle to summon and ride spectral steed. (Dismounts steed when used while on horseback.) Upon death, the spectral steed can be summoned again, but doing so consumes the Flask of Crimson Tears.

stats.Effect: Summon and ride spectral steed Torrent.

item:spectral-steed-whistle.location: Obtained from Melina after visiting three Sites of Grace and then resting. She will give the player the item after a cutscene and some dialogue.

item:spellblade-s-gloves.name: Spellblade's Gloves
item:spellblade-s-gloves.description: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

stats.Negation: Magic 3 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:spellblade-s-gloves.location: - The Spellblade's Gloves are dropped by Sorcerer Rogier.

item:spellblade-s-pointed-hat.name: Spellblade's Pointed Hat
item:spellblade-s-pointed-hat.description: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:spellblade-s-pointed-hat.location:
**Location**: Roundtable Hold
- The Spellblade's Pointed Hat is dropped by Sorcerer Rogier at the end of his questline.

item:spellblade-s-traveling-attire.name: Spellblade's Traveling Attire
item:spellblade-s-traveling-attire.description: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 2 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 12

item:spellblade-s-traveling-attire-alter.name: Spellblade's Traveling Attire (altered)
item:spellblade-s-traveling-attire-alter.description: Lighter version of the Spellblade's Traveling Attire

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 12 · Fire 10 · Lightning 11 · Holy 12

item:spellblade-s-trousers.name: Spellblade's Trousers
item:spellblade-s-trousers.description: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 7 · Fire 6 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:spelldrake-talisman.name: Spelldrake Talisman
item:spelldrake-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a blue ancient dragon. Boosts magic damage negation.

stats.Effect: Boosts magical damage negation.

item:spelldrake-talisman.location: - Obtained by defeating the Runebear in the Earthbore Cave in northern Weeping Peninsula, southern Limgrave.

item:spellproof-dried-liver.name: Spellproof Dried Liver
item:spellproof-dried-liver.description: Cured animal liver, dried out after pickling in a blue medicinal

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts magic damage negation

item:spellproof-dried-liver.location:
- Can be crafted after acquiring the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [11] from the Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore) who sits at the southern end of Lake of Liurnia's great lake, near the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace.
- Found in the room with guillotines in Black Knife Catacombs in Liurnia of the Lakes.
- Found on the same balcony that Pidia, Carian Servant resides on in Caria Manor in Liurnia of the Lakes.
- Found next to a large tombstone near a plank bridge during the outside section with Putrid Corpses at the Academy of Raya Lucaria in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:spiked-caestus.name: Spiked Caestus
item:spiked-caestus.description: A Caestus with the rivets replaced by blood loss-inducing spikes. Fists weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will it to both hands.
item:spiked-caestus.location: Get the Spiked Caestus at the Isolated Merchant Shack in northern Caelid.

item:spiked-club.name: Spiked Club
item:spiked-club.description: A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss. Given only to the toughest of demi-humans, this weapon is a badge of honor. Or so the demi-humans believe.
item:spiked-club.location: The Spiked Club in Elden Ring is acquired by farming large, chief-type Demi-Humans who wield the weapon, featuring a 2% base drop rate.

item:spiked-cracked-tear.name: Spiked Cracked Tear
item:spiked-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Enhances charged attacks for a time in mixed physick

item:spiked-cracked-tear.location: - Found at an altar near Mistwood's Minor Erdtree, along with Greenspill Crystal Tear
