item:spiked-palisade-shield.name: Spiked Palisade Shield
item:spiked-palisade-shield.description: Designed to perform shield bashes, these attacks riddle the enemy with holes, earning it the nickname of "pard shield"
item:spiked-palisade-shield.location: Looted from a corpse at the feet of a Guardian Golem in the chasm northwest of the Deep Siofra Well in Caelid.

item:spiked-spear.name: Spiked Spear
item:spiked-spear.description: Weapon comprised of a spiked cylinder attached to a long pole. Capaable of dealing strike damage when swung. The spikes induce blood loss. Weapon of the Marionette Soliders employed by sorcerers.
item:spiked-spear.location: The Spiked Spear in Elden Ring is farmed by defeating Marionette Soldiers who wield spears near the Converted Tower in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:spinning-slash.name: Spinning Slash
item:spinning-slash.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Spinning Slash: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack."Usable on swords, axes, and polearms (colossal weapons excepted).
item:spinning-slash.location:
**Purchase:** Stormhill / Volcano Manor
- 1x Sold for 1,200 Runes from Bernahl at either the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill or the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor.
- Should Bernahl be killed before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Bernahl's Bell Bearing.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:spinning-strikes.name: Spinning Strikes
item:spinning-strikes.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Spinning Strikes: Polearm skill that performs continuous spinning attacks. Hold to continue the attack. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack. Nullifies projectiles such as arrows while spinning."Usable on polearms (great spears excepted).
item:spinning-strikes.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Weeping Peninsula / Liurnia of the Lakes
- Drops from Castellan Edgar at Castle Morne or when he eventually invades the player by the Revenger's Shack in Liurnia.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:spinning-weapon.name: Spinning Weapon
item:spinning-weapon.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:"Spinning Weapon: Defensive skill employed by Carian princesses. Lifts armament into mid-air, then makes it spin violently. Those it touches will suffer successive attacks."Usable on small and medium swords, axes, and hammers, as well as polearms and staves (great spears excepted)
item:spinning-weapon.location:
**Purchase:** Stormveil Castle / Roundtable Hold
- Sold by Sorcerer Rogier for 1,000 Runes.
- Should Rogier die before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Rogier's Bell Bearing.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:spira.name: Spira
item:spira.location:
**Loot:** Enir-Ilim.
- From the First Rise Site of Grace, pass the fountain surrounded by Inquisitors and go up the stairs. Thereafter, find a way to walk on the branches to cross over to the platform with the single praying Inquisitor.

item:spiralhorn-shield.name: Spiralhorn Shield
item:spiralhorn-shield.description: Small shield of antlers arranged in an eddy-like pattern. If used to attack a foe, the shield's antlers inflict blood loss. Once given to a Tarnished warrior who cultivated close ties to the ancestral followers. Though the effect is only slight, it boosts immunity, robustness, and focus.
item:spiralhorn-shield.location: Found on a corpse on a ledge to the northwest of the Ruined Labyrinth Site of Grace in the Uld Palace Ruins in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:spiraltree-seal.name: Spiraltree Seal
item:spiraltree-seal.location: Reward for solving "The Sacred Tower" Painting puzzle. It can only be solved after using Messmer's Kindling on the Sealing Tree past Romina, Saint of the Bud.

item:spirit-calling-bell.name: Spirit Calling Bell
item:spirit-calling-bell.description: A bell capable of summoning various spirits from ashen remains. It usually requires FP to use.

stats.Effect: Bell that summons various spirits from ashen items

item:spirit-calling-bell.location: **Location A**: Church of Elleh during the night - After receiving the Spectral Steed Whistle from Melina, head to the Church of Elleh in Limgrave where Renna sits on a ruined wall during the night. Talk to her, and she'll give the Spirit Calling Bell, noting it was entrusted to her by Torrent's former master. - If it is not nighttime, pass time at a Site of Grace. **Location B**: Roundtable Hold - After meeting Ranni the Witch at Ranni's Rise, Renna will no longer appear at the Church of Elleh.

item:spirit-glaive.name: Spirit Glaive

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int D

item:spirit-glaive.location: - In order to obtain this weapon, you first start at the site of grace at Charo's Hidden Grave and walk through the arch to the northwest, turn right directly after and take the path that ramps up north, follow it to where it meets the edge of the Gravesite Plain and it will be on a grave.

item:spirit-jellyfish-ashes.name: Spirit Jellyfish Ashes
item:spirit-jellyfish-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon a spirit jellyfish.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit jellyfish.

item:spirit-jellyfish-ashes.location:
Given by Roderika, Spirit Tuner at Stormhill Shack after talking to her.

If it hasn't been obtained by the time Roderika moves to Roundtable Hold it is possible to still obtain it by talking with her, though this option might not be offered if the game progresses to a certain unknown point after Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:spirit-sword.name: Spirit Sword

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int D

item:spirit-sword.location: This weapon can be found in Cerulean Coast, northeast from the  Cerulean Coast West site of grace, the entrance to a triangular ravine can be accessed. It's in the right corner in that lower area, near some demi-humans.

item:spread-crossbow.name: Spread Crossbow
item:spread-crossbow.location: Found along the ravine south of the  Castle Front Site of Grace outside Castle Ensis.

item:square-off.name: Square Off
item:square-off.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Square Off: This skill starts with the sword held level. Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust"Usable on straight swords.
item:square-off.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Siofra River
- Drops from a Scarab north-northwest of the Worshippers' Woods Site of Grace near the edge of a cliff.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:st-trina-s-torch.name: St. Trina's Torch
item:st-trina-s-torch.description: Candlestand torch that burns with a light-purple flame. The carvings depict St. Trina, but in adult form, somewhat unnervingly.  The light-purple flame induces sleep.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Fai D

item:st-trina-s-torch.location: To get St. Trina's Torch in Elden Ring, you must travel to a guarded carriage caravan in the Consecrated Snowfield.

item:staff-of-loss.name: Staff Of Loss
item:staff-of-loss.description: Staff missing its glintstone. Wielded by sorcerers who believe that discovery comes through acts of asceticism. This staff is only capable of casting invisibility sorceries, but that is reason enough for some to wield it.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Int C

item:staff-of-loss.location: To get the Staff of Loss, travel to Sellia, Town of Sorcery in northeastern Caelid.

item:staff-of-the-avatar.name: Staff Of The Avatar
item:staff-of-the-avatar.description: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees. The avatars, emerging in the wake of the Elden Ring's shattering, were determined to protect the withering Erdtree's offspring.

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Fai D

item:staff-of-the-avatar.location: To get the Staff of the Avatar in Elden Ring, travel to the Deeproot Depths, find the Great Waterfall Crest Site of Grace, and defeat the Erdtree Avatar nearby.

item:staff-of-the-great-beyond.name: Staff of the Great Beyond

stats.Scaling: Str E · Int D · Fai D

item:staff-of-the-great-beyond.location:
Trade the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers, dropped by Metyr, Mother of Fingers, with Finger Reader Enia.

Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

item:staff-of-the-guilty.name: Staff Of The Guilty
item:staff-of-the-guilty.description: A heretical staff fashioned from a smoldering, withered sapling that turns the blood of sacrifices pierced by it into glinstone. Similar to hex magic. Sorceries are scaled with faith rather than intelligence when weilding this staff which enhances Thorn sorceries in particular.
item:staff-of-the-guilty.location: To get the Staff of the Guilty in Elden Ring, you must farm Thorn Sorcerers who wield blazing red staves at locations like Fort Laiedd or Guardian's Garrison, as it is a rare random drop.

item:stalwart-horn-charm.name: Stalwart Horn Charm
item:stalwart-horn-charm.description: An accoutrement worn by the ancestral followers. Greatly raises robustness. (Robustness governs resistance to blood loss and frost.)  Said to be a budding horn. The ancestral followers believe that the horns of a long-lived beast continue to bud like antlers, over and over again, until the beast one day becomes an ancestral spirit.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises robustness

item:stalwart-horn-charm.location: - Obtained from a corpse in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes. From Mausoleum Compound, head north up an incline, then left, and proceed southwest to a large tall rock formation. Walk counterclockwise around this formation to find a hole in the formation, forming an archway over a small ledge. Drop down from this ledge and head left to find the corpse, dangling over the edge of a cliff.

item:stamp-sweep.name: Stamp (sweep)
item:stamp-sweep.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Stamp (Sweep): Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks. Follow up with a strong attack for a sweeping strike"Usable on swords, axes, and hammers (small and medium swords excepted)
item:stamp-sweep.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Limgrave
- Drops from an invisible Scarab rolling around on Limgrave's western shores, northwest of the First Step Site of Grace.
  - Since the charge heavy attack when on Torrent as a long, lingering hitbox it is very useful. Alternatively, Glintblade Phalanx and its skill counterpart will fire off when the scarab is close and in front of the character,
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:stamp-upward-cut.name: Stamp (upward Cut)
item:stamp-upward-cut.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Stamp (Upward Cut): Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks. Follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike."Usable on swords, axes, and hammers, (small and medium swords excepted).
item:stamp-upward-cut.location:
**Purchase:** Stormhill / Volcano Manor
- x1 Can be purchased for 1,500 Runes from Bernahl at either the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill or the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor.
- Should Bernahl be killed before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Bernahl's Bell Bearing.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:stanching-boluses.name: Stanching Boluses
item:stanching-boluses.description: Red boluses made from cave moss Craftable item. Alleviates impending blood loss Blood loss escalates gradually, causing great damage once the threshold is reached. Take one of these in timely fashion to avoid such an event.

stats.Effect: Alleviates impending blood loss

item:star-fist.name: Star Fist
item:star-fist.description: Spherical iron manifer covered in spikes which induce blood loss.  Used in brutal games of pugilism.
item:star-fist.location: To get the Star Fist in Elden Ring, travel to the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:star-lined-sword.name: Star-Lined Sword

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Int D

item:star-lined-sword.location: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Marigga on the Cerulean Coast.

item:star-shower.name: Star Shower
item:star-shower.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires six magic shooting stars that pursue the target. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances potency. The most difficult to master of the Olivinus Conspectus sorceries.
item:star-shower.location: **Purchase:** Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold - Sold for 10,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Conspectus Scroll. - Should the scroll be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Sorcery, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Fires six shooting stars that pursue foes

item:stargazer-heirloom.name: Stargazer Heirloom
item:stargazer-heirloom.description: A talisman engraved with the legend of a queen. Raises intelligence.

stats.Effect: Raises intelligence by 5.

item:stargazer-heirloom.location: Found in the Divine Tower of Liurnia.

item:starlight.name: Starlight
item:starlight.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
item:starlight.location:
**Purchase:** Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 2,500 Runes by Sorcerer Thops at the Church of Irith.
- Should Thops die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Thops's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Creates star light to illuminate surroundings

item:starlight-shards.name: Starlight Shards
item:starlight-shards.description: An ephemeral sliver that gives off a pale blue glow.

stats.Effect: Use to gradually recover FP

item:starlight-shards.location:
- Typically found at the base of Stone Hemicycliums throughout the Lands Between and Realm of Shadow.
  - Astrolabes are commonly found near Rises or areas associated with Moon-worship.
- Starlight Shards are plentiful around and inside the Cathedral of Manus Celes on the Moonlight Altar.

item:stars-of-ruin.name: Stars Of Ruin
item:stars-of-ruin.description: Legendary sorcery devised by Lusat, primeval sorcerers.

stats.Effect: Fire twelve dark shooting stars that pursue foes

related: Sellen — sided with her against Jerren

item:starscourge-greatsword.name: Starscourge Greatsword
item:starscourge-greatsword.description: Curved greatswords of black steel wielded by General Radahn. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. Radahn earned considerable renown as the Starscourge in this youth, and it is said that it was during this time he engraved the gravity crest up these blades.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int E

item:starscourge-heirloom.name: Starscourge Heirloom
item:starscourge-heirloom.description: A talisman engraved with a scene from a heroic tale. Raises strength.

stats.Effect: Raises strength

item:starscourge-heirloom.location:
**Location**: Fort Gael
- Obtained from a chest in Fort Gael, located in western Caelid. The chest is found beneath a canopy on the upper platform of the fort.

item:steel-wire-torch.name: Steel-wire Torch
item:steel-wire-torch.description: Torch wound with metal wire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or be used to attack enemies. Heavier than a normal torch, but the heated filament boosts fire damage dealt.
item:steel-wire-torch.location: The Steel-Wire Torch in Elden Ring is found on a corpse along the ramparts of Castle Morne on the Weeping Peninsula.

item:stimulating-boluses.name: Stimulating Boluses
item:stimulating-boluses.description: Light-purple boluses made from cave moss. Craftable item. Alleviates buildup of sleep. Sleep accumulates gradually, causing sudden fogginess and loss of FP once the threshold is reached, even if it does not force the afflicted into true slumber. Take one of these into timely fashion to avoid such events.

stats.Effect: Alleviates buildup of sleep

item:stone-club.name: Stone Club
item:stone-club.description: Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone.  This club is much heavier than its size suggests, but has no magic power. So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand.
item:stone-club.location: The Stone Club is a rare weapon in Elden Ring that drops from Battlemage enemies.

item:stone-of-gurranq.name: Stone Of Gurranq
item:stone-of-gurranq.description: Superior incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.
item:stone-of-gurranq.location:
**Quest Item:** Bestial Sanctum, Greyoll's Dragonbarrow
- Stone of Gurranq is rewarded from Gurranq after giving him the sixth Deathroot. (However, only after Gurranq has been calmed down after he turns hostile on the player's return to him after consuming the fourth Deathroot.)

stats.Effect: Hurls a boulder before the caster

item:stone-sheathed-sword.name: Stone-Sheathed Sword
item:stone-sheathed-sword.location: - Found at an altar in either Fog Rift Catacombs, Ruins of Unte, or Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Since the altar in Fog Rift Catacombs is the most complicated to reach, it's recommended that the sword be taken there so that the later interactions with altars are less time-consuming. - <font color="red">**WARNING**</font>: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle.

item:stonebarb-cracked-tear.name: Stonebarb Cracked Tear
item:stonebarb-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Make attacks more likely to break enemy stances in a mixed physick

item:stonebarb-cracked-tear.location: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in Caelid, on the cliffs north-east of the Smoldering Church.

item:stonesword-key.name: Stonesword Key

stats.Effect: Use to break one imp statue seal

item:stonesword-key.location: **Purchase** - Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold (x3) - Patches in Murkwater Cave (x1) - Nomadic Merchant (Castle Morne Rampart) (x1) - Isolated Merchant (Weeping Peninsula) (x3) - Abandoned Merchant (Siofra River) (x3) **Loot** - Keepsakes choice at character creation. - Limgrave: On a corpse in a tower at Dragon-Burnt Ruins. - Weeping Peninsula: On a corpse at the Bridge of Sacrifice. - Weeping Peninsula: On a chair on the northeastern cliffs, above the entrance to Impaler's Catacombs. - Castle Morne: Found on a wooden ledge near the "Behind the Castle" .

item:storm-assault.name: Storm Assault
item:storm-assault.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Storm Assault: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Leap forward through surrounding storm winds and thrust armament downward. The attack will produce more storm winds at the point of impact."Usable on polearms capable of thrusting, heavy thrusting swords, and twinblades.
item:storm-assault.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Stormveil Castle
- Drops from a Scarab found on Stormveil's western cliffside. It can be reached by jumping down the outer rampart to the west just north of the Rampart Tower Site of Grace, the same route where you'll find the Marred Wooden Shield.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:storm-blade.name: Storm Blade
item:storm-blade.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Storm Blade: Lost skill of Stormveil. Surround armament with shearing storm winds that can be fired forward. Can be fired in rapid succession."Usable on swords (colossal weapons and twinblades excepted).
item:storm-blade.location:
**Purchase:** Stormhill / Volcano Manor
- Sold by Bernahl for 1,800 Runes at either the Warmaster's Shack of the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor.
- Should Bernahl die before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Bernahl's Bell Bearing.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:storm-stomp.name: Storm Stomp
item:storm-stomp.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Storm Stomp: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Stomp hard on the ground to kick up a momentary storm."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:storm-stomp.location:
**Loot:** Limgrave
- Found in the treasure chest located in the cellar of Gatefront Ruins alongside the Whetstone Knife.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:storm-wall.name: Storm Wall
item:storm-wall.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Storm Wall: Swing the shield to create a wall of storm winds in front of you, deflecting arrows and other such physical projectiles. Can also be used in the same way as a regular parry."Usable on small and medium shields.
item:storm-wall.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Stormhill
- Drops from a Scarab on the cliffs outside of Stormveil's eastern walls. It can be found in a dip in the cliffside after jumping off the collapsed bridge (where Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [7] is found).
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
item:stormcaller.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Stormcaller: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Spin armament to create surrounding storm winds. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks."Usable on swords capable of slashing, axes, hammers, and polearms (small and colossal weapons excepted).
item:stormcaller.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Stormveil Castle
- Drops from a Scarab found east of the Secluded Cell Site of Grace.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:stormhawk-axe.name: Stormhawk Axe
item:stormhawk-axe.description: Battle axe designed to resemble a hawk, wioth its wings comprising the blade. Signature weapon of warriors who strive to remain one with the storm, despite being so far from their place of birth. Their hearts are proud, and thereby easily undone.
item:stormhawk-axe.location: The Stormhawk Axe can be obtained in two main ways: by defeating the NPC Nepheli Loux, or by looting it from specific locations in the Royal Capital or Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:stormhawk-deenh.name: Stormhawk Deenh
item:stormhawk-deenh.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Deenh the Stormhawk.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Stormhawk Dreenh

item:stormhawk-deenh.location: Found in the Chapel of Anticipation. After returning to the area via the portal at The Four Belfries, go through the previously locked door near the main entrance, and follow the staircase into the upper level of the chapel to find the ashes.

item:stormhawk-feather.name: Stormhawk Feather
item:stormhawk-feather.description: A feather from a hawk that lived as one with the storms. Material used for crafting items. These feathers, enveloped in swirling winds, are often used for arrow fletching.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:strength-knot-crystal-tear.name: Strength-knot Crystal Tear
item:strength-knot-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts strength in mixed physick

item:strength-knot-crystal-tear.location: Found inside of a bowl at a cliff north-east of the Stormhill Shack, west of the Warmaster's Shack. There will be a Troll guarding it.

item:string.name: String
item:string.description: Boasting no special qualities, this is merely a goodly length of string.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:string.location: - Four found in the ground level sewers of Leyndell, Royal Capital. From the Lower Capital Church Site of Grace, go down the ladder straight ahead and take the lower left route then turn right at the next turn. It is on the left side, guarded by 3 Giant Rats and 1 small Fingercreeper. - Five found in Hermit Village, atop the roof of the southwesternmost house. - Five found in Altus Plateau guarded by some Demi-Humans north of the Grand Lift of Dectus and northeast of Altus Plateau Site of Grace. - Dropped by Demi-Humans of all varieties with a 5% droprate.

item:strip-of-white-flesh.name: Strip Of White Flesh
item:strip-of-white-flesh.description: Thin strips of flesh taken from a bloodless creature. Material used for crafting items. The dried meat toughens the constitution, boosting resistance. It's known for its long-lasting effect.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:sun-realm-shield.name: Sun Realm Shield
item:sun-realm-shield.description: Shield of honor depicting a city crowned by the sun. It has seen better days. Much like the wear upon the shield, the Seat of the Sun is long faded away.
item:sun-realm-shield.location: 2% chance to be dropped from various Skeleton Knights who carry it.

item:surge-o-flame.name: Surge, O Flame!
item:surge-o-flame.description: Superior incantation of the Fire Monks.
item:surge-o-flame.location: **Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants - Sold for 5,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Fire Monks' Prayerbook. - Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Incinerates area before caster with stream of fire

item:swarm-of-flies.name: Swarm Of Flies
item:swarm-of-flies.description: A Blood Oath incantation, shared from the Lord of Blood's power. Releases a swarm of bloodflies before the caster to assault foes. The vile swarm deals damage and builds up onset of blood loss. This incantation can be cast while in motion. The new palace of the Lord of Blood lies in a swamp of festering blood, and these flies are said to spawn from excrement in that land.
item:swarm-of-flies.location:
**Loot:** Mohgwyn Palace
- Located on a corpse at the end of one of the caves found in the northeastern quarter of the lake of blood.

stats.Effect: Releases a swarm of bloodflies before the caster

item:swift-glintstone-shard.name: Swift Glintstone Shard
item:swift-glintstone-shard.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching swift magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be used without delay after performing another action. Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.
item:swift-glintstone-shard.location: Bought from Miriel or Sellen once the Academy Scroll is handed in.

stats.Effect: Swiftly fires magic projectiles from glintstone

item:swift-spear.name: Swift Spear
item:swift-spear.location:
**Location**: Gravesite Plain
- The weapon can be found lying on a corpse guarded by 3 Messmer Soldiers along the upper road going southeast from the  Castle Front site of grace outside Castle Ensis.

item:sword-dance.name: Sword Dance
item:sword-dance.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Sword Dance: Quickly close in to perform a series of spinning upward slashes. Follow up with an additional input to finish with a downward slash."Usable on swords, axes, and polearms capable of slashing (colossal weapons and great spears excepted).
item:sword-dance.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Drops from a Scarab near the Minor Erdtree in west-Liurnia, on the path down to the Road's End Catacombs.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:sword-lance.name: Sword Lance
item:sword-lance.location: Can be obtained after trading Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.

item:sword-of-darkness.name: Sword of Darkness

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai E

item:sword-of-darkness.location: - Take the Stone-Sheathed Sword or Sword of Light to an altar at either Fog Rift Catacombs or Ruins of Unte. - <font color="red">**WARNING**</font>: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle. - See the page for the Stone-Sheathed Sword for all 3 altar locations.

item:sword-of-light.name: Sword of Light

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai E

item:sword-of-light.location: - Take the Stone-Sheathed Sword or Sword of Darkness to an altar at either Fog Rift Catacombs or Ancient Ruins of Rauh. - <font color="red">**WARNING**</font>: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle. - See the page for the Stone-Sheathed Sword for all 3 altar locations.

item:sword-of-milos.name: Sword Of Milos
item:sword-of-milos.description: Sinister greatsword fashioned from a giant's backbone. The spines along each side of the blade have been tapered to a fine point and mete out wounds like a lopside saw-blade. Milos was indersized for a giant, and was viewed as sullied and terribly gortesque.
item:sword-of-milos.location: To get the Sword of Milos, you must defeat the Dung Eater.
related: Dung Eater — defeated at the Leyndell moat
Forge of the Giants / burning the Erdtree

item:sword-of-night.name: Sword of Night
item:sword-of-night.location: - Complete Jolán, Swordhand of Night's questline.

item:sword-of-night-and-flame.name: Sword Of Night And Flame
item:sword-of-night-and-flame.description: Storied sword and treasure of Caria Manor. One of the legendary armaments. Astrologers, who preceded the sroveres, established themselves in mountaintops that nearly touched the sky, and considered the Fire Giants their neighbors.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Int D · Fai D

item:sword-of-st-trina.name: Sword Of St Trina
item:sword-of-st-trina.description: Silver sword carried by clerics of St. Trina. Inflicts sleep ailment upon foes. St. Trina is an enigmatic figure. Some say she is a comely young girl, others are sure he is a boy. The only certainty is that their appearance was as sudden as their disappearance.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int E

item:sword-of-st-trina.location: To get the original Sword of St. Trina in the base game, travel to the Rotview Balcony Site of Grace in Caelid, head down to the Forsaken Ruins while avoiding the giant crows, use a Stonesword Key on the imp statue basement seal, and open the chest inside.

item:tailoring-tools.name: Tailoring Tools
item:tailoring-tools.description: A portable set of tailoring tools.

stats.Effect: Enables armor adjustment at sites of grace

item:tailoring-tools.location:
**Location**: Coastal Cave
- The Tailoring Tools are obtained alongside the Sewing Needle upon defeating the Demi-Human Chiefs at Coastal Cave.

item:taker-s-cameo.name: Taker's Cameo
item:taker-s-cameo.description: A talisman engraved with a stern likeness of Praetor Rykard, master of Volcano Manor.

stats.Effect: Restores HP upon defeating enemies

item:taker-s-cameo.location: - Obtained from Tanith in Volcano Manor in central Mt. Gelmir after completing the third assassination quest, by killing Juno Hoslow in northern Mountaintops of the Giants, near the Shack of the Lofty.

item:talisman-pouch.name: Talisman Pouch
item:talisman-pouch.description: Small, withered bag, knitted by hand. Bestowed upon the ruling lord, or those atempting to become lord, by the elderly Finger Reader.

stats.Effect: Increases Talisman equip slots.

item:talisman-pouch.location:
**Location A**: Defeat Margit, the Fell Omen
- Rewarded automatically upon his defeat at the entrance of Stormveil Castle.

**Location B**: Speak to Finger Reader Enia
- After defeating two or more Shardbearers, speak with Enia at the Roundtable Hold to receive the second pouch.

**Location C**: Defeat Godfrey, First Elden Lord (golden shade)
- Drops upon defeating him in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:tarnished-golden-sunflower.name: Tarnished Golden Sunflower
item:tarnished-golden-sunflower.description: A large flower that blooms facing the Erdtree. Material used for crafting items. Found near Minor Erdtrees.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:tarnished-golden-sunflower.location: - Most commonly found around Minor Erdtrees in Limgrave, Weeping Peninsula, Liurnia of the Lakes (northeast), and Caelid. - The Minor Erdtree (Limgrave), located in Mistwood, has many of these flowers around it and is not guarded by an Erdtree Avatar or Guardians. - Another location is in the Weeping Peninsula, found in an open field beneath a broken wall north of the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace or southwest of the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace. Be cautious of a Deathbird that spawns at night here, but the Holy Water Pot crafted from this material can aid in defeating it.

item:tarnished-s-furled-finger.name: Tarnished's Furled Finger
item:tarnished-s-furled-finger.description: Item for online play. Creates a summon sign for cooperative multiplayer. Your objective will be to defeat the area boss of the world to which you were summoned. A finger of corpse wax, furled like a hook. It is a relic of those who came before, left to help those who would come after.

stats.Effect: Creates cooperative multiplayer summon sign.

item:tarnished-s-wizened-finger.name: Tarnished's Wizened Finger
item:tarnished-s-wizened-finger.description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Messages menu.) Use to write messages. Your messages will be conveyed to other worlds, allowing other players to read them. A finger of corpse wax, so emaciated the bone is visible. It is a relic of those who came before, left to help those who would come after.

stats.Effect: Used to write messages.

item:tarnished-s-wizened-finger.location:
**Location**: Chapel of Anticipation
- The Tarnished's Wizened Finger is looted from a corpse at the Chapel of Anticipation.

item:taunter-s-tongue.name: Taunter's Tongue
item:taunter-s-tongue.description: Item for online play. Lures in invaders. This allows your world to be invaded without any Furled Finger cooperators present, and it also shortens the interval between windows of opportunity for invasion. Additionally, enables the arrival of a second invader. (When two invaders are present, you will be limited to one cooperator.)

stats.Effect: Lures in invanders.

item:telescope.name: Telescope
item:telescope.description: Astrology tool used by members of the Carian royal family. Part of a larger instrument, removed and stolen away. Allows the viewer to better see faraway things. During the age of the Erdtree, Carian astrology withered on the vine. The fate once writ in the night skies had been fettered by the Golden Order.

stats.Effect: Allows viewer to see faraway things

item:terra-magicus.name: Terra Magicus
item:terra-magicus.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Draws an academy sigil upon the ground, raising the magic strength of those within. Once, the sigil would be cast from the highest belfry of the academy, covering the entire institution's grounds. This spell allows such vivid experience of spell—casting success, it turns many a fledgling into a true sorcerer in a flash of newfound understanding.

stats.Effect: Raises the magic strength of those within the sigil

item:thawfrost-boluses.name: Thawfrost Boluses
item:thawfrost-boluses.description: Ice-hued boluses made from cave moss. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Alleviates buildup of frost

item:thawfrost-boluses.location: Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).

item:the-flame-of-frenzy.name: The Flame Of Frenzy
item:the-flame-of-frenzy.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.
item:the-flame-of-frenzy.location:
**Loot:** Weeping Peninsula
- The Flame of Frenzy is found on a corpse in the Callu Baptismal Church near the Frenzied Flame Village, located in the middle of the Weeping Peninsula.

stats.Effect: Emits burst of yellow flame of frenzy from eyes

item:the-stormhawk-king.name: The Stormhawk King
item:the-stormhawk-king.description: Ashes of a hawk revered by all others as sovereign back in the days when Stormveil's winds still raged like no other. This ancient monarch is proud however, refusing to answer anyone's summons.

stats.Effect: Ashes of a hawk which heeds no summons.

item:the-stormhawk-king.location:
**Location**: Chapel of Anticipation
- Use an Imbued Sword Key to activate the Sending Gate at The Four Belfries labeled "Precipice of Anticipation."
- Return to the Chapel of Anticipation and defeat the Grafted Scion.
- Enter the previously locked side door and ascend to the rooftop to find The Stormhawk King.

item:theodorix-s-magma.name: Theodorix's Magma
item:theodorix-s-magma.description: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of the great wyrm Theodorix. Transforms caster into a great wyrm to spew a large volume of magma breath. Allows one follow-up attack. The name of the ancient troll warrior Theodorix lives on — as a hero of the War against the Giants.
item:theodorix-s-magma.location:
**Dragon Communion:** Limgrave / Caelid / Jagged Peak
- Acquired from the altar at the Church of Dragon Communion in Limgrave, the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid, and the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak for 2 Dragon Hearts after defeating Great Wyrm Theodorix in Consecrated Snowfield.

stats.Effect: Spews magma breath of Theodorix from above

item:thin-beast-bones.name: Thin Beast Bones
item:thin-beast-bones.description: Thin, hard beast bones. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting beasts.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:thiollier-s-hidden-needle.name: Thiollier's Hidden Needle

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Int D

item:thiollier-s-hidden-needle.location: Acquired from Thiollier after defeating Promised Consort Radahn at the top of Enir-Ilim, but only if you have completed his quest line before reaching Needle Knight Leda in the Cleansing Chamber.

item:thops-barrier.name: Thops's Barrier
item:thops-barrier.description: The lifelong pursuit of Thops the Bluntstone.

stats.Effect: Erect a magic forcefield to deflect spells

related: Find Thops’s body at Raya Lucaria

item:thorned-whip.name: Thorned Whip
item:thorned-whip.description: Hefty whip coverd in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of fin.  Very effective at inflicting blood loss.
item:thorned-whip.location: The Thorned Whip is a rare drop from a specific Fire Prelate located in the Mountaintops of the Giants region.

item:thorny-cracked-tear.name: Thorny Cracked Tear
item:thorny-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction makes consecutive attacks grow stronger the longer they continue. However, the effect lasts only for a short time.

stats.Effect: Makes consecutive attacks grow stronger in mixed physick.

item:thorny-cracked-tear.location: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in Consecrated Snowfield, east of Ordina, Liturgical Town.

item:through-and-through.name: Through And Through
item:through-and-through.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Through and Through: Powerful archery skill using a greatbow held in an oblique stance. Ready the greatbow, then twist the bowstring to fire a mighty greatarrow that can penetrate through enemies."Usable on greatbows.
item:through-and-through.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Mt. Gelmir
- Drops from a invisible Scarab rolling around northwest of Volcano Manor's main entrance.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to inflict damage

item:thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
item:thunderbolt.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Lightning affinity and the following skill:"Thunderbolt: Skill used by the capital's ancient dragon cult. Raise armament aloft to call down a bolt of lightning. Can be fired in rapid succession."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:thunderbolt.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Leyndell, Royal Capital.
- Drops from a Scarab located in the middle of a courtyard surrounded by ruined buildings, between the bridge down the stairs of the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace and the corpse of the great ancient dragon, Gransax.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:tibia-s-summons.name: Tibia's Summons
item:tibia-s-summons.description: Sorcery of the servants of Death. Summons a group of Those Lost in Death. Three skeletons will appear some distance from the caster and attack foes before disappearing. The dead have long been left to wander; what they need is leadership.
item:tibia-s-summons.location:
- Altus Plateau,(Wyndham Ruins)
  - **Drop:** From the Tibia Mariner miniboss rowing through the waters.

stats.Effect: Summons Those Who Live in Death

item:tooth-whip.name: Tooth Whip
item:tooth-whip.location: Found inside the Whipping Hut on the outskirts of Bonny Village, across a rope bridge.

item:torch.name: Torch
item:torch.description: This torch's tip is wrapped in oil-soaked rags and set on fire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or used to attack enemies. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area.

stats.Effect: Phy 54 Mag 0 Fire 97 Ligt 0 Holy 0 Crit 100

item:torch.location: The easiest way to get a torch in Elden Ring is to purchase the standard Torch for 200 Runes from Merchant Kalé at the Church of Elleh in West Limgrave.

item:torchpole.name: Torchpole
item:torchpole.description: Torch fastened to a long pole. Lights up dark areas, but cannot be raised overhead. Used by soldiers on watch, its attacks set foes aflame.
item:torchpole.location: To get the Torchpole in Elden Ring, you must farm the Exiled Soldiers who carry torch poles in Stormveil Castle.

item:toxic-mushroom.name: Toxic Mushroom
item:toxic-mushroom.description: A mushroom covered in toxic mold that grows in rotten lands. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:toxic-mushroom.location: - Harvestable Toxic Mushrooms are found growing in the rotten lands of Caelid and Lake of Rot, particularly in areas afflicted by scarlet rot.

item:traveler-s-boots.name: Traveler's Boots

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:traveler-s-boots.location: - Found right next to the Haligtree Roots site of grace.

item:traveler-s-clothes.name: Traveler's Clothes

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 4 · Pierce 2 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:traveler-s-clothes.location:
**Location**: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
- The Traveler's Clothes are looted from the rotflower in the sideroom beside the  Haligtree Roots site of grace.

item:traveler-s-gloves.name: Traveler's Gloves
item:traveler-s-gloves.description: Gloves of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:traveler-s-gloves.location:
**Location**: Street of Sages Ruins
- The Traveler's Gloves are found on a corpse alongside the rest of the Perfumer's Traveling Set in the Street of Sages Ruins, north of the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid.

item:traveler-s-hat.name: Traveler's Hat
item:traveler-s-hat.description: Hat of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:traveler-s-hat.location: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside the Street of Sages Ruins located north of Aeonia Swamp in Caelid.

item:traveler-s-manchettes.name: Traveler's Manchettes

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:traveler-s-manchettes.location:
**Location**: Haligtree Roots
- The Traveler's Manchettes are found next to the Haligtree Roots site of grace.

item:traveler-s-slops.name: Traveler's Slops
item:traveler-s-slops.description: Slops of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:traveler-s-slops.location: - Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside the Street of Sages Ruins located north of Aeonia Swamp in Caelid.

item:traveling-maiden-boots.name: Traveling Maiden Boots

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:traveling-maiden-boots.location: Found on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty, located on the west end of the river in Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:traveling-maiden-gloves.name: Traveling Maiden Gloves

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:traveling-maiden-gloves.location:
**Location**: Shack of the Lofty
- The Traveling Maiden Gloves are found on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:traveling-maiden-hood.name: Traveling Maiden Hood

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:traveling-maiden-hood.location: Found on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty located on the west end of the river in Moutaintops of the Giants.

item:traveling-maiden-robe.name: Traveling Maiden Robe
item:traveling-maiden-robe.description: Robe worn by traveling maidens. Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:traveling-maiden-robe.location: Found on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty located on the west end of the river in Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:traveling-maiden-robe-altered.name: Traveling Maiden Robe (altered)
item:traveling-maiden-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Traveling Maiden Robe

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 2 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:traveling-maiden-robe-altered.location: Found unaltered on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty located on the west end of the river in Mountaintops of the Giants. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

item:tree-and-beast-surcoat.name: Tree-and-beast Surcoat
item:tree-and-beast-surcoat.description: Armor worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted. The surcoat depicts the distant Erdtree and the beast regent, an emblem of the golden lineage. Both are symbols of glory now past.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 11 · Slash 12 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 8 · Holy 9

item:tree-and-beast-surcoat.location: Chance to drop from Godrick Soldier enemies.

item:tree-sentinel-armor.name: Tree Sentinel Armor
item:tree-sentinel-armor.description: Golden armor of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

stats.Negation: Physical 18 · Strike 15 · Slash 18 · Pierce 17 · Magic 13 · Fire 17 · Lightning 12 · Holy 14

item:tree-sentinel-armor.location: Received upon destroying the Merciless Chariots patrolling the Auriza Hero's Grave, located in the Capital Outskirts.

item:tree-sentinel-armor-altered.name: Tree Sentinel Armor (altered)
item:tree-sentinel-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Tree Sentinel Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 18 · Strike 15 · Slash 18 · Pierce 17 · Magic 13 · Fire 16 · Lightning 12 · Holy 14

item:tree-sentinel-armor-altered.location: Received unaltered upon destroying the Merciless Chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:tree-sentinel-gauntlets.name: Tree Sentinel Gauntlets
item:tree-sentinel-gauntlets.description: Golden gauntlets of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:tree-sentinel-gauntlets.location:
**Location**: Auriza Hero's Grave
- The Tree Sentinel Gauntlets are obtained upon destroying the Merciless Chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in the Altus Plateau.

item:tree-sentinel-greaves.name: Tree Sentinel Greaves
item:tree-sentinel-greaves.description: Golden greaves of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 8 · Slash 10 · Pierce 10 · Magic 7 · Fire 9 · Lightning 7 · Holy 8

item:tree-sentinel-greaves.location: Received upon destroying the chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau.

item:tree-sentinel-helm.name: Tree Sentinel Helm
item:tree-sentinel-helm.description: Golden helm of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 6 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:tree-sentinel-helm.location:
**Location**: Auriza Hero's Grave
- Received upon destroying the Merciless Chariots inside the Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau.

item:tree-surcoat.name: Tree Surcoat
item:tree-surcoat.description: Blue surcoat draped over chainmail. The tree insignia emblazoned on the front depicts the Erdtree, and is a design beloved throughout the Lands Between.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 8 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 8 · Fire 10 · Lightning 7 · Holy 8

item:treespear.name: Treespear
item:treespear.description: Golden spear with tree-like design. Wielded by knights employed as palace guards in the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Deals only holy damage.  Requiring superior dexterity to wield, this greatspear can perform consecutive thrust attacks despite its larger size.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:treespear.location: The Treespear is located in a chest on the back of an abandoned carriage in southeastern Liurnia of the Lakes, just south of a broken bridge.

item:trina-s-lily.name: Trina's Lily
item:trina-s-lily.description: A pale purple water lily that is on the verge of wilting. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. A symbol of faith in St. Trina. Dulls the senses, preventing agitation.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:trina-s-lily.location: Trina's Lilies grow in hidden corners throughout the Lands Between. Once a lily has been picked up, it will not respawn until the next playthrough. They can be found in every single region except Caelid, Ainsel River, and Deeproot Depths.

item:triple-rings-of-light.name: Triple Rings Of Light
item:triple-rings-of-light.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Produces three rings of light and fires them forwards. The rings of light return to a position close to the caster before disappearing. This incantation can be cast repeatedly. A gift from the young Ivliquella to his father, Radagon.
item:triple-rings-of-light.location:
**Loot:** Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
- Found in a treasure chest in a room locked by an Imp Statue located at the lower level near the Prayer Room Site of Grace.

stats.Effect: Fire three rings of light before the caster

item:troll-knight-s-sword.name: Troll Knight's Sword
item:troll-knight-s-sword.description: Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of the trolls in service to the royal family of Caria. Called into service when the Queen invoked an oath they swore, the trolls are treated as true knights of Caria, and fight arm in arm with their human comrades.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int D

item:troll-knight-s-sword.location: To get the Troll Knight's Sword in Elden Ring, you can get a guaranteed drop from Caria Manor or farm spectral troll knights in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:troll-s-golden-sword.name: Troll's Golden Sword
item:troll-s-golden-sword.description: Sword given to the giants who fought for the Erdtree during the War against the Giants long ago. Though the giants have lost their minds, they stay inseparable from their swords that are in sad shape—such that the gold plating had flaked away.
item:troll-s-golden-sword.location: To get the Troll's Golden Sword in Elden Ring, travel to the Altus Plateau, locate the enemy camp east of the Erdtree-Gazing Hill site of grace, and open the chest on the back of the carriage.

item:troll-s-hammer.name: Troll's Hammer
item:troll-s-hammer.description: Mining tool of stonedigger trolls used to crack bedrock.  Trolls are descended form the giants, and these were supposedly once used as ceremonial smithing tools. In the distance past, smithing was considered divine.

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Fai D

item:troll-s-hammer.location: To get the Troll's Hammer in Elden Ring, you need 2 Stonesword Keys and must travel to the Old Altus Tunnel in the Altus Plateau.

item:troll-s-roar.name: Troll's Roar
item:troll-s-roar.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Troll's Roar: Look into the distance and let out an intense roar, generating a powerful shockwave that blows back surrounding foes. Follow up with a strong attack to slam the armament down."Usable on large and colossal swords, axes, and hammers.
item:troll-s-roar.location:
**Location:** Flame Peak
- Found on top of a colossal skull south of the Church of Repose, at Flame Peak on the Mountaintops of the Giants. The top of the colossal giant skull can be reached via a nearby Spiritspring.

- Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:turtle-neck-meat.name: Turtle Neck Meat
item:turtle-neck-meat.description: A splendid, lengthy cut of turtle neck meat. Material used for crafting items. Turtle meat is said to boost virility, but none in the Lands Between seem to have much appetite for it these days. In Lands Between, the urge to reproduce has waned long ago.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:twiggy-cracked-tear.name: Twiggy Cracked Tear
item:twiggy-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Briefly stop rune loss on death in mixed physick

item:twiggy-cracked-tear.location:
Found at a sap collection basin at the foot of Capital Outskirts' Minor Erdtree.
It is guarded by a group of Death Serving Commoners and an Omen, and is found alongside the Right version of the Crimson Crystal Tear.

item:twinbird-kite-shield.name: Twinbird Kite Shield
item:twinbird-kite-shield.description: Shield featuring a vividly painted twinbird. The twinbird is said to be the envoy of an outer god, and mother of the Deathbirds. At dwindling levels of HP, this shield slightly boosts both attack and defense.
item:twinbird-kite-shield.location: Dropped by the Deathbird that you encounter at night north of the Leyndell, Royal Capital, northeast of the Hermit Merchant's shack in the Capital Outskirts.

item:twinblade.name: Twinblade
item:twinblade.description: A sword with blades on both sides of the hilt. This weapon is difficult to wield, and requires high dexterity. Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is enabled  with dual-handed spinning attacks.
item:twinblade.location: Head east from the Agheel Lake South or The First Step Site of Grace to the Dragon-Burnt Ruins in Limgrave.

item:twinblade-talisman.name: Twinblade Talisman
item:twinblade-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a twinblade and a confessor. Enhances the final hit ending a chain of attacks.

stats.Effect: Enhances final hit of chain attacks.

item:twinblade-talisman.location: - Obtained from a chest in Castle Morne, in southern Limgrave. From Behind the Castle, head down the cliff and northwest to the western corner of the castle. Climb a ladder and circle the top of this tower to find the chest.

item:twinned-armor.name: Twinned Armor (altered)
item:twinned-armor.description: Lighter version of the Twinned Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 14 · Strike 12 · Slash 15 · Pierce 12 · Magic 11 · Fire 11 · Lightning 9 · Holy 10

item:twinned-gauntlets.name: Twinned Gauntlets
item:twinned-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:twinned-gauntlets.location:
- The Twinned Gauntlets are dropped by D, Hunter of the Dead.
- Alternatively, they can be obtained by completing the questline of D, Hunter of the Dead and D, Beholder of Death.

item:twinned-greaves.name: Twinned Greaves
item:twinned-greaves.description: Greaves depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 7 · Slash 8 · Pierce 6 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:twinned-greaves.location: Dropped upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline.

item:twinned-helm.name: Twinned Helm
item:twinned-helm.description: Helm depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:twinned-helm.location: Dropped upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline.

item:twinned-knight-swords.name: Twinned Knight Swords
item:twinned-knight-swords.description: An attractive twinblade of fine make that prizes the chivalric way.  Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.
item:twinned-knight-swords.location: To get the Twinned Knight Swords in Elden Ring, head to East Windmill Pasture in the Altus Plateau, loot the corpse by the burning pile, and watch out for exploding enemies.

item:twinsage-glintstone-crown.name: Twinsage Glintstone Crown
item:twinsage-glintstone-crown.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy. Greatly increases intelligence to the detriment of HP and stamina. Scholars of the Twinsage Conspectus were the elites of the academy, permitted to study and excel in sorceries of all kinds.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:twinsage-glintstone-crown.location:
**Location**: Academy of Raya Lucaria
- The Twinsage Glintstone Crown is dropped by a Crystal Crab next to a wooden structure accessible via the rooftops of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

item:twinsage-sorcerer-ashes.name: Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes
item:twinsage-sorcerer-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Twinsage sorcerer.

stats.Effect: Summons Twinsage sorcerer spirit

item:twinsage-sorcerer-ashes.location:
**Location**: Black Knife Catacombs
- The Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes is dropped by the Cemetery Shade in Black Knife Catacombs.

item:two-fingers-heirloom.name: Two Fingers Heirloom
item:two-fingers-heirloom.description: A talisman engraved with the legend of the Two Fingers. Raises faith.

stats.Effect: Raises faith by 5.

item:two-fingers-heirloom.location:
**Location**: Purified Ruins
- The Two Fingers Heirloom is obtained from a chest in the cellar of the Purified Ruins, located just northeast of Stormveil Castle in southern Liurnia of the Lakes. The stairs to the cellar are covered by wooden planks, which must be rolled over to be broken.

item:two-headed-turtle-talisman.name: Two-Headed Turtle Talisman
item:two-headed-turtle-talisman.location: Waterfall cave under the Ensis bridge.

item:uchigatana.name: Uchigatana
item:uchigatana.description: A katana with a long single-edged curved blade.  A unique weapon wielded by the samurai from the Land of Reeds. The blade, with its undulating design, boasts extraordinary sharpness, and ts slash attacks cause blood loss.
item:uchigatana.location: To get the Uchigatana in Elden Ring, you can either start the game by choosing the Samurai class, or find it on a corpse inside the Deathtouched Catacombs in northern Limgrave.

item:unendurable-frenzy.name: Unendurable Frenzy
item:unendurable-frenzy.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers. Causes the yellow flame of frenzy to violently burst forth from the caster's eyes. Hold to continue channeling the flame. This incantation can be used while in motion. It is the maddening pain and unstoppable tears of those afflicted with the flame of frenzy brought into being.
item:unendurable-frenzy.location: Frenzied Flame incantation from the Frenzied Flame Village.

stats.Effect: Emits violent burst of yellow flame of frenzy from eyes.

item:unseen-blade.name: Unseen Blade
item:unseen-blade.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Enchants armament held in right hand, making it completely invisible. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Used by Sellian assassins to present themselves as unarmed sorcerers.
item:unseen-blade.location:
**Loot:** Altus Plateau
- Acquired from the treasure chest at the top of Mirage Rise.

stats.Effect: Makes right-hand armament completely invisible

item:unseen-form.name: Unseen Form
item:unseen-form.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Makes the caster semi-invisible. While on horseback, effect extends to cover the mount. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. The Sellian assassins considered every option that aided their dirty work.
item:unseen-form.location:
**Loot:** Altus Plateau
- Acquired from the treasure chest at the top of Mirage Rise.

stats.Effect: Makes the caster semi-invisible

item:unsheathe.name: Unsheathe
item:unsheathe.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Unsheathe: Skill of swordsmen from the Land of Reeds. Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance. Follow up with a normal or strong attack to perform a swift slash attack."Usable on katana.
item:unsheathe.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Limgrave
- Drops from a Scarab found in the water in the southeastern corner of Agheel Lake.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:uplifting-aromatic.name: Uplifting Aromatic
item:uplifting-aromatic.description: An of the perfumers who fought in the Shattering. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to raise the attack power of the user and nearby allies while also reducing the damage from one incoming attack by half. This aromatic has an extremely potent morale-raising effect that makes those accustomed to it fearless in the face of death. It was this influence that made the perfumers exceptional commanders.

stats.Effect: Boosts ally attack power and reduces incoming damage once.

item:upper-class-robe.name: Upper-class Robe
item:upper-class-robe.description: Embroidered, bright green robe worn by noble children. Donning such a robe is traditionally the child's first show of burgeoning independence.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 2 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:upper-class-robe.location:
- Bought from the Hermit Merchant in Altus Plateau.
- Found on a corpse on a balcony in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:urgent-heal.name: Urgent Heal
item:urgent-heal.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers faithful.
item:urgent-heal.location:
**Equipped:**
- Urgent Heal is a starting spell for the Confessor origin.

**Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
- Urgent Heal is sold for  1,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn.
- Should Corhyn die before purchasing this incantation from him, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.

stats.Effect: Heals a small amount of HP.

item:urumi.name: Urumi
item:urumi.description: This weapon made of extremely thin, flexible blades of metal is wielded like a whip by Nightfold warriors. Though in essence a whip with a cutting edge, it can also be used as a spear to pierce foes.
item:urumi.location: To get the Urumi whip in Elden Ring, head to Caria Manor in northwestern Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:vacuum-slice.name: Vacuum Slice
item:vacuum-slice.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Vacuum Slice: Lost skill of ancient heroes. Hold the armament aloft to surround it with a shearing vacuum, then launch it forwards as a blade-like projectile."Usable on swords and axes (small and colossal axes excepted).
item:vacuum-slice.location:
**Loot:** Deeproot Depths
- Found inside a partially sunken building near a mountainous wall, located northeast of the Deeproot Depths Site of Grace (or directly east of The Nameless Eternal City site of grace.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:vagabond-knight-armor.name: Vagabond Knight Armor
item:vagabond-knight-armor.description: Chest piece of a knight banished from their motherland.  Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 8 · Holy 8

item:vagabond-knight-armor.location:
- Starting gear for the Vagabond class.
- Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).

item:vagabond-knight-armor-altered.name: Vagabond Knight Armor (altered)
item:vagabond-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Vagabond Knight Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 10 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 9 · Fire 10 · Lightning 8 · Holy 8

item:vagabond-knight-armor-altered.location:
Starting gear for the Vagabond class (unaltered).

Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants)

Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

item:vagabond-knight-gauntlets.name: Vagabond Knight Gauntlets
item:vagabond-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of a knight banished form their motherland. Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey. Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant damage negation.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:vagabond-knight-gauntlets.location:
- The Vagabond Knight Gauntlets are the starting armwear of the Vagabond Origin.
- The Vagabond Knight Gauntlets can be purchased from the Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants) for  1,500 runes.

item:vagabond-knight-greaves.name: Vagabond Knight Greaves
item:vagabond-knight-greaves.description: Greaves of a knight banished from their motherland. Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:vagabond-knight-greaves.location:
Starting gear for the Vagabond class.
Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).

item:vagabond-knight-helm.name: Vagabond Knight Helm
item:vagabond-knight-helm.description: Helm of a knight banished from their motherland. Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:vagabond-knight-helm.location:
Starting gear for the Vagabond class.

Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).

item:valkyries-prosthesis.name: Valkyrie's Prosthesis
item:valkyries-prosthesis.description: Golden prosthesis once used by the one-armed valkyrie. A masterwork of craftsmanship, with practice and skill it can be used as proficiently as a real arm. When Maleigh Marais, Lord of the Shaded Castle, embraced this prosthesis, he claimed to feel the presence of his personal goddess.

stats.Effect: Golden prosthesis used by the one-armed Valkyrie

related: Millicent — cured at the Church of the Plague

item:varr-s-bouquet.name: Varré's Bouquet
item:varr-s-bouquet.description: A steel mace resembling a charming bouquet of roses. Each petal has a sharpened edge, leaving the roses perpetually colored with blood.  This weapon reflects White Mask Varré's manner of speech rather well, enticing in its splendor, but full of deadly consequence.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Arc C

item:varr-s-bouquet.location:
- Mohgwyn Palace (Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance)

**Drop**: Defeat White Mask Varré at the end of his questline.

item:varre-s-bouquet.name: Varre's Bouquet
item:varre-s-bouquet.location: To get Varré's Bouquet in Elden Ring, complete White Mask Varré's questline, travel to Mohgwyn Palace using the Pureblood Knight's Medal, find his red invasion sign near the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint Site of Grace, defeat him in his world, and exhaust his dying dialogue.

item:velvet-sword-of-st-trina.name: Velvet Sword of St. Trina

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int E

item:velvet-sword-of-st-trina.location: From the  Fissure Cross Site of Grace in Cerulean Coast, head north and drop down two stone platforms to a cliff lower down. Inside a Putrescent Rotmound-infested cave to the south is the sword, furthest in.

item:venomous-fang.name: Venomous Fang
item:venomous-fang.description: One of the weapons designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. The black fang protruding from the bronze snake head is coated in deadly poison.
item:venomous-fang.location: The Venomous Fang, a fist/claw weapon known for its unique "deadly poison" effect, is found in the Abandoned Cave in Caelid.

item:verdigris-greatshield.name: Verdigris Greatshield
item:verdigris-greatshield.location: Dropped by Moore upon his death, regardless of how he dies.

item:veteran-s-armor.name: Veteran's Armor
item:veteran-s-armor.description: Old armor that has seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol. Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master. This aging general could not die, nor did he have anywhere to fade away.

stats.Negation: Physical 18 · Strike 17 · Slash 18 · Pierce 17 · Magic 13 · Fire 14 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:veteran-s-armor.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Niall.

item:veteran-s-armor-altered.name: Veteran's Armor (altered)
item:veteran-s-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Veteran's Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 18 · Strike 16 · Slash 18 · Pierce 17 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:veteran-s-armor-altered.location: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Niall. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

item:veteran-s-gauntlets.name: Veteran's Gauntlets
item:veteran-s-gauntlets.description: Old gauntlets that has seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:veteran-s-gauntlets.location: - The Veteran's Gauntlets can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for  4,000 runes after defeating Commander Niall.

item:veteran-s-greaves.name: Veteran's Greaves
item:veteran-s-greaves.description: An old greaves that has seen many battles.Worn by Niall, the great veteran general of Sol.

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 9 · Slash 10 · Pierce 10 · Magic 7 · Fire 8 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:veteran-s-greaves.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Niall.

item:veteran-s-helm.name: Veteran's Helm
item:veteran-s-helm.description: An old helm that has seen many battles.Worn by Niall, the great veteran general of Sol.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:veteran-s-helm.location: - Purchased from Finger Reader Enia for  4,000 runes after defeating Commander Niall.

item:veteran-s-prosthesis.name: Veteran's Prosthesis
item:veteran-s-prosthesis.description: Bladed prosthetic leg enwreathed with the power of lightning, instead attached to the fist. Commander Niall, veteran of Castle Sol, offered this prosthesis in exchange for the lives of defeated knights held prisoner. He went on to lead these men as an army of no nation.
item:veteran-s-prosthesis.location: To get the Veteran's Prosthesis in Elden Ring, you must travel to Castle Sol, locate the boss arena, and defeat the boss, Commander Niall.

item:viridian-amber-medallion.name: Viridian Amber Medallion
item:viridian-amber-medallion.description: A medallion with viridian amber inlaid. Boosts maximum stamina. The Erdtree's old sap becomes amber, treasured as the most precious of jewels in the age of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. A primordial life energy resides inside

stats.Effect: Raises maximum stamina

item:viridian-amber-medallion.location: - Obtained by defeating Miranda Blossom in the Tombsward Cave, in western Weeping Peninsula, in southwestern Limgrave.

item:visage-shield.name: Visage Shield
item:visage-shield.description: Tricksome bronze shield depicting the face of a Fire Giant. Several tongues leap from its open mouth. The dreadful visage and burning flames are designed to remind one of the horror of facing a Fire Giant. In other words, this shield has an instructional function.
item:visage-shield.location: It can be found in northeast Caelid, in a chest after defeating the Pumpkin Head duo boss in the Caelem Ruins.

item:volcanic-stone.name: Volcanic Stone
item:volcanic-stone.description: A smoldering rock containing hot gas.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:vortex-of-putrescence.name: Vortex of Putrescence
item:vortex-of-putrescence.location: Trade the Remembrance of Putrescence with Finger Reader Enia.

item:vow-of-the-indomitable.name: Vow Of The Indomitable
item:vow-of-the-indomitable.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Vow of the Indomitable: Skill of the ancient warriors of the Erdtree. Hold shield aloft to imbue yourself with golden power, granting momentary invincibility."Usable on all shields.
item:vow-of-the-indomitable.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Liurnia of the Lakes
- Drops from a Scarab found in the middle of the swamp underneath the southwestern plateau, southeast of the Folly on the Lake Site of Grace or directly west of the Scenic Isle site of grace.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:vulgar-militia-armor.name: Vulgar Militia Armor
item:vulgar-militia-armor.description: Armor worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 10 · Slash 9 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 10 · Holy 10

item:vulgar-militia-armor.location: The Vulgar Militia Armor is a random drop (1.50%) from Vulgar Militia enemies encountered throughout the Lands Between.

item:vulgar-militia-ashes.name: Vulgar Militia Ashes
item:vulgar-militia-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three vulgar militiamen. Spirits of the vulgar militia who wield long-hafted, serrated hatchets. These brutal weapons are particularly effective at causing blood loss to opponents. In the Lands Between, the small were scorned, and so they formed their vulgar militia as a means to make a living, albeit in ignominy.

stats.Effect: Summons three vulgar Militia spirits

item:vulgar-militia-ashes.location: Found in the Auriza Hero's Grave. At the bottom of the hallway with the two chariots, drop down to the wooden beams below and head north to a room containing a statue. Go through the corridor behind the statue and to the right.

item:vulgar-militia-gauntlets.name: Vulgar Militia Gauntlets
item:vulgar-militia-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Str 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:vulgar-militia-gauntlets.location: - The Vulgar Militia Gauntlets have a 1.50% chance to drop from Vulgar Militia enemies encountered throughout the Lands Between.

item:vulgar-militia-greaves.name: Vulgar Militia Greaves
item:vulgar-militia-greaves.description: Greaves worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 6

item:vulgar-militia-greaves.location: The Vulgar Militia Greaves are a random drop (1.50%) from Vulgar Militia enemies encountered throughout the Lands Between.

item:vulgar-militia-helm.name: Vulgar Militia Helm
item:vulgar-militia-helm.description: Helm worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen. The upward extension serves to create an appearance of larger size, however slightly.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:vulgar-militia-helm.location: The Vulgar Militia Helm is a random drop (1.50%) from Vulgar Militia enemies encountered throughout the Lands Between.

item:vulgar-militia-saw.name: Vulgar Militia Saw
item:vulgar-militia-saw.description: A weapon comprised of a saw blade attached to a long grip. Brandished by the vulgar militia, its serrated edge is very effective at inflicting blood loss. The saw is said to also be used to cut up bodies to feed the militia, but there are no firsthand witnesses to confirm the dire rumor.
