item:vulgar-militia-saw.location: To get the Vulgar Militia Saw in Elden Ring, travel to the Bestial Sanctum or Farum Great Bridge Site of Grace in northern Caelid, and repeatedly defeat the nearby Vulgar Militiamen wielding this weapon until it drops.

item:vulgar-militia-shotel.name: Vulgar Militia Shotel
item:vulgar-militia-shotel.description: A hooked blade attached to a long handle. Wielded by the vulgar militia, its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. The vulgar militia are the undecorated stewards of rancid, scorched battlefields that none dare approach, and forbidden domains better forgotten by the rest of the world
item:vulgar-militia-shotel.location: To get the Vulgar Militia Shotel in Elden Ring, you must farm and defeat the Vulgar Militiamen enemies who wield this specific weapon.

item:vyke-s-dragonbolt.name: Vyke's Dragonbolt
item:vyke-s-dragonbolt.description: Incantation of Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold.
item:vyke-s-dragonbolt.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Mountaintops of the Giants
- Vyke's Dragonbolt is acquired from the defeat of Roundtable Knight Vyke in the Lord Contender's Evergaol.

stats.Effect: Enchants right-hand armament with lightning damage

item:vyke-s-war-spear.name: Vyke's War Spear
item:vyke-s-war-spear.description: War spear singed and blistered by fingers, used by Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable Hold. Like Vyke himself, it has been tormented by the yellow flame of frenzy from within.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Fai D

item:wakizashi.name: Wakizashi
item:wakizashi.description: Short sword with a tempering pattern on the blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds. Afflicts targets with blood loss. These swords are considered auxiliary weapons. Yet, one man is known to wield this weapon in his left hand while using a full-sized katana in his right. A demonic swordsman known only as Okina.
item:wakizashi.location: The Wakizashi is hidden inside Gaol Cave in southwestern Caelid.

item:wandering-noble-ashes.name: Wandering Noble Ashes
item:wandering-noble-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five wandering nobles.

stats.Effect: Summons five wandering noble spirits.

item:wandering-noble-ashes.location: Found on a corpse in Stormfoot Catacombs, in a dead-end room guarded by Imps.

item:war-cry.name: War Cry
item:war-cry.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"War Cry: Give a war cry to rally the spirit and increase attack power. While active, strong attacks change to charging attacks."Usable on melee armaments (daggers, thrusting swords, and whips excepted).
item:war-cry.location:
**Purchase:** Stormhill / Volcano Manor
- 1x Sold for 800 Runes from Bernahl at either the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill or the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor.
- Should Bernahl be killed before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Bernahl's Bell Bearing.

item:war-surgeon-gloves.name: War Surgeon Gloves
item:war-surgeon-gloves.description: Bloodstained white gloves of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers. Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood none were able to tame the accursed blood. None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:war-surgeon-gloves.location: - The War Surgeon Gloves are dropped by one of the Nameless White Mask invaders near the blood marsh in Mohgwyn Palace.

item:war-surgeon-gown.name: War Surgeon Gown
item:war-surgeon-gown.description: "Bloodstained white gown of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers. Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood none were able to tame the accursed blood. None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception."

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 7 · Slash 8 · Pierce 7 · Magic 9 · Fire 10 · Lightning 10 · Holy 10

item:war-surgeon-gown.location: Dropped by a Nameless White Mask invader at the blood river in Mohgwyn Palace.

item:war-surgeon-gown-altered.name: War Surgeon Gown (altered)
item:war-surgeon-gown-altered.description: Lighter version of the War Surgeon Gown.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 7 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 8 · Fire 9 · Lightning 10 · Holy 9

item:war-surgeon-gown-altered.location: Dropped by a Nameless White Mask invader at the blood river in Mohgwyn Palace. Then, alter with Boc.

item:war-surgeon-trousers.name: War Surgeon Trousers
item:war-surgeon-trousers.description: Bloodstained trousers of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers. Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood none were able to tame the accursed blood. None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 3 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 6 · Holy 5

item:war-surgeon-trousers.location: Dropped by Unnamed White Mask invader at the blood river of Mohgwyn Palace.

item:warhawk-ashes.name: Warhawk Ashes
item:warhawk-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a warhawk. Spirit of a Stormveil warhawk, the talons of which have been sliced off so that razor-fine swords could be grafted in their place. With its lord vanquished, and its wings wounded, the hawk perished as it solemnly gazed at its former home. The storm is a warhawk's cradle.

stats.Effect: Summons warhawk spirit

item:warhawk-ashes.location: Obtained in Weeping Peninsula, just north of the Church of Pilgrimage. This is the reward for finding the location depicted on the "Prophecy" Painting, and as such, the painting item must have already been obtained from the sideroom to the big courtyard near the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle.

item:warhawk-s-talon.name: Warhawk's Talon
item:warhawk-s-talon.description: Talon-swords are affixed to the legs of the Stormveil's warhawks, but this one has been repurposed for human use. The blade is thin and lightweight so as not to obstruct the hawk's mobility.
item:warhawk-s-talon.location: To get the Warhawk's Talon straight sword in Elden Ring, you must farm the Bladed Talon Eagle (Warhawk) enemies located inside Stormveil Castle.

item:warming-stone.name: Warming Stone
item:warming-stone.description: Ruin Fragment blessed with an incantation of the Two Fingers. Craftable item. Uses FP to generate warmth, continuously restoring the HP of those nearby. It's said that the Erdtree was once as warm as the gentle sun, and would gradually heal all who bathed in its rays.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to continuously heal nearby allies

item:warming-stone.location:
- Found in the tower to the south of Oridys's Rise (same one with the Great Turtle Shell). Reachable by using the spiritspring near the Nomadic Merchant, jumping towards the tower.
- Craftable (recipe obtained after finding Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [19] )

item:warped-axe.name: Warped Axe
item:warped-axe.description: Oversized double-headed axe with a bizarre, almost melted appearance. Brute strength is the only thing required to wield this weapon, which appears to have taken quite the beating itself.
item:warped-axe.location: The Warped Axe is a rare 4% drop from axe-wielding Omen enemies.

item:warpick.name: Warpick
item:warpick.description: Warhammer with a hard protruding beak. A pickaxe designed for combat, in essence. A simple but highly effective weapon, the weighty piercing attack casually rips through metal armor.
item:warpick.location: The Warpick in Elden Ring is a random drop obtained by defeating specific soldier enemies who wield the weapon, such as those near the Gatefront Ruins or Agheel Lake South in Limgrave.

item:warrior-gauntlets.name: Warrior Gauntlets
item:warrior-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of a nomadic warrior. Crafted from sturdy leather.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:warrior-gauntlets.location:
- The Warrior Gauntlets are the starting armwear of the Warrior Origin.
- The Warrior Gauntlets can be purchased from the Isolated Merchant (Academy of Raya Lucaria) for  1,000 runes.

item:warrior-greaves.name: Warrior Greaves
item:warrior-greaves.description: Greaves of a nomadic warrior. Crafted from sturdy leather.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 5 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 5

item:warrior-greaves.location:
Starting gear for the Warrior class.

Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Academy of Raya Lucaria).

item:warrior-jar-shard.name: Warrior Jar Shard
item:warrior-jar-shard.description: Shard of a shattered warrior jar.

stats.Effect: Boosts the attack power of skills.

item:warrior-jar-shard.location: - Obtained by killing Iron Fist Alexander, before completing his questline.

item:watchdog-s-greatsword.name: Watchdog's Greatsword
item:watchdog-s-greatsword.description: Stone greatsword wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs. Though decorated with the watchman's eye, the pupil was taken by graverobbers and is now hollow, leaving this sword a mere lump of stone.
item:watchdog-s-greatsword.location: To get the Watchdog's Greatsword in Elden Ring, you must farm sword-wielding Erdtree Burial Watchdogs located in late-game dungeons like the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave or the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs.

item:watchdog-s-staff.name: Watchdog's Staff
item:watchdog-s-staff.description: Large stone staff embedded with glintstone. Wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs who protect catacombs. The Watchdogs, battered and broken over their lengthy tenure, rule the catacombs and are even said to command the imps. Unique Skill: Sorcery of the Crozier Channel magic into the glintstone to activate an ancient sorcery, producing floating magic projectiles that chase enemies automatically.
item:watchdog-s-staff.location: To get the Watchdog's Staff in Elden Ring, travel to the Road's End Catacombs in Liurnia of the Lakes, head down two flights of stairs from the site of grace, and strike the illusory back wall.

item:watchful-spirit.name: Watchful Spirit
item:watchful-spirit.location:
**Loot:** Belurat, Tower Settlement
- Gained by speaking to the Hornsent Grandam twice while wearing the Divine Beast Head.
  - She can be found by exiting the room with the Small Private Altar Site of Grace and taking a left to walk across a thin bridge to find a locked door that requires the Storeroom Key on your left. She is on the right side of that room.
  - Must be done before defeating Messmer the Impaler.

item:waves-of-darkness.name: Waves Of Darkness
item:waves-of-darkness.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:"Waves of Darkness: Plunge armament into the ground to release three waves of darkness. Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike."Usable on greataxes, warhammers, and colossal weapons.
item:waves-of-darkness.location:
**Remembrance Item:**
- Trade the Remembrance of the Naturalborn with Finger Reader Enia, which can be obtained by defeating Astel, Naturalborn of the the Void.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:weathered-dagger.name: Weathered Dagger
item:weathered-dagger.description: Dagger received from Fia, the Deathbed Companion.

stats.Effect: Dagger received from Fia, Deathbed Companion

related: Forge of the Giants / burning the Erdtree

item:weathered-straight-sword.name: Weathered Straight Sword
item:weathered-straight-sword.description: Straight sword with a rather short but wide blade. Simple to wield, it was known as the sword of the people. Though the Erdtree styling is still visible, time has not been kind to this sword, now merely a shadow of its former self.
item:weathered-straight-sword.location: To get the Weathered Straight Sword in Elden Ring, you must farm Commoner enemies at Stormveil Castle or the Ailing Village until it drops.

item:whetstone-knife.name: Whetstone Knife
item:whetstone-knife.description: Whetstone with a cipher inscription, made to look like a small knifeblade.

stats.Effect: Can add new battle arts and affinities to weapons

item:whetstone-knife.location:
**Location**: Gatefront Ruins, Limgrave
- Found in a chest inside the underground cellar at Gatefront Ruins, alongside the Ash of War: Storm Stomp.

item:whip.name: Whip
item:whip.description: A leather whip. Not originally used for combat, but as an instrument of pain. Through its supple attacks cannot be thwarted by parrying or even guarding, it is incapable of dealing critical hits.
item:whip.location: The standard base Whip is the easiest to find early on.

item:whirl-o-flame.name: Whirl, O Flame!
item:whirl-o-flame.description: Superior Incantation of the Fire Monks.
item:whirl-o-flame.location:
**Loot:** Caelid
- Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in northern Caelid, between the Caelem Ruins and the Rotview Balcony sites of grace. The scarab is located right behind the black carriage containing the Greatsword.

stats.Effect: Sweeps area before caster with stream of fire

item:white-cipher-ring.name: White Cipher Ring
item:white-cipher-ring.description: Item for online play. Allows you to automatically request for a hunter from another world to come to your rescue when your world is invaded. (You may be unable to summon rescuers under certain circumstances). A lost mystic code, enchanted to take the form of a ring. One of the fetishes said to have been bestowed by the Two Fingers.

stats.Effect: When invaded, request the aid of a hunter.

item:white-cipher-ring.location:
**Location**: Roundtable Hold
- The White Cipher Ring can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for  1,000 runes.

item:white-mask.name: White Mask
item:white-mask.description: Bloodstained, faintly grinning mask. Worn by war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers. The Lord of Blood's curse enlivens the wearer when bloodletting occurs. Slightly raises attack power when there is blood loss nearby.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:white-mask.location: Dropped by the White Mask invaders at Mohgwyn Palace.

item:white-reed-armor.name: White Reed Armor
item:white-reed-armor.description: Armor of the White Reeds, fashioned from banded iron plates. Worn by the Inabam head disciples of the great swordsman Okina.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 10 · Slash 11 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 11 · Holy 10

item:white-reed-armor.location: Found on a corpse inside Spiritcaller Cave in Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:white-reed-gauntlets.name: White Reed Gauntlets
item:white-reed-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the White Reeds, fashioned from banded iron plates. Worn by the Inabam head disciples of the great swordsman Okina. The Inaba traveled in pursuit of not only the master who abandoned them, but also proper deaths, won honorably through hard-fought combat. To be a White Reed is to seek death; fitting for the Inaba, who desired nothingmore than to die by the sword.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:white-reed-gauntlets.location:
**Location**: Spiritcaller Cave
- The White Reed Gauntlets are found on a corpse in the Spiritcaller Cave in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:white-reed-greaves.name: White Reed Greaves
item:white-reed-greaves.description: Greaves of the White Reeds, fashioned from banded iron plates. Worn by the Inabam head disciples of the great swordsman Okina. The Inaba traveled in pursuit of not only the master who abandoned them, but also proper deaths, won honorably through hard-fought combat. To be a White Reed is to seek death; fitting for the Inaba, who desired nothingmore than to die by the sword.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 5 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 5

item:white-reed-greaves.location: Found on a corpse inside Spiritcaller Cave in Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:white-shadow-s-lure.name: White Shadow's Lure
item:white-shadow-s-lure.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:"White Shadow's Lure: Hold armament in a brief, silent prayer to create a white shadow. The apparition lures in foes of human build who are not in combat, drawing their aggression. Effective on demi-humans even if they are already in a combat state."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:white-shadow-s-lure.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Consecrated Snowfield
- Dropped by an invisible Scarab at the Consecrated Snowfield. North-west of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace, just north of the river. There will be a pack of wolves chasing it.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:wild-strikes.name: Wild Strikes
item:wild-strikes.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Wild strikes: Swing armaments with wild abandon. Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack."Usable on axes and hammers as well as curved swords and greatswords (colossal weapons excepted).
item:wild-strikes.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Stormhill
- Drops from a Scarab found on the road approaching the Castleward Tunnel Site of Grace northwest of Stormhill Shack and on the approach towards Stormveil Castle.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

item:windy-crystal-tear.name: Windy Crystal Tear
item:windy-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction increases the effectiveness of dodgerolls for a certain duration. However, damage taken is also increased during the concoction's effect.

stats.Effect: Enhances dodge rolls for a time in mixed physick

item:windy-crystal-tear.location: Looted from a bowl in southern Caelid, south of the highway.

item:wing-of-astel.name: Wing Of Astel
item:wing-of-astel.description: Sword fashioned from a delicate wing, suffused with the magic of the stars. Strong attack unleashes a wave of enchanted light. Crafted from a relic of the Naturalborn of the Void who is said to have assailed the Eternal City.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int D

item:wing-of-astel.location: The Wing of Astel is found in a chest atop a ruined structure in the Uhl Palace Ruins, located in the Ainsel River underground area.

item:winged-crystal-tear.name: Winged Crystal Tear
item:winged-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Temporarily reduces equip load in mixed physick

item:winged-crystal-tear.location:
Found at a sap collection basin on top of some cliffs west of Capital Outskirts' Minor Erdtree and east of Hermit Merchant's Shack.
It is guarded by a group of Skeletal Slugs along with an additional Deathbird at night.

item:winged-greathorn.name: Winged Greathorn
item:winged-greathorn.description: A unique horn in which the power of ancestral spirit fiercly dwells, this large, wing-shaped specimen is wielded as weapon of spirit worship.  In the ancestral spirit-woshipping faith, these are considered envoys' wings, made to reap the lives of beings which experience no sprouting.
item:winged-greathorn.location: Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor (Regal Ancestor Spirit)

item:winged-misbegotten-ashes.name: Winged Misbegotten Ashes
item:winged-misbegotten-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a winged misbegotten.

stats.Effect: Summons winged misbegotten spirit

item:winged-misbegotten-ashes.location: Unsightly Catacombs, on the bottom level of a hall with lots of dead Misbegotten on the ground around it.

item:winged-scythe.name: Winged Scythe
item:winged-scythe.description: Sacred scythe resembling a pair of white wings. Deals holy damage. According to pagan belief, white-winged maidens are said to be Death's gentle envoys.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Fai D

item:winged-scythe.location: To get the Winged Scythe, travel to the Tombsword Ruins in the Weeping Peninsula (south of Limgrave).

item:winged-spear.name: Winged Spear
item:winged-spear.description: A spear with winged ornamentation at the base of its head. A thrusting weapon with long reach that can be used to attack from behind a shield. It is also effective against mounted foes.

item:winged-sword-insignia.name: Winged Sword Insignia
item:winged-sword-insignia.description: A talisman depicting a raised prosthetic blade. An honor bestowed upon the knights who fought alongside Malenia the Severed.

stats.Effect: Raises attack power with successive attacks

item:winged-sword-insignia.location: Reward for helping Millicent at Dominula.

item:witch-s-glintstone-crown.name: Witch's Glintstone Crown
item:witch-s-glintstone-crown.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 3 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: **Patches** is an NPC and boss in Elden Ring. He surrenders if you reduce his HP to 50% or less. From then on, he acts as a merchant and gives helpful advice to players.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Patches is a Tarnished who leads a group of bandits, operating out of Murkwater Cave in Limgrave. He is a nomadic and free-spirited individual with a proclivity for tricking people and robbing them of their possessions. If the Tarnished opens the treasure chest in Murkwater Cave, Patches accosts them with accusations of theft. After a brief fight, Patches surrenders and offers his services as a merchant. He reveals that the bandits he leads are former foot soldiers from a defeated army. Later, Patches moves to Liurnia of the Lakes, setting up camp on the Scenic Isle.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Patches is a reoccurring character in From Software's games, having appeared in *Armored Core: For Answer*, *Demon's Souls*, *Dark Souls*, *Bloodborne*, and *Dark Souls III*. Many of his recognisable traits, such as his physical appearance, use of a spear, and proclivity for tricking the player have been retained for his appearance in *Elden Ring*. - Patches can be summoned during the boss fight against Starscourge Radahn, however he will return to his world after a few seconds.

mechanic:affinities.name: Weapon affinities
mechanic:affinities.description: An affinity changes a weapon’s damage type and scaling: Heavy favours Strength, Keen favours Dexterity, Quality uses both, and Magic and Cold add Intelligence. Fire and Flame Art add fire with Strength and Faith scaling respectively, Lightning is Dexterity, and Sacred is Faith. Blood, Poison and Occult scale with Arcane.

mechanic:ashes-of-war.name: Ashes of War
mechanic:ashes-of-war.location: A total of **15** Lost Ashes of War can be obtained per playthrough. **Purchased:** - x1 sold by the Isolated Merchant (Weeping Peninsula) in his shack in the Weeping Peninsula. - x1 sold by the Isolated Merchant (Liurnia of the Lakes) south of the Main Academy Gate Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes. - x2 sold by the Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow) at the top of the mountain in northwestern Dragonbarrow. - x1 sold by the Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River) at the Uhl Palace Ruins. - x1 sold by the Imprisoned Merchant in Mohgwyn Palace.

mechanic:attack-rating.name: Attack rating (AR)
mechanic:attack-rating.description: Attack rating, or AR, is the total damage number a weapon shows across every damage type it deals, after the character’s stats are applied through scaling. Buffs, enemy negation and status buildup are not part of the displayed AR. The number the game shows is the summed damage types floored, matching the AR calculator the app uses.

mechanic:buff-stacking.name: Buff stacking
mechanic:buff-stacking.description: Buffs fall into categories such as aura, body, weapon and shield, and two buffs from the same category overwrite each other. Golden Vow is an aura and Flame, Grant Me Strength is a body buff, so they stack with each other and with a weapon grease. The Wondrous Physick supplies another independent layer.

mechanic:critical-hits.name: Backstabs, ripostes & critical hits
mechanic:critical-hits.description: A critical hit multiplies your weapon’s attack rating rather than adding a flat amount. Backstabs land from directly behind an unaware or outmanoeuvred enemy, while ripostes follow a successful parry or a stance break. The Misericorde is the classic critical weapon because of its very high critical modifier.

mechanic:damage-types.name: Damage types
mechanic:damage-types.description: Physical damage splits into standard, strike, slash and pierce, and enemies resist each differently. Elemental damage comes as magic, fire, lightning and holy, and a weapon can carry a physical component plus one or more elements. The type matters more than the number against a boss with a lopsided negation.

mechanic:defense-negation.name: Defense & negation
mechanic:defense-negation.description: Defense is the flat number that shaves damage off every hit, while negation is the percentage that reduces what is left. Physical defense comes mostly from your stats and armour, and elemental negation comes from armour and talismans. Because the two apply in sequence, stacking a matching negation talisman can blunt a boss’s signature element.

mechanic:equip-load.name: Equip load classes
mechanic:equip-load.description: Your equipped weight as a share of maximum equip load decides your roll. Under thirty percent you light roll with the most distance, from thirty to seventy you medium roll, and above seventy you heavy roll with a long recovery. Going over one hundred percent overloads you and slows movement to a crawl.

mechanic:guard-boost.name: Blocking & guard boost
mechanic:guard-boost.description: Blocking an attack absorbs part of its damage and drains stamina based on your shield’s guard boost. A higher guard boost means less stamina lost per blocked hit, which lets you hold the line and set up guard counters. Greatshields and the Greatshield Talisman push guard boost highest.

mechanic:hyperarmor.name: Hyperarmor
mechanic:hyperarmor.description: Hyperarmor is temporary immunity to being staggered during specific attack animations. It is granted by the move itself, not by your poise, so a colossal swing can power through a hit that would interrupt a lighter weapon. Your poise still decides whether damage that lands outside those frames staggers you.

mechanic:jump-attacks.name: Jump attacks
mechanic:jump-attacks.description: A jumping heavy attack leaps in, hits hard, does solid stance damage and has a short recovery. It is the safest way to punish a boss because you are already moving out of range as the swing ends. The Claw Talisman boosts jump attack damage and the Raptor’s Black Feathers add another jump-attack bonus.

mechanic:larval-tears.name: Rebirth & Larval Tears
mechanic:larval-tears.description: After defeating Rennala you can ask her to rebirth your character, redistributing every level you have spent. Each rebirth costs one Larval Tear, which are found through the world and bought from a few merchants. Your level total and collected gear do not change, only where the points sit.

mechanic:map-fragments.name: Map fragments
mechanic:map-fragments.description: Each region’s map is blank until you collect its Map Fragment from a stele marked on the map edge. Until then you can still travel and explore, but you have no map of the area. Collecting the fragment reveals the terrain, graces and many markers for that region.

mechanic:matchmaking.name: Co-op & PvP matchmaking
mechanic:matchmaking.description: Summon range is decided by both your rune level and the highest-upgraded weapon you have ever held. That weapon memory means a low-level character who picked up a late-game weapon can only be matched with tougher players. A password overrides both limits and downscales the stronger player to the host.

mechanic:memory-slots.name: Memory slots & Memory Stones
mechanic:memory-slots.location: A total of 8 Memory Stones can be acquired: - **Purchased** - Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 3,000 Runes. - **Found in chests at the top of rises** - Oridys's Rise in the Weeping Peninsula (solve the three tortoise puzzle). - Testu's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes (solve the three tortoise puzzle). - Lenne's Rise in northeastern Caelid (access via Torrent's wind draft jump to the balcony). - Converted Tower in Liurnia (perform the Erudition gesture in front of the statue; requires an Academy Glintstone Key given to Thops at the Church of Irith).

mechanic:ng-plus.name: NG+ scaling
mechanic:ng-plus.description: Starting Journey 2 keeps your level, gear, items and most graces but makes every enemy tougher and worth more runes. The difficulty climbs each cycle up to Journey 7, after which it stops rising. Some quest items and key items are reset, so re-earn anything a quest needs.

mechanic:parry.name: Parrying
mechanic:parry.description: A parry deflects an incoming attack during a short window and leaves the attacker open to a riposte. Small shields and the Parry Ash of War have the widest timing, while medium shields and weapons parry poorly or not at all. Some attacks, including many grabs and colossal swings, cannot be parried.

mechanic:point-of-no-return.name: Point of no return
mechanic:point-of-no-return.description: Resting at the Forge of the Giants and burning the Erdtree permanently changes the world. Leyndell becomes the Ashen Capital, several quest lines close and some items can no longer be obtained. The app warns before this and other gates so you can finish what matters first.

mechanic:poise.name: Poise
mechanic:poise.description: Poise is the hidden stat that decides whether an incoming hit interrupts your attack or cast. Every hit drains poise by that attack’s poise damage; reaching zero staggers you and briefly opens you up. Poise refills on its own after roughly thirty seconds without being hit.

mechanic:powerstance.name: Powerstancing
mechanic:powerstance.description: Equipping two weapons of the same class, one in each hand, unlocks paired attacks that swing both at once. The L1 chain and the jumping L1 hit with both weapons, stacking status buildup and stance damage in a single swing. It costs more stamina than a normal attack line.

mechanic:revered-spirit-ash.name: Revered Spirit Ash
mechanic:revered-spirit-ash.description: Revered Spirit Ashes raise the Revered Spirit Ash Blessing, which strengthens your summoned spirits in the Realm of Shadow. It is a separate track from the Scadutree Blessing and only affects summons, not you. It runs to level ten with twenty-five ashes.

mechanic:rune-arc.name: Rune Arc
mechanic:rune-arc.location: **Rune Arcs can be earned by completing online objectives**: - All summoned Furled Fingers gain one Rune Arc upon when the area Boss is defeated, regardless of contribution. - All present Invaders (Bloody Fingers and Recusants) gain one Rune Arc when the Host of Fingers dies, regardless of circumstances. - All present Hunters gain one Rune Arc whenever an Invader dies, regardless of circumstances. **Enemy Drops**: - Rats and Giant Rats have a 1.00% chance of dropping x1 Rune Arc.

mechanic:rune-loss.name: Rune loss & recovery
mechanic:rune-loss.description: When you die you drop all carried runes at the spot where you fell. Return and touch them to recover the lot; die again before that and the first drop is gone for good. A Sacrificial Twig in your inventory prevents the loss once.

mechanic:scadutree-blessing.name: Scadutree Blessing
mechanic:scadutree-blessing.location:
**Location**: Realm of Shadow
- The About the Scadutree Blessing is added to the inventory upon collecting a Scadutree Fragment for the first time.

mechanic:scaling-letters.name: Scaling letters
mechanic:scaling-letters.description: The letter beside a stat on a weapon shows how strongly its AR grows from that stat, running E, D, C, B, A, S from weakest to strongest. The grade is a band of the weapon’s stored scaling coefficient, so S adds far more per point than E. Upgrading a weapon usually raises these coefficients, which is why a weapon can climb a letter as it is reinforced.

mechanic:sites-of-grace.name: Sites of Grace
mechanic:sites-of-grace.location:
**Location**: Site of Grace
- **About Fast Travel to Sites of Grace** is automatically acquired upon resting at a Site of Grace for the first time.

mechanic:soft-cap-endurance.name: Endurance soft caps
mechanic:soft-cap-endurance.description: Endurance raises stamina as well as maximum equip load. Stamina gains are largely done past thirty and effectively stop at fifty, but the equip-load curve keeps climbing all the way to ninety-nine. That is why a heavy build may keep investing long after a light one stops.

mechanic:soft-cap-mind.name: Mind soft caps
mechanic:soft-cap-mind.description: Mind raises your FP pool and therefore how many spells, Ashes of War and summons you can chain before drinking. The FP gains slow down after forty and nearly stop after sixty. Casters usually stop at forty early and push toward sixty later.

mechanic:soft-cap-offensive.name: Offensive stat soft caps
mechanic:soft-cap-offensive.description: Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Faith and Arcane all scale weapon and spell damage through breakpoints around twenty, sixty and eighty. Points before twenty are the most efficient, the stretch to sixty is the main investment, and gains past eighty are small. Matching the weapon’s own scaling letters is what makes a point pay off.

mechanic:soft-cap-vigor.name: Vigor soft caps
mechanic:soft-cap-vigor.description: Vigor is the stat that buys you mistakes, and it is the first one most builds should push. Its HP gains fall off sharply after forty, then again after sixty, so points spent past the second cap return very little. Sixty Vigor is a common endgame target for a comfortable health pool.

mechanic:sorcery.name: Sorceries
mechanic:sorcery.description: Sorceries are cast with a staff and scale with Intelligence, with a few exceptions that dip into other stats. They cost FP and are gated by the staff’s stats and upgrade level as well as your own. Glintstone magic is the core family, with frost and gravity branches.

mechanic:spirit-ashes.name: Spirit Ashes
mechanic:spirit-ashes.location:
**Location**: Caelid Colosseum
- The **About Combat with Spirit Ashes** is automatically acquired upon interacting with Marika's Effigy inside the Caelid Colosseum for the first time.

mechanic:stamina.name: Stamina
mechanic:stamina.description: Stamina is spent on attacks, rolls, running, jumping and blocking. It regenerates after a short delay and the rate is raised by the Green Turtle Talisman and similar effects. Running out mid-swing usually means eating the next hit, so manage the bar rather than mashing.

mechanic:stance-break.name: Stance break
mechanic:stance-break.location:
**Location**: Cave of Knowledge
- **About Stance-Breaking** is automatically acquired toward the end of the Cave of Knowledge.

mechanic:stat-requirements.name: Stat requirements
mechanic:stat-requirements.description: Each armament and catalyst lists minimum Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Faith and Arcane. Failing a requirement cuts your damage sharply and can make the weapon bounce off enemies, even though you can still swing it. Two-handing lowers the Strength requirement you need to meet.

mechanic:status-bleed.name: Blood loss (bleed)
mechanic:status-bleed.description: Blood loss drains a percentage of the target’s maximum HP plus a flat amount when the bar fills. It scales with Arcane on most blood-affinity weapons and is the fastest way to delete a high-health boss. Because resistance rises after each proc, bleed builds pair best with rapid multi-hit attacks.

mechanic:status-buildup.name: Status buildup & resistance
mechanic:status-buildup.description: Status effects fill a hidden bar as hits land, and the effect triggers when the bar fills. After it triggers the bar empties and your resistance to that status rises, so the same effect takes longer the next time. Buildup also decays gradually while you are not being hit.

mechanic:status-death-blight.name: Death blight
mechanic:status-death-blight.description: Death blight kills the target outright when the bar fills, with no saving throw. It is rare from the player side and mostly appears on certain enemies and in PvP. Its bar decays quickly, so it must be applied in a burst.

mechanic:status-frostbite.name: Frostbite
mechanic:status-frostbite.description: Frostbite deals burst damage and temporarily lowers the target’s absorption, so follow-up hits land harder. It can trigger again after a cooldown, and cold affinity weapons also keep a physical component. Fire damage removes the frost debuff early, so avoid mixing the two.

mechanic:status-madness.name: Madness
mechanic:status-madness.description: Madness damages both HP and FP and staggers the victim when it triggers. It only affects humanoid, Tarnished-descended enemies, so it does nothing to most beasts and monsters. In PvP it is one of the strongest burst windows in the game.

mechanic:status-poison.name: Poison
mechanic:status-poison.location:
**Guaranteed Drop:** Caelid
- Drops from the Night's Cavalry patrolling the southern highway in Caelid at night, northeast of the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

mechanic:status-scarlet-rot.name: Scarlet rot
mechanic:status-scarlet-rot.description: Scarlet rot is a stronger damage-over-time than poison and is the signature tool of Caelid and the Haligtree. A rot proc ticks for a large share of health over a short window, which makes it ideal against bosses with huge health pools. Boluses and Preserving Boluses cure it.

mechanic:status-sleep.name: Sleep
mechanic:status-sleep.location:
- About Dense Fog of Sleep is unobtainable through normal gameplay.
- It was presumably obtained upon acquiring St. Trina's Crystal Ball.

mechanic:stealth.name: Stealth
mechanic:stealth.description: Crouching lowers the noise you make and the distance at which enemies notice you, and tall grass hides you completely. From behind, an unaware enemy can be backstabbed or simply walked past. The Crepus’s Vial and similar talismans improve stealth further.

mechanic:summoning-pools.name: Summoning pools
mechanic:summoning-pools.location:
**Location**: Summoning Pools

mechanic:torrent.location:

mechanic:two-handing.name: Two-handing
mechanic:two-handing.description: Holding a weapon in both hands multiplies your effective Strength by one and a half, rounded down. That raises both the Strength scaling of the weapon and your effective Strength for meeting its requirement, letting a lower-Strength build wield heavy armaments. It does not change Dexterity, Intelligence, Faith or Arcane.

mechanic:upgrades.name: Upgrades & smithing
mechanic:upgrades.description: Regular armaments upgrade to plus twenty-five with Smithing Stones and somber armaments to plus ten with Somber Smithing Stones. The final step of either track needs an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone from a late-game or optional boss. Spirit Ashes upgrade the same way with Grave Glovewort and Great Grave Glovewort.

mechanic:weapon-scaling.name: Weapon scaling
mechanic:weapon-scaling.description: Every weapon scales its attack rating with one or more stats, shown as a letter grade from E up to S. Levelling the stats the weapon actually uses, and upgrading the weapon, raises that contribution. A weapon with high base damage and poor scaling wants minimum stats, while an S-scaling weapon rewards heavy investment.
